jobs.title: Warehouse job: order picker in day shift
jobs.description:
Are you already familiar with orderpicking and logistics? And are you looking for a stable and physically engaging role with job security? And do you like great hours to get a good work-life balance? Then this is an excellent opportunity for you!

For a large and growing logistics in Oostkamp specialised in frozen goods, we're looking for an orderpicker to join the day shift team in the freezer warehouse. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an orderpicker, you play a crucial part in the company’s logistical process. You work in the freezer every day to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

  • Making orders based on order lists
  • Preparing completed orders for shipment
  • Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks

You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

  • Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
  • Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
  • Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

jobs.title: Horecamanager
jobs.description:
Een reusachtig winkelparadijs waar beleving, interieur en ontspanning samenkomen. Hier kom je terecht in een gedreven familiebedrijf dat blijft vernieuwen. Trots op een ruim aanbod, kwaliteit en een unieke sfeer waar klanten graag terugkomen voor een complete uitstap.


Jobomschrijving

3 redenen om voor deze job te kiezen

  • Geen avondwerk en 1 op 4 weekends vrij
  • Groei door naar eindverantwoordelijke
  • Mooie combi van bureauwerk en actie


Zo ziet je job er uit

Als horecaverantwoordelijke in Vichte stuur je het horecaconcept aan en werk je actief mee op de vloer.

  • Je maakt de weekplanning op voor het vaste personeel en de jobstudenten.
  • Je plaatst de dagelijkse en wekelijkse bestellingen bij leveranciers en volgt de voorraad op.
  • Je begeleidt en coacht het team op de werkvloer tijdens de drukke servicemomenten.
  • Je leidt nieuwe medewerkers en studenten op zodat de kwaliteit en snelheid geborgd blijven.
  • Je schakelt mee in de bediening en achter de toog tijdens piekmomenten.
  • Je waakt over de hygiënestandaarden, netheid en de algemene administratie van de zaak.

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

Voor de functie van zaalverantwoordelijke in Vichte zoeken we een hands-on aanpakker met leiderschapspotentieel.

  • Je hebt een eerste ervaring in de horeca of retail op zak en wil graag doorgroeien.
  • Je bent administratief stipt en kan vlot overweg met planningen en voorraadbeheer.
  • Je weet hoe je een team enthousiast krijgt en studenten op een fijne manier coacht.
  • Je bent bereid om in het weekend te werken, maar waardeert een vaste regelmaat.
De ideale collega is...

Iemand met goesting om bij te leren en de handen uit de mouwen te steken. Geen zweverige leidinggevende, maar iemand die vooropgaat in de strijd. Je straalt energie uit, behoudt het overzicht als het druk wordt en heeft de ambitie om op termijn de zaak zelfstandig te runnen.

jobs.title: Beton Laborant te Zele (M/V/X)
jobs.description:
Bij Adfil ontwikkelen en produceren we macro synthetische vezels die beton versterken. Onze hoogwaardige vezels worden wereldwijd gebruikt in meer dan 60 landen en in een breed scala aan toepassingen, waaronder betonnen vloeren en bestrating, tunnelbouw, prefabbeton, maritieme toepassingen, landbouw, etc.

Als Beton Laborant werk je, samen met je collega's van R&D, aan projecten om de technologie en kwaliteit van vezelversterkt beton te verbeteren, vanuit ons eigen innovatief betonlabo te Zele:

  • je voert R&D- en kwaliteitscontroles uit voor mortel en beton
  • je organiseert verse, mechanische en duurzaamheidstesten
  • je doet voorbereiding van apparatuur en stalen voor analyse
  • je werkt effectief samen met het R&D-team
  • je neemt actief deel aan vergaderingen
  • je geeft feedback over uitgevoerde projecten

Algemene vereisten:

  • je hebt basiskennis van betontechnologie
  • ervaring met kwaliteitscontrole voor mortel en beton is een plus
  • je wil actief deelnemen aan R&D-projecten
  • je werkt vlot samen in team en staat open voor feedback
  • je neemt jouw verantwoordelijkheid en toont graag initiatief
  • communicatieve vaardigheden in Engels en Nederlands

Persoonsgebonden competenties:

  • Betrouwbaarheid
  • Communiceren
  • Zorgvuldigheid
  • Analyseren
  • Initiatief
  • Samenwerken

Job gerelateerde competenties:

  • Analyses uitvoeren
  • Apparatuur en stalen voorbereiden voor de analyse
  • Gegevens registreren
  • De samenstelling van een product aanpassen

Pluspunt indien kennis van:

  • Analysetechnieken

jobs.title: Verpleegkundige PAZA
jobs.description:
In het UZ Gent kom je terecht in een innovatieve omgeving die oog heeft voor je talent en je uitdaagt om te groeien. Dankzij het engagement van alle collega's voor patiënten, opleidingen en wetenschappelijk onderzoek, is het UZ Gent een baken van zorg. Denk Zorg kunnen we pas ten volle realiseren als we voldoende oog hebben voor het welzijn van onszelf, onze collega's en een gezonde organisatiecultuur.
Maak jij binnenkort mee het verschil?

Elk operatiekwartier heeft een ‘post-anesthesiezorgen afdeling', soms ook ontwaakruimte of ‘recovery' genoemd. Hier verblijft de patiënt ter observatie in de eerste post-operatieve fase alvorens de gezondheidstoestand van de patiënt stabiel genoeg is om naar de verpleegeenheid terug te keren.

  • Je staat in voor de technische en acute zorg voor patiënten met zeer diverse pathologie (d.w.z. alle heelkundige disciplines, behalve cardiochirurgie).
  • Je observeert en volgt nauwlettend de pre- en postoperatieve patiënt op.
  • Je reageert adequaat op acute, levensbedreigende situaties.
  • Je hebt inzicht in de vereiste controleparameters gelinkt aan de diversiteit van ingrepen.

Momenteel heeft het UZ Gent onderstaande openstaande vacatures.
- 1 contract onbepaalde duur (100%).

Daarnaast leggen we ook steeds een wervingsreserve aan.

Gewenst profiel

  • Je hebt een bachelordiploma verpleegkunde.
  • Je handelt respectvol. Je waardeert en erkent anderen. Je gaat constructief en vriendelijk met hen om.
  • Je handelt integer. Je bent je bewust van je eigen waarden en normen en handelt consequent, eerlijk, betrouwbaar en transparant.
  • Je handelt verantwoordelijk en in overeenstemming met de doelstellingen, belangen, waarden, normen en geldende afspraken van de organisatie.
  • Je speelt in op de (zorg)behoeften en noden van je patiënten en hun omgeving. Je hebt oog voor je eigen welzijn en dat van collega's.
  • Je draagt bij aan een positieve werksfeer waar voortdurend leren, ontwikkelen en samenwerken op de voorgrond staan.
  • Je staat open voor vernieuwing en groeit mee met verandering. Je werkt actief mee aan de verbetering van kwaliteit, omgeving, processen en producten.
  • Je blijft efficiënt functioneren in situaties met hoge complexiteit, tijds- of werkdruk, ook bij tegenslag, teleurstelling of kritiek.
  • Je bepaalt effectief doelen en prioriteiten, plant de nodige acties en gebruikt efficiënt tijd en middelen.
  • Je communiceert helder en gestructureerd, afgestemd op de doelgroep en de situatie. Je neemt informatie op, stelt vragen en gaat in op (non-)verbale reacties.

jobs.title: HR Specialist Personeelsbeheer
jobs.description:
ZAS, De drijvende kracht voor gezondheidszorg in beweging. Drijf je mee?

Wil jij mee het verschil maken voor onze medewerkers? Als HR Specialist Personeelsbeheer combineer je personeelsadministratie, payroll en HR-advies. Met jouw nauwkeurigheid en klantgerichte aanpak zorg je ervoor dat medewerkers steeds op jou kunnen rekenen.

WAT?

  • Contract onbepaalde duur
  • ZAS Vincentius (2018, Antwerpen)
  • 38 uur/week (100%)

OVER DE JOB

  • Personeelsbeheer van A tot Z – Je volgt medewerkers op van indiensttreding tot uitdiensttreding en zorgt voor een correcte personeelsadministratie.
  • Payroll – Je verwerkt en controleert personeelsgegevens zodat medewerkers tijdig en correct worden uitbetaald.
  • HR-advies – Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor vragen over loon, loopbaan, sociale wetgeving en het arbeidsreglement en biedt gericht advies.
  • Sociale documenten – Je zorgt voor correcte arbeidsovereenkomsten en andere sociale documenten.
  • Samenwerken & verbeteren – Je werkt nauw samen met de HR Business Partner, signaleert aandachtspunten en denkt mee over oplossingen en verbeteringen.
  • Digitale HR-administratie – Je verwerkt personeelsgegevens vlot en nauwkeurig in verschillende HR- en computersystemen.

OVER JOU

  • Opleiding & ervaring – Je hebt een bachelor Maatschappelijk Assistent, optie personeelswerk, en/of relevante ervaring in personeelsbeheer.
  • Payrollkennis – Je bent vertrouwd met payrollsystemen, zoals e-Blox, X-tend en SAP.
  • Sociale wetgeving – Je hebt een goede kennis van sociale en arbeidswetgeving en houdt die actief bij.
  • Administratief sterk – Je werkt nauwkeurig en efficiënt en houdt moeiteloos overzicht over verschillende dossiers.
  • Analytisch & oplossingsgericht – Je analyseert administratieve vraagstukken snel en komt met doeltreffende oplossingen.
  • Klantgericht – Je helpt medewerkers graag verder en communiceert duidelijk, professioneel en klantvriendelijk.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Vous êtes à la recherche d'un job d'Account Manager à Leuven ? Vous souhaitez développer des relations clients durables en Wallonie et apporter des solutions concrètes dans un environnement technique ? Alors postulez maintenant !

En tant qu'Account Manager, vous aurez les tâches suivantes :

  • Vous gérez et développez un portefeuille de clients en Wallonie et entretenez une relation commerciale de proximité.
  • Vous identifiez les besoins de vos clients, les conseillez et recherchez avec eux les solutions techniques les plus adaptées.
  • Vous assurez le suivi des opportunités commerciales et contribuez activement à l'atteinte des objectifs de vente.
  • Vous collaborez étroitement avec le Sales Manager, l'équipe commerciale interne et les différents départements afin d'assurer un service qualitatif.

Voici le profil d'Account Manager que nous recherchons :

  • Vous disposez d'une première experience commerciale concluante en environnement technique.
  • Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français et possédez une bonne connaissance du néerlandais et de l'anglais.
  • Vous avez une affinité avec les produits et environnements techniques.
  • Vous êtes à l'aise avec la suite Office, notamment Excel et PowerPoint, ainsi qu'avec les outils digitaux.
  • Vous êtes communicatif, orienté client, persévérant et appréciez autant le travail en équipe que l'atteinte de résultats commerciaux.

jobs.title: Flexi housekeeping bij Hotel Vé
jobs.description:
Word jij één van onze Védettes?

Welkom bij Hotel Vé!

Hotel Vé is een warm en eigenzinnig 4-sterren designhotel in hartje Mechelen. Achter onze deuren vind je karaktervolle kamers, wellness, gezelligheid én vooral een team dat ervoor zorgt dat onze gasten zich écht thuis voelen.

Om ons housekeepingteam te versterken, zijn we op zoek naar een flexi-medewerker housekeeping.

Wat ga je doen?

Als medewerker housekeeping zorg jij ervoor dat onze gasten binnenkomen in een kamer die tot in de puntjes verzorgd is.

Je taken bestaan onder andere uit:

  • hotelkamers en badkamers schoonmaken en klaarmaken voor nieuwe gasten
  • bedden opmaken en handdoeken & amenities aanvullen
  • zorgen voor een nette en verzorgde uitstraling van de kamers en publieke ruimtes
  • kleine details controleren die het verschil maken voor onze gasten
  • samenwerken met je collega's van housekeeping en de receptie

Wanneer?

We zoeken iemand die op regelmatige basis kan helpen, vooral:

  • weekends, feestdagen en/of vakanties

De uren zijn voornamelijk overdag, zodat deze job ook perfect te combineren is met studies of een andere job.

Ben je als flexi op zoek naar een leuke, afwisselende bijverdienste? Dan leren we je graag kennen!

Wie zoeken we?

We zoeken vooral iemand die:

  • graag de handen uit de mouwen steekt
  • oog heeft voor detail en hygiëne
  • zelfstandig kan werken, maar ook graag deel uitmaakt van een team
  • betrouwbaar en stipt is
  • een positieve en collegiale ingesteldheid heeft
  • graag zorgt dat anderen zich goed voelen

Ervaring in housekeeping is mooi meegenomen, maar zeker geen must. Een goede werkmentaliteit en zin om erin te vliegen vinden we minstens even belangrijk!

jobs.title: Opvoeder in dagcentrum
jobs.description:
VZW Tandem biedt opvang voor volwassenen met een mentale beperking in Diepenbeek. Momenteel vangt Tandem 80 personen voltijds of deeltijds op. Dit gebeurt zowel in dag- als woonondersteuning.

In de dagondersteuning werken gebruikers samen in groepen van ongeveer 7 personen. We zijn op zoek naar versterking voor ons team van de dagondersteuning. In deze werking bieden we allerhande activiteiten aan, zowel ambachtelijke als sportactiviteiten. Als begeleider sta je in voor de invulling van deze activiteiten en het betrekken van de gebruikers bij de uitvoerende taken. Je biedt ondersteuning aan de gebruikers zowel op persoonsgericht als lichamelijk vlak. Je levert een actieve bijdrage aan de communicatie, informatiedoorstroming en samenwerking op niveau van het team.

Het is de taak van de begeleiders om een zinvolle dagbesteding aan te bieden aan de gebruikers.

Je hebt een goede persoonlijke en spontane omgang met personen met een handicap. Je bent vlot en ruimdenkend. Je straalt vertrouwen uit en bent goed in het organiseren. Je bent een teamspeler maar eveneens resultaatgericht. Je beschikt over goede communicatieve vaardigheden om te overleggen met collega’s en gebruikers en je bezit veel verantwoordelijkheidszin. Je bent vlot met je handen en je kan verschillende activiteiten aanbieden. Je bent goed en zedelijk en kan hier een attest van voorleggen. Je bent flexibel in je handelingen en leergierig ingesteld. Je hebt een rijbewijs.

jobs.title: Verpleegkundige Neurologie endocrinologie en inwendig dagziekenhuis 6B
jobs.description:
ZAS, De drijvende kracht voor gezondheidszorg in beweging. Drijf je mee?

Als verpleegkundige op afdeling 6B maak je elke dag het verschil voor patiënten met neurologische, endocrinologische en interne aandoeningen. Met jouw deskundigheid, betrokkenheid en warme zorg op maat begeleid je hen tijdens hun zorgtraject. Samen met een hecht multidisciplinair team zet je in op kwaliteit, vertrouwen en mensgerichte zorg.

WAT?

  • Contract onbepaalde duur
  • ZAS Middelheim (2020, Antwerpen)
  • 38 uur/week (100%), overig regime is bespreekbaar
  • Je bent bereid om in een gevarieerd shiftensysteem te werken, zowel overdag als ‘s nachts en in weekends.

OVER DE JOB

  • Zorg op maat – Je biedt deskundige en planmatige zorg aan patiënten met neurologische, endocrinologische en interne aandoeningen, afgestemd op hun lichamelijke en psychosociale noden.
  • Veelzijdige verpleegkundige zorg – Je voert verpleegkundige handelingen uit in opdracht van de arts en werkt volgens de geldende kwaliteits- en veiligheidsnormen.
  • Continuïteit verzekerd – Je zorgt voor een vlotte overdracht en een correcte registratie in het verpleegkundig dossier.
  • Samen sterk – Je werkt nauw samen met artsen en collega's om elke patiënt de best mogelijke zorg te bieden.
  • Kwaliteit voorop – Je draagt actief bij aan kwaliteitsverbetering, patiënteneducatie en gezondheidsvoorlichting.
  • Een veelzijdige rol – Je ondersteunt de dagelijkse werking van de afdeling, begeleidt stagiairs en neemt indien nodig bijkomende verantwoordelijkheden op.

OVER JOU

  • De juiste basis – Je hebt een bachelor of HBO5 Verpleegkunde en beschikt over een geldig visum van de FOD Volksgezondheid.
  • Leergierig en gemotiveerd – Ervaring in neurologie, endocrinologie of interne geneeskunde is een plus, maar jouw motivatie is minstens even belangrijk.
  • Klinisch sterk – Je schat zorgbehoeften correct in en plant, verleent en evalueert zorg op een deskundige manier.
  • Een echte teamspeler – Je werkt graag multidisciplinair samen en communiceert helder met patiënten, collega's en artsen.
  • Zelfstandig en nauwkeurig – Je neemt initiatief, werkt ordelijk en houdt kwaliteit en patiëntveiligheid steeds voor ogen.
  • Stressbestendig – Je behoudt het overzicht in een dynamische werkomgeving en speelt flexibel in op veranderende zorgnoden.

jobs.title: Financial Controller | €6.500 + wagen | Regio Ieper
jobs.description:
Voor een internationale organisatie binnen de voedings- en landbouwsector zijn we op zoek naar een Financial Controller / Senior FP&A Analyst die financiële data weet te vertalen naar heldere inzichten en concrete aanbevelingen voor de business.

Je komt terecht in het Europese Financial Planning & Analysis-team en ondersteunt de financiële planning, rapportering en besluitvorming voor verschillende businessactiviteiten. Je werkt nauw samen met accounting, operations en andere stakeholders en krijgt een brede rol waarin reporting, budgettering, forecasting, cashflow en financiële analyses samenkomen.







Jouw takenpakket

  • Je stelt maandelijkse financiële rapporteringen op en analyseert onder andere P&L, balans, SG&A-kosten, KPI's en rendabiliteit per business unit.
  • Je ondersteunt management en business stakeholders met duidelijke financiële inzichten en analyses.
  • Je helpt bij de voorbereiding en opvolging van het jaarlijkse budgetproces.
  • Je ondersteunt de kwartaalforecast en maandelijkse forecastcycli binnen Sales & Operations Planning.
  • Je werkt nauw samen met verschillende afdelingen om budgetten en financiële prognoses correct op te bouwen.
  • Je stelt wekelijkse cashflowprognoses op voor de food operations.
  • Je werkt samen met accounting en operations om een correcte en tijdige managementrapportering te garanderen.
  • Je ondersteunt projecten met financiële analyses, modellen en businesscases.
  • Je denkt actief mee over procesverbetering, rapporteringsoptimalisatie en datagedreven finance.












Jouw profiel

  • Je beschikt over een Master in Finance, Accounting, Economie of een gelijkaardige richting.
  • Je hebt minstens 5 jaar relevante ervaring binnen finance, accounting, FP&A of controlling.
  • Je bent analytisch sterk en werkt nauwkeurig.
  • Je kunt financiële data vertalen naar duidelijke inzichten en concrete acties.
  • Je hebt een sterke kennis van Excel, inclusief formules, draaitabellen en grafieken.
  • Ervaring met Power BI, SAP of andere reporting tools is een sterke plus.
  • Je werkt gestructureerd en weet deadlines goed te bewaken.
  • Je communiceert helder en werkt vlot samen met verschillende stakeholders.
  • Je bent leergierig en neemt nieuwe systemen en processen snel op.
  • Je voelt je thuis in een internationale en dynamische omgeving.

jobs.title: Anläggare

Anläggare sökes – Heltid & Deltid (Stockholmsområdet)

jobs.title: Vil du hjelpe menneske med helseutfordringar vidare mot arbeid og utdanning?
jobs.description:
I Nav Nordhordland møter du engasjerte fagfolk som trur på at arbeid kan vere ein viktig veg til meistring, inkludering og betre livskvalitet. Kvar dag arbeider vi for at fleire menneske skal få moglegheit til å delta i arbeidslivet og samfunnet.

No søkjer vi ein rådgjevar som ønskjer å gjere ein forskjell for menneske som treng støtte på vegen mot arbeid og utdanning.

Om stillinga
Som rådgjevar hos oss arbeider du med arbeidsretta oppfølging av personar som har helseutfordringar. Du følgjer opp brukarar både digitalt og fysisk, jobbar systematisk mot arbeid eller utdanning og samarbeider tett med arbeidsgivarar, helseaktørar og andre samarbeidspartnarar. Stillinga inneber også saksbehandling etter relevant lovverk. Stillinga har ansvar for oppfølging av brukarar i heile regionen. Primær arbeidsstad er Nav Alver i Knarvik, men det må også påreknast arbeidsdagar ved Nav Fensfjorden og Nav Osterøy.

Kvifor jobbe hos oss?
Nav Alver er eit utviklingsorientert kontor med 80 medarbeidarar i fire fagavdelingar. Hos oss møter du engasjerte kollegaer som deler kompetanse, samarbeider tett på tvers av fagområde og er opptekne av å finne gode løysingar for innbyggjarane våre. Lokala våre i Knarvik senter er lyse og trivelege, og legg til rette for ein variert arbeidskvardag i møte med menneske med ulike behov og bakgrunnar.


Kva skal du jobbe med?
  • følgje opp og avklare brukarar gjennom digitale og fysiske møter
  • kartleggje ressursar, moglegheiter og behov knytt til arbeid og utdanning
  • motivere og støtte brukarane på vegen mot arbeid og/eller utdanning
  • dialog og samarbeid med arbeidsgivarar, helseaktørar og andre samarbeidspartnarar
  • saksbehandling i tråd med gjeldande lovverk
Kva kompetanse er viktig i denne rolla?

Du må ha

  • fullført utdanning på minimum bachelornivå, til dømes innan helsefag, sosialfag eller juridiske fag. Relevant erfaring og/eller utdanning kan kompensere for utdanningskravet.
  • erfaring med rettleiing og motivasjonsarbeid
  • erfaring med saksbehandling etter lovverk
  • god skriftleg og munnleg framstillingsevne på norsk
  • god digital kompetanse og erfaring med digitale arbeidsverktøy
  • god forståing for Nav sitt samfunnsoppdrag

Det er ein fordel om du har

  • erfaring frå oppfølgingsarbeid, arbeidsretta oppfølging eller liknande
  • kjennskap til arbeidsmarknaden og samarbeid med arbeidsgivarar
Kva vi ser etter hos deg?
  • skapar tillit i møte med menneske i ulike livssituasjonar
  • handterer krevjande situasjonar på ein profesjonell måte
  • arbeider strukturert, tek sjølvstendige vurderingar og prioriterer oppgåver
  • er endringsvillig og bidreg aktivt til samarbeid og fagleg utvikling

jobs.title: Undervisningsstilling
jobs.description:
Vil du være en av oss på Tåsen skole?

Vi trenger lærere i vikariater til høsten. Vi ønsker oss lærere som kan jobbe fra 1.-7.trinn. Det er fint om du har erfaring fra småskoletrinnet, helst erfaring som kontaktlærer, men ingen krav. Om du har kompetanse på engelsk er det ønskelig, du vil ha noe engelsk i planen neste skoleår. Vi har ca.650 elever på skolen med fire paralleller.   

På Tåsen skole jobber vi for at alle elever skal oppleve et trygt og godt skolemiljø både faglig og sosialt. Elevene skal lære å være fleksible og robuste. De skal øve seg på å se nytten av fellesskapet for å nå sitt potensiale gjennom samarbeid, kreativitet og samhandling. Elevene skal lære, mestre og trives og skal rustes til å bli gode samfunnsborgere. Skolen har marka i gangavstand og mange fine alternative læringsarenaer. 

Vi jobber med periodeplanene våre i tråd med LK20 med fokus på dybdelæring, samarbeidslæring og videreutvikler vår praksis i tråd med overordnet del. Læringen skal være mer tilpasset, kreativ og elevene skal delta aktivt i egen læring. Alle elever har eget læringsbrett som skal være ekstra verktøy for å støtte læringen.
Vi er opptatt av grunnleggende ferdigheter og tidlig innsats, både faglig og sosialt. Aktivitetsskolen og Fritidsklubben (5.-7.trinn) gjennomfører aktiviteter som støtter læringen.

Tåsen skole har godt kvalifiserte lærere og barneveiledere som bidrar til elevenes faglige og sosiale utvikling. Vi har også et mestringsteam bestående av gode spesialpedagoger, PP-rådgiver og helsesykepleiere som også er en del av laget rundt elevene sammen med ledelsen. Alt dette får du være en del av hos oss på Tåsen.   


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Du sørger for et trygt, godt og inkluderende læringsmiljø

  • Du har interesse for, og erfaring med, digitale læringsverktøy for å fremme elevenes læring

jobs.title: Post-Market Surveillance (Complaints) Specialist
jobs.description:
Vision RT is a fast-growing MedTech company transforming radiation therapy for cancer patients by helping make it more accurate, effective, and comfortable. The company is the inventor of, and a market leader in, Surface Guided Radiation Therapy (SGRT). This technology uses advanced 3D cameras to track surface data, providing enhanced guidance across every step of the radiotherapy workflow.
 
Our systems are used in over 3,000 clinics worldwide, including in 29 of the top 30 Best Hospitals for Cancer (source: US News and World Report 2026 rankings).
 
The company is recognized as one of Britain’s fastest-growing private tech companies, as featured in the 2025 Sunday Times 100 Tech list. Vision RT is also a recipient of the 2026 King’s Award for Enterprise, our fifth in 10 years. It is the UK’s most prestigious accolade for business excellence.
 
Company video
 
With around 400+ employees globally and offices in the UK, Poland, and the USA, Vision RT operates independently as part of the Danish company William Demant Invest A/S, one of the world’s largest investors in healthcare companies. Employees benefit from the security and reach of being part of a large global enterprise, combined with the agility and innovation of a startup.
 
Vision RT is a company with strong values, a clear mission, and a bright future. It is an exciting and rewarding organization in which to work.
 

About the role

The Post-Market Surveillance (Complaints) team is backfilling a position after a successful career development. The primary role of the successful applicant will be investigating support tickets, with root-cause analysis as the goal, and regulatory report writing as the end result. It suits someone with a history of investigation, an enquiring mind, and a desire to expand their knowledge within the non-clinical side of Surface Guided Radiation Therapy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in the review and classification of complaints against applicable regulations and company procedures to determine reportability.
  • Under supervision, work with internal and external stakeholders to investigate complaints, determine the root cause and close or escalate for further action as appropriate.
  • Liaise with the Product Risk Management Team and other internal teams to complete initial risk assessments.
  • Assist in supporting internal and external audits by Vision RT’s notified body and other third parties.
  • Work collaboratively with other teams within the Quality & Regulatory Compliance department and other areas, particularly Production, R&D and Service.
  • Once trained, act as an internal auditor to ISO 13485, MDSAP and the EU MDR.
  • Other duties as may be reasonably required.
  • This role requires occasional UK and international travel.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Strong administration skills and attention to detail.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively, and ability to prioritise and plan tasks.
  • Competent in Microsoft Office products.
  • Fluent in written and spoken English

Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Advanced MS Excel skills (e.g. VLOOKUP, Pivot Table analysis).
  • Demonstrates understanding of navigating medical device regulations and regulatory guidance for regulatory submissions in MDSAP markets and/or the EU.
  • Qualified internal auditor with experience of performing internal and/or supplier audits to ISO 13485, MDSAP requirements, the EU MDR and/or ISO 9001.
  • 2 years’ experience with Trend Analysis.
Vision RT is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and development without regard to race, colour, religion, sexual orientation, gender, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Head of Finance (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

In this role you own all of finance at Superchat end to end and report directly to the founders. When the board or our investors have a question about the numbers, you're the one who answers it.
You'll take over our financial model and turn it into something the whole company can steer by. You'll own accounting through to the P&L, run forecasting and liquidity planning, and lead the annual audit.

Who We Want

7+ years of finance experience.
You know the full cycle first-hand, from closing to forecast to board reporting.

Closing and audit expertise.
You independently own monthly and annual closings under HGB, including revenue recognition and accruals, and you coordinate the annual audit with our external auditors through to completed financial statements.

Expert financial modelling.
You build driver-based, integrated three-statement models from scratch and you document them so that others can operate them too.

Forecasting.
You've owned full budget and forecast cycles, you bring together top-down targets and bottom-up input from team leads, and you treat forecast accuracy as a measurable figure that has to improve.

Business partner.
You deliver a reasoned recommendation, not just the numbers and you follow up on whether it gets implemented.

Experience with investors and the board.
You've prepared and presented board materials, and you've been through a financial due diligence - ideally on the company side.
Bridges finance and startup culture. You bring the rigour a finance function demands, while working productively with fast decisions and shifting priorities.

Appetite for automation.
You actively look for ways to take manual work out of the close and the reporting cycle, so the team's time goes into analysis rather than assembly.

Strong communicator.
You translate complex financial data into clear narratives for stakeholders without a finance background, and you're confident in the room with founders, board and investors. Fluent German and English, written and verbal.

Who We Don't Want

Manages the status quo.
You run an inherited function competently, but you don't develop it further.

Reports instead of advising.
You deliver numbers without drawing a recommendation from them, and consider the job done once the report is sent.

Treats the model as personal property.
You build something only you can operate with undocumented logic and manual overrides nobody else can follow. Uncomfortable in front of investors.

Looking for predictability.
You need stable priorities and permanently fixed responsibilities.

Your Day To Day

Financial Model & Steering (~30%)

  • You own and maintain our driver-based financial model documented, operable by others, and reconciled to actuals every month
  • You own forecasting, budgeting, liquidity and runway planning, and the management of cash conversion
  • You own headcount planning together with the founders, People and team leads
  • You evaluate business cases for new products, markets and pricing models, and act as a sparring partner to the founders on strategic decisions

Accounting, Tax & Audit (~30%)

  • You own bookkeeping and monthly, quarterly and annual closings under HGB, with clean revenue recognition and accruals
  • You coordinate the annual audit with our external auditors end to end, through to completed financial statements
  • You manage the relationship with our tax advisors and ensure tax obligations are met
  • You own AR, AP and payment processes, and a cost centre structure that scales with the company

KPIs & Business Partnering (~20%)

  • You define and monitor the metrics each team steers by - engagement, conversion, retention - as inputs to the model rather than a separate reporting exercise
  • You sit in the business reviews, translate numbers into concrete recommendations, and follow up on execution
  • You deliver month-end variance analysis and management reporting as a clear, action-oriented narrative rather than a data dump
  • You analyse revenue, margin and cost development at customer, product and channel level

Funding & Investor Relations (~20%)

  • You build and continuously maintain our data room so we're due-diligence-ready at any time
  • You lead the financial due diligence on our side and support the next funding round end to end
  • You own investor reporting and communication on a monthly and quarterly cadence, as well as the board reporting packages
  • You maintain relationships with investors, banks and financing partners

Stakeholders

Founders & Leadership Team: your most important counterpart day-to-day, from annual planning to ongoing prioritisation and the most consequential financial decisions

Team Leads across Sales, Marketing, Product & Customer Success: for KPI definition, budget ownership and business reviews

Board & Investors: for monthly and quarterly reporting, board meetings and funding rounds

External Partners: tax advisors, auditors, banks and financing partners

Benefits & Culture

  • Choose between an Urban Sports Club/John Reed membership or a public transport/Dance subscription
  • Regular company and team events
  • Annual personal development budget of €500 for conferences, courses, books, career coaching, and more
  • An inclusive and exciting startup culture that enables fast professional and personal growth
  • Beautiful office in the heart of Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) with free snacks, drinks, and top-notch equipment

We want to build a community, not just a company.

It’s important to us to create an environment where people genuinely enjoy spending time together - whether that’s through HYROX training, golfing, beer pong tournaments, running clubs, Warhammer, weekend activities, or whatever kind of community you’d like to help build here!

We're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the description. At Superchat, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously.

Relocating to Berlin? We support you with practical relocation help. You'll feel home in no time.

We look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Senior Product Data Analyst - Consumer Growth
jobs.description:
About the team

SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way.

As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates into sustainable commercial growth. This includes understanding our acquisition funnel, improving activation and conversion, increasing customer value, and reducing churn.

We're looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Designers and Engineers, alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and connect product performance to business outcomes.

You'll help answer questions such as:

  • Which acquisition channels and customer segments generate the strongest long-term value?
  • Where do customers drop out of the journey from acquisition to activation?
  • What drives repeat usage, retention and churn?
  • Which product changes improve conversion, customer value or commercial performance?
  • How should we prioritise product investments across markets and customer segments?

If you're motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence both product decisions and commercial outcomes, this role is for you.

What you'll do

  • Analyse customer behaviour and product performance across the full consumer lifecycle — from acquisition and activation through engagement, retention, churn and reactivation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve conversion, customer value and sustainable growth using funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analytics.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers and Data teams to ensure decisions are grounded in robust analysis, customer insight and commercial understanding.
  • Evaluate the performance of customer segments, markets, channels and product journeys, helping the team understand where growth opportunities and commercial trade-offs exist.
  • Support decisions that improve key business outcomes, such as activation, conversion, repeat usage, retention, churn, customer lifetime value and revenue-related metrics.
  • Conduct exploratory analysis to answer product and business questions, translating complex data into clear, commercially relevant recommendations.
  • Define, monitor and communicate core SumUp Consumer KPIs, covering acquisition, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, churn and customer value.
  • Design, execute and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer impact and commercial impact.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that stakeholders actively use, proactively surfacing trends, anomalies, performance risks and growth opportunities.
  • Help Product Managers assess the expected impact of opportunities and evaluate whether product investments are delivering the intended customer and business outcomes.
  • Partner with Analytics Engineering to ensure KPI definitions, business logic and product instrumentation are accurate, scalable and trusted.
  • Bring a curious eye to AI and machine learning techniques, including LLM-assisted analysis, to speed up insight generation, customer understanding and product measurement.

You'll be great for this role if…

  • You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable querying, analysing and validating data in a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery or similar.
  • You have hands-on experience with product analytics techniques such as funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analysis.
  • You understand the commercial drivers of a digital product, including customer acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, churn and customer lifetime value.
  • You can connect customer behaviour and product performance to business outcomes, and use data to identify growth opportunities and inform prioritisation.
  • You've worked on A/B tests or product experiments, with a solid grounding in the statistics behind them.
  • You're proficient in a visualisation tool such as Looker, Tableau or Power BI, with a track record of building dashboards that stakeholders actually use.
  • You can translate ambiguous product or business questions into structured analysis, and explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
  • You're comfortable assessing trade-offs, challenging assumptions and making recommendations based on evidence.
  • You're curious about how AI and emerging techniques can improve product measurement, experimentation, customer understanding and commercial decision-making.
  • You're comfortable managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders, with strong prioritisation and a proactive communication style.

This role does not support Visa sponsorship and candidates must have the right to work in the UK.

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our central London Bridge location, wrapped in historic charm and modern flair. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave, plus bank holidays and special leaves

We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way.

jobs.title: Golang Backend Engineer, Financial Product Fraud
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person.

We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform.

This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch.

We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one.

This role will be based in London, UK as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin.

What you'll do:

  • Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers.
  • Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout.
  • Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times.
  • Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer.
  • Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter.
  • Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decisions as we establish the fraud infrastructure baseline for financial products, with support from senior engineers on the team.
  • Write well-tested, observable code and help the team hold a high quality bar. In fraud, a silent failure is a loss event.

Our expectations:

  • 3 to 6 years of professional software engineering experience, including backend services you have shipped and owned in production.
  • 1+ years of production experience in Golang, or strong experience in another backend language and real enthusiasm for picking Go up quickly.
  • A working understanding of low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems. Real-time decisioning comes with a latency budget, and you are keen to learn to build inside one.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, and some exposure to event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar).
  • Willingness to operate what you build, including a share of on-call, with a pragmatic approach to reliability.
  • Uses AI tooling in day-to-day development and can critically evaluate its output for correctness and quality.

Nice to have

  • Experience in fraud, risk, payments, lending, or financial crime, especially money movement fraud, bank account linking fraud, payout abuse, or lending fraud.
  • Experience with rules engines, real-time feature stores, or ML model serving in a decisioning path.
  • Background in Kotlin, Java, Python, or Node.js alongside Go.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP).
  • Experience working across multiple brands, regions, or regulatory regimes.

What we value

  • A product-oriented mindset. You think beyond the ticket, understand the "why" behind the work, and take a high level of responsibility for outcomes rather than output.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. This is a new team on a new surface; parts of the charter are still being drawn, and you will help draw them.
  • A track record of owning a project or feature end to end, especially in fast-paced environments.
  • Clear and proactive communication, with a collaborative spirit. We work across three companies and several time zones, so we move fast, but we succeed together.
  • An adversarial instinct. The best fraud engineers enjoy thinking like the attacker.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

We’re looking for a sales leader who wants to build, lead and win in a fast growing startup that’s changing how legal research is done. You’ll take ownership of our DACH sales team, help us move upmarket and play a key role in shaping the next stage of Pandektes’ growth.

About Pandektes

Our mission is to rebuild legal research from the ground up. Lawyers still lose countless hours to fragmented sources, outdated systems, and databases that fight them at every turn. We're building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world to make that friction disappear.

We're a team of 45+ based in our Copenhagen HQ, Zurich, London, and Hamburg. We’re a small team with high trust and flat structure. We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

We have raised more than €4M, including a €2.9M seed round (Feb 2025) led by People Ventures, Interface Capital, and a strong bench of angels. We already serve 450+ customers across Europe and we’re just getting started.

About the role

As our Head of DACH Sales, you’ll lead our sales team across Germany, Austria and Switzerland and take ownership of growing one of our key markets.

You’ll manage and develop a team of Account Executives working across a wide range of customers and deal sizes. A big part of the role will be helping the team move further upmarket and win larger, more complex customers. You’ll stay close to the team and the deals, coaching regularly, joining important customer conversations and helping your AEs progress and close opportunities.

 

We’re still building, so there’s plenty of opportunity to shape how we sell. You’ll help us improve the way we work, build a more predictable pipeline and develop a sales team that can grow with the business.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and develop our DACH Account Executive team

  • Coach the team through regular 1:1s, call reviews and deal reviews

  • Own team targets, pipeline and forecasting across the DACH market

  • Help the team win larger and more complex customers as we continue to move upmarket

  • Get involved in key deals and support the team with customer meetings, objections, negotiations and closing

  • Help Account Executives improve their discovery, pitching and ability to work with multiple stakeholders

  • Make sure we have a healthy pipeline and a clear view of where revenue is coming from

  • Look at where deals are progressing, where they are getting stuck and what we can do differently

  • Work closely with Marketing, Customer Success and the wider commercial team to improve how we find and win customers across our global target market

  • Improve our sales processes and playbooks as the team grows

  • Hire and onboard new Account Executives as we continue to build the DACH team

The experience you bring

  • Experience leading a B2B SaaS sales team, ideally with Account Executives selling into the DACH market

  • A strong sales background and a track record of delivering against team revenue targets

  • Experience working across different deal sizes, including larger opportunities with longer sales cycles and multiple decision makers

  • Experience helping a team move upmarket and win larger customers

  • You enjoy coaching and know how to help salespeople improve rather than simply telling them what to do

  • You’re comfortable getting involved in deals and working alongside your team when needed

  • You understand what good pipeline management and forecasting looks like

  • You’re confident using CRM data to understand performance and where the team needs support

  • You’re comfortable joining a growing company where processes are still being built and improved

  • You’re able to balance hitting the number today with building a stronger sales team for the future

  • Professional fluency in German and English

How we work

We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We believe that ownership is what brings us the best teams – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

What we offer

You’ll join at a point where there’s still a lot to shape. We offer competitive pay and equity so you can share in the success you help create.

You’ll have your own Pleo card for the tools and work expenses you need, plus 25 vacation days a year, public holidays, pension and paid parental leave when your family grows.

We have offices in Copenhagen, London and Hamburg. This role will be based in Germany with some travels to our offices to meet the team.

We also make time to get together away from our usual work - you can expect social events, opportunity to travel to our different locations to visit the teams, and offsites - our last team trip was to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you along for the next one.

jobs.title: Network Operation Engineer
jobs.description:
Network Operations Engineer

1. About the role

Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure into a single layer and give ISPs, hyperscalers, and AI companies a clean path to deliver connectivity into every home and business across Kenya and the continent. Behind that marketplace is a real network: a BGP edge peering with Tier 1 transit, hyperscalers, and local exchanges, an MPLS backbone, aggregation and access gear, and the systems that watch all of it.

For the partners who run on us, the network is the product, and the NOC is where they feel it. A clean shift is a partner who never knew anything happened. That is the bar.

We are early and the team is small, so we cannot afford a pair of hands that only knows how to escalate. We need a capable network engineer who can stand a shift, resolve real faults without waking anyone, and then keep building the network while East Africa sleeps: propagation and peering checks, health passes across the estate, config changes through to merge, tickets off the board, automation that takes the next repetitive job off everyone's plate. The watching is the floor of this role, not the ceiling.

The NOC you would be joining is not a legacy one. We are building it as an AI assisted operations environment from the ground up. The forwarding plane runs on open source routing and forwarding software, every device configuration lives in Git, and an LLM layer sits on top of the live network state. When something moves, that layer reads the telemetry, correlates it against the topology and the config history, and puts a probable cause and a candidate fix in front of the engineer on shift. The point is not to replace your judgment. It is to collapse the time between an alert firing and you knowing where to look, so mean time to repair is measured in minutes.

You sit inside that system. You use it, you push back on it when it is wrong, and what you catch that it misses is part of how it gets smarter. As we build automation out across the NOC, you are not just a consumer of the tooling. You help write it.

2. What you'll do

Watch, and know what you're looking at. Sit on our monitoring stack (Zabbix and Grafana dashboards, flow telemetry, alerting) and actually read it. Learn what normal looks like so abnormal jumps out at you: a BGP session that dropped, a link that went down, latency climbing on a path, a capacity threshold breached, a partner suddenly pushing or pulling nothing.

Troubleshoot and resolve. This is where you earn your seat. Confirm the alert is real, gather the facts, and localise the fault: one peer or many, us or upstream, a real outage or a monitoring blip. The assistive layer surfaces a likely diagnosis and a suggested fix, the config history is right there in Git, and the runbooks are live. Your job is to read all of it critically, decide what is actually true, and close out what you can on your own. Every ticket you resolve yourself is one our senior people did not get pulled out of deep work, or out of bed, to deal with.

Keep the network healthy, not just alive. A quiet shift is not an idle one. Run the proactive passes: check that routes are propagating the way they should, that RPKI and filter chains are doing their job, that peering and transit sessions are clean across the edge, that no PoP is drifting toward a capacity wall. Catch the slow degradations that never trip an alert. The day team should inherit a network in a known good state.

Build and automate. The repetitive parts of this job should not stay repetitive. Write the scripts that turn a manual check into a scheduled one. Push our config automation forward (Jinja driven generation, NAPALM or NETCONF/gNMI against the devices) so changes ship from data, not from memory. When the assistive layer keeps missing the same thing, that is a candidate for automation, and you are well placed to build it during the hours nobody else is online.

Move the work forward. You are part of the network team, working the same board they do. Pick up tickets from the Linear queue, take config changes through review to merge, and keep our source of truth (Nautobot) accurate as the estate changes. Real work lands while East Africa is offline, so the team wakes up further ahead than they went to bed.

Report exactly what is happening. For everything you cannot or should not fix alone, the handoff has to be clean: what is wrong, where, since when, what is affected, whether it is getting worse, and what you have already tried. No guessing dressed up as fact. No "the internet is down." A clear, written incident note a senior engineer can act on the moment they open it, and a tidy handover to the East Africa team at the end of your shift.

Escalate well. Know the ladder cold: what you are cleared to touch, what you must not touch alone, and who to bring in for what. Escalating early on a genuine outage is good judgment. Sitting silently on a problem because you were unsure is the one thing that gets people out of bed angry. Handle what you can, raise the rest fast and clearly, and do not turn either dial too far.

3. Who we're looking for

A network engineer who can stand on their own through a shift, and who treats the quiet hours as time to build rather than time to wait. You will not be the most senior engineer on this team, and you do not need to be. The people you escalate to are CCIE level. What we need from you is independence and range: work a problem properly, resolve a fair share of it yourself, and use what is left of the shift to actually move the network forward. Pair that with clear reporting, sound judgment about when to bring in help, and the instinct to question a machine's suggestion rather than follow it blindly, and you are who we are looking for.

Must-have

  • Strong networking competence, held in your hands rather than on paper. CCNA and well beyond it. You understand TCP/IP, routing and switching, IP addressing and subnetting, DNS, DHCP, NAT, and how they behave when they go wrong.

  • Real troubleshooting instinct. Given a degraded link or a dropped session, you know where to look and what to rule out. You can read BGP session state, follow a path with ping and traceroute, and tell a local fault from an upstream one without waiting to be told.

  • Working BGP knowledge. Reading communities and route policy, spotting a flap or a leaky origin, understanding how transit, peering, and RPKI behave at the edge.

  • Comfortable on the gear and the CLI. Linux, network device CLIs, and dashboards are familiar ground. We run MikroTik (RouterOS) across the network and so do many partners, so RouterOS experience is a real plus.

  • Comfortable working with config in Git. Configuration lives in repos, not on devices. Reading a diff, understanding why a config changed, and proposing one yourself should not be foreign to you.

  • Some scripting, and the appetite to do more. Bash or Python, enough to automate the repetitive parts away and to grow into our config and automation pipelines. We are not hiring a button pusher.

  • Clear written English. You can describe a technical situation accurately and briefly so someone picking it up cold understands it instantly.

  • Calm under pressure and dependable. When the graphs go red you get more precise, not more panicked. You show up for every shift, alert and on time.

  • Located in New Zealand or a nearby time zone where covering our deep overnight maps onto your normal working day.

Nice-to-have

  • CCNP, or MikroTik MTCNA / MTCRE.

  • Prior NOC, ISP, or carrier operations experience.

  • Hands on with MPLS (L3VPN, EVPN) and the multi-tenant isolation a shared backbone needs.

  • Exposure to open source and white box routing or forwarding stacks (SONiC, IP Infusion OcNOS, FRR, or similar).

  • Network source of truth and automation tooling (Nautobot, NAPALM, Jinja config generation, NETCONF or gNMI).

  • Familiarity with a monitoring stack such as Zabbix, Grafana, Loki, or Prometheus, and with flow telemetry.

  • Working familiarity with FreeRADIUS, CoA and Disconnect flows, and how session control and accounting hook into the network.

  • Exposure to applying ML or AI in network operations: anomaly detection, predictive failure analysis, automated triage or remediation.

  • IPv6 and dual stack exposure, and internet exchange operations (looking glass and route server behaviour, IRR and RPKI hygiene).

4. What we offer

  • A seat inside a serious, very senior network team, with people who have deep service provider backgrounds and will sharpen you fast. You will see how a real carrier network behaves under live conditions.

  • A front row seat to how a network actually gets run in 2026. Open source forwarding, config as code, and an LLM layer doing real operational work. Not a slide about the future of network operations, but the environment you would work in every shift, and help build.

  • Real engineering, not just monitoring. The role is built so the quiet hours go into automation, propagation and health work, and tickets off the board. The path into deeper network engineering and automation work is the plan, not a vague someday.

  • Competitive salary and private health and wellness benefits, fully remote, in a mission driven, investor backed company building the backbone of Africa's next generation internet.

jobs.description:
Finance, Controlling, Risk and Compliance-teamet leverer verdiskapende tjenester innen økonomi, internkontroll, risikostyring og compliance, og er en viktig støttespiller for hele organisasjonen. Det vil variere i hvilken grad av operativt ansvar man har til en hver tid på de forskjellige områdene. Teamet har også et spesielt ansvar for den finansielle oppfølgingen av donoravtaler og fungerer som et faglig ressurssenter på området.

  Du vil inngå i faglig dyktig team på 8. Vi søker en leder som evner å utvikle mennesker og skape gode resultater gjennom tydelig ledelse, samarbeid og struktur, samtidig som man tar mer operativt ansvar for enkelte områder.Rollen har et betydelig strategisk ansvar, herunder ledelse av tverrfaglige initiativer, utvikling av ansvarsområdet og tett samarbeid med avdelingsleder om både strategiske og operative prioriteringer.     Dine arbeidsoppgaver vil være: 
  • Være en proaktiv samarbeidspartner og et faglig ressurssenter for hele organisasjonen innen økonomi, controlling, risiko og compliance.
  • Sikre relevant og beslutningsstøttende økonomirapportering til ledelse, styre, føderasjon og andre interessenter, inkludert budsjett- og regnskapsprosesser.
  • Lede og videreutvikle organisasjonens økonomi-, controlling- og lønnsfunksjon i tråd med gjeldende lover, interne retningslinjer og donorkrav.
  • Ha ansvar for økonomisk oppfølging av donorfinansierte prosjekter, inkludert budsjettering, finansiell rapportering og revisjoner.
  • Sikre etterlevelse (compliance) på tvers av organisasjonen, samt følge opp evalueringer, revisjoner og andre kontrollprosesser.
  • Videreutvikle og forvalte organisasjonens arbeid med innkjøp, anti-korrupsjon, anti-mislighet og varsling, inkludert dialog med relevante donoraktører.
  • Samarbeide tett med nasjonale og internasjonale kontorer for å sikre god og effektiv finansiell styring på tvers av føderasjonen.

Vi tror dette er en god beskrivelse av deg: 

  • Relevant høyere utdanning på bachelor- eller masternivå innen økonomi, finans eller tilsvarende.
  • Minimum 10 års relevant erfaring innen økonomi, controlling, risikostyring og/eller compliance.
  • God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk og engelsk.
  • Ledererfaring er en fordel.
  • En inkluderende og inspirerende leder som motiverer, utvikler og støtter medarbeidere gjennom åpen dialog og coaching.
  • Sterke samarbeids- og koordineringsevner, med evne til å bygge relasjoner og nettverk internt og eksternt.
  • Strategisk og oprativt orientert, med evne til å se helheten, skape retning og omsette mål til resultater.

Hvordan er det å jobbe hos oss? 

Hos oss får du en sentral rolle i en global organisasjon som jobber målrettet for barns og jenters rettigheter. Du vil få reell mulighet til å påvirke og skalere finansiering til programmer som skaper varig endring, og bidra til å styrke vårt arbeid internasjonalt. 

Du blir en del av et sterkt fagmiljø med kolleger som har høy kompetanse og stort engasjement for arbeidet sitt. Samtidig vil du arbeide i et internasjonalt miljø med tett samarbeid på tvers av land og organisasjonsledd. 

Arbeidsplassen vår ligger i moderne og attraktive lokaler i Oslo sentrum, med gode rammer for både samarbeid og faglig utvikling. 

Vi tilbyr også en omvendt referansesjekk, slik at du kan snakke med noen av våre ansatte og få innsikt i hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss, og forsikre deg om at vi er en god match.  

Vi oppfordrer deg til å søke uansett bakgrunn, funksjonsevne eller identitet. Mangfold er en styrke og vi ønsker å bygge en organisasjon som reflekterer den verden vi lever i.  

Søknadsfrist er 11.10.26 og vi vurderer kandidater forløpende.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Plan International jobber for barns rettigheter, både langsiktig og gjennom nødhjelp, i 80 land og over 66 000 lokalsamfunn. Der barn ikke har det bra, har jenter det ofte verst. Derfor setter vi jenter først. Vi er en del av den globale organisasjonen Plan International, og har et tett faglig samarbeid med våre internasjonale kollegaer. Hos oss møter du 70 engasjerte og faglig dyktige ansatte. Vi er opptatt av innovasjon, forretningsutvikling og har vunnet flere priser for markeds- og kommunikasjonskampanjer. Uansett hvilken stilling du har så er målet det samme – å jobbe for at barn skal få en bedre fremtid.

jobs.title: Senior Finanzbuchhalter:in (m/w/d) Düsseldorf
jobs.description:
Gestalte die Buchhaltung von morgen: cloudbasiert, KI‑unterstützt, papierlos. Du betreust Mandant:innen mit modernsten Tools, führst die digitale Finanzbuchhaltung eigenverantwortlich inklusive der Vorbereitung und Unterstützung der Erstellung von HGB‑Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen, steuerst Projekte end‑to‑end und optimierst Buchhaltungsprozesse.

Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung aus einem Steuerbüro mit, hast bereits an Jahresabschlüssen mitgewirkt und kennst dich mit digitalen Workflows in der Buchhaltung aus. Wenn du zusätzlich noch eigene Mandant:innen mitbringst oder ein eigenes Netzwerk aktiv einbringen möchtest, um unseren Kundenstamm weiter auszubauen, passt du perfekt zu uns.

Flexibles Arbeiten (remote oder im modernen Büro mitten in der Düsseldorfer Altstadt), 30 Urlaubstage, kontinuierliche Weiterbildung und echter Gestaltungsspielraum warten auf dich, wenn du mindestens 3 bis 5 Jahre Buchhaltungserfahrung, eine kaufmännische Ausbildung/ Studium und Lust auf Innovation mitbringst.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Betreue unsere Mandant:innen mit Hilfe modernster Technologien
  • Übernehme eigenverantwortlich die digitale Finanzbuchhaltung
  • Bereite selbstständig Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB und Finanzbuchhaltungsvorgaben vor und unterstütze deren Erstellung
  • Führe Kontenabstimmungen durch, bereite den Zahlungsverkehr vor und erstelle Umsatzsteuervoranmeldungen
  • Analysiere und optimiere kontinuierlich die Buchhaltungsprozesse unserer Mandant:innen durch den Einsatz digitaler Tools
  • Gestalte und nutze digitale Workflows (z.B. Belegflüsse, Freigabeprozesse, Dokumentenmanagement), um Prozesse effizienter und transparenter zu machen
  • Bringe, wenn möglich, dein bestehendes Mandant:innen‑Netzwerk mit ein und unterstütze uns beim weiteren Ausbau unseres Kundenportfolios

Das bringst du mit:

  • Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein vergleichbares, erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium
  • Mindestens 3 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Buchhaltung
  • Idealerweise Praxiserfahrung aus einer Steuerkanzlei/ einem Steuerbüro
  • Erfahrung in der Bilanzbuchhaltung bzw. Beteiligung an Jahresabschlüssen
  • Umfassende Kenntnisse in HGB und Finanzbuchhaltung
  • Begeisterung für digitale Innovationen im Bereich Buchhaltung
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit digitalen Workflows (z.B. digitale Belegverarbeitung, Workflow-Tools, elektronische Freigabeprozesse)
  • Ein hohes Maß an Sorgfalt und Genauigkeit und ein gutes Gespür für Zahlen
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft M365 und DATEV
  • Erfahrung mit Business Central, Oracle, oder branchenspezifischen ERP-Systemen von Vorteil
  • Von Vorteil: ein eigenes Mandanten‑Netzwerk oder Kund:innen, die du mit zu uns bringst
  • Selbstständige, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke und Teamfähigkeit, sowohl digital als auch persönlich
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C2-Niveau)

Deine Benefits:

  • Verantwortung: baue unser Team in Düsseldorf mit auf
  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Bring deine Ideen ein und gestalte aktiv die Zukunft der Buchhaltung
  • Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung: Bleibe stets am Puls der digitalen Entwicklung, insbesondere im Bereich digitale Workflows und Automatisierung
  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Arbeite remote oder im modernen Büro mit höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen in der Düsseldorfer Altstadt, du hast die Wahl
  • Work-Life-Balance: 30 Urlaubstage, zusätzlich frei an Heiligabend und Silvester sowie flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Mitarbeiter-Benefits: spendit-Karte, kostenlose Getränke, regelmäßige Teamevents (in Planung)
  • Mobilität: Fahrtkostenzuschuss für das Deutschlandticket

Über uns

Die advacc advanced accounting GmbH ist der Partner für moderne, vollständig digitale Buchhaltung mit Standorten in Düsseldorf und Greifswald. Als externe Buchhaltung übernehmen wir für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden zentrale Aufgaben der Finanzbuchhaltung. Von der Bearbeitung von Ein- und Ausgangsrechnungen über die Buchung aller Geschäftsvorfälle bis zur Lohnabrechnung und stellen fristgerechte, transparente und rechtssichere Abläufe sicher.

Darüber hinaus beraten wir betriebswirtschaftlich, steuern das Forderungsmanagement und treiben die Digitalisierung sowie Optimierung von Buchhaltungsprozessen voran. Unser erfahrenes Team arbeitet softwareunabhängig, schnell und proaktiv, mit dem Anspruch, Abläufe zu vereinfachen, Liquidität zu sichern und Freiräume für das Kerngeschäft unserer Kundinnen und Kunden zu schaffen.

Wir stehen für innovative Lösungen, hohe Serviceorientierung und echte Hands-on-Mentalität. Wir suchen Persönlichkeiten, die Bilanzbuchhaltung, digitale Workflows und Mandantenbetreuung auf dem nächsten Level mit uns gestalten wollen.

jobs.title: (Senior) Consultant (m/w/d) Planning & Forecasting
jobs.description:
Seit über 25 Jahren verwandeln wir bei der Windhoff Group Daten in echte Geschäftschancen – von klassischer Business Intelligence bis zur KI-getriebenen Automatisierung. Dabei denken wir ganzheitlich: Wir begleiten unsere Kunden End-to-End, von der Strategie über die technische Umsetzung bis zum produktiven Betrieb. Ob BI-Reporting, Data Warehousing, Predictive Analytics oder KI-Lösungen – unser Anspruch ist es, aus Daten messbaren Mehrwert zu machen.

In unserem Competence Center Planning & Forecasting begleiten wir Unternehmen auf dem Weg zu einer schnellen, integrierten und steuerungsrelevanten Planung: von der strategischen Standortbestimmung über die Einführung moderner Planungslösungen bis hin zum Einsatz von KI, Predictive Analytics und Simulation.
Du bringst dein Controlling-Know-how ein und machst daraus Lösungen, die im Planungsalltag unserer Kunden wirklich funktionieren.

Neben unserer fachlichen Expertise sind wir ein Arbeitgeber, der Vielfalt fördert und sicherstellt, dass alle Mitarbeitenden fair behandelt werden. Teile
uns mit, wenn wir auf etwas besonders Rücksicht nehmen sollen - wie zum
Beispiel auf bestimmte Arbeitszeiten oder andere Rahmenbedingungen, deine
Situation im Privatleben oder besondere Bedürfnisse bei der Arbeit.

Klingt nach einem Traumjob? Dann jetzt Teil des Teams werden!

Aufgaben

  • Du gestaltest mit uns die Planung unserer Kunden von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung: In Projekten nimmst du gemeinsam mit Controlling, Fachbereichen und IT den Status quo auf, bewertest Reifegrad und Potenziale und leitest Zielbild, Prozesse, Governance und Roadmap mit ab.
  • Du beschäftigst dich mit aktuellen Konzepten integrierter Finanzplanung mit GuV, Bilanz und Cashflow sowie den vorgelagerten Teilplanungen, etwa Vertriebs-, Personal-, Kostenstellen- oder Investitionsplanung.
  • Zusammen mit deinen KollegInnen übersetzt du fachliche Anforderungen in Konzepte und setzt sie mit der SAP Analytics Cloud um: Datenmodelle, Planungs- und Berechnungslogiken, Erfassungsmasken und Berechtigungen, inklusive der Datenversorgung.
  • Du bringst moderne Ansätze in die Planung: treiberbasierte und prädiktive Planung, Szenario- und Risikosimulation sowie KI-Agenten, die Planungsprämissen ermitteln und Planungsschritte unterstützen.
  • Du begleitest unsere Projekte über den gesamten Lebenszyklus, von der Anforderungsaufnahme über Konzeption und Umsetzung bis zum Go-Live, zur Hypercare und zur Übergabe an den Betrieb.
  • Du arbeitest aktiv im Projektteam mit und übernimmst je nach Erfahrung die Teilprojektleitung für einzelne Teilpläne. Mit wachsender Erfahrung entwickelst du dich in Richtung Projektleitung weiter.
  • Durch Schulungen, Projektpräsentationen und unsere internen und externen Technologie-Events hast du Zugang zu einem Netzwerk von Expertinnen und Experten und bringst dich aktiv ein.

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Controlling oder Finanzbereich, zum Beispiel im Konzern-, Group- oder Unternehmenscontrolling, idealerweise mit eigener Verantwortung für Planungs- und Forecastprozesse.
  • Idealerweise erste Erfahrung als Consultant (m/w/d) in Planungsprojekten mit der SAP Analytics Cloud oder vergleichbaren Planungslösungen. Falls nicht, hast du große Lust, dich in die SAP Analytics Cloud einzuarbeiten, und wir unterstützen dich dabei.
  • Neben einem guten Verständnis für betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge, Planungslogiken und Konsolidierung hast du fundierte Erfahrungen oder eine hohe Affinität im Umgang mit Datenbanken, Datenmodellen und technischen Planungslösungen.
  • Du nimmst fachliche Anforderungen gern strukturiert auf, moderierst Workshops und erklärst Lösungen verständlich, gegenüber Fachbereichen ebenso wie gegenüber dem Management. Erfahrung mit hybriden oder agilen Projektmethoden wie Scrum ist ein Plus.
  • Du interessierst dich für den Einsatz von KI, Predictive Analytics und Simulationsverfahren in der Planung und hast Lust, diese Themen bei unseren Kunden mit voranzubringen.
  • Durch deine hohe Eigeninitiative und sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit bringst du deine Ideen sowohl in unsere internen Teams als auch im Umfeld des Kunden erfolgreich ein. Hierfür sind verhandlungssichere (C-Niveau) Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse erforderlich.
  • Du begeisterst dich für neueste Technologien und gibst dein Wissen gerne an KollegInnen weiter.

Benefits

  • Wir stellen standortunabhängig ein. Du kannst – je nach Projekt – zu 90 % von zuhause aus oder an einem unserer Standorte arbeiten, wenn dieser für dich gut erreichbar ist. Zu gelegentlichen Kundenterminen und Teamevents startest du von deinem Lebensmittelpunkt aus, egal wo in Deutschland du wohnst.
  • 130 Data & Analytics Consultants zum Austausch sowie eine interne Weiterbildungsacademy
  • Langfristige Projekte mit wechselnden technologischen Herausforderungen
  • Ein festes Budget für Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sowie persönliche und fachliche Entwicklungsperspektiven
  • Eine gute Work-Life-Balance durch flexible Arbeitszeiten, Überstundenausgleich sowie bis zu 40 Tagen Urlaub
  • Sowohl erstklassige Hard- und Softwareausstattung als auch Leasingangebote für Firmenwagen, IT-Hardware und Fahrräder
  • Kurze Wege im Unternehmen, ein fairer Umgang miteinander sowie unterhaltsame Teamevents

Du verfügst über die gewünschten Erfahrungen und suchst eine neue Herausforderung? Du bist flexibel, lösungsorientiert und kommunikationsfähig?

Nutze deine Chance: Wir bieten das passende Umfeld für deine Karriere.
