jobs.title: Kvalitetsleder
jobs.description:
SSB søker en kvalitetsleder som skal lede SSBs kvalitetsteam og ha en sentral rolle i å ivareta og videreutvikle SSBs kvalitetsarbeid. Teamet består for tiden av fire medarbeidere i Kongsvinger og Oslo og koordinerer arbeidet med kvalitet i offisiell statistikk.
 
Offisiell statistikk blir for det meste produsert av SSB, men også av andre produsenter i Utvalget for offisiell statistikk. SSB skal holde et overordnet oppsyn med at kravene til kvalitet i den offisielle statistikken etterleves, og har utviklet et system for å følge dette opp. Kvalitetsteamet skal blant annet gjøre behovsanalyser, dokumentere kvalitetsarbeid og videreutvikle systemet for kvalitetssikring av offisiell statistikk.
 
Kvalitetsteamet arbeider på tvers i hele SSB, i Kongsvinger og Oslo, og samarbeider med Utvalget for offisiell statistikk og internasjonale fagmiljøer. Kvalitetsteamet samarbeider også med etterlevelsesfunksjonen i SSB, som bygger på mange av de samme prinsippene og metodene. Stillingen kan også omfatte oppgaver og ansvar knyttet til etterlevelse på andre områder i virksomheten. Dette kan blant annet innebære samarbeid med fagområder som informasjonssikkerhet, personvern og beredskap. 


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Lede og koordinere kvalitetsteamet i SSB
  • Forvalte og videreutvikle SSBs system for kvalitet i offisiell statistikk
  • Utvikle metoder og verktøy for kvalitetsarbeid og kontinuerlig forbedring
  • Planlegge og lede gjennomganger av kvalitet i statistiske produksjonsprosesser i SSB og hos andre produsenter av offisiell statistikk, analysere resultatene og følge opp forbedringsarbeidet
  • Støtte og gi råd til SSBs ledelse i arbeidet med kvalitet og etterlevelse, og delta i seksjonens ledelse
  • Bidra til å koordinere og videreutvikle SSBs arbeid med etterlevelse på andre områder i virksomheten
  • Delta i nasjonalt og internasjonalt samarbeid om kvalitet i offisiell statistikk
  • Drive opplærings- og informasjonsarbeid om kvalitet og etterlevelse                        
Kvalifikasjoner

Du må ha:

  • Relevant utdanning på mastergradsnivå, for eksempel innen økonomi og revisjon, samfunnsfag, statistikk, matematikk, IT eller andre relevante fagområder
  • Lang og særlig relevant erfaring kan kompensere for deler av utdanningskravet
  • Relevant erfaring med kvalitetsarbeid, etterlevelse, revisjon eller forbedringsarbeid
  • Erfaring med å lede og gjennomføre prosesser eller utviklingsarbeid
  • Meget god muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk og engelsk

Det er en fordel om du også har:

  • Erfaring med internrevisjon, internkontroll, risikostyring eller annet systematisk etterlevelsesarbeid
  • Erfaring med å utvikle og forvalte kvalitetssystemer, styringssystemer eller rammeverk for etterlevelse
  • Kjennskap til rammeverk og metoder for kvalitetsarbeid i offisiell statistikk
  • Erfaring med kvalitetsarbeid eller forbedringsarbeid i statistikkproduksjon
  • Erfaring med internasjonalt samarbeid  
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du evner å arbeide langsiktig og strategisk
  • Du arbeider strukturert, systematisk og helhetlig
  • Du er analytisk, setter deg raskt inn i komplekse problemstillinger og identifiserer forbedringsbehov
  • Du skaper engasjement og driver prosesser på tvers av fagmiljøer
  • Du er selvstendig og løsningsorientert og evner å omsette krav til praktiske løsninger
  • Du har gode samarbeids- og kommunikasjonsevner og formidler komplekse problemstillinger på en klar og forståelig måte 
Vi tilbyr
  • Jobb i en virksomhet med et viktig samfunnsoppdrag. Vi har stor tillit hos befolkningen og blant beslutningstakere, og som medarbeider i SSB blir du del av et stort fagmiljø 
  • Gode muligheter for utvikling, samarbeid og nettverksbygging. Vi har nyansattprogram, årlig hackathon og arenaer for faglig deling på tvers 
  • Stilling som seniorrådgiver (kode 1364) i lønnsspenn kr 700 000 - 900 000. Høyere lønn kan vurderes for søkere som er særlig godt kvalifisert
  • Fleksitid, betalt overtid og sommertid i perioden 15. mai til og med 14. september
  • Godt miljø også utenom arbeidstid, med idrettstilbud og ulike sosiale aktiviteter. Du kan trene én time i uken i arbeidstid, med treningsrom i kontorlokalene
  • Medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse, som betyr at du får en av Norges beste pensjonsordninger og mulighet til å søke om boliglån med gunstige betingelser
  • Arbeidsplass i SSBs lokaler i nytt bygg ved Kongsvinger stasjon

    Verdt å merke seg: 
  • For at vi best mulig skal kunne vurdere din søknad trenger vi at du innen søknadsfristen registrerer relevant dokumentasjon i den elektroniske søkeportalen (attester, vitnemål osv.). For kandidater som vi vurderer å ansette kan vi utføre bakgrunnssjekk og kontroll av dokumentasjon. 
  • Når du søker jobb hos oss, vil navnet ditt stå på en offentlig søkerliste, som kan bli gjort tilgjengelig for de som ber om innsyn i listen. Det er mulig å bli unntatt denne søkerlisten. Da må du i så fall begrunne hvorfor du ønsker å bli unntatt. Vi tar deretter stilling til om vi kan innvilge ønsket ditt. Kan vi ikke det, hører du selvsagt fra oss.
  • SSB skal være et godt sted å jobbe for alle, og vi ønsker medarbeidere med ulike kompetanser, fagkombinasjoner, livserfaring og perspektiver for å løse fremtidens oppgaver. SSB jobber for en positiv utvikling i antall ansettelser av personer med innvandrerbakgrunn, funksjonsnedsettelse og/eller midlertidig fravær fra arbeid, utdanning eller opplæring. Hvis dette gjelder deg, vil vi oppfordre deg til å krysse av for dette når du søker på stillingen. Det gir deg mulighet for å få positiv særbehandling. Vi inviterer minst én kvalifisert søker fra hver av disse gruppene til intervju. Dersom du har behov for særskilt tilrettelegging vil vi strekke oss langt for å imøtekomme ditt behov.
KontaktinformasjonXeni Kristine Dimakos, Seksjonssjef, +47 41628602

2211 Kongsvinger

Om arbeidsgiveren:

 Statistisk sentralbyrå - tall som forteller

Statistisk sentralbyrå (SSB) har hovedansvaret for utvikling, utarbeiding og formidling av offisiell statistikk i Norge. Statistikk, forskning og analyse fra SSB bidrar til innsikt om samfunnsutviklingen, danner grunnlag for det offentlige ordskiftet og gir mulighet for informerte beslutninger.

SSB er en kunnskapsorganisasjon med faglig utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver og gode utviklingsmuligheter. Vi har et stort kontaktnett, også internasjonalt. Vi har 830 medarbeidere lokalisert i Oslo og Kongsvinger, i tillegg til intervjuere over hele landet. Kompetente og motiverte medarbeidere er avgjørende for at vi skal kunne nå målet om å være den fremste leverandøren av fakta om norske samfunnsforhold.

jobs.title: Chef to join our international kitchen team
jobs.description:
CHEF WANTED FOR STAFF RESTAURANT IN COPENHAGEN, DENMARK

Looking for a chef position in Copenhagen with great working hours, professional cooking and weekends mostly free?

We are looking for a skilled and motivated chef to join our international kitchen team in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Your main workplace will be The Staff Restaurant at Abacus Medicine, located at Kalvebod Brygge in central Copenhagen.

This is a full-time position with working hours primarily Monday to Friday from 06:30 to 14:30 – giving you the opportunity to work in an ambitious professional kitchen while still having your afternoons, evenings and most weekends free.

Occasional evening and weekend events may occur.

THE JOB

You will become part of a professional kitchen team responsible for the daily production and service at our staff restaurant.

We cook from scratch and care about good ingredients, seasonality, flavour and proper craftsmanship.

You will work primarily with hot kitchen production and take responsibility for your own preparation and tasks while working closely with the rest of the team.

Our kitchen is busy, so we are looking for someone who works efficiently and in an organised manner without compromising quality.

Just as importantly, we are looking for a good colleague.

We believe a professional kitchen should be a place where people communicate respectfully, help each other and enjoy coming to work.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

You may already be living in Denmark, or you may be considering moving to Copenhagen from another EU/EEA country.

We would like to hear from you if you:

  • are a trained chef or have equivalent professional kitchen experience

  • have experience from à la carte restaurants, quality staff restaurants, hotels or similar professional kitchens

  • have solid experience in the hot kitchen

  • have a genuine interest in food, ingredients and good craftsmanship

  • can organise your own work and maintain a good pace throughout the day

  • are reliable and comfortable starting work early

  • enjoy working as part of a team

  • communicate in a positive and respectful way

  • can maintain an overview when the kitchen gets busy.

A background in classic French or Mediterranean cuisine would be particularly relevant to our kitchen.

However, we are also interested in chefs who bring their own culinary background and experience. Whether your inspiration comes from France, Spain, Italy, Portugal, Greece, North or South America, Asia or somewhere else, we would like to see what you can bring to the team.

We want to taste what you are passionate about.

WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a full-time chef position in central Copenhagen with a working schedule that is unusual in the restaurant industry:

Monday–Friday
Primarily 06:30–14:30
Most evenings and weekends free

You will join a friendly and international workplace with experienced colleagues, high professional standards and room to contribute your own knowledge and ideas.

We value professional pride, teamwork, reliability and a positive working environment.

Our goal is simple: good food, good ingredients, good craftsmanship and a kitchen team that works well together.

MORE THAN A STAFF RESTAURANT

Your daily workplace will be:

The Staff Restaurant at Abacus Medicine
Kalvebod Brygge 35
1560 Copenhagen V
Denmark

Our kitchen also produces food for our small Copenhagen wine bar, Sankt Annæ 8, located in Christianshavn.

Within the same ownership group, we operate several Copenhagen restaurants, including Le Métier, La Propina and Ma Cuisine.

You will therefore become part of a wider restaurant family with different concepts and opportunities for future professional development.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION

Position: Chef
Employment: Full-time
Working hours: Primarily Monday–Friday, 06:30–14:30
Workplace: Copenhagen, Denmark
Starting date: As soon as possible / by agreement
Salary: Based on qualifications and experience and agreed individually
Evening/weekend work: Occasional events only

INTERESTED?

Send us your CV and a short application in English to:

job@willworkforfood.dk

Please write “CHEF FOR ABACUS” in the subject line.

Tell us a little about yourself, your kitchen experience, what kind of food you enjoy cooking and when you would be available to start.

Applications are reviewed continuously, and suitable candidates will be invited for an interview.

If you are currently living outside Denmark, please mention your current location and when you would potentially be available to relocate to Copenhagen.

We look forward to meeting you for a coffee and a conversation about food, ambitions and your future in Copenhagen.

The Staff Restaurant at Abacus Medicine
Copenhagen, Denmark

jobs.title: Brenner du for mennesker og resultater? Bli vår nye kundeansvarlig i Jessheim!
jobs.description:
Vil du være med og løfte Norges mest engasjerte bemannings- og rekrutteringsselskap videre?

Hos Pecus mener vi at trivsel og resultater går hånd i hånd. Vi er i vekst, og nå styrker vi laget med en ny Kundeansvarlig til vår satsing i Jessheim. Vi ser etter deg som brenner for gode relasjoner, høyt tempo og varierte dager.

 

Som kundeansvarlig blir du en nøkkelperson for både kunder og medarbeidere, og en sentral bidragsyter i å videreutvikle vår avdeling på Romerike. Du vil få ansvar for en spennende kundeportefølje i vekst som strekker seg fra Lørenskog til Gardermoen. Du må derfor trives med å være på farten, besøke kunder og utvikle gode relasjoner.

 

Til daglig blir du en del av vårt team i Jessheim, sammen med fire engasjerte kollegaer. Samtidig jobber du tett med resten av gjengen vår i Oslo og Vestby. Totalt er vi 19 kollegaer som heier på hverandre, deler kunnskap og har det gøy sammen både på og utenfor jobb.

 

Dette blir arbeidshverdagen din:
  • Booke personell til våre kunder basert på deres behov.
  • Håndtere innringing og erstatning ved sykdom/fravær.
  • Utvikle samarbeid med både kunder og ansatt, med fokus på kundemøter og andre relasjonsbyggende aktiviteter.
  • Intervjue kandidater og matche dem med riktige oppdrag.
  • Selge inn kandidater aktivt til egen kundeportefølje.
  • Følge opp kandidater i og uten oppdrag, både via telefon og ved kundebesøk.
  • Onboarding av nye medarbeidere og oppfølging for en god oppstart.
  • Skrive stillingsannonser og bidra med rekrutteringsinnhold.
  • Være med på å videreutvikle avdelingen og finne nye vekstmuligheter.

 

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som har erfaring fra kundebehandling, personalledelse og/eller salg. Har du erfaring fra bemanningsbransjen, er det et stort pluss! I tillegg motiveres du av å skape resultater sammen med andre, og har et langsiktig blikk på hvordan vi kan bygge opp Pecus sin posisjon i regionen.

Vi tror du:

  • Har høyt tempo og trives i et aktivt miljø.
  • Er ansvarsfull med fokus på kvalitet i egne prosesser.
  • Har førerkort klasse B og liker å være ute hos kunder.
  • Er strukturert, engasjert og løsningsorientert.
  • Har positiv energi og evnen til å motivere andre.
  • Kommuniserer godt både på skandinavisk språk og engelsk.
  • Er en lagspiller som heier på kollegene dine.

 

Derfor kommer du til å trives hos oss:
  • Fast lønn + attraktiv teambonus.
  • Et engasjert arbeidsmiljø med fokus på trivsel, humor og høy takhøyde.
  • Store karriere- og utviklingsmuligheter i et selskap som vokser raskt.
  • Fleksibilitet til å styre din egen hverdag.
  • Årlig firmatur - i fjor gikk turen til Kroatia!
  • Fri telefon og treningstilbud.
  • Sosiale arrangementer som Holmenkollstafetten, båttur, quiz og after work (om du vil)!
  • God opplæring og oppfølging – vi løfter hverandre.

 

Praktisk informasjon om stillingen:
  • Stilling: Fast heltidsstilling.
  • Arbeidstid: Fleksitid, med kjernetid mellom 09-15. Fleksibilitet er nødvendig, da telefoner og meldinger utenfor kontortiden forekommer.
  • Oppstart: Etter avtale – men vi ønsker oss deg så snart som mulig.

 

Søk i dag!

Dette gjør du enkelt ved å laste opp din søknad og CV. Grunnet GDPR vil søknad per e-post ikke vurderes.
Har du spørsmål? Send e-post til Silje på silje@pecus.no – hun svarer raskt.

Bli med i vårt fantastiske Pecus-team som alltid spiller hverandre gode – vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Pecus AS er et rekrutterings- og bemanningsselskap som setter mennesker først. Siden etableringen i 2013 har vi hjulpet bedrifter med å finne de rette medarbeiderne, samtidig som vi har skapt nye muligheter for mennesker på vei inn i arbeidslivet eller videre i karrieren.
Vi tror de beste resultatene skapes gjennom tillit, tett oppfølging og gode relasjoner. Derfor ser vi mennesket bak CV-en og ønsker å være en langsiktig samarbeidspartner for både kunder, kandidater og ansatte. Når menneskene lykkes, lykkes også virksomhetene de jobber i.

jobs.title: Associate Professor in near-Real-Time Interactive Systems Development
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus on professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 44,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

The Department of Computer Science at NTNU Gjøvik campus is looking for a candidate for an Associate Professor position in near-Real-Time Interactive Systems Development. The position focuses on advancing research and education in the engineering of near-real-time interactive software systems, with games and immersive technologies as the primary application domain.

The successful candidate will be associated with the Games and Immersive Technology Lab, which serves as the primary research home for this position. The lab brings together expertise in interactive systems engineering, game platform development, and immersive virtual environments. Its research spans game engine architecture and platform-level development, the design and construction of near-real-time interactive software, extended reality and immersive simulation (VR/AR/MR). The successful candidate is expected to contribute actively to the lab's research agenda, strengthen its profile in games and interactive systems engineering, and build open research artefacts (prototypes, tools, and systems) that connect research with practice and community.

Your immediate leader is the head of the Intelligent Systems and Analytics unit.


Duties of the position

The candidate is expected to:

  • Play a leading role in research and research-based education in games and near-real-time interactive systems. This includes securing highly competitive research funding, such as ERC and FRIPRO grants. 
  • Take part in the department's research strategy, including shaping the future direction of the Games and Immersive Technology Lab, including game engine architecture and platform-level development, software design and construction for interactive and performance-constrained systems, extended reality and immersive simulation contexts.
  • Contribute to the department's educational profile and an excellent learning environment in collaboration with colleagues, students and external stakeholders.
  • Deliver high-quality teaching at undergraduate, graduate and PhD levels, primarily in systems programming, real-time and interactive systems programming, and game development, and supervise BSc students, MSc students, PhD candidates and postdoctoral fellows.
  • Engage in applications for external funding, e.g. from the Research Council of Norway, European research and educational agencies, the industry sector and other available sources.
  • Build and maintain open-source prototypes, tools, and artefacts that support research, teaching, and community engagement.
  • Communicate relevant parts of their research through public outreach, industry engagement, and dissemination activities.
  • Participate in the management of research, education and other relevant academic activities in agreement with the Head of Department.

Required qualifications 
  • Must have a PhD in computer science or a related field.
  • Must document a relevant research track record (e.g., peer-reviewed publications, active collaborations, and evidence of research independence) in games and interactive systems, with a demonstrated focus on the engineering and architecture of near-real-time interactive software.
  • Must demonstrate strong programming skills and experience including the languages at the lower abstraction level, such as C.
  • Should demonstrate excellent teaching skills and the ability to teach and develop courses in systems programming, real-time and interactive systems programming, and game development across bachelor and master programmes, and contribute where needed to foundational computer science courses (e.g., programming, algorithms, software development).
  • Norwegian language skills at level B2. New employees who do not speak a Scandinavian language by appointment is required, within three years, to demonstrate skills in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language equivalent to level B2 of the course for Norwegian for speakers of other languages at the Department of Language and Literature at NTNU.
  • You must document relevant basic competence in teaching and supervision at a university/higher education-level, as referenced in the NTNUs guidelines for academic positions. If this cannot be documented, you will be required to complete an approved course in university pedagogy within two years of commencement. NTNU offers qualifying courses.

Preferred qualifications
  • Development experience with game engine architecture, platform-level game development, or interactive simulation systems, demonstrated through code repositories, or shipped software.
  • Must demonstrate hands-on competence in the design and construction of near-real-time interactive software systems, including familiarity with software architecture patterns characteristic of game and interactive systems.
  • Hands-on experience with one or more industry-standard game development engines or frameworks (e.g., Unreal Engine, Unity, Godot, or equivalent), with preference for demonstrated use in a research or advanced development context.
  • Experience constructing, refactoring, and evolving performance-constrained interactive software, including the application of secure and defensive coding practices appropriate to game and interactive application contexts.
  • Experience with extended reality (XR) platforms and immersive simulation systems (VR/AR/MR), including relevant APIs and toolchains.
  • Familiarity with performance-oriented and systems-level software development, such as C++ or C#.
  • Experience with modern functional paradigms, such as Rust, Kotlin, or Haskell.
  • Experience teaching systems programming, game development, immersive or XR systems, mobile or IoT programming courses in higher education.
  • Experience in collaboration with industry or public-sector partners in game technology, simulation, or interactive systems contexts.

Personal qualities
  • Enthusiastic: Has the drive to take the extra step to include all students and support a good dialogue with them.
  • Willing to learn: Will develop excellent competence over the duration of employment and will learn from experience and feedback from others.
  • Team player: Will work perfectly together with colleagues, students, and external stakeholders.
  • Communication: The successful candidate will be able to relay information with clarity and ease, both orally and in writing, and solve any challenges that may appear using transparency and honesty.
  • Taking initiative: The successful candidate will seek out new opportunities at work, initiate activities and projects by working independently.

We offer 
  • Exciting and challenging tasks in a strong international academic environment 
  • An open and inclusive work environment with dedicated colleagues 
  • Favourable terms in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund 
  • employee benefits 

Salary and conditions

As an Associate Professor (code 1011), you are normally paid from gross NOK 690.000 – 885.000 NOK per annum before tax, depending on qualifications and seniority. As required by law, 2% of this salary will be deducted and paid into the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund.

The engagement is to be made in accordance with the regulations in force concerning State Employees and Civil Servants, and the acts relating to Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology. Candidates who by assessment of the application and attachment are seen to conflict with the criteria in the latter law will be prohibited from recruitment to NTNU.  

After the appointment you must assume that there may be changes in the area of work.

It is a prerequisite that you can be present at and accessible to the institution on a daily basis.


Application Process

You can find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

Video: https://youtu.be/bwfNPj8HxHwAbout the application

Your application and supporting documentation must be in English. 

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. Publications and other scientific work must follow the application.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no.If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

If, for any reason, you have taken a career break or have had an atypical career and wish to disclose this in your application, the selection committee will take this into account, recognizing that the quantity of your research may be reduced as a result.

Your application must include:

  • Application letter containing the experience, competence and motivation for the position.
  • CV, diplomas, and certificates.
  • A description of the scientific/academic works you consider most relevant, which you particularly wish to be factored into the assessment (up to 10 items).
  • Research plan.
  • A teaching portfolio in which your teaching competence is compiled and presented systematically (See guidelines for applicants: Documentation of teaching qualifications in applications and appointments to positions at NTNU).
  • Link(s) to code repositories or other artefacts demonstrating programming experience.
  • Students’ evaluation of teaching (if applicable).
  • Details of the projects you have managed, with information about funding, duration and size.
  • Names and contact information for three relevant referees.

It is important that you both document and reflect on your competence. You are encouraged to use the NTNUs competence matrix as a guide for  documentation of your competence.

Joint work will also be considered. If it is difficult to identify your specific input to a joint project, you must include evidence of your contributions.

In the evaluation of which candidate is best qualified, emphasis will be placed on education, experience and personal and interpersonal qualities. Motivation, ambitions, and potential will also count in the assessment of the candidates. Our assessment of the pedagogical skills will be based on documented pedagogical material, forms of presentation in your academic works, teaching experience, PhD, and Masters supervision, and any other relevant pedagogical background. Both quality and scope will be taken into consideration, and an open scientific practice will be recognized.

NTNU is obliged by the evaluation criteria for research quality in accordance with The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment – DORA and the obligations in the Coalition for Advancing Research Assessment ( CoARA) on responsible assessment of research and recognition of a wider range of academic contributions to science and society. This means that we will pay particular attention to the quality and academic range demonstrated by your scientific work to date. We will also pay attention to research leadership and participation in research projects. Your scientific work from the last five years will be given the most weight.

Your application will be considered by an expert committee. Candidates of interest will be invited to an interview, and to deliver a trial teaching session.


General information

The city of Gjøvik has a population of 30 000 and is a town known for its rich music and cultural life. The beautiful nature surrounding the city is ideal for an active outdoor life! The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world.

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse, and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability, and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time. 

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.

As an employee at NTNU, you must continually maintain and improve your professional development and be flexible regarding any organizational changes. 

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you want to reserve yourself from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the reservation is not accepted.

For the sake of transparency, candidates will be given expert evaluations of their own and other candidates. As an applicant you are considered part of the process and are stipulated by rules of confidentiality.

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Deepti Mishra, e-mail deepti.mishra@ntnu.no.
If you have questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact HR, e-mail hr@idi.ntnu.no
 

Application deadline: 29.10.26

jobs.title: Tenure-track position in Archaeology
jobs.description:
About the position 

A tenure-track position (tenure-track in a postdoctoral position and tenured as associate professor) in Archaeology is available at The Department of Archaeology, Conservation and History (IAKH), University of Oslo. IAKH comprises the three disciplinary fields of archaeology conservation and history. The archaeology section has nine academic faculty positions, each with teaching and research components. The section’s research profile and teaching program are internationally oriented and span archaeologies of the Stone Age to the present. The announced position is focused on GIS, statistics and Mesolithic archaeology in Scandinavia.

The announced tenure-track position starts as a full-time postdoctoral position (SKO 1352) for a period of six years, including a 25 % component devoted to teaching and administrative duties. These duties include obtaining basic pedagogical qualifications. A formal midterm evaluation will be held in the fourth year of this period, and the candidate will receive feedback on performance relative to the requirements for the six-year tenure-track period. Toward the end of the six-year period, the candidate will be evaluated for a tenured position as associate professor (SKO 1011). During the final assessment, the candidate’s research performance will first be assessed by an expert (adjudication) committee within the candidate’s subject area. Subsequently, the candidate will be interviewed by an internal interview committee assessing the full range of criteria in the contract of employment.


More about the position 

Applicants apply with a research project including GIS, statistics and the Mesolithic in Scandinavia to be carried out in the initial six years period. In the application letter, candidates should also describe long term plans for building an international research group, for future development of the teaching in Stone Age Archaeology, for contributing to the public dissemination of research, and for developing their own academic career. 

The contract of employment will specify results, requirements, and criteria regarding academic production, public dissemination, research leadership and teaching that the candidate must fulfil during the six-years period to be favourably evaluated for a tenured position. According to the Regulations on appointments to tenure-track positions, with supplementary provisions for UiO, the contract of employment will also specify the criteria for the midterm and final assessment of competencies and milestones. Candidates will also be evaluated on personal suitability and ability to contribute to academic citizenship, both during the initial hiring process and during the mid-term and final evaluations. The contract of employment will further outline the Department’s obligations in supporting the candidate’s research as well as offering academic mentorship, guidance and training. 

Make sure to follow the description of required results necessary in order to be eligible for the tenured position as associate professor.


Requirements 
  • PhD or equivalent academic qualifications within archaeology of the Mesolithic in Scandinavia, with a clear profile in GIS and statistical analysis, granted within the past five years (excluding documented parental and sickness leaves) 
  • Thorough knowledge of the material culture of the Mesolithic in Scandinavia 
  • Demonstrated ability to handle large datasets, geographical information systems and theoretical perspectives on archaeological methodology/practice 
  • Experience in handling of archaeological data using high-end digital tools for quantitative and/or qualitative analysis 
  • Experience with interdisciplinary research approaches within the environmental humanities and/or crossing over to natural sciences 
  • Documented pedagogical skills (either a teaching course certificate or based on teaching experience), see how to document your pedagogical skills 
  • Documented potential for project acquisition • Interest and ability in leadership and administration 
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English and a Scandinavian language 
  • Personal suitability and motivation for the position 

To be eligible, candidates must have submitted for final evaluation or defended their doctoral dissertation within five years preceding the application deadline. In the former case, the appointment will be contingent upon the successful defence of the thesis. Someone who has been employed for more than one year in an ordinary postdoctoral position at the University of Oslo cannot be employed in a postdoctoral position on tenure-track terms.


In the evaluation of the applications, emphasis will be placed on:
  • The research project’s scientific merit and contribution to GIS-based and statistical approaches to the Mesolithic in Scandinavia, including the applicant’s academic and personal ability to carry out the project 
  • The applicant’s long-term plans for building and leading an international research group and successfully join in academic collaboration within and across disciplines, including plans for obtaining external research funding 
  • Academic qualifications and academic production. Originality and quality of publications will be weighted more heavily than quantity 
  • Interest in and motivation for teaching, ability to inspire and provide guidance to students, and potential to teach university-level courses about Stone Age Archaeology and within Archaeology more generally 
  • Interest and ability in leadership and administration, including collaborative skillsExperience with and potential for popular dissemination and public outreach 
  • Academic citizenship, personal suitability and potential to contribute to a positive working environment and the long-term development of teaching and research at the Department 

In the evaluation of the qualified candidates the full range of these criteria will be explicitly addressed and assessed. Academic quality, development, potential and breadth will be prioritised in this order. 

The appointed candidate should demonstrate mastery of both English and one of the Scandinavian languages as working languages.


We can offer you 
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK from 595 000 to 677 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


Application

Your application must include: 

  • Application letter describing the applicant’s qualifications and motivation for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (including list of education, previous and current positions, teaching experience, administrative experience, and other qualifying activities) 
  • List of publications 
  • Project description (3 - 5 pages, maximum 14,000 characters. See Template for project descriptions) 
  • A realistic progress plan for all six years, including activities beyond the postdoctoral research project itself, such as teaching, professional development and project development 
  • Two writing samples (e.g. two chapters from the PhD dissertation or two academic articles) 
  • Copies of educational certificates 

Please note that all documents should be in English (or a Scandinavian language), either in the original or in translation. 

The application with attachments must be delivered in our electronic recruiting system, jobbnorge.no. Applicants with education from non-Norwegian universities must attach an explanation of their grading systems.


Selection procedure

As the first step in the evaluation process, a Selection Committee will assess all applications and invite the most qualified applicants to submit a teaching portfolio and academic works (up to 7 publications) for expert assessment. Academic texts, except for the two writing samples, shall therefore not be enclosed with the initial application. Applicants who are invited to submit academic works are asked to select three works, published within the last 5 years, to be considered as most relevant for the position. In longer publications (monographs), applicants should specify the most relevant pages. Applicants are also asked to submit a teaching portfolio of 3-6 pages documenting educational certificates, competence and experience, including a reflection note in which your own practice and learning vision is anchored in the principles of Scholarship of Teaching and Learning (SoTL). 

Finally, the most highly ranked candidates will be invited for at least one interview and trial lecture. Ranked candidates will be asked to provide a list of 3 reference persons (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number). References are contacted after the interviews.


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO. 

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Department of archaeology, conservation and history (IAKH) is comprised of three disciplines which in different ways study the past.The department has internationally oriented archaeologists, the only conservation program in Norway and the biggest group of historians in Scandinavia. The department has close to 100 employees, including non-permanent research fellows. The study programs span archaeology from the Stone Age to the Middle Ages, object and paintings conservation, and history from Antiquity to the present age.

Vågan kommune nærmer seg 10 000 innbyggere, hovedsete for kommunen ligger i Svolvær. Kommunen har et rikt idretts- og kulturliv, full barnehagedekning og ny videregående skole. Lofoten er kjent for sin mektige natur og mangfoldige friluftsliv.

Vågan kommune er den største arbeidsgiveren i kommunen med ca 850 årsverk. Vår visjon i Vågan kommune er å være "tett på havet og fjellan i en kreativ kystkultur" og vi har et tydelig mål om å framstå som attraktiv for både innbyggere, næringsdrivende og besøkende.

Ansatte i kommunen har gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.

Søknaden sendes inn elektronisk. CV må fylles inn elektronisk, samt at det må legges med dokumentasjon på utdanning og arbeidserfaring. 

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at alle våre søkere kan komme på en offentlig søkerliste jf. offentlighetsloven § 25. Eventuelt fritak fra offentliggjøring må begrunnes i søknaden og gjøres bare unntaksvis.

Vi ønsker deg velkommen som søker på stilling hos oss!

jobs.title: Vi søker deg som vil jobbe med utvikling av verdensledende produkter!
jobs.description:
Selskapet er i en meget positiv utvikling og vi trenger flere som jobber med telemetri til våre spennende utviklingsprosjekter og verdensledende missilprodukter (NSM, JSM).

Vi søker deg som er interessert i å skape komplekse produkter med stor verdi for nasjonal sikkerhet.

Som Prosjektingeniør i Divisjon Missiles & Aerostructures (DMA) vil du spille en sentral rolle i å samle inn, analysere og rapportere data gjennom telemetriske systemer, og dermed bidra til å optimalisere drift og beslutningsprosesser.

Vi har et sosialt og godt arbeidsmiljø med mange faglig sterke og motiverte kollegaer, og ønsker deg med sterk interesse for produkt, teknologi og fag med på laget.

Vi søker medarbeidere til vår lokasjon i Kongsberg.

 

Arbeidsoppgavene er varierte og kan bestå av:

  • Implementere og administrere telemetriske systemer og sensorer.
  • Overvåke og analysere innsamlede data for å sikre pålitelighet og nøyaktighet.
  • Feilsøking og vedlikehold av elektroniske systemer og komponenter.
  • Identifisere og implementere løsninger for å forbedre systemenes ytelse.
  • Samarbeide tett med ulike avdelinger for å sikre optimal datainnsamling og -bruk.
  • Bistå ved operativ bruk av telemetrisystemet

 

Du bør ha bakgrunn fra minst ett av disse områdene/fag:

  • Elektronikk, automasjon, dataoverføring fag
  • Telemetri-teknologi, kommunikasjonssystemer

 

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner og egenskaper:

  • Kunnskap innen elektronikk, for eksempel gjennom utdanning eller erfaring med elektroniske systemer og sensorer.
  • Interesse for å jobbe med telemetri og dataoverføringsteknologi systemer.
  • Interesse for feilsøking og vedlikehold av elektroniske systemer og komponenter.
  • Evne til å arbeide både selvstendig og i team, med en praktisk tilnærming til problemløsing.
  • Å kunne løser komplekse problemstillinger gjennom tverrfaglig samarbeid.
  • Målrettet, engasjert og initiativrik, med evne til å ta beslutninger.
  • Gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk
  • Bachelor eller Master innen elektronikk, elektroniske systemer, automasjon eller teknisk fagområder er ønskelig, men relevant erfaring kan også kompenseres.  
  • Både erfarne og nyutdannede oppfordres til å søke.

 

Vi tilbyr:

Spennende, utviklende og selvstendige arbeidsoppgaver i et høyteknologisk miljø. Vi ønsker å utvikle våre ansatte både faglig og personlig.  Hos oss vil du møte et inkluderende, sammensveiset og uformelt arbeidsmiljø. Vi har konkurransedyktige betingelser, pensjons- og forsikringsordninger, samt et fordelaktig aksjeprogram og bonusprogram for deg som er ansatt.

Du får god oppfølging av din fadder og individuell opplæring.

Videre legger vi til rette for kontinuerlig utvikling, både faglig og personlig, gjennom utfordringer i hverdagen, kurs og mulighet for videreutdanning

Vi har mye å tilby også utenfor arbeidstid, blant annet eget treningssenter, innovasjons lab, firmahytter, rabatterte billetter til flere kultur- og sportsarrangementer. I tillegg har vi et eget fritidsprogram for unge medarbeidere.

  

For å være aktuell kandidat til stillingen må du kunne sikkerhetsklareres og autoriseres, jfr. Sikkerhetsloven. Les mer om sikkerhetsklarering på www.nsm.no.  

 

Noe reisevirksomhet må påregnes.  

 

Søknader behandles fortløpende 

 

Om oss

Missiles & Aerostructures (DMA) er en divisjon i KONGSBERG med ledende kompetanse innen utvikling, produksjon og leveranse av avanserte missilsystemer og høyteknologiske strukturer til forsvars- og aerospacekunder.

I divisjonen jobber vi med noen av verdens mest avanserte teknologier. Våre ansatte utvikler, sammenstiller, tester og leverer missiler til fartøy, kystartilleri, helikopter og kampfly, blant annet Naval Strike Missile (NSM) og Joint Strike Missile (JSM). Samtidig har divisjonen en teknologisk ledende produksjon av avanserte mekanikk- og komposittstrukturer med ekstremt høye krav til kvalitet og presisjon og pålitelighet. Vi har betydelige leveranser til F-35 kampfly og KONGSBERGs egenutviklede systemer og leverer også vedlikehold av kritiske, dynamiske komponenter til helikoptre, med en avansert testfasilitet som er kapabel til å teste dagens og fremtidige helikopterflåter.

Divisjonen har et høykompetent fagmiljø som leverer kritiske løsninger og teknologi i verdensklasse til forsvars- og aerospacekunder.

KONGSBERG beskytter mennesker og kritisk infrastruktur – fra havdypet til verdensrommet. Vi utvikler innovative teknologier for forsvars-, sikkerhets- og overvåkingsmarkedene, og kombinerer militær og sivil kompetanse. Våre løsninger innen forsvar og sikkerhet omfatter blant annet missiler, våpenstasjoner, luftvern, kommando- og kontrollsystemer og digitale tårn. KONGSBERG leverer også avansert teknologi for hav og rom – fra autonome maritime systemer til satellitter og datatjenester – som bidrar til bærekraft, klimaovervåking, beskyttelse av kritisk infrastruktur og økt sikkerhet. jobs.title: Associate Professor in Software Engineering for Intelligent Interactive Systems
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus on professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 44,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WWHqR5i1FHEAbout the position

The Department of Computer Science at NTNU Gjøvik campus is looking for a candidate for an Associate Professor position in Software Engineering for Intelligent Interactive Systems. The position focuses on advancing research and education in the engineering of intelligent systems designed to perceive, reason, and interact with humans in natural, trustworthy, and socially meaningful ways.


The successful candidate will be affiliated with the Educational Technology Laboratory and will strengthen its research activities, including work on Social Robots, which will be the primary research home for this position. The lab investigates the design, development, and deployment of socially intelligent systems that interact with humans in natural, trustworthy, and beneficial ways. Its research spans responsible and trustworthy human–robot interaction, multimodal perception that combines natural language processing and computer vision, assistive technologies for active ageing and workplace well-being, and the conditions for responsible AI deployment in care and community settings. The new hire is expected to lead and grow the lab's social robotics research strand, contribute to its international collaboration network and strengthen the department's software engineering research profile in AI-enabled application development.

Your immediate leader is the head of the Intelligent Systems and Analytics unit.


Duties of the position

The candidate is expected to:

  • Play a leading role in research and research-based education in software engineering, with a specialization within intelligent interactive systems. This includes securing highly competitive research funding, such as ERC and FRIPRO grants.
  • Take part in the department's research strategy, including shaping the future the direction of intelligent interactive systems, with emphasis on responsible and trustworthy human–robot interaction, the integration of AI/ML components into socially deployed systems, transparency and accountability in AI-driven interactive behavior, and software engineering practice for real-world robotic applications.
  • Contribute to the department's educational profile and an excellent learning environment in collaboration with colleagues, students and external stakeholders.
  • Deliver high-quality teaching at undergraduate, graduate and PhD levels, primarily in software engineering, full-stack development, and programming.
  • Supervise and mentor BSc students, MSc students, PhD candidates and postdoctoral fellows.
  • Engage in applications for external funding, e.g. from the Research Council of Norway, European research and educational agencies, the industry sector and other available sources.
  • Engage in interdisciplinary collaboration and innovation activities.
  • Communicate relevant parts of their research through public outreach, industry engagement, and dissemination activities.
  • Participate in the management of research, education and other relevant academic activities in agreement with the Head of Department.

Required qualification criteria

You must have the following qualifications required for the position of associate professor:

  • The candidate must have a PhD in computer science, or a related field.
  • The candidate must document a relevant research track record (e.g., peer-reviewed publications, active collaborations, and evidence of research independence) in software engineering with a focus on the design and construction of intelligent interactive systems.
  • The candidate must demonstrate strong programming skills and experience.

  • The candidate should demonstrate excellent teaching skills and the ability to teach and develop courses across bachelor and master programmes, and contribute, where needed, to foundational computer science courses (e.g., software engineering, full-stack development, programming).

    The candidate must document relevant basic competence in teaching and supervision at a university/higher education-level, as referenced in the NTNUs guidelines for academic positions. If this cannot be documented, you will be required to complete an approved course in university pedagogy within two years of commencement. NTNU offers qualifying courses.

    New employees who do not speak a Scandinavian language by appointment is required, within three years, to demonstrate skills in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language equivalent to level three of the course for Norwegian for speakers of other languages at the Department of Language and Literature at NTNU. 


Preferred qualifications
  • Research experience in the field of social robotics with responsible and trustworthy AI-human-robot interaction.
  • Have experience in developing specialized platform applications, such as social robotic applications, using relevant frameworks and tools.
  • Familiarity with software architecture patterns appropriate to intelligent interactive systems.
  • Experience integrating AI or ML components into interactive systems for purposes such as multimodal perception, natural language processing and dialogue management, emotion or intent recognition, or behavior and decision-making.
  • Familiarity with frameworks and ecosystems (e.g., Robot Operating System) relevant to intelligent interactive systems.
  • Experience with more than one programming language relevant to the design and implementation of intelligent interactive systems.
  • Experience in teaching software engineering, web development, or AI/ML courses.
  • Experience in interdisciplinary collaboration with industry or public-sector partners.

Personal qualities
  • Enthusiastic: Has the drive to take the extra step to include all students and maintain a good dialogue with them.
  • Willing to learn: Will develop excellent competence over the duration of employment and will learn from experience and feedback from others.
  • Team player: Will work excellently together with colleagues, students and external stakeholders.
  • Communication: The successful candidate will be able to relay information with clarity and ease, both orally and in writing, and solve any challenges that may appear using transparency and honesty.
  • Taking initiative: The successful candidate will seek out new opportunities at work, initiate activities and projects by working independently.

Emphasis will be placed on personal and interpersonal qualities.


We offer 
  • Exciting and challenging tasks in a strong international academic environment 
  • An open and inclusive work environment with dedicated colleagues 
  • Favourable terms in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund 
  • Employee benefits 

Application Process

You can find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

Video: https://youtu.be/bwfNPj8HxHwSalary and conditions

As an Associate Professor (code 1011), you are normally paid from gross NOK 690.000 – 885.000 NOK per annum before tax, depending on qualifications and seniority. As required by law, 2% of this salary will be deducted and paid into the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund.

The engagement is to be made in accordance with the regulations in force concerning State Employees and Civil Servants, and the acts relating to Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology. Candidates who by assessment of the application and attachment are seen to conflict with the criteria in the latter law will be prohibited from recruitment to NTNU.  

After the appointment you must assume that there may be changes in the area of work.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.


About the application

Your application and supporting documentation must be in English.

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. Publications and other scientific work must follow the application.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

If, for any reason, you have taken a career break or have had an atypical career and wish to disclose this in your application, the selection committee will take this into account, recognizing that the quantity of your research may be reduced as a result.

Your application must include:

  • Application letter containing the experience, competence and motivation for the position.
  • CV, diplomas, and certificates
  • A description of the scientific/academic works you consider most relevant, which you particularly wish to be factored into the assessment (up to 10 items)
  • Research plan
  • A teaching portfolio, in which your teaching competence is compiled and presented systematically, (See guidelines for applicants: Documentation of educational competence
  • Link(s) to code repositories or other artefacts demonstrating programming experience
  • Details of projects for which you have served as project manager, including information on financing, duration, and size
  • Names and contact information for three relevant referees

It is important that you both document and reflect on your competence. You are encouraged to use the NTNUs competence matrix as a guide for  documentation of your competence.

Joint work will also be considered. If it is difficult to identify your specific input to a joint project, you must include evidence of your contributions.

In the evaluation of which candidate is best qualified, emphasis will be placed on education, experience and personal and interpersonal qualities. Motivation, ambitions, and potential will also count in the assessment of the candidates. Our assessment of the pedagogical skills will be based on documented pedagogical material, forms of presentation in your academic works, teaching experience, PhD, and Masters supervision, and any other relevant pedagogical background. Both quality and scope will be taken into consideration, and an open scientific practice will be recognized.

NTNU is obliged by the evaluation criteria for research quality in accordance with The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment – DORA and the obligations in the Coalition for Advancing Research Assessment ( CoARA) on responsible assessment of research and recognition of a wider range of academic contributions to science and society. This means that we will pay particular attention to the quality and academic range demonstrated by your scientific work to date. We will also pay attention to research leadership and participation in research projects. Your scientific work from the last five years will be given the most weight.

Your application will be considered by an expert committee. Candidates of interest will be invited to an interview, and to deliver a trial teaching session.


General information

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse, and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals.

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education.  

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability, and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.

-----------------

The city of Gjøvik has a population of 30 000 and is a town known for its rich music and cultural life. The beautiful nature surrounding the city is ideal for an active outdoor life! The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world.

----------------------

As an employee at NTNU, you must continually maintain and improve your professional development and be flexible regarding any organizational changes.

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you want to reserve yourself from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the reservation is not accepted.

For the sake of transparency, candidates will be given expert evaluations of their own and other candidates. As an applicant you are considered part of the process and are stipulated by rules of confidentiality. 

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Deepti Mishra, e-mail deepti.mishra@ntnu.no.

If you have questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact HR, e-mail hr@idi.ntnu.no

Application deadline: 27 October 2026.

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

We are the leading academic IT environment in Norway, and offer a wide range of theoretical and applied IT programmes of study at all levels. jobs.title: Maria söker timvikarier att komplettera sitt stjärnteam av assistenter, är
jobs.description:
Vårt mål är att ha de mest nöjda kunderna samt de mest stoltaste medarbetarna i branschen. Visionen för AssistansExperten är att vara den självklara utföraren av personlig assistans för kunder, anhöriga, medarbetare och beställare med höga kvalitetskrav. Vi är en trygg personlig assistansanordnare som lägger stort hjärta i det vi gör. Vi har den nära kontakten från ett litet bolag och den stora kunskapen från ett stort bolag. Hos oss är du inte en i mängden utan en viktig kugge i vårt dagliga arbete. Vi är måna om vår personal som är ryggraden i vår verksamhet, hos oss får du möjligheterna. att utvecklas i din roll. AssistansExperten´s värdegrund bygger på kompetens, engagemang och värme. Genom hög kompetens säkerställs att varje insats håller hög kvalitet och anpassas efter individens behov. Med genuint engagemang arbetar vi nära våra kunder för att skapa trygghet och delaktighet. Vår värme genomsyrar allt vi gör- vi bemöter varje person med respekt, omtanke och ett stort hjärta. Tillsammans skapar dessa värden en grund för en trygg och meningsfull assistans.

Vi på AssistansExperten söker nu en trygg och erfaren personlig assistent som vill jobba hos vår 17-åriga kund.

Kunden är en glad och social tjej som är 17 år gammal. Hon har nära till bus och skratt och vill nu hitta en ny engagerad och trygg personlig assistent till sitt team som kan hjälpa henne leva ett aktivt och så självständigt liv som möjligt. Hon har en CP-skada, epilepsi och intellektuell funktionsnedsättning och behöver hjälp med det mesta i sin vardag. Du kommer att finnas i hennes närvaro hela tiden för att hon ska kunna få ett väl fungerande liv och må bra och därför är det viktigt att ni trivs bra tillsammans.

Kunden behöver hjälp med allt i vardagen, till exempel vid matsituationer, träning, personlig hygien och vid sina fritidsintressen. På fritiden tycker honom att gå ut på promenader, gunga, springa med sin Race Runner, bygga med lego, lyssna på musik, sjunga, rida, bowla och åka och bada.

Tjejen bor i en villa i Västerås med sin familj så din arbetsplats kommer framförallt att vara hemma hos henne men ni kommer även att åka ut på olika äventyr tillsammans och assistansen sker därför där hon befinner sig. Kunden har beslut på dubbelbemanning vissa delar under dygnet vilket betyder att du ofta kommer att arbeta tillsammans med en kollega.

Kunden har inget eget talat språk men kommunicerar med sin omgivning på en massa olika sätt, bland annat genom kroppsspråk, tecken som stöd och bilder. Som assistent behöver du vara nyfiken och ha en vilja att lära hennes sätt att kommunicera så att i kan förstå varandra på bästa sätt.

Ni kommer att hänga ihop i vått och torrt och vi kommer att utveckla en nära relation till varandra. Därför är det viktigt att personkemin stämmer och att ni trivs ihop. Kunden tycker bäst om att leka och busa med tjejer, så vi ser gärna att du som söker är tjej.

Teamet runt kunden

Du får ett härligt gäng av kollegor som är en sammansvetsad grupp. I teamet sätter vi lojalitet, engagemang, ansvar, delaktighet och glädje som viktiga egenskaper för att passa in och kunna göra ett bra jobb.

För denna tjänst krävs det att du:

    Ser detta uppdrag som långsiktigt
    Är rökfri
    Är simkunnig
    Tycker om lek & bus
    Är lugn, trygg, tålmodig och inkännande
    Har hög ansvarskänsla och är flexibel
    Är en pigg och driven person
    Är arbetsvillig och lojal
    Behärskar det svenska språket obehindrat i tal och skrift
    Erfarenhet av CP-skada & epilepsi är meriterande
    Det är önskvärt att du har körkort
    Stor vikt kommer att läggas på personlig lämplighet

Anställningsform: Timvikarie

Arbetstider: Dag, kväll, helg. Det kan även vara aktuellt med vaken nattjänstgöring så småningom.

Lön: Fast timlön enligt överenskommelse. Övriga ersättningar enligt kollektivavtal.

Tillträde: Omgående

Krav: Du behöver ha ett giltigt polisregisterutdrag. En rekommendation är att du beställer utdraget till din digitala brevlåda, då kommer det oftast inom någon dag. Om du inte har en digital brevlåda beställer du utdraget med posten och det kan då ta någon vecka att få hem så beställ gärna ett sådant redan nu. Du beställer det genom polisens hemsida:

https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/barn-med-funktionsnedsattning/

jobs.title: Thesis project: Reinforcement Learning (RL) for Autonomous Forklift Testing
jobs.description:
Are you interested in reinforcement learning, autonomous systems, and finding the limits of intelligent software? At Toyota Material Handling, you will investigate how reinforcement learning can be used to automatically generate challenging test scenarios for autonomous forklift software and discover failures and edge cases more efficiently.

In your Master Thesis at Toyota, you will work on:

    Develop and evaluate a reinforcement learning approach for generating test scenarios for autonomous forklift software.
    Work with an existing simulation and testing environment and explore how reinforcement learning can interact with it.
    Define relevant scenario parameters and investigate how the learning process can be guided toward challenging or interesting operating conditions.
    Compare reinforcement learning with simpler scenario-generation approaches, such as random testing and other search or optimization methods.
    Analyze discovered failure scenarios and evaluate test coverage, failure discovery rate, and testing efficiency.
    Investigate whether failure scenarios discovered in simulation can be reproduced and validated on a physical autonomous truck.

The thesis will be carried out with support from Toyota Material Handling, including guidance on the existing testing environment, available data, and autopilot system. As this is an exploratory research project, well-founded partial results are considered valuable outcomes, and the goal is not to deliver a production-ready solution.
Validation of autonomous forklift software requires testing across a large number of operating conditions. Warehouse layouts, obstacles, pallet locations, vehicle configurations, traffic, and other environmental factors create a scenario space that is difficult to cover through manually designed test cases alone.
The purpose of this thesis is to investigate whether reinforcement learning can be used to intelligently generate test scenarios. Rather than controlling the forklift, the RL agent selects the conditions under which the autonomous forklift is tested. Based on the outcome of previous tests, the agent learns which areas of the scenario space are more likely to expose failures, unexpected behavior, or challenging edge cases.
The approach will be evaluated against simpler testing strategies to determine whether reinforcement learning can improve failure discovery, test coverage, or testing efficiency. An important outcome will be an objective assessment of when RL provides value and when simpler approaches may be sufficient.

SCOPE
2 persons / 30 ECTS each

Requirements:
For this master thesis, we are looking for students with following educations or equivalent:

    M.Sc. in Computer Science or Artificial Intelligence or equivalent
    M.Sc. in Robotics or Autonomous Systems or equivalent
    M.Sc. in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering field
    A background in machine learning and reinforcement learning, together with good programming skills, is beneficial. Experience or interest in autonomous systems, optimization, mechanical and electrical knowledge, simulation, or software testing is considered an advantage.

Who is Toyota Material Handling?
Toyota Material Handling is a global leader in material handling, and we are making significant investments to meet the needs of the future. At our site in Mjölby, 3,000 employees work across the entire material handling value chain, from development concepts to finished vehicles. Our product range spans from manual hand trucks to autonomous vehicles and innovative energy solutions.
At Toyota Material Handling, we strive to create a friendly, safe and forward-thinking workplace. Our culture is built on Toyota's core values, where respect and consideration guide us in our daily work. Our ambition is to strengthen our competitiveness by increasing diversity across the organization and embracing our differences.

January 2027

Your application can be written in English or Swedish.

jobs.description:
Teknisk Säljare till ProvideU

Är du tekniskt nyfiken, affärsdriven och gillar att bygga relationer samt vill vara med på en spännande tillväxtresa?

Hos ProvideU får du en central roll i ett växande entreprenörsdrivet företag med korta beslutsvägar där du ges stort eget ansvar och goda möjligheter att påverka både din egen och företagets utveckling.

Vad kommer du att göra?

Som Teknisk Säljare ansvarar du för att utveckla både nya och befintliga kundrelationer. Du identifierar affärsmöjligheter, driver försäljningsaktiviteter och verkar som kundens strategiska partner genom hela affärsprocessen, från första förfrågan och behovsanalys till kalkylering, offert, förhandling och långsiktigt affärsansvar.

Sekisui Alveo ontwikkelt en produceert hoogwaardige polyolefineschuimen voor diverse industriële marktsegmenten. In Roermond werken ze met moderne productietechnieken in een driestapsproces, bestaande uit extrusie, crosslinking en foamen. Als Scrap Operator speel je een belangrijke rol in het hergebruik van grondstoffen binnen de productie. Jij zorgt ervoor dat afgekeurde sheet- en trimafval worden verwerkt tot opnieuw bruikbare grondstoffen. Daarbij ben je verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Je slaat gemalen grondstof correct op en zet deze tijdig klaar.
  • Je maakt molens schoon en controleert de staat van de machines.
  • Je signaleert onderhoudsbehoeften en afwijkingen.
  • Je voert logistieke werkzaamheden uit binnen de productieafdeling.
  • Je werkt volgens veiligheids-, kwaliteits- en milieuregels.
  • Je zorgt voor orde en netheid volgens de 5S-methodiek.
  • Je beschikt over concrete en aantoonbare werkervaring als Operator in een soortgelijke werkomgeving.
  • Je hebt affiniteit met productieprocessen (kennis van extrusie is een pré).
  • Je werkt veilig, nauwkeurig en gestructureerd.
  • Je bent fysiek in staat om in een industriële omgeving te werken.
  • Je bent in het bezit van een geldig hef- en reachtruckcertificaat of bent bereid dit te behalen.

jobs.description: Per conto di una realtà tecnologica di grandi dimensioni, operante in un contesto internazionale, siamo alla ricerca di un/una Senior Cyber Security Engineer da inserire all'interno di un team Cyber Security strutturato. La risorsa entrerà a far parte di una funzione tecnica che opera trasversalmente a supporto delle diverse aree IT, Software e Business del Gruppo, contribuendo alla progettazione, evoluzione e miglioramento dei servizi e dei controlli di Cyber Security. Cerchiamo un professionista con una buona seniority tecnica e una visione trasversale della sicurezza, capace di andare oltre la gestione operativa degli incidenti e contribuire all'evoluzione dell'ecosistema Cyber aziendale. Principali responsabilità La persona sarà coinvolta in attività quali: supporto a nuovi progetti IT e Software secondo principi di Security by Design, attraverso security review e definizione dei requisiti di sicurezza; definizione ed evoluzione dei controlli di Cloud Security, principalmente in ambienti Microsoft Azure e AWS; presidio delle tematiche di Identity Security, con particolare riferimento a Microsoft Entra ID e Active Directory; valutazione e scouting di nuove tecnologie e servizi messi a disposizione dai principali cloud e security provider; evoluzione dei servizi di Cyber Security Monitoring, collaborando con il SOC esterno e contribuendo al tuning delle piattaforme SIEM e dei relativi controlli di detection; attività di Vulnerability Management su componenti infrastrutturali e applicative; evoluzione dei presidi di sicurezza relativi a Firewall, WAF, endpoint, infrastrutture e ambienti Cloud; supporto ad attività di Incident Response e miglioramento continuo dei relativi processi e controlli; partecipazione alla definizione di iniziative di Purple Teaming, finalizzate all'identificazione delle aree di miglioramento della postura difensiva; confronto con Software Architect, Service Manager, team IT e Business per integrare i requisiti Cyber all'interno di nuovi servizi e applicazioni; supporto, quando necessario, nel confronto con clienti enterprise sui presidi di sicurezza adottati nei servizi erogati. Profilo ricercato Cerchiamo un professionista con esperienza in ambito Cyber Security Engineering, Cloud Security, Infrastructure Security o Security Architecture, maturata in contesti aziendali strutturati o all'interno di società di consulenza tecnologica. Non è necessario aver maturato esperienza approfondita in tutte le aree indicate. Sarà particolarmente interessante una solida competenza in una o più delle seguenti: Cloud Security in ambienti Azure e/o AWS; Identity & Access Security, Entra ID / Active Directory; Security Engineering e definizione di security controls; Cyber Security Monitoring e tecnologie SIEM/XDR; Vulnerability Management; Infrastructure & Network Security; Application Security / Security by Design. Saranno considerate un plus esperienze in ambito Microsoft Security, Microsoft 365 Security, Incident Response, Purple Teaming e attività di security assessment. È richiesta una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Offerta RAL indicativa: €50.000 - €60.000 + MBO, valutabile in funzione dell'esperienza; inserimento diretto a tempo indeterminato; modalità di lavoro ibrida con 2 giorni alla settimana in presenza a Bologna; #LI-AM2

Principali responsabilità Gestire l'intero ciclo di vita della commessa di nuova costruzione, dall'avvio alla consegna finale dell'unità. Pianificare e monitorare il programma generale di commessa, assicurando milestone e scadenze contrattuali. Coordinare funzioni interne e stakeholder (Ufficio Tecnico, Produzione, Procurement, Qualità, HSE, AFC/Controllo di Gestione). Gestire la parte economica della commessa: predisposizione e monitoraggio di budget/forecast, controllo costi, cash flow, analisi scostamenti e azioni correttive a tutela della marginalità. Selezionare e gestire fornitori/subappaltatori/partner: valutazione offerte, controllo prestazioni e gestione criticità/ritardi. Gestire la relazione con Cliente/Armatore/Classifica/Autorità: governance, riunioni di avanzamento, comunicazioni e reporting. Governare aspetti contrattuali e tecnici (varianti, change order, extra work, claim) e assicurare commissioning/HAT/prove in mare, chiusura punch list, non conformità e documentazione finale. Il Profilo Ideale Formazione: Laurea in Ingegneria Navale (valutabili Ingegneria Meccanica/Industriale o titoli equivalenti con consolidata esperienza nel settore). Esperienza: - Consolidata esperienza (almeno 8-10 anni) nel ruolo di Project Manager nel settore navale con un focus sulla costruzione navale o in società del settore marittimo. - Preferibile esperienza presso primari cantieri navali internazionali. - Esperienza su commesse di elevato valore economico e complessità tecnica. Competenze tecniche/gestionali: - Conoscenza dei processi e delle fasi di costruzione navale. - Buona conoscenza di strutture navali, impianti di bordo e discipline tecniche. - Capacità di lettura e interpretazione di specifiche tecniche, contratti, disegni costruttivi e documentazione di commessa. Lingue - Ottimo inglese scritto e parlato (seconda lingua preferenziale). Competenze personali - Leadership su team multidisciplinari e forte orientamento al risultato. - Decision making in contesti complessi, pianificazione e gestione priorità. - Flessibilità e disponibilità a trasferte. Industry- Automotive

Location- Stockholm

Language- Swedish and English

Handle monthly bookkeeping, including invoices, bank statements, and journal entries.

Manage fixed assets, including acquisitions, disposals, and depreciation.

Strong knowledge of bookkeeping, payroll, VAT, and financial reporting.

    

Proficiency in accounting systems and Microsoft Excel.

    

Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
