jobs.title: International Field Service Representative Silvus
jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Description

Silvus Technologies, a Motorola Solutions company, is dedicated to one mission: connecting those who keep us safe. We do so by delivering the most advanced Mobile Ad-hoc Network (MANET) radios powered by our custom and ever evolving Mobile-Networked MIMO waveform. Together, our radios and waveform provide vital communications for mission-critical applications in the harshest environments from underground tunnels to high-altitude balloons. Silvus StreamCaster™ radios are being rapidly adopted by customers all over the world ranging from the U.S. and Allied Nations Departments of Defense to International, Federal, State, and Local Law Enforcement agencies, all the way to the Superbowl, Grammys, and industry-leading drone, robot, and unmanned systems manufacturers. Would you like to join an incredibly talented group of people, doing very challenging work, with the prime directive of “Keeping Our Heroes Connected”? Silvus’ rapid growth is fueled by a focus on research and innovation and a team of the most passionate, skilled, and creative thinking individuals. If you are looking for a challenging experience, you owe it to yourself to learn how Silvus can be the next chapter of your career.

Job Description

We are seeking an International Field Service Representative (IFSR) to work closely with the international Silvus team to provide our customers with tailored solutions to meet their needs. This role participates in technical demonstrations, support, and sales of the Silvus family of advanced multi- antenna MIMO radio and mesh networking solutions. This position plays a key role in influencing product development.

This position reports to the Senior Sales Engineer and is a 100% remote role.

Candidates must be based in Sweden.

The following is a list of at least some of the current essential job functions of the position. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time at its discretion.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

    Provide pre-sales and post-sales technical support including system planning, customer training, system optimization, etc.
    Become an expert on the operation and application of Silvus' unique radio and networking solutions and its advantages over competing technologies.
    Prepare and conduct product demonstrations for customer visits and equipment evaluations.
    Visit customer sites to provide technical support and deliver training.
    Troubleshoot failures and abnormal situations in the field.
    Collect and analyze field failures and abnormalities and provide feedback to the development team.
    Help the Design Engineers reproduce and troubleshoot problems.
    Travel up to 75% of the time and work on-site at the customer's location.

Basic Requirements

    Completion of secondary education (such as GCSEs or an equivalent national qualification; High School Diploma or GED) is required.
    Experience as a Field Service Representative or equivalent.
    Experience in supporting the Ministry of Defense tactical communications with a focus on data networks and radios.
    Proficiency with TCP/IP protocol and networking.
    Basic proficiency in English (reading and writing) is required.
    Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
    Must be based in Sweden.
    Willingness to travel to potential conflict areas in support of radios.

PREFERRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

    Proficiency with radio frequency instruments such as signal generators and spectrum analyzers.
    Experience with operating and testing IP radios/modems is a huge plus.
    Knowledge of wireless communication systems, radio frequency signal propagation, and digital communication technologies.
    Proficiency with programming languages such as C/C++.
    Familiarity with Linux.
    Preferred Military background.

WORKING CONDITIONS & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

    Trade shows.
    Outdoor environment for demonstrations.
    Occasional exposure to heat, cold, and allergens while performing tests or demonstrations in the field.
    Lift equipment up to 50 lbs. for the set-up of demonstrations and testing.

jobs.title: Nattresepsjonist, Scandic Byporten, heltid 70%
jobs.description:
VI HAR ROM FOR DEG
Resepsjonist som vil være der det skjer

Etter en lang dag på reise er det få ting som er mer hyggelig enn å møte et vennlig ansikt som ønsker deg varmt velkommen. Det gjør vi i resepsjonen på Scandic Byporten hver dag.

Resepsjonen er også hotellets naturlige møtepunkt, så du kommer til å være i sentrum av der det skjer. Vi vet ikke alltid hvilke utfordringer vi kan møte på under en arbeidsdag, men vi vet at når vi samkjører avdelingene på hotellet, så kommer alle til å slutte opp om våre gjesters ønskemål. Dette gjør vi sammen!.

**Dine arbeidsoppgaver som resepsjonist: **

  • Inn og utsjekking av våre gjester i vårt system Opera/Scorpio
  • Renhold av lobbyområde
  • Koordinere med alle avdelinger for å oppfylle våre gjesters ønsker og behov
  • Påfyll av varer
  • Bidra til mer salg
  • Servering fra bar
  • Ta del i og aktivt arbeide med avdelingsmålene
  • Ta imot bookinger
  • Svare på spørsmål i fra våre gjester, både elektronisk og over skranke
  • Kassehåndtering

Vi har gode utviklingsmuligheter i vår organisasjon. Hvis du har ønske og ambisjoner om utvikling, vil du få mulighet til å vokse hos oss!

Erfaring og kvalifikasjoner som vi ønsker at du har og kan dele med oss:

  • Fagbrev som resepsjonist eller erfaring med lignende jobb innen servicebransjen
  • Snakker et av de skandinaviske språkene og engelsk flytende
  • Barkunnskaper
  • Saluttkurs

Personlige egenskaper vi ser etter hos deg:

  • Kvalitetsbevisst med salg og service i ryggraden
  • Operativ, fleksibel og serviceinnstilt
  • Pålitelig
  • Evne til å takle høyt arbeidspress

Oslos mest sentrale hotell som år etter år ligger i topp på service søker nå en ny stjerne-kollega til natt. Hovedsakelig arbeidstid er fra 23.00-07.00. Dette er en stilling på 70% hvor turnusen er en uke på, en uke av med mulighet for ekstrajobb i friuken sin. Like viktig som det er å yte best mulig service stiller vi høye krav til at man tenker sikkerhet. I tillegg skal du føle deg komfortabel med bardrift da det er en barception du vil jobbe i. Du må ha fyllt 20 år. Har du erfaring fra opera/scorpio er det et stort pluss.

Kandidater vil bli vurdert fortløpende så ikke vent med å søke :)
Startdato etter avtale.

Vi verdsetter mangfold og inkludering på arbeidsplassen vår og er interessert i å lære mer om dine behov og eventuelle tilrettelegginger som kan støtte deg i å lykkes i denne rollen. Vi oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke uavhengig av funksjonsnivå eller bakgrunn.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Alt starter med deg. Å jobbe på et av våre hoteller betyr å være en del av et team der omtanke, samarbeid og små øyeblikk i hverdagen gjør en forskjell. Du er med på å skape den varme, hjemmekoselig følelsen som kjennetegner Scandic – ved å være til stede, her og nå, og la detaljene telle.

Noen dager går fort, andre er mer forutsigbare – ingen dager er helt like. Men det som alltid består, er lagånden. Dere stiller opp for hverandre, løser ting når de oppstår og er stolte av å levere kvalitet – selv når tempoet er høyt. Og når dere gjør det, vil gjestene ikke bare nyte oppholdet – de får lyst til å komme tilbake.

Slik jobber vi i Scandic

Vi er på vårt beste når vi jobber sammen – på tvers av roller, hoteller og team – og fokuserer på det som virkelig gjør en forskjell i hverdagen. Våre verdier veileder oss i hvordan vi møter hverandre og hvordan vi leverer: Be Pro, Be Bold, Be Caring og Be You.

Hvis du mener at ekte gjestfrihet skapes gjennom samarbeid, jevn kvalitet og små øyeblikk gjort godt, vil du føle deg hjemme hos oss.

jobs.title: Principal Account Manager
jobs.description:
AWS is seeking a world-class sales professional to lead and grow our strategic relationship with one of the largest global Telco customer. As a Principal Account Manager within AWS Global Telco, you will drive digital transformation through strategic engagement with C-level executives, IT decision-makers, and key business leaders across one of AWS's most strategic global accounts.

You will define and execute a comprehensive account strategy that drives revenue growth, deepens customer adoption across the full AWS portfolio — including compute, networking, storage, AI/ML, Generative AI, and edge solutions — and positions AWS as the preferred cloud partner for next-generation telco workloads. This role requires deep understanding of the telecommunications industry, to support transforming their business models through cloud adoption.

On a daily basis, you will empower your customer to solve complex challenges, delivering measurable business outcomes while guiding them to become more agile, innovative, and efficient. You will establish AWS as the strategic cloud technology provider, leveraging the fastest pace of innovation, broadest and deepest functionality, most secure computing environment, and most proven operational expertise in the industry.

Do you look around corners for ways to engage and service customers? Are you passionate about using technology to solve business problems with significant customer impact?

Come build the future with us.

Key job responsibilities

Account Strategy & Revenue Growth: Define and execute a comprehensive account strategy for a global Telco provider, driving revenue targets and long-term growth. Work backwards from the customer's business needs to accelerate adoption of the most appropriate AWS services and programs.

Customer Business Outcomes: Create compelling value propositions around AWS products, services, and partnership programs (co-sell, co-build, Marketplace) to consistently deliver on desired customer outcomes — including SaaS transformation, GenAI adoption, and cloud-native network solutions.

Executive & Technical Engagement: Engage at the C-Suite level as well as with software architects and engineering teams. Use interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders from technical teams to executives, ensuring short-term technology decisions align with long-term business goals.

Solution-Led Selling: Drive solutions discussions diving deep into complex challenges — including modernization, migration, AI/ML, and infrastructure optimization for telco workloads. Recommend AWS products and services aligned with how the Telco delivers solutions to their end customers (Telco operators globally).

Cross-Functional Orchestration: Partner with Solutions Architects, Technical Account Managers, Professional Services, Partner teams, and GTM resources to define and execute strategy. Coordinate global resources across regions to support the ISV's worldwide customer base.

Pipeline Development: Build and manage a robust pipeline across the ISV's end-customer opportunities, identifying new workloads in GenAI, SaaS, network transformation, and managed services.

About the team

The team is a high-performing, customer-obsessed sales team within the AWS Global Telco organization, covering the largest global telecommunications providers and ISVs. This role will focus on a major multinational telco network equipment provider, driving AWS adoption across their product portfolio and internal IT transformation.

About the team

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

    Experience in sales or sales management of infrastructure or cloud technology
    Experience working with, presenting to, and negotiating with C-level executives, IT, lines of business, procurement, finance, legal and internal stakeholders for sizeable commercial/enterprise deals
    Bachelor's degree, or MBA in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent
    Experience creating and implementing long-term transformational account strategies in a customer-facing role or equivalent
    - Knowledge of the Telecommunications industry

Preferred qualifications

    Experience with the AWS platform, web services, software development, or related technologies
    Experience and track record of exceeding sales goals
    Bachelor's degree or equivalent in MBA highly desired
    Track record of winning in competitive/challenger account environments where you are not the incumbent

Det er en ny og spennende erfaring for meg å ha assistent, men jeg ser fram til å bli kjent med deg og utvikle et godt samarbeid. Jeg trives godt med å jobbe sammen med andre, så dette kan fort gå veldig bra. Jeg er utdannet og jobber som lærer fra hjemmekontoret mitt noen timer i uka. Det er derfor viktig at du kan jobbe selvstendig, men med tilstrekkelig veiledning fra meg når det er nødvendig.

 

Stilling: Jeg har behov for tilkallingsassistenter som kan jobbe ved fravær og ved skoleferier, men det vil være mulighet for fast stilling fra nyåret av.

 

Arbeidstid:

Arbeidstiden din vil hovedsakelig være fra kl. 08.30 til 14.00 alle hverdager (mandag-fredag). Det vil ikke være helgearbeid i denne stillingen. 

 

Arbeidsoppgaver:

Husarbeid

Matlaging

Assistanse til personlig stell ved behov

Assistanse med påkledning

Assistere i fysioterapiøvelser 

Assistanse ved toalettbesøk

Kjøre meg til lege/sykehus og annen oppfølging ved behov

Være med på turer ut til handling eller annet

 

Jeg søker deg som kan være mine armer og bein når jeg trenger det. Det er et pluss om du liker å lage mat og kan jobbe selvstendig. Også fint at du er positiv, løsningsorientert og tåler litt galgenhumor. Jeg ser fram til å møte deg!

Vi tilbyr (Prima Assistanse)

  • En meningsfull jobb som bidrar til likestilling
  • Lønn og arbeidsvilkår etter tariffavtale
  • Grundig opplæring og tett oppfølging
  • En selvstendig jobb med varierte oppgaver


Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: Senior Digital Design Engineer for ASIC Development
jobs.description:
Take digital ASIC designs from early concepts all the way to mass production.



We are strengthening our ASIC Design Team at Murata Finland and are looking for a Senior Digital Design Engineer to join us in Vantaa, Finland. We work in a hybrid model, so partial remote work is possible.

Murata Finland develops leading-edge gyroscope and accelerometer safety-critical sensors for global automotive, industrial and healthcare markets. We design full-custom mixed-mode ASICs from concept to volume production, including wafer-level testing.



Your role

As a Senior Digital Design Engineer, you will work on digital ASIC design from early concept development through to mass production ramp-up. You will collaborate with design partners, Murata lead engineers, product managers and the design team throughout the development process.



What you bring

We are looking for an experienced digital design professional with:

- Technical education (e.g. B.Sc., M.Sc., Ph.D. or D.Sc.) with an emphasis on digital microelectronics
- 3+ years of experience in digital design
- Experience in Verilog (or VHDL) RTL coding
- Experience in design verification using digital design tools
- Understanding of the RTL-to-GDSII flow
- A proactive, systematic and careful way of working
- Fluent communication skills in English
- Good communication skills and the ability to understand various requirements and communicate effectively with external partners and internal teams
- An innovative mindset and interest in working in an international environment



Additional experience we value

Experience in any of the following areas is considered an advantage:

- Architecture planning and functional specification
- Implementation of DSP algorithms, such as FIR or IIR filters and floating-point MAC (Multiply and Accumulate) calculations
- Digital interfaces: SPI, I2C, I3C or PSI5
- Test bench reference models using e.g. Matlab, Simulink or Python
- Verification environments: UVM (Universal Verification Methodology) based on SV (SystemVerilog) or CocoTB (Coroutine cosimulation testbench) based on Python
- ATPG (Automatic Test Pattern Generation) and LBIST (Logic Built-In Self-Test)
- FPGA, e.g. as a development environment, for customer emulator use or test support
- Digital backend design, including synthesis, timing analysis, DFT, layout and power analysis



How we work

Our culture is based on two values: employee satisfaction and customer satisfaction. Together, we have defined what these values mean in practice in what we call our cultural etiquette.

For us, employee satisfaction means helping each other, treating each other equally and in a friendly manner, and maintaining an open discussion culture. Customer satisfaction means being proactive and innovative and considering our customers needs in what we do. Would this kind of work community suit you?



Small technology, real-world impact

We believe that the tiniest things can have the greatest impact. With our innovative sensor technology, cars remain in their lanes, peoples hearts keep beating and bridges do not collapse.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology that contributes to the advancement of society. The combination of our Finnish and Japanese capabilities will enable safe and autonomous driving – in all places.



Interested?

For more information, please contact the hiring manager Teemu Salo tel. +358 50 327 8984 or e-mail teemu.salo@murata.com, who will be happy to tell you more about Murata and the position.

Please send your application, resume and salary expectations by 18 October 2026 via the application link. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

Read more about Murata at www.muratafinland.com and follow us in LinkedIn (Murata), Instagram (@muratafinland) and Facebook (@MurataFinland).



From our News & Stories, you can read more about what it's like to work at Murata and find out if Murata is the right workplace for you! You can read about the different teams, the study and career path opportunities, as well as how development and growth appear at Murata, from product development to production work.

jobs.title: Natportier på fuld tid – vær med til at etablere Danmarks første Citybox-hotel

Om Citybox

Citybox er en nordisk hotelkæde med hoteller i flere europæiske lande og et koncept bygget på enkelhed, høj kvalitet og smarte digitale løsninger. Målet er at gøre hoteloplevelsen nem, effektiv og tilgængelig – uden at gå på kompromis med kvaliteten.

Som natportier er du hotellets ansvarlige vært i nattetimerne. Du sikrer, at vores gæster føler sig trygge, velkomne og godt hjulpet gennem hele natten.

  • Samarbejde med hotellets øvrige afdelinger for at sikre en sammenhængende gæsteoplevelse.

  • Bidrage aktivt til implementeringen af Citybox-konceptet og tage nye systemer, digitale løsninger og arbejdsgange i brug.

  • Sikre, at hotellets procedurer, kvalitetsstandarder og sikkerhedskrav overholdes.

Arbejdet ligger primært om natten og omfatter vagter på hverdage, i weekender og på helligdage.

  • Har erfaring fra hotel, reception, service eller en anden relevant branche.

  • Trives med at arbejde om natten og kan arbejde selvstændigt.

  • Er stabil, ansvarsbevidst og møder til tiden.

  • Er serviceminded, imødekommende og professionel i din fremtoning.

  • Bevarer roen og overblikket, når der opstår uforudsete situationer.

  • Kan træffe selvstændige beslutninger og tage ansvar for hotellets drift om natten.

  • Har gode administrative evner og er fortrolig med IT og digitale løsninger.

  • Trives i et miljø præget af udvikling og forandring og er åben over for nye systemer, procedurer og måder at arbejde på.

  • Taler og skriver dansk eller et andet skandinavisk sprog samt engelsk.

  • Er en god kollega, som bidrager positivt til samarbejdet og hotellets kultur.

Det er vigtigt, at du er tryg ved at arbejde alene i dele af vagten, og at du forstår det ansvar, der følger med at være hotellets primære kontaktperson i nattetimerne.

Vi tilbyder

  • En fuldtidsstilling med selvstændigt ansvar og varierede arbejdsopgaver.

  • En unik mulighed for at være med til etableringen af Danmarks første Citybox-hotel.

  • Mulighed for at følge og bidrage til en spændende transformation.

  • Indflydelse på nye arbejdsgange, processer og gæsteoplevelser.

  • Et internationalt arbejdsmiljø med engagerede kolleger.

  • Grundig oplæring i hotellets systemer, procedurer og sikkerhedsforhold.

  • Faglig og personlig udvikling.

  • Gode ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

  • Personalegoder, sundhedsforsikring og sociale arrangementer.

Stillingen ønskes besat snarest muligt.

Ansættelse snarest muligt. Interviews afholdes løbende, så skynd dig, at sende din ansøgning

Hvis du motiveres af gæsteservice, selvstændigt ansvar og muligheden for at blive en del af transformationen til Danmarks første Citybox-hotel, glæder vi os til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV.

jobs.title: Vi søger en souschef der vil tage ansvar for et køkken ved havet

Stedet

Charlottenlund Fort er bygget i 1886 som kystforsvar nord for København. I dag er det en restaurant med 180° udsigt over Øresund, plads til 140 gæster indendørs. Vi laver à la carte til daglige gæster og selskaber op til høj gastronomi — bryllupper, firmafester, private events. Maden er fransk-nordisk og sæsonbaseret.

Det er en destination. Folk tager aktivt herud. Det giver en anden stemning end en byrestaurant — og en anden stolthed over arbejdspladsen.

Hvad du laver

Du arbejder tæt på køkkenchefen og er ansvarlig for køkkenet når han ikke er der. Du holder overblik over daglig produktion, selskaber og personalet i køkkenet. Du er med til at udvikle menuer og sæsonretter, og du sætter standarden for kvalitet og tempo i hverdagen.

Vi leder efter en der

–    Er uddannet kok med solid erfaring fra seriøst køkken

–    Har prøvet at lede og koordinere andre i et travlt køkken

–    Tager ejerskab — også på en svær aften

–    Kommunikerer klart og skaber ro i køkkenet under pres

–    Har ambitioner uden at det går ud over teamet

–    Trives med variation: selskaber, à la carte, sæsonmenuer

 

DET PRAKTISKE

Løn

Fra 35.000 kr./md.

Lønnen afhænger af

Erfaring og niveau

Vagter

Typisk 3-4 vagter/uge, primært 10-22

Fast fri

Mandage + hver anden weekend

Arbejdssted

Charlottenlund Fort, Strandvejen 150

Snarest muligt

Vi lover ikke Michelin-drømme eller "en plads i en familie". Vi tilbyder et seriøst køkken, en usædvanlig arbejdsplads og en reel lederrolle. Hvis du er klar til at tage ansvar og vil arbejde et sted der faktisk giver noget at arbejde med, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

gustav@charlottenlundfortet.dk

Skriv "Souschef til køkkenet" i emnefeltet.

jobs.title: Thesis: Evaluate AI Agents&AIOps for DevOps Practices Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Company description:

"Founded in 1927, the Volvo Group is committed to driving prosperity and shaping the future landscape through sustainable transport, mobility, and infrastructure solutions. By offering trucks, buses, construction equipment, power solutions for marine and industrial applications, financing and services that increase our customers’ uptime and productivity. Our headquarters are in Gothenburg, Sweden. Volvo Group shares are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm."

Job description:

Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

    What do we do in VAS?  

The DevOps Group within Volvo Autonomous Solutions (VAS) is responsible for the Software Factory and provides Test Automation and Orchestration frameworks that enable efficient software development and validation.







We deliver the frameworks, tools, services, and engineering capabilities that allow development and verification teams to build, test, deploy, and operate software efficiently. Our responsibilities span the entire software delivery ecosystem, including source control management, CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, container platforms, infrastructure services, test orchestration, and observability solutions.







Together, these capabilities form our Software Factory, which accelerates software delivery, improves software quality, increases automation, and promotes DevOps best practices across the organization.







Description of the Area



As part of our Software Factory, VAS has developed Octopus, an in-house workflow orchestration platform designed to automate and streamline engineering processes across the software development and validation lifecycle.







As we evolve from a traditional DevOps organization toward a Platform Engineering operating model, we are exploring how Artificial Intelligence (AI), AI Agents, and AIOps can transform platform operations and software delivery. This thesis will investigate how AI-driven capabilities can be integrated into the Octopus platform to enhance automation, operational efficiency, and developer experience.







Using Octopus as the experimental environment, the study will evaluate how the role of DevOps engineers may evolve, identify operational activities that can benefit from AI assistance or autonomous execution by AI agents, and determine where human oversight remains essential. The work will also explore governance, reliability, security, compliance, and competency considerations required for the safe and successful adoption of AI-enabled operations.

     Thesis Description  

This thesis investigates how AI Agents and AIOps can reshape DevOps practices and accelerate the transition toward Platform Engineering within Volvo Autonomous Solutions (VAS).







Through an industrial case study using the Octopus platform, the research will analyze:




    How AI impacts the role and responsibilities of DevOps engineers.
    Which operational activities are suitable for AI-assisted execution.
    Which activities can be safely automated through autonomous AI agents.
    Where human decision-making, accountability, and oversight must remain mandatory.
    The governance, reliability, security, compliance, and operational requirements for AI-enabled platforms.
    The skills, competencies, and organizational capabilities required for future Platform Engineering teams.







The outcome will be an evidence-based adoption framework that provides a structured and low-risk approach for introducing AIOps and AI Agents within VAS. The study will help define how Octopus can evolve from a workflow orchestration platform into an intelligent Platform Engineering capability while maintaining appropriate guardrails, operational control, security, and human accountability.

     Ready for the next move?  

Are you excited to bring your skills and disruptive ideas to the table? We can’t wait to hear from you. Apply today!



Questions?



Contact: shilpa.avasarala@volvo.com

    

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.







Who we are and what we believe in We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.







Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.







Part of Volvo Group, Volvo Autonomous Solutions accelerates the development, commercialization and sales of autonomous transport solutions, focusing on defined segments for the on- and off-road space. The combination of strong tech expertise and skilled customer solutions creates innovative transport offers never seen before. We are constantly pushing our own skills and ability to drive change in a traditional industry to meet a growing customer demand. We are now looking for innovative, committed individuals to join us in our endeavor to create customer solutions that enhance safety, flexibility and productivity.

jobs.title: Associate Professor in Clinical Pharmacy
jobs.description:
Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy, and Environmental Medicine at the Department of Public Health, Faculty of Health, University of Southern Denmark, is offering a new 5-year (20%) position for an Associate Professor within clinical pharmacy. The position is to be filled from February 1st, 2027.

The academic position

The research areas of Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy and Environmental Medicine (CPPEM) span from pharmacological epidemiology to clinical studies and cell-based basic pharmacology. CPPEM has a strong background in investigations of exposure to environmental chemicals, pharmacoepidemiology, pharmacogenetics, pharmacokinetics, drug-drug interactions, and therapeutic drug monitoring. The academic position is affiliated with the pharmacoepidemiologic research group, that utilizes the Danish registries to assess pharmacological questions in large populations. 

The area of research is flexible within the area of pharmacoepidemiologic and clinical research and could be (but is not limited to) drug use patterns and rational pharmacotherapy. The department has a strong focus on interdisciplinary collaboration both in-house and with external researchers and the new person is expected to continue this tradition.
 

Areas of responsibility

The applicant will be expected to establish their own research area within the pharmacoepidemiologic research group at the department. Thus, the applicant should be able to attract external research funding to support research and employ scientific and technical staff. The applicant may have a background within pharmacy or medicine.

The research unit teaches in four educations: Medicine, Pharmacy, Chiropractor, and Biomedicine, and the position comes with teaching obligations within these subjects at the University as well as supervision of bachelor and master projects. Additionally, we expect that you will contribute to administrative duties, e.g., participating in Study Board or other similar activities. 

Fluent English (both written and spoken) is required. You are expected to have qualifications that renders it probable that you will be able to establish your own research area within the research unit. Further, you are required to have a PhD degree or similar research experience. 
 

Employers

Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy and Environmental Medicine today has approximately 50 employees. It consists of three separate research groups: pharmacoepidemiology, translational pharmacology, and environmental medicine. Additionally, it collaborates closely with the Department of Pharmacology at OUH. Collectively, this constitutes Denmark’s largest center for research, teaching and clinical service in pharmacology.

It produces approximately 100 international peer-reviewed publications per year. 

Professor Tore B. Stage heads the unit and Professor Pernille Tanggaard Andersen heads the Department.


Management

The Associate Professor answers to the research leader for the unit of Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy and Environmental Medicine.
 

Contact information

Further information can be obtained from the leader for the pharmacoepidemiologic research group, Professor Anton Pottegård (apottegaard@health.sdu.dk).
 

Application deadline and interviews

November 1, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. CET
 

Salary and terms of employment

The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Applications will be assessed by an expert committee. Applicants will be informed of their assessment by the university.

Applications – including the required attachments – must be sent via the below-mentioned link “Apply online". Only online applications will be accepted. Attached files must be Adobe PDF or Word format. Each field in the application form can contain up to max. 10 MB.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.
 

Application (as pdf- or Word/docx- files):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of PhD diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 10 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please notice that one pdf- or docx- file must be attached for each publication

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work

Incomplete applications regarding the above-mentioned requirements will not be assessed.

References will be obtained for the applicant who is the first choice for the position – from the applicant’s most recent employer and previous employers as required.

Further particulars concerning the application – please see the link below.
 

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark is a world-class university driven by an ambition to promote research results that develop society. The major challenges of the 21st century are complex and multifaceted; sustainable change and solutions require new – often interdisciplinary – research-based knowledge, and the University of Southern Denmark is an indispensable stakeholder in the transition process. 

Value, quality, talented people and outstanding environments are pivotal for the University of Southern Denmark’s strategic initiatives. 

Read more: https://www.sdu.dk/en/om_sdu

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Jobbeskrivning

Would you like to work with advanced technology combining sensors, hardware, and software in safety-critical systems? We are currently looking for a Senior Systems Engineer to join an innovative technology company in Lund.



About the role

As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will play a central and leading role in developing advanced sensor systems and technical solutions with high requirements for performance, reliability, and safety. You will take a system-level perspective and ensure that hardware, software, sensors, and other subsystems work together effectively within the complete product.

You will collaborate closely with specialists in software, electronics, mechanics, optics, and testing. The role requires someone who can create structure, establish a clear technical direction, and lead cross-functional engineering activities from initial concept to a functioning and verified solution.

Your responsibilities may include:

    Developing and maintaining system architectures
    Defining, analyzing, and breaking down system requirements
    Ensuring traceability between requirements, design, implementation, and verification
    Leading and coordinating technical activities across engineering disciplines
    Coordinating interfaces between hardware, software, sensors, and external systems
    Planning and supporting system integration, verification, and validation
    Performing technical risk assessments and system performance analyses
    Collaborating with internal teams, external partners, customers, and suppliers
    Communicating technical decisions and creating alignment between stakeholders
    Providing technical leadership and guidance to development teams and project management



Baskunskaper

We are looking for someone who has:

    A relevant Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering
    Several years of experience in systems engineering or complex product development
    Experience in requirements management, system architecture, and technical documentation
    A strong understanding of hardware and software interaction
    Experience in system integration, verification, and validation
    Experience leading technical activities or cross-functional engineering teams
    The ability to approach complex technical challenges in a structured manner
    Excellent communication skills in Swedish and English

Experience in the following areas is considered an advantage:

    The automotive industry, particularly ADAS, autonomous systems, or active safety systems
    Sensor-based systems, computer vision, optics, radar, lidar, or camera technology
    Functional safety and standards such as ISO 26262
    Model-based systems engineering and requirements management tools
    The Swedish Armed Forces, defence industry, or another safety-critical and regulated environment
    Product development from early concepts and prototypes through testing and industrialization



Personliga färdigheter, egenskaper, erfarenhet

Your personal qualities are essential for succeeding in this role. We are looking for someone with a strong inner drive who takes initiative, creates momentum, and ensures that technical activities move forward. You are comfortable taking ownership and making decisions, even when the available information is incomplete or the technical challenges are complex.



You are highly communicative and able to explain complicated technical matters clearly and confidently to different audiences. You naturally build relationships and create trust with colleagues, customers, suppliers, and other stakeholders.



As a social and collaborative person, you enjoy bringing people together and creating engagement around common goals. You listen to others, welcome different perspectives, and can challenge ideas constructively when needed.



You also have the ability and confidence to lead. This does not necessarily mean formal personnel responsibility, but you should be comfortable setting direction, coordinating others, following up on progress, and helping teams make decisions. You lead through clarity, credibility, and engagement.

You combine these qualities with an analytical and solution-oriented mindset. You are pragmatic, hands-on, and motivated by turning ideas and requirements into functioning, verified products.



Vi erbjuder

ou will join an innovative and technology-intensive environment where you can work closely with both the product and some of the industry’s most exciting technologies. You will have the opportunity to influence technical direction, lead cross-functional activities, and contribute to the development of solutions with a clear safety purpose.





Location: Lund

jobs.title: Social- og sundhedshjælpere søges til Kristinehøj Plejehjem
jobs.description:
Banker dit hjerte for omsorg for ældre og med ordentlighed og respekt? Så har vi jobbet til dig!

Du bliver en del af et plejehjem, hvor vi vægter trivsel for beboere såvel for personale. Vi byder dig velkommen til et unikt og hjemligt hjem med et stærkt værdigrundlag.

Hvem er du?
Du er social- og sundhedshjælper med erfaring fra eller lyst til at arbejde inden for ældre- og demensområdet. Du er fagligt velfunderet, reflekterer over egen praksis og arbejder struktureret og sikkert inden for dit kompetenceområde.

Dine opgaver vil bl.a. være at:
Skabe hjemlighed, tryghed og stjernestunder sammen med beboere og bidrage til den gode stemning på hjemmet.

Tage ansvar med udgangspunkt i beboerens behov og værdier.

Samarbejde på tværs og sparre med kolleger.

Dokumentere. Vi anvender Nexus.

Vi søger dig som:
  • Er uddannet social- og sundhedshjælper
  • Har lyst til at udvikle dig
  • Brænder for at skabe et godt hverdagsliv for ældre
  • Er positiv, fleksibel og arbejder godt både selvstændigt og i teams

Hvad kan du forvente af os?
  • Et stærkt fællesskab med engagerede kollegaer
  • Stor selvbestemmelse og ansvar i hverdagen
  • Fokus på faglighed, udvikling og videndeling
  • Sundhedsforsikring der bl.a. tilbyder fysioterapeut, kiropraktor m.m.

Om stillingen
Stillingerne er på 24-37 timer, med arbejde hver 2. weekend. Vi har ledige stillinger i hhv. dag- og aftenvagt.

Løn og ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst.

Sundhedsforsikring

Tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt eller efter aftale.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Om Kristinehøj Plejehjem
Vores værdier
Som en del af Danske Diakonhjem baserer vi vores værdier på det samme fundament, nemlig at yde omsorg for medmennesker med udgangspunkt i det kristne livs- og menneskesyn.

Det betyder, at vi:
  • betragter ethvert menneske som unikt, skabt og værdifuldt.
  • styrker det enkelte menneskes identitet og ligeværd.
  • respekterer andres holdninger, meninger, værdier og levevis.
  • imødekommer det hele menneskes behov for både fysisk, psykisk, social, kulturel og åndelig omsorg.
  • giver plads til livsglæde, medindflydelse og engagement for beboere, pårørende, frivillige og medarbejdere.

Om Danske Diakonhjem
Danske Diakonhjem er en selvejende, nonprofitorganisation med mere end 65 års erfaring i at opføre og drive plejehjem. Vi er landets største private aktør inden for plejehjem og friplejehjem med 41 hjem og knapt 3.000 medarbejdere.

Derudover administrerer vi en række selvejende institutioner inden for løn, regnskab, bolig, IT og rådgivning — i alt omkring 80 plejehjem, hospices og bofællesskaber.

Vores arbejde bygger på et kristent livs- og menneskesyn, hvor hvert menneske betragtes som unikt og værdifuldt. Vi forventer, at du kan se dig selv i en organisation, hvor respekt, ordentlighed og rummelighed er centrale værdier.

Læs mere om Danske Diakonhjem: https://www.diakonhjem.dk/ og følg os LinkedIn

jobs.title: Word Begeleider via ons Werken-Leren Traject
jobs.description:
Droom jij van een baan waar je van betekenis bent? Een baan waar jij het verschil maakt? Heb jij er ooit aan gedacht om jouw talent in een andere sector in te zetten? Dan is werken als begeleider in de gehandicaptenzorg wellicht iets voor jou. Kom alles te weten over de vacature, wie Tragel is, waar we voor staan en kom bij ons werken.

Wat ga je doen?

Bij Tragel zijn we op zoek naar verschillende type begeleiders. Afhankelijk van jouw:

  • talenten (bijvoorbeeld: je blijft rustig ook wanneer er iemand tegen je roept).
  • interesses (bijvoorbeeld: je hebt een sterke drang om mensen altijd te helpen).
  • en eventuele eerdere werkervaringen (bijvoorbeeld: bij de politie, in de beveiliging, als maatschappelijk werker of in de horeca).

Wat heb je nodig?

Om in de zorg voor mensen met een beperking aan de slag te gaan, moet je naast een hart voor de zorg hebben ook stevig in je schoenen staan. Je krijgt te maken met onverwachte situaties. Samen met je collega’s weet je van aanpakken. Samen ga je voor oplossingen! Je hebt oog voor detail en een sterk verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel. Jouw interesse voor de wereld van je cliënten en hoe zij dingen beleven houdt je scherp. Je bent flexibel, want een dag is vaak niet te plannen. Dat je goed met mensen kunt omgaan, is vereiste nummer 1. Je ziet wat je cliënten nodig hebben, ondersteunt ze en beweegt met ze mee.

jobs.title: Begeleider – Ernstig verstandelijke en meervoudige beperking
jobs.description:
Jouw werkplek

Op jouw nieuwe werkplek wonen cliënten met een ernstig verstandelijke en meervoudige beperking (EVMB+), soms met bijkomende gedragsproblematiek. Samen met jouw team bied je hen een veilige, betrouwbare omgeving waarin zij zich op hun eigen manier kunnen ontwikkelen. Op je werkplek word je ondersteund door een zorgcoördinator en gedragsdeskundige, die je helpen bij het begeleiden van cliënten met moeilijk verstaanbaar gedrag.

Elke dag zorg je voor een zinvolle invulling, thuis of bij dagbesteding dichtbij. Met een persoonlijk en groepsgericht dagprogramma bied je structuur en veiligheid, zodat bewoners zich écht thuis voelen. Of het nu gaat om een wandeling, een activiteit in de woonkamer of samen rustig zitten – jullie doen het samen, in een omgeving vol vertrouwen.

Jouw rol en aanpak Je werkt volgens de Triple C-visie, waarbij onvoorwaardelijke begeleiding en het samen ondernemen van betekenisvolle activiteiten centraal staan. Met een luisterend oor en oog voor non-verbale signalen stem jij af op de behoefte van de cliënten. Je bent alert op subtiele veranderingen, zodat je op tijd kunt inspelen op wat iemand fysiek of emotioneel nodig heeft.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Ondersteuning bieden bij persoonlijke verzorging en indien nodig verpleegkundige handelingen.
  • Begeleiden bij dagelijkse activiteiten, zoals zwemmen, wandelen en fietsen afgestemd op de individuele behoeften van de cliënt.
  • Je moet kunnen observeren, rapporteren en helder kunnen communiceren.
  • Je werkt vanuit verbinding samen met collega’s en het sociale netwerk van de cliënten.

Wat heb je nodig?

  • Je hebt ervaring of affiniteit met de zorg voor cliënten met een ernstig verstandelijke en meervoudige beperking
  • Je bent geduldig, empathisch en kunt goed afstemmen op de behoeften van de cliënt
  • Je werkt onvoorwaardelijk en kunt voorbij probleemgedrag kijken om tot de kern te komen

jobs.title: Technical Marketing Content Creator (Intern) Aktiivinen
jobs.description:
**This position can be fixed term part-time job or Internship. Length of employment is 10 weeks.**

**Internship length:** 10 weeks (Helsinki), or longer if part time.

AILiveSim provides an advanced simulation platform that integrates AI, robotics, and video game technology. Located in Helsinki, we serve a variety of industries, including maritime, defence, aeronautics, and mobile machines. With controlled simulations, we accelerate the development cycles and provide scalable solutions for training, testing, and validating autonomous systems and AI algorithms.

To showcase the best capabilities of our simulation platform, we are looking for a creative and driven **Marketing Content Creator (Intern)** to plan, capture, and edit inspiring and eye-catching video content. This is a unique opportunity if you are studying marketing, media, IT, or communications, combining hands-on video production with cutting-edge AI and simulation technology.

**Key Responsibilities**

- **Content Planning & Ideation:** Collaborate with the team to plan recordable content, actively proposing and suggesting interesting content ideas.

- **Capture Simulation Footage:** Record dynamic, high-quality video material directly from the AILiveSim simulation engine across various scenarios (land, sea, air).

- **Video Editing & Production:** Edit marketing and product videos for use across our website, social media channels (LinkedIn, YouTube), sales demos, and product documentation.

- **Competitor & Content Analysis:** Research industry trends and analyze previous marketing material to craft engaging, high-impact visuals.

- **Cross-Team Collaboration:** Work closely with the Sales & Marketing and technical team to align video content with campaign goals and product launches.


**Requirements**

- **Video Production Experience:** Hands-on experience in video editing and storytelling with a portfolio or demo reel of past video projects.

- **Software Proficiency:** Familiarity with modern video editing software. (You can propose what tools you want to use)

- **Communication Skills:** Excellent written and spoken English skills.

- **Technical Curiosity:** Comfort and enthusiasm for working with computers and technical software, including interactive 3D simulation tools.


**Valuable Assets**

- Interest or experience in AI, robotics, 3D graphics, game technologies, or autonomous systems.

- Understanding of graphic design, motion graphics, or social media content strategy.


**What We Offer**

- **Impact & Growth:** A close-knit, supportive team dedicated to your personal and professional growth.

- **Inspiring Environment:** Work mostly from our office in Helsinki (Maria 01) with flexible hybrid working arrangements.

- **Perks:** Team lunches and access to a fully equipped office gym.


**How to Apply**

To apply, please send your CV, cover letter, and a link to your portfolio or video samples with **"Marketing Content Creator (Intern)"** in the subject line to **Jobs@ailivesim.com**.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position will be filled as soon as a qualified candidate is identified.

More information can be requested from **Jobs@ailivesim.com.**

jobs.title: Mekaniker
jobs.description:
Mekaniker til servicéring udlejnings maskiner og Have park maskiner

Har du godt styr på to- og en firetaktsmotor? Og vil du være en del af et værksted, hvor vi løfter i flok? Og hvor reparation handler om mere end bare at udskifte dele?

Hos os får du:

• en alsidig hverdag, hvor du roder med alt fra robotplæneklippere til gravemaskiner

• efteruddannelse – vi holder dig skarp i dit fag

• gode kolleger – og en endnu bedre stemning.

Få maskinerne til at køre som smurt

Hos Aagaard Maskiner & Udlejning indgår du i et team på 4 mekanikere. Vi sørger for at vores kunder får maskiner, der fungerer – hver gang. Du bliver en vigtig del af værkstedet og får ansvar for at holde både udlejningsmaskiner og kundemaskiner i topform.

”Hvis du vil arbejde et sted, hvor vi kan tage gas på hinanden og samtidig brænder for motorer, så er det her stedet,” fortæller indehaver Kristian Utoft.

Det betyder, at du:

• servicerer og reparerer maskiner fra mærker som Husqvarna, Stihl, Hustler, Stiga, Solo, Kwern og Ariens

• klargør udlejningsmaskiner – lige fra robotplæneklippere og lifte til gravemaskiner

• hjælper kunder med rådgivning og hurtig problemløsning

• udfører ad hoc-opgaver, der kræver kreativitet og en hands-on tilgang til maskiner og værktøj

• sparrer med kolleger og bidrager til teamet med din faglige viden og praktiske erfaring.

Du har hænderne skruet rigtigt på …

… og en praktisk tilgang til arbejdet. For at blive en del af vores team er det vigtigt, at du:

• har erfaring med 2- og 4-taktsmotorer.

• er vant til at arbejde med mekanik og elsker at finde løsninger, der virker.

• kan bruge IT

• har kørekort – og har du trailerkørekort og/eller truckcertifikat, er det en fordel.

Olie på fingrene? Lad os høre fra dig!

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send din ansøgning og dit CV via linket nedenfor. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at ringe til indehaver Kristian Utoft på tlf. 40 80 81 31.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Fagansvarlig BPA (80–100 %) – en meningsfull fagrolle med ansvar og frihet
jobs.description:
Vi søker deg som har bachelorutdanning innen helse-, sosial- eller pedagogiske fag. Utdanningsbakgrunn kan for eksempel være sykepleier, vernepleier, miljøterapeut, ergoterapeut, fysioterapeut, sosionom, barnevernspedagog eller annen relevant treårig høyskoleutdanning.

En engasjert fagansvarlig som ønsker en selvstendig rolle med ansvar for kvalitet, koordinering og utvikling av en BPA-ordning. Hos oss får du kombinere faglig ansvar med praktisk arbeid, samtidig som du bygger en trygg og velfungerende tjeneste rundt én bruker.

Det er behov for arbeid på dag, ettermiddag, helg og natt. 

Dette er et vikariat frem til 1. april 2027, med gode muligheter for forlengelse.

Kvalifikasjoner
  • Treårig høyskoleutdanning innen helse-, sosial- eller pedagogiske fag
  • Førerkort klasse B 

(Egen bil er en fordel grunnet begrensede bussforbindelser)

  • Gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Du må ikke være allergisk eller redd for katter
Om stillingen

Jeg heter Guro, er 25 år og lever med alvorlig ME. Sykdommen gjør at jeg har begrenset energi i hverdagen, og jeg trenger derfor assistenter som kan være mine armer og bein slik at jeg kan bruke kreftene mine på det som gir meg glede og livskvalitet.

Til daglig er jeg en rolig og positiv ung kvinne som setter pris på humor, gode samtaler og hyggelige stunder. Når formen tillater det, liker jeg håndarbeid og å sitte ute i frisk luft. Jeg har også to snille katter som er en viktig del av hverdagen min.

Mitt mål med BPA-ordningen er å få mer overskudd til de tingene som betyr mest for meg, og etter hvert kunne delta på flere aktiviteter utenfor hjemmet. Derfor søker jeg nå flere personer som ønsker å bidra til økt selvstendighet, trygghet og gode hverdagsøyeblikk.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Bidra til struktur, trygghet og forutsigbarhet i ordningen
  • Opplæring, veiledning og oppfølging av assistenter
  • Bidra til kvalitetssikring og videreutvikling av BPA-ordningen
  • Samarbeid med arbeidsleder, arbeidsgiver og øvrige samarbeidspartnere
  • Administrative oppgaver knyttet til fagansvarlig rolle 
  • Delta aktivt i det daglige assistentarbeidet
Arbeidsoppgaver assistent
  • Matlaging og tilrettelegging av måltider
  • Personlig stell og praktisk bistand
  • Husarbeid og rengjøring
  • Handling og andre ærender
  • Hjelp med stell av katter
  • Kjøring til og fra avtaler og aktiviteter
  • Bistand ved sosiale sammenkomster
  • Støtte ved telefonsamtaler og kontakt med fastlege, sykehus og offentlige instanser
  • Være en trygg samtalepartner og støtte i hverdagen
Vi ser etter deg som
  • Er rolig, trygg og omsorgsfull
  • Har god forståelse for andres behov og grenser
  • Klarer å sette pris på rolige stunder, humor og gode samtaler
  • Er observant og tilpasser deg ulike dagsformer
  • Tar initiativ når det trengs
  • Er pålitelig og ansvarsbevisst
  • Har gode kommunikasjonsevner
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.
Vi tilbyr
  • En meningsfull jobb med stor betydning i ett menneskes hverdag
  • Muligheten til å bidra til økt livskvalitet og selvstendighet
  • En variert stilling med ansvar og påvirkningsmuligheter for fagansvarlig
  • Et nært og hyggelig arbeidsmiljø
  • Grundig opplæring og tett oppfølging fra arbeidsgiver og arbeidsleder
  • Tilgang til kurs og fagressurser via NHI

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da håper jeg å høre fra deg.

Har du spørsmål om stillingen, kan du kontakte koordinator Agnethe Lynn Ytrøy på ay@assent.no.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Assent har organisert BPA-tjenester siden 2014. I dag har vi konsesjon på levering av BPA i flere kommuner over hele landet. Vi har medarbeidere med god kjennskap til ordningen og arbeidsgiverrollen, samt lang erfaring med organisering av individuelle tjenester både i og utenfor hjemmet. For oss er det viktig at arbeidleder i størst mulig grad kan leve et uavhengig og selvstendig liv. Assent er medlem i NHO og våre tjenester er i henold til ISO 9001,ISO 14001 og OHSAS 18001.

jobs.title: 15 år gammel jente søker ung kvinnelig brukerstyrt personlig assistent (BPA)
jobs.description:
Vi søker etter en ung kvinne med egen bil til en stilling på tilkalling som brukerstyrt personlig assistent (BPA), for en jente på 15 år, som bor med familien nær Bergen sentrum. Du vil jobbe tett med brukeren som trenger din støtte i hverdagen. Vi ser etter deg som bor i eller i nærheten av Bergen sentrum, maks 30 minutter unna. 

Vi ser etter deg som:

Er positiv, empatisk, omsorgsfull og motiverende

Har et rolig og tålmodig vesen

Har sertifikat og egen bil 

Liker å lage sund og god mat og stelle i hjemmet

Behersker norsk 100 %

Helsemessig skikket (psykisk og fysisk)

Studenter med fleksibel studietid oppfordres til å søke.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

Følge brukeren til avtaler og aktiviteter

Hjelpe med daglige gjøremål hjemme

Om brukeren: 

Brukeren er en jente på 15 år som elsker katter og å bake kaker. Hun liker å tegne, spille spill, være med venner, prate, shoppe, og gå på kafé. Hun har bevegelsesvansker og variabel helse, så assistenten vil være hennes armer og bein. Hun trenger en assistent som kan hjelpe henne slik at hun kan delta på lik linje med andre barn.

Arbeidstid:

Som tilkalling får du alltid forespørsel om å jobbe før du takker ja/nei. Tidspunktene du vil få spørsmål om er i hovedsak disse:

Mandag - Fredag: Morgen (07.00-09.00) og/eller ettermiddag (12.00-16.00)

Enkelte helgevakter

Tidspunktene kan variere.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: Join NordicNeuroLab as an Electrical Compliance Engineer
jobs.description:
Join NordicNeuroLab and help shape the future of medical technology

 

Headquartered in Bergen, Norway, NordicNeuroLab is an international and growing company with ambitious plans. To support continued growth and increasing regulatory demands, we are now looking for an Electrical Compliance Engineer to join their Quality & Regulatory Affairs team. 

 

About the Role

This is a newly established position that will work closely with the VP Quality & Regulatory Affairs and engineering teams across the organization.

 

This role bridges engineering, product development, testing, verification and validation, and regulatory compliance. You will help ensure that NNL’s products meet applicable international standards and certification requirements while providing compliance support to engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle.

 

We are looking for someone who combines strong technical understanding with an interest in standards, compliance, certification, technical documentation, and product safety.

 

This role offers a unique opportunity to help shape and develop NNLs' compliance capabilities while working with innovative medical technology products used worldwide.

 

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Interpret and apply international standards and regulatory requirements for electrical and electronic products.
  • Support engineering teams in translating regulatory requirements into practical design, testing, verification, and validation activities.
  • Review product designs, technical solutions, test plans, and engineering documentation from a compliance perspective.
  • Develop and maintain compliance and traceability documentation.
  • Support verification and validation activities throughout product development and sustaining engineering.
  • Coordinate compliance and certification activities with external laboratories, testing facilities, and certification bodies.
  • Contribute to product risk management activities related to electrical safety and compliance.
  • Support regulatory submissions and technical documentation for global markets.
  • Assess the compliance impact of product changes, component obsolescence, and design updates.

 

Preferred Background

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Automation, Physics, Medical Technology, or related technical discipline.
  • Experience working with standards, compliance, certification, verification, validation, testing, quality, or regulatory activities.
  • Experience with product certification, technical documentation, and engineering documentation.
  • Strong technical writing and documentation skills.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

 

Valuable Experience

Experience from the medical device industry is highly desirable, particularly within active medical devices and electrical safety standards.

Knowledge of one or more of the following areas is considered advantageous:

  • Medical electrical equipment standards for safety and Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) (IEC 60601 series)
  • Verification and Validation (V&V)
  • ISO 14971 Risk Management and ISO 13485 Quality management system
  • FDA, MDR, or other regulatory frameworks
  • CE marking and product certification processes
  • Wireless product compliance (RED, FCC, ETSI)
  • Environmental compliance requirements (RoHS, REACH, PPWR, WEEE)
  • Product certification processes involving UL, TÜV, CSA, or similar organizations

 

Who We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate is:

  • Structured, organized, and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable working with standards, regulations, and technical requirements.
  • A strong technical writer capable of producing clear, accurate, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Able to understand complex technical systems and communicate effectively across disciplines.
  • Self-driven and capable of working independently.
  • Comfortable balancing engineering challenges with regulatory requirements.
  • Motivated by quality, compliance, and continuous improvement.

 

Why Join NordicNeuroLab?

  • Work with innovative medical technology products used worldwide.
  • Join an international company with ambitious growth plans.
  • Thrive in a collaborative environment where experienced Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and Engineering teams work together to advance innovation.
  • Help shape a newly established role with significant influence and development opportunities.
  • Contribute directly to patient-focused technology that makes a difference globally.

 

Candidates residing outside Norway are welcome to apply, provided they are willing to relocate to Bergen.

 

For questions regarding this position, please contact Michelle Kolskår, Head of Sales at Folk AS.
Phone: +47 48 13 66 56
E-mail: michelle@folkas.com

 

Since its establishment in 2004, Folk AS has assisted both Norwegian and international companies in finding highly skilled professionals within technical and administrative disciplines for project-based, temporary, and permanent positions. This is what we do best, and where our expertise lies.

Our core values are: ethical, personal, committed, and flexible.

 

We see opportunities in your competence!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

NordicNeuroLab AS (NNL) develops and manufactures advanced solutions for functional MRI (fMRI) studies and patient comfort systems used in MRI environments worldwide. Their products are trusted by hospitals, universities, and research institutions across the globe and play an important role in supporting the diagnosis and treatment of neurological disorders.

jobs.title: Utvecklare för hobbyverksamhet
jobs.description:
Vi söker en **Utvecklare för hobbyverksamhet** på heltid till en tillsvidareanställning för att, i enlighet med vår strategi, utveckla föreningens verksamhet för nybörjare samt verksamhet med låg tröskel för deltagande.

Den huvudsakliga arbetsuppgiften är att öka antalet personer som deltar i föreningens hobbyverksamhet genom att hitta nya deltagare samt stärka möjligheterna att behålla dem som redan är aktiva. Ett särskilt fokus ligger på verksamhet för barn i åldern 9 år och yngre.

För att lyckas i rollen behöver du trivas med att arbeta med barn, ha förmåga att planera och genomföra evenemang för barn och barnfamiljer samt vara entusiastisk, initiativrik och villig att lära dig i ett arbete med varierande och mångsidiga arbetsuppgifter. Du kan till exempel vara utbildad ungdomsledare, idrottsinstruktör eller närvårdare med inriktning på barn och ungas fostran.

Hos oss är dagarna sällan den ena lik den andra, så det är viktigt att du självständigt och lösningsorienterat kan ta tag i uppgifter och uppskattar variationen i arbetet. Arbetstiderna varierar och omfattar även kvälls- och helgarbete. Ibland uppstår situationer som inte kunnat förutses, vilket gör att förmågan att reagera snabbt och vara flexibel är en grundförutsättning för att lyckas i arbetet. Som arbetsgivare strävar vi också efter att vara flexibla gentemot våra medarbetare, och arbetstiderna erbjuder därför flexibilitet även för den anställda.

God vana att använda sociala medier samt förmågan att bjuda på sin egen personlighet är en fördel i arbetet. Tvåspråkighet och kunskaper inom marknadsföring ses som betydande meriter.

Arbetet förutsätter möjlighet att använda egen bil.

Arbetet inleds så snart en lämplig person har hittats, så skicka in din ansökan utan dröjsmål.

Skicka din ansökan, en kort videopresentation av dig själv, löneanspråk samt CV per e-post senast den **10.10.2026**. Ange **Ansökan Utvecklare för hobbyverksamhet** i ämnesraden.

jobs.title: Work part-time: English-speaking babysitter, Stockholm
jobs.description:
Looking for a fun and meaningful job? Do you love working with children and speaking English?

We are looking for enthusiastic, responsible, and creative English-speaking babysitters to join our team in Stockholm. We offer a unique concept where pedagogy and development of the English language are at the heart of the babysitting.

Our assignments

Upgrades offers English language focussed babysitting in several different forms, ranging from occasional help to spending many hours with the family and becoming like an additional family member. Based on your preference regarding age and number of children, we match you with a suitable family.

The work includes picking up the child or children from preschool or school, basic food preparation, play and activities while maintaining a focus on English language development. Each session is a minimum of 2.5 hours and you can combine several assignments to increase your total working hours per week.

Some of our assignments require a clean driving licence, so please state this in your application.

Please note that this is a part-time position, and you are therefore expected to have another primary occupation. If employed as a babysitter at Upgrades, you will be required to provide a criminal record extract.

Your profile

As a babysitter at Upgrades, you are warm, responsible, and genuinely enjoy working with children. You are playful, dedicated, and proactive, with a natural ability to take initiative. You also bring creative ideas for incorporating English into play and everyday interactions, supporting children’s language development in a natural way.

Requirements

    Full professional proficiency in English
    Excellent sense of responsibility and child safety
    Strong social and interpersonal skills
    Genuinely interested in childcare and pedagogy
    Positive, creative, dedicated, flexible, and proactive, with a natural ability to take initiative
    Swedish and/or other languages are not required, but are considered an advantage.

About Upgrades

Upgrades offers tailored language lessons, language camps and language-focused childcare. We combine standard babysitting with a strong focus on language development. Visit our website to learn more: www.upgrades.se

We recruit on a regular basis. Note: The position may therefore be filled before the application deadline.

Submit your resume and cover letter to work@upgrades.se

jobs.title: PhD scholarship at the Danish Institute for International Studies
jobs.description:
PhD scholarship at the Danish Institute for International Studies, Military Artificial Intelligence, Peace and International Security

The Danish Institute for International Studies (DIIS) is recruiting a PhD candidate to research military applications of artificial intelligence and their implications for peace and international security. We are especially interested in projects that examine how the development and use of AI-based military capabilities affect established practices of decision-making, human control, and accountability. The project should connect a nuanced understanding of the dynamics of technological change to wider questions of arms control and international regulation. 

The position is based at the DIIS Centre for Peace Research and will thematically be placed under one of the three pillars of the Centre, namely Arms control in a time of arms races and war. One of the questions that the Centre focuses on is how Nordic countries, including Denmark, can navigate a situation where the development of new technologies (e.g. AI and drones), along with increasing great power rivalry and competition in space, entail new types of security risks that traditional arms control models and treaties do not effectively regulate.

The successful candidate will develop an independent PhD project that speaks to the overall focus of the center and produces research relevant to Nordic and international debates on security and peace.

About the position 
AI is changing how military organizations collect information, assess threats, select targets and coordinate operations. These capabilities are currently developed faster than military doctrine, legal interpretation and oversight arrangements intended to govern their use. This raises questions about who exercises control, how responsibility is assigned, and how other states interpret capabilities whose operation is difficult to observe. Within this overall frame relevant proposals may examine:

  • The relationship between the adoption of AI and the development of military doctrine

  • The effects of AI-enabled decision support on military decision-making and the human role therein

  • The impact of uncertainty and opacity around the current state of AI integration among militaries on escalation dynamics and arms-race dynamics

  • Regulation of AI through multilateral governance mechanisms in and beyond the UN

  • Human judgement and accountability in military applications of AI

About DIIS and the position
The successful candidate will be employed by DIIS in a three-year, full-time PhD position, expected to commence on 1 February 2027. The candidate will be enrolled in the PhD School at the Faculty of Social Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU), while their primary place of work will be the Centre for Peace Research at DIIS.

The PhD project will be jointly supervised by a senior researcher at DIIS and Professor Ingvild Bode at SDU.

At DIIS, the PhD candidate will join an inspiring and ambitious research environment committed to advancing multidisciplinary scholarship. The successful candidate is expected to engage actively in cross-disciplinary collaboration and to value insights from colleagues working with different theoretical and methodological approaches. Such exchanges across disciplinary boundaries are central to the research environment at DIIS.

We expect the candidate to:

  • have obtained a master’s degree in a relevant field

  • have at least received the grade of 10 (or equivalent) for the master’s thesis according to the Danish 7-point grading scale and a high weighted grade point average 

  • meet the general requirements for being accepted for enrolment as a PhD candidate (see below)

  • live up to the DIIS entry criteria for PhD positions https://www.diis.dk/files/media/document/diis-entry-criteria-rev-okt-24.pdf 

  • communicate clearly in written and spoken English, and proficiency in Danish is an advantage.

DIIS as a workplace
We offer an attractive and inclusive workplace where our employees can develop. We consider knowledge sharing and feedback essential to creating a dynamic workplace. We expect you to participate proactively in the common efforts of the institute. We prioritize a high degree of presence but want our employees to have a good work-life balance. Therefore, we offer flexible working hours and some possibility of working from home. We are located very close to Copenhagen’s city center with excellent public transportation options.

DIIS is a diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified candidates to apply for this position regardless of their personal background. DIIS is also a workplace where we consider the environmental consequences of our activities and strive to adopt more environmentally sustainable practices both in relation to our daily business at DIIS and our global travel activities.

In the assessment, consideration will be given to the following criteria:

  • The applicant has a relevant master’s degree or equivalent qualifications (corresponding to the 3 + 2 Bologna process), cf. the Danish qualifications framework for higher education

  • Quality and relevance of the project description

    • Quality and relevance of the methodical and theoretical choices

    • Consistency and coherence between the research problem and the choice of method and theory

    • The realistic and feasible scope of the PhD project

  • Relevance of the project for the DIIS Centre for Peace Research and DIIS in general

Contract and remuneration
The position as PhD candidate starts on 1 February 2027 and is a 3-year full-time position. Remuneration and other job conditions follow the general agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC) and the Danish Ministry of Finance, local collective agreements at DIIS as well as the 28 June 2019 Danish state protocol on PhD candidates. 

The standard starting salary for a PhD candidate at DIIS is 379,702,61 DKK per year excl. pensions – this may be increased depending on prior work experience after the acquisition of the master’s degree. A pension contribution of 18,07% is added to the above-mentioned salary.

Do you want to know more?
Visit http://www.diis.dk/jobs to learn more about DIIS as a workplace. Questions regarding employment and renumeration can be sent to hr@diis.dk. If you have inquiries regarding the professional focus of the position, you can contact Senior Researcher and Head of Research Unit, Mona Kanwal Sheikh at mosh@diis.dk  

The application
Deadline for applying is 23 October 2026, at 12.00 pm CET. 

Please note that we only accept applications through DIIS’ electronic recruitment system. 

Your application must include all the following documents:

  1. A motivational letter

  2. Curriculum Vitae 

  3. Master’s diploma including grades. If you hold a master’s degree which is not within the ECTS-framework, please also provide:

    • Your bachelor diploma and bachelor grades

    • A statement clarifying the subject and length (in years) of the master’s degree

    • An English translation of your diplomas 

  4. PhD project proposal (max 5 pages)

  5. Publication list

DIIS is an independent public research institution for international studies. We conduct and communicate multidisciplinary research on globalisation, security, development and foreign policy and within these areas we aim to be agenda-setting in research, policy and public debate.

DIIS participates in academic networks and publish in high-ranking academic journals, always striving to excel in academic scholarship.

We continuously assess Denmark's foreign and political situation and inform the Danish media, politicians and the public about our work
