jobs.description:
Looking for a fun and meaningful job? Do you love working with children and speaking French?

We are looking for enthusiastic, responsible, and creative French-speaking babysitters to join our team in Stockholm.

At Upgrades, we offer a unique concept where pedagogy and development of the French language are at the heart of the babysitting.

We currently have assignments available throughout Stockholm, including Central Stockholm, Lidingö, Täby, and several other areas.

Our assignments

Upgrades offers French language focused childcare in several different forms, ranging from occasional help to spending many hours with the family and becoming like an additional family member.

Based on your preference regarding age and number of children, we match you with a suitable family.

Please note that this is a part-time position and you are therefore expected to have another primary occupation.

If employed as a babysitter at Upgrades, you will be required to provide a criminal record extract.

What You'll Do

The work includes picking up the child or children from preschool or school, basic food preparation, play and activities while maintaining a focus on French language development.

Each session is a minimum of 2.5 hours and you can combine several assignments to increase your total working hours per week.

Some of our assignments require a clean driving licence, so please state this in your application.

Your profile

As a babysitter at Upgrades, you are warm, responsible, and genuinely enjoy working with children. You are playful, dedicated, and proactive, with a natural ability to take initiative. You also bring creative ideas for incorporating French into play and everyday interactions, supporting children’s language development in a natural way.

Requirements

    Full professional proficiency in French
    Excellent sense of responsibility and child safety
    Strong social and interpersonal skills
    Genuinely interested in childcare and pedagogy
    Positive, dedicated, flexible, and proactive, with a natural ability to take initiative
    Swedish and/or English are not required, but are considered an advantage.

About Upgrades

Upgrades offers tailored language lessons, language camps and language-focused childcare. We combine standard babysitting with a strong focus on language development. Visit our website to learn more: www.upgrades.se

We recruit on a regular basis. Note: The position may therefore be filled before the application deadline.

Submit your resume and cover letter to work@upgrades.se

Primary location:
SEINÄJOKI

Haemme RAVINTOLASIISTIJÄÄ Original Sokos Hotel Vaakunan ja Lakeuden ravintoloihin Seinäjoelle
Avoinna oleva työsuhde on pitkä, määräaikainen ja osa-aikainen perhevapaan sijaisuus heinäkuun loppuun 2027 asti, sopimustunnit keskimäärin 60h/3vkoa.
Tässä työssä sinulla on tärkeä rooli asiakkaiden viihtyvyyden varmistamisessa. Tehtävänäsi on huolehtia hotelliemme yhteydessä sijaitsevien ravintoloiden siisteydestä ja työvuorosi sijoittuvat pääosin klo 4.30-13.00 välille. Saat käytännönläheisen perehdytyksen ja opastuksen työhön, joten aikaisempi kokemus siistijän tehtävästä ei ole välttämätön.

Haku on avoinna 12.10.2026 saakka. Käsittelemme hakemuksia ja teemme valintoja jo hakuaikana, joten hae viipymättä!

Etelä-Pohjanmaan Osuuskauppa on monipuolinen työpaikka!
Eepee on osuuskauppa,jonka omistavat sen yli 95 000 asiakasomistajaa. Tarjoamme toimialueellamme työpaikan 1300 palvelualan ammattilaiselle 71 toimipaikassamme.
Eepeellä teemme ihan tavallisia töitä. Tavallisuus on voima, joka erottaa meidät muista. Meillä työ ei ole vain peruspesti, mutta samalla se on juuri sitä. jobs.title: Organist søges til Hans Egedes Sogn på Østerbro og i Nordhavn
jobs.description:
Vi søger en organist, der har lyst, energi og mod til at udvikle et stærkt musikmiljø i sognet. Der er gode muligheder for at udvikle og opbygge kirkens musikliv herunder et nyt professionelt kantori. Vi har et højt musikalsk ambitionsniveau og en musikinteresseret menighed.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer pr. uge og ønskes besat pr. 1. januar 2027 eller snarest derefter.

Hvad lægger vi vægt på?

Fagligt:

Du er klassisk uddannet organist fra konservatoriet (DOKS) eller med anden tilsvarende uddannelse. Du spiller kirkemusikkens forskellige genrer, du er åben for andre gudstjenesteformer i samarbejde med præsterne, og du akkompagnerer på klaver, f.eks. til sange fra Højskolesangbogen.

Du er fortrolig med liturgien, har respekt for den kirkemusikalske tradition og blik for udvikling.

Du har forståelse for gudstjenestens liturgiske og musikalske helhed og vil være åben for samskabelse med præsterne.

Du har evner for og erfaring med korledelse.

Har du koncerterfaring som organist eller pianist og evner for komposition og improvisation, vil det være en fordel. 

Organisatorisk:

Du er fleksibel i forhold til arbejdstider og er indstillet på at arbejde på to forskellige lokationer: Hans Egedes Kirke på Østerbro samt det nye kirkerum Tiny Church i Fiskerihavnen i Nordhavn. 

Socialt:

Du engagerer dig i kirkens liv og dagligdag og har lyst til at være en del af et frugtbart professionelt fællesskab på tværs af faggrupper.

Udviklingsmæssigt:

Du har visioner for den kirkemusikalske udvikling både i Hans Egedes Kirke og i Tiny Church i den nye bydel.

Organistens arbejdsopgaver bliver bl.a. at:

  • have det overordnede ansvar for musikken i sognet 

  • at stå for musikledsagelse til gudstjenester og kirkelige handlinger

  • medvirke ved gudstjenester i den færøske menighed i Hans Egedes Kirke første og tredje søndag hver måned kl. 14

  • udvikle og planlægge kirkens koncertprogram, evt. også som udøvende musiker

  • være ansvarlig for at passe og vedligeholde kirkernes instrumenter

  • administrere sognets koncertbudget

  • dirigere og være nærmeste foresatte for kirkekoret og de færøske kirkesangere

  • deltage i relevante arrangementer, møder og udvalg.

Der er desuden mulighed for udvikling af musikalske initiativer og arrangementer alt efter ansøgerens interesser og kompetencer. 

Sognet består af Hans Egedes Kirke på Østerbro og det nye kirkerum Tiny Church/Tolvkanten i Nordhavn. Der er 11.500 indbyggere, og der er et betydeligt kulturelt potentiale blandt beboerne. Den nye bydel i Nordhavn er under stærk udvikling.

Orgelet i Hans Egedes Kirke er bygget af Gunnar Fabricius Husted i 1984, har 22 stemmer, 2 manualer og pedal, fordelt på hovedværk, svelleværk med 2 sveller og pedal. Orgelet er et særdeles velklingende og alsidigt instrument, og kirkens akustik er ideel til både orgel- og kormusik.

I kirken står desuden et velklingende Blüthner-flygel, og kirken råder over endnu et flygel og flere klaverer. 

I Tiny Church-Tolvkanten står pt. et Hammond-orgel, der vil kunne suppleres med et opretstående klaver.

Sognet har to præster samt en præst til den færøske menighed og et medarbejderteam med en daglig leder. Teamet består af kirketjenere, kirke-og kulturmedarbejdere, kordegn, organist og fire sangere. Hans Egedes kirke er hjemsted for den færøske Sankt Olav Menighed.

Læs mere om Hans Egedes Kirke og Tiny Church-Tolvkanten på: www.hansegedeskirke.dk 

Vil du vide mere om stillingen kan du kontakte næstformand Birgit Toft, T: 2374 8593 eller Email: birgit@teamtoft.dk. 

Ansøgninger med relevante bilag sendes samlet i en pdf-fil til 7046fortrolig@sogn.dk.  Ansøgninger modtages kun elektronisk. 

Ansøgningsfristen er torsdag den 21. oktober 2026 kl. 12.00.

Ansættelsessamtaler og prøvespil forventes afholdt 17/11 og 22/11.

Menighedsrådet kan oplyse, at der vil blive indhentet referencer og børneattest i forbindelse med ansættelse. Der er tre måneders prøvetid. 

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår:  

Ansættelse af en organist med kirkemusikalsk kandidateksamen eller bacheloreksamen (DOKS) vil være omfattet af Overenskomst for akademikere i staten med tilhørende protokollat om overenskomstansættelse af DOKS-organister samt rektorer og faste lærere på kirkemusikskolerne på folkekirkens område. Indplacering og rådighedstillæg ydes efter anciennitet på ny løn/AC-skalaen, og årslønnen for ansøgere med en kandidateksamen udgør mellem 363.169 og 442.529 kr. For ansøgere med bacheloreksamen udgør lønnen mellem 332.306 og 417.106 kr. årligt. Rådighedstillægget udgør mellem 46.727 og 72.573 kr. årligt for både kandidater og bachelorer.

Ud over løn og tillæg ydes arbejdsgiverbetalt pensionsbidrag på 18,07% af lønnen og 12,5% af rådighedstillægget.

Ansættelse af en organist med eksamen i orgel- og korledelse vil være omfattet af Overenskomst mellem By-, Land- og Kirkeministeriet og CO10 for visse organister. Årslønnen udgør afhængig af anciennitet på første basisløntrin 350.4355 kr. årligt og på andet basisløntrin 368.189 kr. årligt. Rådighedstillægget udgør 37.941 kr. årligt.

Ud over løn og tillæg ydes arbejdsgiverbetalt pensionsbidrag på 18,4%.

Ansættelse af en kirkemusiker vil være omfattet af Fællesoverenskomsten mellem Finansministeriet og CO10 og Organisationsaftale mellem Kirkeministeriet og CO10 – Centralorganisationen af 2010 - for kirkefunktionærer med kerneopgaver som kordegn, kirke- og kulturmedarbejder eller kirkemusiker og det tilhørende protokollat for kirkemusikere. Aftale om indplacering i lønintervallet indgås mellem menighedsrådet og Dansk Kirkemusiker Forening. Årslønnen for en kirkemusiker aftales indenfor intervallet 333.748 – 475.590 kr. Rådighedstillægget udgør 27.641 kr. årligt. Endelig ydes et OK-tillæg på 1.082 kr. årligt.

Ud over løn og tillæg ydes arbejdsgiverbetalt pensionsbidrag på 18,4%.

Alle ovennævnte beløb er i niveau pr. 1. august 2026 ved fuldtidsbeskæftigelse, og alle aftalerne kan ses på https://folkekirkensintranet.dk/vejledninger/menighedsraadet-som-arbejdsgiver/ok24

jobs.title: Marketing Science Specialist
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy turning data into clarity – and clarity into better decisions? In this role, you connect strategy, data, and execution to ensure insights drive action, shaping how brand and demand investments deliver real business impact.

About the job

You strengthen marketing strategy and decision‑making through data, insight, and analysis, ensuring that long- and short-term marketing investments are evidence‑based, prioritized, and tied to business impact. Providing analytical input to global brand and marketing strategy is part of your job, as is applying marketing science, such as brand growth, mental availability, buyer behavior, pricing power, and effectiveness theory, in an industrial B2B context. You report to the Head of Brand & Marketing Strategy.

Job responsibilities

    Support customer research and brand health measurement frameworks to assess brand strength over time
    Design and evolve frameworks for measuring marketing effectiveness across brand and demand activities
    Own the design and interpretation of marketing KPIs linked to business outcomes
    Lead analysis of campaign performance, media effectiveness, and long‑term versus short‑term impact
    Support segmentation, targeting, and buyer journey understanding in complex, multi‑stakeholder buying environments
    Act as a strategic thought partner to Brand, Demand, Content, and Sales teams
    Enable better decision‑making by clarifying trade‑offs, scenarios, and expected outcomes
    Support business and finance stakeholders by translating marketing performance and effectiveness into clear commercial implications and investment recommendations.

Location and flexibility

This position offers a flexible location and can be based near any of our Sandvik Coromant sites.

Your profile

You combine analytical depth with a strategic perspective and enjoy working where insight meets decision‑making. You have experience in measurement and evidence‑based marketing principles, such as brand growth, mental availability, and effectiveness theory, and the confidence to apply them in an industrial B2B context.  

You also bring:

    A track record of working in matrix organizations with cross‑functional stakeholders
    Experience translating insights into strategic direction and actionable frameworks
    Background in driving or contributing to structured marketing measurement cycles
    Demonstrated ability to influence and align teams through clarity and structure
    Education in a relevant field

Success in this role comes from curiosity, structured thinking, and the confidence to challenge assumptions. You’re collaborative by nature, clear in your communication, and pragmatic in how you balance long‑term brand building with short‑term performance.

Our culture

Innovation is in our DNA and we’re proud to shape the future of manufacturing in close collaboration with our customers and partners. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results. Add fair and rewarding benefits, as well as many different career opportunities in an inspiring global environment. Meet some of your future colleagues at our career page or visit our website, LinkedIn or Facebook page to get to know us further.  

Contact information

Are you curious to know more about this position? Please contact Rafael Araujo, hiring manager, at rafael.araujo@sandvik.com

We’ve already decided on which advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contacts in that matter.

    Tord Engström, Akademikerföreningen, +46 (0)76 106 62 87

Recruitment Specialist: Hanna Thomas

How to apply

Send your application no later than October 14, 2026. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by e-mail. Job ID: R0092743.

We aim for an open and fair recruitment process and use different tools to ensure an objective assessment. Later in the process, you may be invited to complete a personality and logic test.

To learn more about our recruitment process, please visit our career site or contact HR Services at hrservices.sweden@sandvik.com

Sandvik Coromant is part of the global industrial engineering group Sandvik and is at the forefront of developing manufacturing tools and machining solutions, with knowledge that drives the industry standards and innovations demanded by the metalworking industry now and in the next industrial era. Collaborations with educational institutions, extensive investment in research and development and strong customer partnership ensure the development of machining technologies that change, lead and drive the future of manufacturing. Sandvik Coromant owns over 1700 patents worldwide, employs around 8000 staff and is represented in more than 150 countries.

jobs.title: Waiter - Quality Grand Hotel Kongsberg
jobs.description:
Er du klar for å skape uforglemmelig gjesteopplevelser?

På Quality Hotel™ er ingen dag lik - heldigvis! I det ene øyeblikket sjekker vi inn stamgjesten på forretningsreise, mens vi i det neste serverer middag til hockeylaget. Et hotell er et puslespill av mennesker som skaper minneverdige gjesteopplevelser. En viktig brikke for å levere akkurat dette er servitøren. En person som beveger seg gjennom rommet, leverer service med stor S og som er født med glimt i øyet!

Nå søker Quality Hotel™ Grand Kongsberg en servitør som kan balansere tallerkener, bestillinger og mersalg, samtidig som hen skaper minneverdige gjesteopplevelser. Stillingen innebærer arbeid på dagtid, kveldstid og i helger.

Nysgjerrig på hva stillingen innebærer?

  • I samarbeid med Food & Beverage-teamet er arbeidsoppgavene å sørge for at driften flyter smidig i restauranten/baren/frokosten, holde orden og bidra til et godt arbeidsmiljø.
  • Du er med på å bidra til at avdelingen når målene.
  • Vi jobber for å opprettholde vårt gjesteløfte ved å levere en innbydende atmosfære og pålitelig service.

Høres dette ut som deg?

  • Du elsker virkelig å møte nye mennesker og å skape positive opplevelser for gjestene.
  • Du har evnen til å møte gjesten ut fra hvem de er og tilpasse servicen din deretter.
  • Du trives i et raskt og dynamisk miljø og kan håndtere nesten alt som dagen har å by på.
  • Du har en spesiell evne til å finne den beste veien videre.
  • Du er en lagspiller, og kollegene dine ser på deg som tilgjengelig og støttende.
  • Erfaring fra restaurant- og hotellbransjen er et pluss.

Hvorfor velge Quality Hotel™ & Strawberry?

Vi tilbyr mer enn bare en jobb – vi tilbyr en plass hvor du kan vokse, både personlig og profesjonelt. På Quality Hotel™ tror vi på generøs gjestfrihet, og det gjelder også vårt personale. Hos oss får du:

  • Et dynamisk og pulserende arbeidsmiljø hvor ingen dag er lik.
  • Muligheter for karriereutvikling og vekst innen Strawberry.
  • Personalrabatter og friends & family-priser på våre 200+ hotell.
  • Fire gratis hotellnetter hvert år.
  • 25 % rabatt på mat och drikke på alle våre restauranter og barer.
  • Fantastiske tilbud på opplevelser, reiser, shopping og mye mer.  

Om Strawberry

Strawberry er ikke et hvilket som helst selskap i hotellbransjen – vi er en rebell med et varmt, bankende hjerte. Strawberry er en portal til en verden av mer enn 240 hotell, 120 restauranter og 20 spaanlegg, hvor vi skaper tusenvis av opplevelser hver dag. Strawberry bygger på våre kjerneverdier: energi, mot og begeisting. Vårt team, bestående av 20 000 kvalifiserte medarbeidere fra mer enn 166 land, er det som får oss til å vokse. 

Forbered deg på å skape uforglemmelige gjesteøyeblikk sammen med oss!

Søk i dag for å bli en del av vårt team hvor vi sammen skal skape uforglemmelige gjesteopplevelser! Vi går gjennom søknadene fortløpende, så vent ikke – stillingen kan bli besatt før siste søknadsfrist.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Det er en grunn til at det er akkurat du som ønsker å jobbe i Strawberry. Du ser muligheter på våre 100 destinasjoner. Du tror du vil passe inn i vårt mangfold blant 18.000 ansatte. Du er spent på våre fantastiske hotellkjeder og du har energi, mot og begeistring så det holder. Vil du vite mer ...

jobs.title: IT Project Manager (German-speaking), Matrix42, Espoo, Kuopio, Frankfurt
jobs.description:
About the role

As an IT Project Manager at Matrix42, you will be responsible for delivery projects related to Service Management (ITSM/ESM) and Identity Management (IAM/IGA) solutions. Your work will focus particularly on the German and Finnish markets and on successfully delivering projects related to public and private sector tenders. You will collaborate closely with sales, technical consultants, and clients to ensure successful project delivery and high customer satisfaction.

You can work in a hybrid model from the Espoo (Säteri), Kuopio, or Frankfurt office, and you enjoy meeting colleagues and customers face-to-face on a regular basis. The role requires occasional travel depending on project and customer needs.

You are offered:
- The opportunity to build your career in a growing international company
- A warm, low-hierarchy, people-centric work community where colleagues support each other and laughter is part of everyday life
- An agile growth company of the right size, without unnecessary bureaucracy, but with clear processes and strong development opportunities
- A working culture where humanity and well-being come first, while drive and high motivation are visible in everyday work

Work tasks

In your role as IT Project Manager, you will be fully responsible for planning, executing, and steering customer projects related to Service and Identity Management solutions. Your tasks include close collaboration with sales, technical experts, and customers, as well as managing project resources, time entries, and budget adherence.
- Lead end-to-end planning and execution of IT implementation and development projects
- Guide and coordinate technical consultants and the project team
- Monitor project resources, budgets, and schedules to ensure targets are met
- Conduct status meetings and report progress to steering groups and other stakeholders
- Ensure customer satisfaction and proactive communication throughout all project phases

We are looking for

- Strong experience leading IT projects in direct client-facing roles, ideally on the supplier side, acting as the primary point of contact between customer and delivery teams
- Fluent German and English skills, and Finnish language skills are an advantage
- Knowledge of different project management methodologies (e.g., Agile and Waterfall)
- Willingness to travel when required by projects
- Excellent collaboration and communication skills with various stakeholders

Experience with public sector tendering processes and working with public sector customers as well as delivering SaaS-based or platform solutions are seen as an addition asset.

To succeed in this role you are:
- Proactive and eager to learn – you adopt new knowledge quickly and boldly seize development opportunities
- Curious about change – you thrive in an environment where processes evolve, new people and products are introduced, and you can adapt your approach to different situations
- Natural organizer and bridge-builder – you guide both customers and project teams toward shared goals, collaborate smoothly with stakeholders, and communicate credibly even in demanding situations
- Service-minded and solution-oriented – you sense the dynamics of customer situations, identify opportunities to add value, and take responsibility for ensuring smooth progress for both the customer and your own organization

The role will later require passing a limited security clearance.

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Planning & Navigation)
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer on Robot Autonomy, you will make our robots navigate dependably across real customer sites. Our stack works. The gap between working and dependable is the whole job. Every new site tests how a robot understands its surroundings and chooses where to go: a ramp the planner avoids, a narrow passage that exposes a poor route, a gate that changes the map, a person who steps into the robot's path, or localization drift that builds over a long patrol. You treat those cases as the real navigation problem to solve, not as edge cases.

You'll shape the technical choices behind reliable navigation, from sensor selection, ground segmentation, and traversability estimation to predicting how people and vehicles move and planning safe, efficient routes around them. The system has to work day and night, in challenging weather, across different embodiments and changing site conditions. We measure success by whether the robot completes its patrol on a live site, not by how it performs in simulation.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

  • Navigation and path-planning design: how robots represent traversable space, select routes, avoid obstacles, and reach goals across complex sites.

  • Sensor integration driven by navigation requirements, including what ground segmentation and traversability estimation need in day, night, and challenging weather.

  • Environment understanding: how the robot distinguishes ground from obstacles and estimates which terrain is safe and practical to traverse.

  • Behavior prediction: anticipate how people, vehicles, and other dynamic obstacles will move, and plan routes that stay safe and efficient around them.

  • Field reliability: reproduce failures from deployments, find the root cause, and fix it at the right layer, from sensor data and maps to costmaps, planners, and recovery behaviors.

  • Planning under imperfect localization: plans that stay useful when the state estimate drifts and the robot must execute routes in tight or dynamic environments, working with the rest of Robot Autonomy on localization and control.

  • Validation on real robots: logs, simulation, and repeatable field tests to verify that design choices and changes hold across routes, lighting, weather, and site layouts.

  • New autonomy capabilities: work with the engineers building the operator application and backend so operator requests and new robot capabilities rest on a sound navigation design.

  • The field feedback loop: work closely with forward-deployed engineers to turn site issues into bugs, design changes, and improvements to the navigation stack.

  • Regular site visits to build a practical understanding of how robots and sensors behave in real operating conditions.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for an engineer who has taken a robotics system from unreliable to dependable and takes ownership beyond individual tickets. You can explain why you made a navigation design choice and what it costs. When a robot takes a bad route, you can tell whether the planner, the map, the state estimate, or the robot's behavior is at fault, and you fix the right one. You are comfortable in the field and want to understand how robots behave in real customer environments.

YOUR BACKGROUND:

  • A Master's degree or PhD in mechanical engineering, computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Proven track record building and deploying navigation on ground mobile robots in the real world (3+ years or equivalent depth).

  • Hands-on experience with mobile robot navigation and path planning: route or local planning, static and dynamic obstacle avoidance, costmaps, or recovery behaviors.

  • Understanding of how mapping and localization affect navigation, and the ability to diagnose when a planning issue is actually caused by the map, the state estimate, or robot behavior.

  • Understanding of how lighting, weather, terrain, and sensor limitations affect perception and navigation, with experience developing or validating systems for demanding real-world conditions.

  • Hands-on experience with robotics sensors and hardware, especially LiDAR, IMUs, and cameras. You can investigate issues across software, networking, and hardware boundaries.

  • Experience testing and debugging navigation on physical robots using logs, visualization, simulation, and repeatable field tests.

  • Strong ROS 2, C++, and Python skills.

  • Clear communication of navigation and path-planning design choices and their trade-offs.

  • Willingness to visit customer sites regularly.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Experience with legged robots or with more than one robot embodiment.

  • Experience with Nav2 or a comparable navigation framework.

  • Motion prediction or planning among people and vehicles, such as trajectory forecasting or socially aware navigation.

  • Terrain mapping and traversability methods: elevation mapping, learned traversability, or semantic segmentation for navigation.

  • Experience with night-time or all-weather sensing, such as thermal cameras or LiDAR in rain and fog.

  • Background in security, defence, or other safety-critical robotics deployments.

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

  • Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.

  • Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package

  • Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Localisation & State Estimation)
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer on Robot Autonomy, you will build and own the state estimation that tells our robots how they are moving and where they are. You'll fuse data from IMUs, cameras, LiDAR, GNSS, and platform-specific odometry into accurate, real-time estimates that support reliable autonomy day and night, across different robot platforms.

This is a builder's role first: you'll use the estimation methods and tools best suited to the problem, then do the engineering needed to make them work on real robots. Our robots operate in complex environments where terrain, weather, vibration, lighting, and sensor dropouts degrade measurements. We care less about novelty for its own sake and more about whether your systems perform reliably across platforms in the field.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

  • Design and ship real-time estimators for position, orientation, velocity, and angular velocity across our robot platforms.

  • Fuse data from multiple sensors, handling noise, asynchronous measurements, calibration errors, changing sensor quality, and dropouts.

  • Develop estimation approaches suited to different platforms, including reusable components and interfaces that account for their distinct sensors and dynamics.

  • Improve localization and odometry in challenging conditions, including GNSS-denied environments and cases with degraded or intermittent sensing.

  • Integrate state estimation with perception, planning, and control so downstream systems receive reliable estimates and useful uncertainty information.

  • Investigate failures using logs, datasets, simulation, and field testing; identify root causes and verify that fixes improve performance on real robots.

  • Build evaluation and testing workflows that make estimator performance measurable and repeatable across robot types and operating conditions.

  • Work closely with the rest of Robot Autonomy and with forward-deployed engineers to turn deployment experience into improvements to the estimation stack.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for an engineer who has built or deployed state estimation systems for real robotic or autonomous platforms. You understand that estimator performance depends on the whole system: sensor behavior, calibration, timing, platform dynamics, and how autonomy uses the estimate.

You're comfortable choosing an approach based on the operational need, then making it robust through careful implementation, evaluation, and field validation. You measure success by whether robots operate reliably in the real world, not by algorithmic novelty alone.

YOUR BACKGROUND:

  • A Master's degree or PhD in mechanical engineering, computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Proven experience building or deploying state estimation, localization, or odometry systems for robots or autonomous systems (3+ years or equivalent depth).

  • Strong understanding of nonlinear state estimation, sensor fusion, Kalman filtering, and uncertainty representation.

  • Experience working with real sensor data and practical issues such as noise, calibration, synchronization, vibration, and data loss.

  • Strong C++ and Python skills, with experience building robotics software in ROS 2.

  • Ability to analyze estimation failures and debug issues across sensors, software, and robot behavior.

  • Experience evaluating robotics systems using recorded data, simulation, or physical robots.

  • Strong software engineering practices, including version control, reproducible experiments, and disciplined performance evaluation.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Experience with both ground and aerial robots, or with applying estimation methods across different robot platforms.

  • Experience with visual-inertial odometry, LiDAR-inertial odometry, SLAM, or GNSS/INS integration.

  • Familiarity with optimization-based estimation and factor graph tools such as GTSAM or Ceres.

  • Understanding of robot dynamics and how estimation affects planning and control.

  • Experience operating robots in challenging conditions such as GNSS-denied areas, low light, dust, rain, or high vibration.

  • Experience monitoring or improving deployed robotics systems in the field.

  • Publications at top robotics venues are a plus, but not expected. We value reliable systems shipped on real robots.

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

  • Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.

  • Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package

  • Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Device Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Technology that speaks your language

Domera Labs builds Ami, the first AI companion for seniors. Ami brings the power of a smartphone into a more human form: voice-first and deeply personalized

We at Domera Labs are rethinking human-machine interaction from first principles by introducing a better interface to interact with technology: voice

By combining the most intuitive hardware design with frontier AI, Ami makes AI accessible for the fastest growing demographic worldwide. The goal is to make the everyday life older adults more seamless, while addressing that generation's biggest challenge: loneliness and isolation. With Ami we are building the category leader of a new hardware paradigm by building a full standalone device (and not a gadget) that aims to makes the smartphones of today redundant.

The underlying technology of Ami combines a model-agnostic streaming pipeline consisting of proprietary models and off-the-shelf frontier models to create a hyper-personalized and proactive user experience. The backbone of Ami is built by our foundational lab that builds a social intelligence model that is optimized for social interaction, human behavior and interpersonal skills.

Domera Labs has secured large distribution agreements, a model co-development partnership with a leading AI lab, and ODM manufacturing proposals. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of human-machine interaction, mass-consumer facing hardware and shape frontier research with social/non-quantifiable benchmarking.


Core Responsibilities

You own the software that makes Ami work. Your primary responsibility is to architect, write and ship the on-device application and services for our mass-market consumer device, from voice interaction and cloud connectivity to onboarding, recovery and everyday reliability. You will work directly with our ODM and silicon partners to integrate that software with the underlying platform.

Our target hardware uses a Qualcomm SoC with Android/AOSP or embedded Linux depending on the final platform selection.

Our users are 75 years old and there is no screen, no settings menu, and no IT support. If the device does not work out of the box, it fails. Your job is to make the following work.

  • On-device application: build and own Ami's application and services, including interaction logic, real-time audio streaming, cloud communication, local state and recovery from network interruptions or service failures

  • Device identity and fleet management: provisioning, unique device identity, secure key storage, and the systems that let us know what every unit in the field is doing

  • The maintenance channel: a reliable service and diagnostics path to the device (BLE, USB-C, or both) for field debugging, factory test, and recovery

  • Out-of-the-box experience: first-boot network onboarding that a senior can complete alone, with no screen and no smartphone as a crutch. This is the single highest-stakes piece of the product

  • Flash and update management: partition layout, A/B OTA with rollback, staged fleet rollouts, and bricking as a category of bug that never happens

  • Base platform behaviors: boot and recovery, factory and soft resets, button and LED mappings, audio feedback, power states and battery behavior

  • The audio front end: working with our ODM and silicon partners on mic array, echo cancellation, wake word, and the latency budget from mic to first spoken token

  • Bringing the device through EVT, DVT, and PVT with our ODM as the technical counterpart on our side

 

What we are looking for

  • ⁠A builder's mindset: ship > fail > learn > improve

  • Stay focused when multiple priorities compete and the ranking is unclear

  • Work seamlessly across research and engineering

  • Can navigate ambiguity and make progress in fast-moving research environments

  • This is a founding-level position. You will work directly with the founders, shape the architecture from the ground up, and see your work in users' hands within months, not years.

 

Technical Requirements

  • You have shipped a connected consumer device to production, not just to a demo table. You know what goes wrong between DVT and mass production

  • Strong hands-on experience building production device applications and services on Android/AOSP, using Kotlin or Java and C/C++ for native components and hardware integration. You can own the on-device application end to end, including background execution, connectivity, audio and integration with platform services. Experience with embedded Linux is a plus; Python proficiency for tooling and testing is expected.

  • Experience developing for AOSP-based devices beyond standard smartphone apps: integrating privileged applications and services, working with system permissions and hardware interfaces, and collaborating with an ODM or silicon vendor on the underlying platform. Qualcomm platform experience is a plus.

  • Wireless connectivity in the real world: Wi-Fi provisioning, BLE, and ideally cellular. You have debugged a device that would not join a network in someone's home

  • OTA and flash: bootloaders, secure boot, A/B partitioning, rollback, and staged rollouts across a fleet

  • You can diagnose issues across application code, platform services and hardware interfaces

  • A builder's mindset: you'd rather ship and measure than debate

  • Bonus: real-time audio pipelines (I2S, DSP, AEC, wake word), on-device ML inference, factory test and manufacturing line bring-up, regulatory certification (CE, FCC), power optimization for battery life, experience in NLU / NLP

 

We lean toward senior engineers who can independently own production device software, but demonstrated ownership matters more than years of experience. Experience integrating real-time AI services into a consumer product is a plus.

 

What you get

  • ⁠Founding-team equity and a real say in technical direction

  • ⁠A product with signed launch partners, not a demo in search of a market

  • ⁠A small team, short decision paths

  • Cash compensation range of CHF 80 - 120k with significant equity incentives

  • Opportunity to shape the future of hardware and social intelligent AI models


We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.

Compensation: CHF 70K – CHF 120K • Offers Equity

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja – Tampere
jobs.description:
**Services Netto Oy** hakee henkilökohtaisia avustajia työskentelemään vammaispalvelulain mukaisessa henkilökohtaisessa avussa **Tampereella ja muualla Pirkanmaan alueella**.

Etsimme luotettavia, vastuullisia ja asiakaslähtöisiä henkilöitä avustamaan asiakkaitamme heidän jokapäiväisessä elämässään. **Työ alkaa heti.**

**Työtehtävät**

Henkilökohtaisen avustajan tehtävänä on mahdollistaa vammaisen henkilön itsenäistä elämää ja tukea hänen omia valintojaan. Asiakas määrittelee itse, missä asioissa ja miten häntä avustetaan.

Työtehtävät määräytyvät aina asiakkaan yksilöllisen avuntarpeen mukaan ja voivat sisältää esimerkiksi:

- avustamista päivittäisissä toimissa

- pukeutumisessa ja henkilökohtaisissa toimissa avustamista

- ruoanlaitossa ja kodin arjen tehtävissä avustamista

- kauppa- ja asiointikäynneillä avustamista

- ulkoilussa ja liikkumisessa avustamista

- harrastuksissa, vapaa-ajalla ja yhteiskunnallisessa osallistumisessa avustamista

- asiakkaan mukana kulkemista kodin ulkopuolella

- opiskeluun tai työhön liittyvää avustamista asiakkaan tarpeiden mukaan.


Henkilökohtainen apu perustuu asiakkaan **itsemääräämisoikeuteen, omiin valintoihin ja yksilölliseen avuntarpeeseen**. Avustaja toimii asiakkaan ohjeiden mukaisesti ja tukee asiakasta tekemään itse niitä asioita, joita hän tekisi ilman toimintarajoitettaan.

Tehtävä ei ole sairaanhoito- tai hoivatyötä, eikä avustajan tehtävänä ole päättää asiakkaan puolesta hänen arjestaan.

**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Toivomme sinulta:

- luotettavuutta ja vastuullisuutta

- asiakaslähtöistä ja kunnioittavaa työotetta

- hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja

- kykyä kunnioittaa asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta ja yksityisyyttä

- oma-aloitteisuutta ja joustavuutta

- kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti

- riittävää suomen kielen taitoa työtehtävien hoitamiseen.


Aikaisempi kokemus henkilökohtaisen avustajan työstä katsotaan eduksi, mutta se **ei ole välttämätöntä**. Perehdytämme työntekijät tehtävään ja asiakkaan yksilöllisiin tarpeisiin.

**Työsuhde ja palkkaus**

- **Työskentelyalue:** Pirkanmaa

- **Työn aloitus:** Heti

- **Työaika:** Osa-aikainen / keikkatyö asiakkaiden avuntarpeiden mukaan

- **Palkka:** 12,59 €/h + mahdolliset työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät


Työvuorot määräytyvät asiakkaiden henkilökohtaisen avun päätösten ja yksilöllisten tarpeiden perusteella. Työtä voi olla arkisin, iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin.

**Hakeminen ja rekrytointi**

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV sähköpostitse osoitteeseen: **tyohakemukset@servicesnetto.com**

Kerro hakemuksessasi lyhyesti itsestäsi, aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi, käytettävyydestäsi sekä siitä, millä Pirkanmaan alueilla pystyt työskentelemään.

**Työhaastattelu voidaan järjestää joustavasti etänä videoyhteydellä (WhatsApp). Myös työsopimuksen allekirjoittaminen onnistuu sähköisesti, joten rekrytointiprosessi voidaan tarvittaessa hoitaa kokonaan etänä.**

Hakemuksia käsitellään jo hakuaikana, ja työntekijöitä voidaan palkata **heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä**.

**Tervetuloa työskentelemään Services Netto Oy henkilökohtaisen avun palveluihin!**

jobs.title: Personlig assistent sökes till kvinna i Täby
jobs.description:
Vi söker nu en kvinnlig personlig assistent till en självständig kvinna som är rullstolsburen och bor i villa i Täby tillsammans med sina barn och hund.

Vi söker dig som vill bli en trygg och uppskattad del av hennes vardag och som har möjlighet att arbeta på ett varierat schema med både vardagar och helger.

Om rollen

Som personlig assistent är du ett viktigt stöd i vardagen och bidrar till att familjens liv fungerar smidigt. Arbetet utgår från hennes behov och innebär att vara lyhörd för när stöd behövs, samtidigt som du respekterar hennes självständighet.

Det är en personlig roll där personkemi, förtroende och lyhördhet är viktigt.

Vem är du?

Vi tror att du är en person som är:

    

Ansvarsfull och pålitlig

    

Lugn, trygg och ödmjuk

    

Lyhörd och flexibel

    

Praktiskt lagd och har god fysik

    

Bekväm med att arbeta självständigt

    

Positiv till att vara en del av en familjs vardag

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av personlig assistans eller liknande arbete, men det viktigaste är personkemin och att du förstår rollen som personlig assistent.

I hemmet finns hund, så du behöver vara hundvan och inte hundallergisk.

Det är ett plus om du tycker om att vara ute och kanske även har ett intresse för trädgård och praktiska saker kring hemmet.

Arbetstider

Tjänsten innebär arbete enligt schema med både vardagar och helger. Vi ser gärna att du är flexibel och har möjlighet att hoppa in extra vid behov, exempelvis vid sjukfrånvaro eller när någon annan assistent är ledig.

Det är en fördel om du bor i Täby eller närområdet.

Vad kan du förvänta dig?

Du får en personlig och varierad arbetsplats där du blir en viktig del av vardagen. Här finns möjlighet att bygga en fin relation över tid och bidra till en trygg, fungerande och glädjefylld tillvaro.

För rätt person är detta ett arbete där du verkligen kan göra skillnad – samtidigt som du blir en del av en familjs vardag.

Känner du att detta skulle passa dig? Då ser vi fram emot att höra från dig!

Tjänstgöringsgrad: Deltid, enligt schema med vardagar och helger Lön: Timlön enligt överenskommelse. Övriga ersättningar enligt kollektivavtal. Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse

Vilka är vi? Omsorg assistans är ett assistansbolag med huvudkontor i Eskilstuna och kunder över hela Sverige. Vår målsättning är att skapa de bästa förutsättningarna för individanpassad personlig assistans. Hos oss får du trygghet genom kollektivavtal, marknadsmässig lön, pension, försäkringsskydd och friskvårdsbidrag.

jobs.title: Sosiaaliohjaaja, Alppikadun asumispalveluyksikkö
jobs.description:
Hakusessa hyvä tyyppi!

Etsimme vakinaiseen työsuhteeseen mielenterveys, päihde- ja asunnottomuustyöstä kiinnostunutta sosiaaliohjaajaa Alppikadun asumispalveluyksikköön.

Sosiaaliohjaajat ovat asiakkaiden tukena asumisen eri vaiheissa. Tehtävä sisältää mm. vuokranmaksun seurantaa, etuuksien hakemista yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa, tuen tarpeen arviointia sekä yhteistyötä eri verkostojen kanssa. Tehtävässä korostuu eri tavoin asumisen sujumisen ja jatkumisen turvaaminen. Työ on arkisin tapahtuvaa päivätyötä liukuvalla työajalla ja saat suunnitella työpäiväsi kulun itse.

Sosiaaliohjaajien työryhmä koostuu neljästä sosiaaliohjaajasta, joista kukin toimii noin 20 asukkaan omana sosiaaliohjaajana. Työn tukena ovat yksikön ohjaajat, sairaanhoitaja, työvalmentaja, tiiminvetäjä, esihenkilö ja yksikön johtaja.

Olet koulutukseltasi sosionomi ja sinulla voi olla aiempaa kokemusta päihde- ja mielenterveystyöstä, mutta tärkeintä on kyky kohdata asiakkaat vaihtelevissa elämäntilanteissaan ja toimia osana moniammatillista työyhteisöä. Omaat hyvän huumorintajun, paineen sietokykyä ja kestät keskeneräisyyttä. Tarjoamme vaihtelevan ja mielenkiintoisen työn, jossa kahta samanlaista päivää ei ole. Saat kattavan perehdytyksen ja osaavan työyhteisön tuen työllesi.

Alppikadun asumispalveluyksikkö toimii Asunto ensin -periaatteen mukaisesti tarjoten tuettua asumista asunnottomuutta kokeneille. Yksikössä on 89 asukaspaikkaa ja henkilökunta paikalla ympäri vuorokauden. Yksikön perustehtävänä on turvata asukkaisen asuminen omissa vuokra-asunnoissaan. Kantavana ajatuksena on tarjota asukkaille mahdollisuus ihmisarvoiseen elämään, johon olennaisena osana kuuluu asunto, osallisuuden kokemus omaan elämään, yhteisöön ja yhteiskuntaan.

Palkkaus yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:n G25E( 3073,62-3353,31€/kk). Tarjoamme lisäksi työterveyshuollon ja e-passiedun.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa tuetun asumisen esihenkilö Anu Ratinen, puh. 045-77347362.

Paikka täytetään heti sopivan hakijan löydyttyä ja haastatteluja tehdään jo hakuaikana, joten ole pikaisesti yhteydessä, mikäli kiinnostuksesi heräsi!

jobs.title: Supply Chain Specialist - Master Data
jobs.description:
Reliable data is the foundation for efficient supply chain flows, high customer satisfaction and smarter ways of working. We are now looking for a Supply Chain Specialist - Master Data to join our Supply Chain Planning team. The role is about ensuring that material data is accurate, structured and available when needed, enabling materials to be ready for ordering and supporting colleagues across the business.



Your role

In this role, you will play an important part in keeping our supply chain moving. By making sure our master data is accurate, complete and available at the right time, you help create the foundation for efficient planning, smooth material flows and strong customer delivery. You will work closely with the business, collaborate with many different stakeholders and contribute to smarter, more reliable ways of working in SAP and support material availability in our distribution center.



With a mix of structure, curiosity and collaboration, you will:

    Create and maintain materials in SAP, helping ensure the right data is in place when the business needs it.
    Follow up on data quality, resolve errors and support material availability in our distribution center.
    Support engineering changes, reactivations, phase-outs, Last Time Buys and related analysis that help us make informed supply chain decisions.
    Collaborate with colleagues across supply chain planning, plants, sourcing, logistics, production, marketing, trade and spare parts.
    Ask the right questions, follow up and help create structure when information is missing, priorities change or ownership needs to be clarified.



The role reports to Manager Supply Chain Planning S&OE.



To succeed, you will need

We are looking for someone who understands the value of accurate, reliable data and see how supply chain flows come together. You have experience and/or education within master data and data management in the area of supply chain, logistics, sourcing, planning, and information management. Just as important, however, is your willingness to learn, ask questions and grow into the role.



Creating structure and accuracy comes natural for you, you thrive in details, solving problems and understanding how details connect to the bigger picture. You like collaborating with others, communicate in a clear and helpful way and are comfortable following up when information is missing or priorities shift. With your positive attitude and ownership mindset, you help move things forward together with the team.



In return, we offer

You will join a team where collaboration, curiosity and continuous improvement are part of everyday work. In this role, we offer:

    A role with clear impact on efficiency, customer satisfaction and smarter ways of working.
    Support from experienced colleagues as you learn, grow and build confidence in the role.
    The opportunity to build specialist knowledge and contribute to better, more scalable master data processes.
    For recent graduates, a possible opportunity to be considered for our Graduate Kickstart Program.



Job location

The role is based at our office in Sickla, Stockholm, with a hybrid work model combining collaboration at the office with flexibility.



Application & Contact information

Talent Acquisition Team:Hanna Andersson

Email:hanna.andersson@atlascopco.com

Our selection process includes interviews and for some roles skills assessments to gain a deeper insights into your profile. We're eager to get to know you, hear about your skills, and discuss your potential to grow with us.



Please note that we review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.





Uniting curious minds

Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

jobs.title: Head of Business Operations
jobs.description:
Company description:

Ericsson AB

Job description:   Join our Team  About this opportunity:

Ericsson invites you to join our team as a Service Delivery Line Manager. This dynamic role is focused on supporting service sales directly or indirectly through the allocation of our team's resources. As a Service Delivery Line Manager, you will play an essential role in aligning with and understanding our overarching Service Delivery Processes, Models, Tools, and Strategies. Safety is paramount in our operations, with all work being carried out within Occupational Health and Safety requirements. This opportunity requires the management of both our internal workforce and our ARPs/ASPs. Acting in accordance with the respected Ericsson Leadership Framework, the successful candidate will promote the organization's corporate values, ethics, and culture, driving optimum performance.

What you will do:

- Implement Performance Management for the correct understanding and adherence to processes, methods, and tools.



- Conduct Resource and Competence Management to ensure cost-effective allocation of quality resources.



- Oversee unit finance to guarantee a secured budget for the unit.



- Assure service delivery execution aligned with well-defined KPI/SLA/targets for contract-conforming deliveries.



- Collaborate with and support service sales to back our delivery.



- Apply the Service Delivery Strategy, translating strategic plans to the unit level.

The skills you bring:

- Competency Management, SRM Process, Merlin and data analytics.



- Capacity Planning, SRM Process, forecasting tools and data analytics.



- Strategic Planning.



- Sales process.



- Financial structures for Service Delivery.



- Work Level Agreement (WLA) and Service Level Agreement (SLA).



- Financial Acumen.



- Customer Insights.



- Employee Performance Management.



- Market insights.



- Ericsson Business Processes Knowledge.

jobs.title: Resepsjonist 40-50% søkes
jobs.description:
Vi søker etter en arbeidssom og serviceinnstilt person til vårt team i resepsjon på P-Hotels Brattøra.

Stillingen innebærer selvstendig resepsjonsarbeid på kveldstid og i helger, og krever derfor serviceinnstilling, fleksibilitet, høy arbeidskapasitet og et øye for detaljer. Det er må være forbredt på ett høyt arbeidstempo. Den ansatte er alene på jobb.

Søker må være fylt 20 år grunnet salg av alkohol.

Søker må snakket nakke flytende skandinavisk og engelsk. Dersom du har erfaring med servicearbeid er dette en fordel.

Stillingen innebærer inn og utsjekk, hendvendelser fra gjester, daglige gjøremål og eventuelt annet forefallende arbeid.

Stillingen er helg og ukedager dag/kveld.

Det må kunne jobbes natt ved sykdom.

Det må påregnes ekstra arbeid i ferier.

Oppstart i midt oktober. Må jobbes i jul/nyttår

Søknad kan sendes til:

louise@p-hotels.no

Om arbeidsgiveren:

P-Hotels Brattøra åpnet dørene i 2012, og har ønsket gjester velkommen siden da. Hotellet har 128 hotellrom, 3 møterom og en restraurantavdelig som benyttes ved arrangement på hotellet.

Hotellet ligger midt i Trondheims nye knutepunkt for all kommunikasjon, hvor tog, buss og båt møtes ved Trondheims sentralbanestasjon.

Det er en nydelig takterrasse på hotellet med utsikt over byen og fjorden.

jobs.title: Miljøarbeider/terapeut
jobs.employer: PLEIE- OG OMSORGSTJENESTEN I VÆRØY HJEMMEBASERTE TJENESTER
jobs.description:
Drømmer du om en jobb der faglig utvikling møter storslått natur og ekte nærhet til mennesker?
Velkommen til Værøy kommune – et unikt øysamfunn ytterst i havgapet i Lofoten.
Her får du ikke bare en jobb som miljøterapeut, men en livsstil preget av frisk havluft, mektige fjell, kritthvite strender og et varmt, inkluderende lokalmiljø.
Som miljøterapeut hos oss blir du en viktig del av et lite, men engasjert miljø der du virkelig får brukt kompetansen din.
Hos oss er det personen – ikke diagnosen – som står i fokus. Du får tett samarbeid med kollegaer, møte tjenestemottakere der de er, stor grad av selvstendighet og muligheten til å påvirke tjenesten direkte. Hos oss blir du sett, hørt og verdsatt – både som fagperson og menneske. På Værøy er avstandene korte, skuldrene lave og fellesskapet sterkt. Her kan du starte dagen med en fjelltur, nyte stillheten ved havet etter jobb, og oppleve spektakulære naturopplevelser året rundt – fra midnattssol til nordlys.
Vi tilbyr ikke bare en spennende og meningsfull jobb, men også en unik mulighet til å leve enklere, friere og nærmere det som virkelig betyr noe.
Er du klar for å kombinere faglig engasjement med livskvalitet i verdensklasse? Da kan Værøy være stedet for deg.



For alle stillinger gjelder de regler som går fram av lover, reglement og gjeldende tariffavtale.
Ved første gangs ansettelse i kommunen gjelder en prøvetid på 6 måneder.
Dokumentasjon legges fram i forbindelse med intervju, eller før tiltredelse.  
Før tiltredelse i stilling må godkjent politiattest etter Helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven § 5-4 fremvises.




Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidsoppgaver omfatter målrettet miljøarbeid og praktisk bistand til tjenestemottakere 
Utøve miljøterapeutiske oppgaver med utgangspunkt i tjenestemottakers ressurser og behov
Primærkontakt oppgaver
Gi bistand og oppfølging til mennesker med daglige og sammensatte behov
Dokumentere i fagsystemer
Rapportskriving/oppgaveskriving
Samarbeid med pårørende/verge
Målrettet miljøarbeid

Interne endringer kan bli aktuelt av hensyn til tjenestens behov, eller med bakgrunn i søkers motivasjon og/eller kompetanse.
Sammen med fagleder vil du være med på å kartlegge, igangsette og følge opp tiltak som bidrar til økt livskvalitet for tjenestemottaker.
Vi jobber etter nasjonale faglige retningslinjer og lovverk. 






Kvalifikasjoner
  • 3årig bachelor innenfor helse- og sosialfag. 
  • Relevant erfaring kan vurderes dersom vedkommende ikke har 3 årig høgskoleutdannelse, eller er miljøarbeider. 
  • Gjerne med kompetanse innen målrettet miljøarbeid eller annen relevant tilleggsutdanning, men ikke et krav

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Værøy er den nest ytterste av Lofotkommunene med ca. 700 innbyggere, plassert sentralt midt i havet. Øya er et eldorado for deg som er glad i friluftsliv til vanns og til lands, med spektakulære fjell som er forholdsvis enkle å bestige. Her har kunstnere som Theodor Kittelsen og Karl Erik Harr latt seg inspirere, og det polare lyset inviterer til fotografering. Værøy har dessuten en svært spesiell kulturhistorie knyttet til unike fangst- og mattradisjoner. Ørn ble fanget med hendene og lundefugl med garn og hund fram til 1950-tallet. Et kreativt næringsliv med prisvinnende matprodukter er i dag med på å sette Værøy på kartet. Værøy har Nord Norges største pelagiske fiskemottak, og nær 60% av all norsk lutefisk produseres hos oss.

Værøy er et produktivt og livskraftig samfunn. Om lag 90 % av befolkningen bor på tettstedet Sørland. Her finner man butikkene, fiskeindustri, bilverksted og det meste av servicetilbud i kommunen. På nordsiden av øya ligger Lofotens eldste kirke.

Værøy har 10-årig grunnskole med ca. 70 elever og full barnehagedekning.

Kommunen har daglig ferge- og helikopterforbindelse med Bodø, og fergeforbindelse med Moskenes (fastlands Lofoten) flere dager i uka.

jobs.title: Santa Claus
jobs.description:
SANTA CLAUS WANTED IN ROVANIEMI CITY CENTRE – JOIN SANTA CLAUS CITY OFFICE!

Would you like to bring joy and create unforgettable moments as Santa Claus? Santa Claus City Office is looking for a Santa Claus performer at Lordi Square in the heart of Rovaniemi for the season from 1 November 2026 to 31 March 2027.

SHIFTS AND EARNING OPPORTUNITIES Evening shifts are available every day from 4 pm to 9 pm or 10 pm. Morning shifts are also available on Saturdays and Sundays.

Ideally, we would like to find someone who can work plenty of shifts. For the right person, we offer good pay and the opportunity to make this a full-time job for the season.

However, shifts can also be shared among several Santa performers as a team, just as we did last year. You do not need to be available for every shift – a few shifts a week or occasional cover would also be a valuable help. You can combine this role with another job and start with a few shifts to get to know the work.

Please feel free to apply and tell us what availability would suit you. Lets see how we can arrange the shifts together!

WHAT IS THE WORK LIKE? Being Santa is all about warm welcomes and creating happy moments. You will meet children and adults from around the world, chat with them and become part of their Christmas memories.

This is a cheerful, people-focused role where you can bring your own personality and sense of humour. We value a relaxed, positive atmosphere where both our team and our visitors feel welcome.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? We are looking for a warm, calm and friendly person with a customer service mindset who feels comfortable stepping into the role of Santa Claus. We value a convincing Santa presence, life experience and the ability to connect with both children and adults.

Basic conversational English is enough – you do not need perfect grammar or fluent English. Most of our visitors are not native English speakers either, so basic English and a willingness to chat will take you a long way. Any additional language skills are a bonus!

International and English-speaking applicants are warmly welcome. Previous experience is not essential, as we provide training. Training will begin soon, and we will agree on your starting date with you.

LOCATION Santa Claus City Office, Lordi Square, Rovaniemi, Finland. You will work in a warm Santas cabin brought to the square for the season.

HOW TO APPLY Send us a short introduction about yourself by email. Tell us why you would suit the role of Santa Claus, how much work you are looking for and when you could start training. Please also describe your language skills and your availability for evening shifts and weekend morning and evening shifts.

We would love to hear from you!

CONTACT

Marko Paksuniemi, Santa Claus City Office

paksuniemimarko@yahoo.com

EMAIL SUBJECT JOB APPLICATION – Santa Claus / Santa Claus City Office

PLEASE NOTE BEFORE APPLYING Unfortunately, we are unable to provide accommodation. Applicants must already be in Rovaniemi or be able to arrange their own travel to Rovaniemi and accommodation for the entire employment period. Applicants must also have the legal right to work in Finland.

jobs.title: Kalankäsittelijä, fish processer to Föglö, Åland Islands for Fish Industry, +6 months,
jobs.description:
--- *Suomeksi alla* ---

We are now looking for fish processer(s) to Föglö, Åland Islands.

The job involves many different functions at the fish factory: killing, gutting, "cleaning" the fish, "collecting" roe, packing, lifting heavy boxes, among other tasks. If you have forklift skills, you can also drive a counter balance forklift. The working conditions are cool, around +2 – +6°C, so readiness to work in cold conditions is important. At Nordic Trout/Bolt.works, you will become part of a skilled and truly collaborative "work family".

Who is this job suitable for?
The work requires decent general strength, endurance, and proactivity. Previous experience in fish processing jobs is a plus but not necessary. You will receive orientation to the job. The job is suitable for someone who enjoys being close to nature, as the workplace is located on Föglö Island, in a scenic archipelago. Finnish hygiene passport will be needed but we can train it for the right person. You should be able to communicate in English to ensure smooth communication within the team.

- Working hours: 20-37,5hr/week
- Salary: approx. 12-13 EUR/h, depending on experience
- Contract length: approx. 6 months, with good possibility to continue further as permanent employment
- Start date: Sometime during October
- Collective agreement: Food Industry collective agreement
- Employment: through Bolt

Information about the workplace and practical arrangements:
Föglö does not have city services: the island has small grocery store, a library, and a gym, while other city services can be found in Mariehamn, 35 minutes by ferry + 30 minutes by car/bus. You can also manage without a car on the island, as the workplace is close to accommodation and there is a bus to Mariehamn. If desired, we can arrange accommodation for you: you will typically stay with another employee in a two-room apartment, and the rent is around 300-450 EUR, which may or may not include electricity/water, depending on the apartment (you will receive exact information with the job offer).

About Nordic Trout (Kalaneuvos):
Nordic Trout is the largest player in the Finnish fish industry and a pioneer in fish processing, fish wholesale, fish import and export, and fish farming. Kalaneuvos has been producing high-quality fish products for over 40 years, focusing not only on product quality but also on modern production methods and employee well-being. The Kalaneuvos brand offers a wide range of delicious fish products. For more information: www.kalaneuvos.fi

Please apply for the job soon: the position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

--- SUOMEKSI ---

Etsimme nyt kalankäsittelijää Föglöön, Ahvenanmaalle.

Työtehtävät pitävät sisällään monipuolisia toimintoja kalatehtaalla: kalan teurastusta, perkausta, "putsaamista", mädin keruuta, pakkaamista sekä raskaiden laatikoiden nostelua. Jos sinulla on trukin ajotaitoja, voit ajaa myös vastapainotrukkia. Työskentelyolosuhteet ovat viileät (noin +2 – +6 °C), joten valmius työskennellä kylmässä on tärkeää. Nordic Troutilla / Bolt.worksilla pääset osaksi ammattitaitoista ja todella yhteisöllistä "työperhettä".

Kelle työ sopii?
Työ vaatii kohtalaista yleiskuntoa, kestävyyttä ja oma-aloitteisuutta. Aiempi kokemus kalankäsittelystä on plusa, mutta ei välttämätöntä – saat työhön perehdytyksen. Tehtävä sopii henkilölle, joka nauttii luonnon läheisyydestä, sillä työpaikka sijaitsee Föglön saarella saaristossa. Hygieniapassi vaaditaan, mutta voimme kouluttaa sen oikealle henkilölle. Sinun tulee pystyä kommunikoimaan englanniksi sujuvan tiimityöskentelyn takaamiseksi.

- Työaika: 20–37,5 t/vk
- Palkka: n. 12–13 €/h kokemuksesta riippuen
- Sopimuksen kesto: n. 6 kuukautta, hyvä mahdollisuus jatkua vakituisena työsuhteena
- Aloitus: Lokakuun aikana
- TES: Elintarvikealan työehtosopimus
- Työsuhde: Bolt.worksin kautta

Tietoa työpaikasta ja käytännön järjestelyistä:
Föglössä ei ole kaupunkipalveluita: saarella on pieni ruokakauppa, kirjasto ja kuntosali, kun taas muut palvelut löytyvät Maarianhaminasta (35 min lautalla + 30 min autolla/bussilla). Saarella pärjää myös ilman autoa, sillä työpaikka sijaitsee majoituksen lähellä ja Maarianhaminaan kulkee bussi. Halutessasi järjestämme sinulle majoituksen: yleensä asut toisen työntekijän kanssa kaksiossa. Vuokra on noin 300–450 €, ja se voi sisältää tai olla sisältämättä sähköä/vettä asunnosta riippuen (saat tarkat tiedot työtarjouksen yhteydessä).

Nordic Trout (Kalaneuvos):
Nordic Trout on Suomen kalatoimialan suurin toimija sekä edelläkävijä kalanjalostuksessa, tukkukaupassa, tuonnissa, viennissä ja kasvatuksessa. Kalaneuvos on valmistanut korkealaatuisia kalatuotteita jo yli 40 vuotta panostaen tuotteiden laadun lisäksi nykyaikaisiin tuotantomenetelmiin ja työntekijöiden hyvinvointiin. Kalaneuvos-brändi tarjoaa laajan valikoiman herkullisia kalatuotteita. Lisätietoja: www.kalaneuvos.fi

Hae paikkaa pian: tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

jobs.description:
Personlig assistent för man i rullstol - Ulricehamn

Vi söker nu en engagerad och omtänksam personlig assistent till en man i rullstol i centrala Ulricehamn. Som assistent kommer du att vara en viktig del av kundens vardag och ge stöd inom olika områden.

I denna roll kommer du att assistera kunden med personlig hygien, måltider, övriga dagliga aktiviteter samt vara behjälplig med att svara i telefonen och hantera kommunikation med externa parter. Du kommer vara kundens förlängda armar och ben, och din närvaro kommer göra en verklig skillnad i hans liv. Lika viktigt som att ingripa när det behövs behöver man ha respekt och förståelse när man ska ta ett steg tillbaka och låta kunden få tid för sig själv.

Erfarenhet/Kvalifikationer:

    Förmåga att kommunicera tydligt och respektfullt.
    Empatisk och tålamodig samt har förmåga att lyssna och vara stödjande.
    Förmåga att vara flexibel och anpassa sig till kundens behov och önskemål.

Personliga egenskaper:

Vi söker dig som är empatisk, lyhörd och har förmågan att skapa en trygg och tillitsfull relation med kunden. Du är noggrann och pålitlig samt har förmågan att arbeta självständigt och ta egna initiativ när det behövs. Det är viktigt att du är följsam och respektfull gentemot kundens integritet och önskemål. Du har inga problem med axlar eller rygg då en del tunga lyft förekommer i arbetet.

Vad vi erbjuder dig som anställd:

    En meningsfull och givande arbetsuppgift där du kan göra verklig skillnad i en persons liv.
    Möjlighet att utveckla din förmåga att kommunicera, arbeta med empati och skapa relationer.
    Ett positivt och stöttande arbetsklimat där din insats uppskattas och värderas högt.


Anställningen är vid behov när ordinarie personal är sjuk eller ledig. Arbetspassen är mån-sön kl 10-19.30

Om du känner att du har den empati, engagemang och vilja som krävs för att vara en bra personlig assistent, och vill vara en del av att skapa en meningsfull vardag för en annan person, tveka inte att söka till denna position. Vi ser fram emot att få träffa dig och välkomna dig till vårt team!

Monument Assistans är alternativet för personer med personlig assistans som söker skräddarsydda lösningar. Vi har hög kompetens och bred erfarenhet av personlig assistans. För att vi ska kunna hjälpa våra kunder på allra bästa sätt så arbetar vi med hög tillgänglighet och ett nära och personligt samarbete.

Vi vet att vår personal är nyckeln till att bedriva en bra personlig assistans. Därför är det centralt för oss att du som medarbetare är både känner stolthet och glädje över att arbeta hos oss. Vi på Monument Assistans vill därför ge dig möjligheten att utvecklas i din yrkesroll. Vi uppskattar nyfikna och engagerade medarbetare.

Vi erbjuder dig goda lönevillkor, ett nära ledarskap och friskvårdsersättning. Vi ger dig en arbetsmiljö där det är högt i tak och där du har goda möjligheter att påverka din egen arbetssituation. Vi tar gärna fram individuella fortbildningslösningar beroende på i vilken typ av uppdrag du arbetar i. Hos oss får du möjligheten att växa!

jobs.title: Zorgcoördinator – Ernstig verstandelijke en meervoudige beperking
jobs.description:
Wij zoeken een ervaren zorgcoördinator voor de doelgroep ernstig verstandelijke en meervoudige beperking.

Wat ga je doen?

Je komt te werken in Clinge met de doelgroep ernstig verstandelijke en meervoudige beperking. Jouw toewijding als zorgcoördinator is bijzonder, jij biedt cliënten een fijn thuis, geborgenheid, structuur, stabiliteit en perspectief. Binnen deze doelgroep kan sprake zijn van moeilijk verstaanbaar gedrag. Dit vraagt om een sensitieve, geduldige en professionele benadering, waarbij je samen met het team en gedragsdeskundige zoekt naar de betekenis en behoeften achter het gedrag. Je begeleidt cliënten vanuit een individueel begeleidingsprogramma. Hierbij is het opbouwen en borgen van een onvoorwaardelijke ondersteuningsrelatie essentieel.

Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor de coördinatie en kwaliteit van zorg. In samenwerking met de manager en gedragsdeskundige zet je de lijnen van het behandelklimaat uit. Je stemt met alle betrokkenen af hoe jullie de zorg het beste laten aansluiten. Samen met het team en betrokken netwerk, heb je een coachende rol in het leven van deze cliënten. Dit doe je vanuit de Triple -C methodiek.

Je bent als zorgcoördinator teamcoach van het team, waarbij je het team coacht op zorginhoudelijke aspecten en de teamdynamiek. Daarnaast werk je wekelijks mee in het rooster, samen met je team. Met jouw enthousiasme breng je je kennis en ervaring over op je collega’s.

Naast je rol binnen het team ben je onderdeel van een zorgcoördinatorteam. Samen met je collega’s werk je aan kwalitatief goede zorg binnen Tragel. Je neemt actief deel aan de overleggen, denkt mee over ontwikkelingen binnen het cluster en bent een betrokken sparringpartner voor je collega’s in de dagelijkse praktijk.

Wat kun je?

De ideale zorgcoördinator werkt vanuit de visie en een positieve houding met minstens 3 jaar ervaring. Dit doe je met een grote mate van zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid voor de totstandkoming, actualisatie en uitvoering van bijvoorbeeld het zorgplan. Hiervoor heb je een relevante opleiding gevolgd en/of relevante werkervaring opgedaan.

Daarnaast ben je taak- en resultaatgericht en durf je voorop te lopen. Je hebt een goed beeld van zorgvragen en de mogelijkheden van de cliënten. Daar maak je concrete afspraken over. Je hebt een actieve rol in projecten vanuit maatschappelijke betrokkenheid, en je werkt zowel intern als extern samen met diverse disciplines en cliëntvertegenwoordigers.

Tot slot ben je goed in plannen, organiseren en doelgericht werken. Dit doe je met jouw goede communicatie- en sociale vaardigheden. Je bent in staat om op een inspirerende wijze collega’s aan te zetten tot kwaliteitsverbeteringen van zorg en begeleiding van de cliënten en bij te dragen aan ontwikkelingen in het team.

Een A1- of A2-opleiding, bachelor/graduaat orthopedagogiek, of opvoeder jeugd- en gehandicaptenzorg past perfect.
