jobs.title: Athlete Welfare and Sustainability Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Role
The Athlete Welfare & Sustainability Assistant plays a key role in supporting the delivery of the ISU’s athlete welfare and sustainability strategy.  Working closely with the Head of Athlete Welfare & Sustainability, the Coordinator will help develop, implement and monitor initiatives that enhance athlete wellbeing, strengthen safeguarding practices, support athlete education, and advance sustainability across the sport.  
This position is ideal for an organized, proactive and people focused professional with experience in athlete welfare, sports administration, athlete services, or related fields.  The successful candidate will work with a wide range of stakeholders, including athletes, Member Federations, event organizers, volunteers, committees, and external partners to ensure the successful delivery of programs and initiatives worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

Athlete Welfare

Sports Medicine and Athlete Health Committee
•    Coordinate meeting logistics and administration such as preparing agendas, taking minutes and tracking action items as required.
Injury Reporting/Monitoring
•    Support the collection, analysis and reporting of athlete injury data.
•    Assist in the preparation of injury monitoring reports and related documentation.

Calm Zone
•    Assistance with recruiting, supporting and coordinating a network of volunteers to ‘staff’ Calm Zones at ISU events.
•    Liaise with Organizing Committees and the ISU Events Team to plan and deliver Calm Zones throughout the season.
•    Support the ongoing development and evaluation of Calm Zones initiatives.

Event based Mental Health/Welfare
•    Attend event medical meetings as required to promote and coordinate mental health and welfare provision.
•    Act as a point of contact for welfare and safeguarding concerns, ensuring appropriate referral and escalation to the Head of Athlete Welfare and Sustainability.

Anti-Doping Education delivery
•    Coordinate with the International Testing Agency (ITA) regarding event-based Education delivery.
•    Liaise with Organizing Committees to facilitate anti-doping education programs with regards to Event Based Education delivery (ITA and ISU lead).
•    Delivery of ISU Anti-Doping education sessions and support for athlete awareness initiatives.

Cyber Safety
•    Assist with the administration, promotion and development of the ISU Cyber Safety Program.
•    Support awareness campaigns and educational initiatives aimed at protecting athletes online.

Safeguarding
•    Maintain and regularly update safeguarding contact information within Member Federations.
•    Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of safeguarding practices across the ISU community.
•    Assist in promoting safe sport education and awareness initiatives.
Athletes Committee
•    Provide meeting coordination and administrative support, including minute taking when required.

Career/Transitions/Personal Development/Education
•    Support the coordination and administration of athlete development programs delivered in person, online or through the eRink platform.
•    Assist with the initiatives that support athlete education, career planning and life skills development.

Retired Athlete/Alumni Support Program
•    Support the development and maintenance of a global skating alumni network.
•    Assist in creating engagement opportunities, resources and support programs for retired athletes.

Sustainability

Sustainable Ice Rinks Alliance
•    Support the planning and coordination of the New Energy for Ice Rinks Conference and related sustainability initiatives.

Sustainability Awards & Sustainability Fund
•    Provide administrative and coordination support for sustainability awards and funding programs.
•    Assist with application processes, stakeholder communications and program management.

Environmental Sustainability Working Group
•    Coordinate meetings and provide administrative support, including agenda preparation and minute taking when required.

Reporting
•    Support sustainability reporting activities and data collection processes.
•    Provide administrative assistance for sustainability projects, partnerships, and industry collaboration.

 
Essential Requirements:
•    Experience in athlete welfare, athlete services, sport administration, coaching or related field.
•    Strong understanding of athlete wellbeing, including physical health, mental health, safeguarding and athlete transitions.
•    Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to handle sensitive matters professionally and confidentially.
•    Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
•    Experience coordinating projects, events, programs, or stakeholder networks.
•    Highly level of administrative proficiency and attention to detail.
•    Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
•    Demonstrated commitment to safeguarding, diversity, equity and inclusion.

Desirable:
•    Knowledge of environmental sustainability principles and best practices
•    Experience supporting sustainability programs, projects, or reporting initiatives.
•    Previous experience working directly with athletes.
•    Personal experience as a current or former athlete.

Personal Attributes:
•    A genuine passion for athlete wellbeing and development.
•    Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.
•    Initiative, adaptability and a solution-focused mindset.
•    The ability to exercise sound judgement and maintain confidentiality.
•    A collaborative approach and commitment to fostering a positive, inclusive sporting environment.

What We Offer
•    A unique opportunity to contribute to the growth of one of the world's leading International Sports Federations.
•    A dynamic, international, and collaborative working environment based in Lausanne, the Olympic Capital.
•    The opportunity to work on prestigious global sporting events and commercial partnerships.
•    A high-impact role with autonomy, responsibility, and exposure to senior stakeholders.
•    Competitive remuneration and benefits package, commensurate with experience.
•    Opportunities for professional development and continuous learning.
•    A flexible and inclusive workplace that values innovation, collaboration, and excellence.

Why Join Us
If you are passionate about sport and driven by creating successful commercial partnerships, this role offers a unique opportunity to shape the commercial future of an International Sports Federation. You will work with leading global brands, develop innovative sponsorship opportunities, and help drive the continued growth and global impact of the ISU.

How to Apply
If you are passionate about sports and want to use your welfare and sustainability expertise to support an international federation, we would love to hear from you.

Former athletes and skaters are strongly encouraged to apply, as their unique experiences are highly valued. At ISU, we are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and supportive environment where everyone is valued and empowered to succeed.

jobs.title: Product Portfolio Senior Manager Education & Athletes Pathways
jobs.employer: Académie Internationale des Sciences et Techniques du Sport (AISTS)
jobs.description:
Postulation : https://www.jobup.ch/en/jobs/detail/b2dabcb5-de1a-49d7-870d-91c536ce96a7/?source=company_detail

Are you passionate about creating seamless experiences in education and sport? Are you sensitive to serving the
athletes and bringing them at the center of the sport ecosystem ?
Do you thrive in dynamic, multicultural environments?
Are you driven by developing projects and businesses?
Then join AISTS – the International Academy of Sports Management and Technology – and contribute to shaping
the future of sports leadership.
About AISTS
AISTS, the International Academy of Sport Management and Technology, is a prestigious not-for-profit academic
centre at the heart of the global sport industry. Founded in 2000 in Lausanne, Switzerland, it offers world-class
education and advisory services in sport management. AISTS's unique multidisciplinary approach combines
expertise in technology, management, economics, medicine, career and leadership. With a network of over 750
alumni, 100 distinguished lecturers, and partnerships with leading sport organisations, AISTS shapes the future of
international sport. Located in the Olympic Capital, it serves as a bridge between academia and industry, promoting
excellence in sport management to drive positive global impact through the power of sport.
Your role
The Product Portfolio Senior Manager is responsible for translating the AISTS portfolio strategy into a coherent,
prioritised and commercially viable product portfolio across three product areas: Education, Athletes Pathways, and
Advisory. It initially owns direct responsibility for both Education and Athletes Pathways products streams.
The role ensures that AISTS moves from a primarily MAS-centred organisation toward an integrated platform
combining industry access, short and tailored education, athlete-career transition solutions, and international sport
organisations advisory services (e.g. impact assessments, certification, research mandates, etc.).
Positioning & Context
Reporting to the Executive Director, you will work in partnership with the Professors, experts, speakers and partners
of the AISTS network. Internally, you will work closely with the Head of B2B Partnerships & Development and the
Head of Operations & Delivery. Initially, you will manage the Sport Advisory Product Coordinator.
This role is established as part of a new strategy adopted and rolled out by AISTS. The scope of the role may evolve
according to the deployment of the strategy.
Key responsibilities
Portfolio Management
• Own the consolidated product portfolio roadmap across Education, Athletes Pathways and Advisory.
• Establish common product management standards and coherence across products in terms of target
audiences, value propositions, pricing logic, delivery model, resource needs and expected contribution.
• Prioritise product development using mission alignment, market demand, revenue potential, profitability,
scalability, feasibility and strategic value.
• Translate strategic priorities into clear product briefs, annual product plans, performance indicators and
implementation milestones.
• Maintain product governance discipline, ensuring that each product has an owner, business case, delivery
model, quality criteria, review cycle and is aligned with B2B development (proposal development) and clearly
framed for the Operations and Delivery team to operate
• Provide the Executive Director with a consolidated view of product performance, portfolio risks,
dependencies and investment priorities.
Product ownership
1. Athlete Pathways
• Design and develop the AISTS Athletes Pathways offer, including education, transition, employability,
leadership, entrepreneurship and mentoring formats for active, retiring and retired athletes.
• Build the product value proposition for IFs, NOCs, Olympic stakeholders, athlete commissions, agencies,
sponsors and individual athletes.
• Coordinate athlete-specific curriculum development, mentor pools, career coaching components and
storytelling opportunities with alumni, industry experts and corporate partners.
• Track performance of the athlete pathway product, including athletes supported, revenues, scholarships,
partner satisfaction and post-programme outcomes.
2. Master of Advanced Studies in Sport Management and Technology (MAS) & Continued Education
programmes
• Coordinate curriculum architecture, learning formats, field visits, internships, Client Team Projects, research
papers and industry exposure to maintain and strengthen the leading positioning of the programme.
• Work with delivery coordinators and academic partners to ensure programme design is feasible, coherent
and quality-controlled.
• Lead on the design of the annual Continued Education portfolio across Sport Business, Sport Leadership and
Sport Technology, ensuring their relevance for market needs
• Define course value propositions, target segments, learning outcomes, course leaders, pricing logic and
annual calendar priorities.
• Source lecturers and guest speakers and, where relevant, supervise MAS Client Team Projects
3. Training Houses and tailored education solution
• Develop repeatable B2B education offers for sport organisations starting with IFs and then NOCs, NFs,
LOCs, etc.
• Package tailored education into clear formats, such as staff training, leadership journeys, member federation
modules, Olympic Capital Training Weeks and capability-building workshops ensuring balanced
customisation and reusability
4. Learning innovation and online support
• Use digital or online learning selectively to support continuity, blended formats, pre-work, follow-up modules
or scalable partner needs.
• Contribute to the development of reusable learning assets, templates, cases and content libraries when they
improve product quality and scalability.
• Coordinate with academic and industry stakeholders to keep education products relevant to emerging
trends such as digital, AI, sustainability, governance, fan engagement and commercial innovation.
Product team management
• Manage and coordinate the work with the product coordinator(s).
• Ensure that product owners work closely with Business Development and Marketing for market relevance,
positioning and partnerships and with Operations for delivery feasibility.
What we offer
• Dynamic Work Environment: Join an international team passionate about sports and education.
• Career Development: Gain exposure to a wide range of projects in a prestigious organisation.
• Inclusive Culture: We value diverse perspectives and actively encourage applications from all genders,
backgrounds, and experiences.
• Professional Growth: Access to training programmes to enhance your skills and career development.
• Mentorship Opportunities: Be part of a supportive team committed to helping you thrive in your role.
• Prime Location: Work in Lausanne, the Olympic Capital, with access to sports facilities and view on the
lake
Your skills and experience
• Experience:
o 8 years of experience, with minimum 3 years in continuing education programme design and/or
product development;
o Strong ability to bring strategy into product architecture, priorisation and execution plans;
o Business mindset, with ability to assess value propositions, pricing and financial contribution
without compromising AISTS quality and mission;
o Strong understanding of Olympic and international sport ecosystem, including trends and
challenges in the sport industry, and experience in working with / on elite-athletes related topics;
o Relevant network in the sport industry and international sport organisations a strong asset;
o Familiarity with Swiss higher education environment an asset;
• Technical Skills:
o Proficiency in MS Office 365; experience with e-learning, AI solutions, data management and CRM
an asset;
o Native-level fluency in English or French, with proficiency in the other language (3rd language is
a plus).

Are you passionate about challenging the status-quo in sport?
Do you value research-driven and scientifically rigourous solutions?
Are you driven by developing projects and businesses?
Do you thrive in dynamic, multicultural environments?
Then join AISTS – the International Academy of Sports Management and Technology – and contribute to shaping
the future of sports leadership.
About AISTS
AISTS, the International Academy of Sport Management and Technology, is a prestigious not-for-profit
academic centre at the heart of the global sport industry. Founded in 2000 in Lausanne, Switzerland, it
offers world-class education and advisory services in sport management. AISTS's unique multidisciplinary
approach combines expertise in technology, management, economics, medicine, career and leadership.
With a network of over 750 alumni, 100 distinguished lecturers, and partnerships with leading sport
organisations, AISTS shapes the future of international sport. Located in the Olympic Capital, it serves
as a bridge between academia and industry, promoting excellence in sport management to drive
positive global impact through the power of sport.
Your role
The Product Coordinator – Sport Advisroy is responsible for building AISTS sport advisory – such as
impact assessment, sport equipment certification, etc. – into clear, market-facing products with
scientifically-rigorous methodologies and lean delivery models. The role covers two main product
families: impact assessments and analysis for sport events and organisations; and sport equipment
compliance/certification services for key sport equipment stakeholders (rule-makers, designers,
producers, users…).
Positioning & Context
Reporting into the Product Portfolio Senior Manager, you will work in partnership with the Professors
and researchers of the AISTS network. Internally, you will work closely with the B2B Development &
Marketing team and the Operations & Delivery team.
This role is established as part of a new strategy adopted and rolled out by AISTS. The scope of the role
may evolve according to the deployment of the strategy.
Key responsibilities
Product development
• Transform AISTS globally recognised assessment methodologies into clear, repeatable and costefficient
products while preserving its core characteristics: scientifically rigorous and pragmatic for
industry application, incl.:
o standardised impact assessment products with economic impact as a core entry point and
extensions into environmental, social & media and stakeholder/community-relevant impacts
o independent sport equipment regulation assessment and certification processes to support
key sport stakeholders – federations, event organisers, manufacturers and athletes – in
guaranteeing a level-playing field companies in designing, assessing and certifying
processes, operational frameworks and quality standards.

event organisers, cities, hosts, sponsors and sport organisations.

academic partners and delivery coordinators where appropriate:

timelines and delivery roles.

engineering or standards partners.

standards to protect AISTS credibility.

and infrastructures, innovation with new materials, compliance with emerging standards and
certification, etc.
Commercial packaging and performance, governance and continuous improvement

providers and venues.

pitch narratives.

projects

repeatability.

jobs.title: SOFTWARE SOLUTION ENGINEER
jobs.description:
Securecell is a Swiss technology company at the intersection of biotechnology, engineering, and healthcare. For more than three decades, we have been developing innovative solutions that help advance scientific discoveries and improve people's lives. Combining deep expertise in bioprocess control with a strong culture of innovation, we collaborate across disciplines to transform complex challenges into practical technologies that create real-world impact.

Continuing steadily on our sustainable innovation path and growth journey, we are looking for a
SOFTWARE SOLUTION ENGINEER
for our Information Technology Department – Software Architecture team – product R&D role

THE OPPORTUNITY
It is an opportunity to contribute to technologies that support groundbreaking scientific discoveries and help shape the future of biotechnology and healthcare.
As a member of our Software Architecture team, you will play an important role in designing, developing, verifying, and managing the lifecycle of software solutions for innovative medical and biotechnological devices. Working closely with experts from various disciplines, you will contribute to challenging projects, develop innovative solutions, and help deliver products that create value for our customers worldwide.
Whether you are improving existing technologies, driving innovation, or solving complex technical challenges, your contributions will have a direct impact on our success and future growth.
You are part of our Software Architecture Team and accountable for the design, development, verification, and lifecycle management of our Lucullus software platform. In this role, you actively contribute to software development, provide technical leadership, and oversee the software development, integration, and verification of our innovative devices. Lucullus is our process information management platform for bioprocess labs: it connects and controls lab devices and bioreactors, acquires and stores process data, and supports experiment planning and analysis.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
•    Design and evolve the architecture of the Lucullus platform (modules, APIs, data model, device-integration layer) and document key decisions in architecture decision records and design specifications.
•    Implement key components yourself (approx. 50% of time is hands-on design and coding)
•    Own the non-functional requirements: performance, reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability.
•    Prototype and evaluate new technologies before they are adopted in the product.
•    Create, review, and maintain technical documentation, including specifications and design descriptions.
•    Support requirements management, risk management, and compliance activities in accordance with applicable standards and quality requirements.
•    Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams across Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Manufacturing, and Product Management.

WHO YOU ARE
You enjoy solving complex technical challenges and thrive in an environment where software architecture and development are critical to delivering innovative technologies. You are proactive, hands-on, and motivated to develop technologies that advance biotechnology and improve lives. You are comfortable providing technical leadership within cross-functional and agile teams. You would rather design and build than coordinate: you enjoy writing code, sketching architecture, and defending technical trade-offs with facts. Leading here means leading by technical example, not by managing people or schedules.


YOUR PROFILE
•    Completed studies (FH / Uni / ETH) in Engineering, preferably Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology.
•    At least 3years of experience in software development.
•    Strong expertise in software development with experience in enterprise-grade applications. Hands-on approach.
•    Ability to collaborate effectively, translating architectural decisions into technical solutions across teams.
•    Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate complexity in a large technical stack.
•    Ability to mentor engineers and drive technical decisions through design reviews, code reviews.
•    Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD tools, and automation frameworks.
•    Proficiency in Linux environments, particularly with LTS distributions and Oracle Linux (preferred but open to alternatives).
•    Industry experience in Medtech/Biotech and in (bio)process technology is not a prerequisite; however, there must be a strong interest and awareness that the environment is regulated.
•    Experience working with enterprise databases, particularly Oracle DB and PostgreSQL.
•    Solid understanding of security best practices, compliance, and secure coding methodologies.
•    A valid work permit is required, and only direct applications will be taken into consideration (no agencies)

WHAT WILL MAKE YOU SUCCESSFUL
•    Experience in biotechnology, bioprocessing, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, diagnostics, or life sciences (nice to have)
•    Proven track record of designing and personally implementing software systems end-to-end
•    Passion for innovation and technology
•    Ability to navigate ambiguity and identify practical solutions
•    Strong sense of ownership and accountability
•    Curiosity and a continuous learning mindset
•    Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trusted relationships across disciplines
•    Experience working in multidisciplinary and international environments

WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT SECURECELL
Make an Impact: Your work contributes to innovative technologies that support scientific progress, improve healthcare outcomes, and help address real-world challenges
Work with Exceptional People: Join a global team of talented scientists, engineers, software developers, and business professionals who are passionate about innovation and collaboration
Grow Your Career: We encourage continuous learning and provide opportunities to develop new skills, expand your expertise, and take on new challenges
Innovate Every Day: Be part of cutting-edge projects and help develop solutions that push the boundaries of biotechnology, automation, and healthcare technology
Take Ownership: We believe great ideas can come from anywhere. You'll enjoy a high level of responsibility, autonomy, and the opportunity to make a visible contribution
Enjoy a Collaborative Culture: Our success is built on teamwork, knowledge sharing, mutual respect, and a genuine passion for solving complex challenges together
Be Part of Our Growth Story: Join a growing Swiss technology company where innovation, entrepreneurship, and long-term thinking are at the core of everything we do

WHAT WE OFFER
With flexible working arrangements, a modern workplace, flat hierarchies, and short decision-making paths, we empower individuals to take ownership, contribute ideas, and make a visible impact. Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, and continuous improvement, allowing every team member to help shape the future of our company and the industries we serve. To complement this, we offer:
•    Competitive compensation aligned with your experience and contribution
•    Comprehensive benefits package supporting your well-being
•    Generous vacation entitlement, flexible working hours, and hybrid or remote work options
•    Flexible leave arrangements that support work-life balance
•    Learning and development opportunities through training, mentoring, and hands-on experiences
•    Opportunities to collaborate with international customers and partners
•    Convenient location with direct access to public transport, free indoor parking, complimentary coffee and mineral water
•    Private accident insurance and paid time off for new parents
•    Employee share purchase programs (availability varies upon eligibility)
•    Regular team events and company gatherings that strengthen connections and celebrate success

JOB LOCATION
This position is based at Securecell AG headquarters in Urdorf (Zurich), Switzerland. Reporting to: Head of Software.

INTERESTED?
We look forward to learning more about you! Please submit your complete application, including a cover letter, a resume, certificates, and references, through our career portal at www.securecell.ch/jobs, and share, in 2-3 sentences, what attracted you to our company and this role.

jobs.title: Head of Physical Education and Sport Faculty
jobs.description:
Aiglon College seeks to appoint a suitably qualified
Head of Physical Education and Sport Faculty
to join the school from: August 2027

Your profile
The role and candidate profile for this role is detailed in the attached job description and person specification.

Successful Aiglon staff are enthusiastic, experienced, committed, reflective, dynamic and willing to try new ideas. If you share these values and have an appetite for challenge and an ambition to make a positive impact on our world, we welcome your application.  

About us
Located in Chesières (Vaud, Switzerland), Aiglon College is a not-for-profit, international boarding school offering a distinctive, world-class education in a stunning alpine setting.
The school was founded on a distinctive ethos: the balanced development of mind, body and spirit. This philosophy underpins everything we do at Aiglon, both inside and outside the classroom.
There are over 480 students, representing more than 70 nationalities, following the International GCSE (IGCSE) and International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB Diploma) programmes.

What we offer
Aiglon is dedicated to the well-being and professional development of all staff, within a vibrant, friendly, and modern workplace. Beyond competitive salaries and comprehensive social security benefits, we provide free accident and loss of salary insurances, generous pension and leave entitlements, as well as a range of special perks and advantages.

How to apply
Deadline for applications: 02.11.2026
Early applications are encouraged.  We reserve the right to appoint before the application deadline should we find the right candidate.  Please apply through our School platform (eteach) following the instructions; applications sent by standard email will not be considered.

Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children.
Applicants will therefore need to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.

You can find information on how the School processes your personal data within the School’s Privacy Notice.

JOB PURPOSE

Aiglon College is an international boarding school based in the Swiss Alps with a worldwide reputation for providing a challenging holistic education in an inspiring setting within a safe, caring and supportive framework. The School is CIS accredited, and caters for around 500 students aged 7-18 representing 70 nations. Students prepare for IGCSEs and the IB Diploma Programme.

The ideal candidate for this position would be an experienced, enthusiastic, dynamic, knowledgeable leader and/or teacher of Physical Education and Sport. PE and Sport are compulsory for students throughout the Junior and Senior schools. In Years 10 and 11 students have the option of studying IGCSE PE. Subsequently, in Years 12 and 13, Sports, Exercise and Health Science is offered and is currently taught in conjunction with the Science department.
KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Professional Standards and Expectations
Carry out teaching duties and exercise responsibilities in line with the Guiding Principles of Aiglon;
Treat all members of the community, colleagues and students, with respect and consideration. Treat all students fairly, consistently and without prejudice;
Set a good example to students in terms of appropriate dress, standards of punctuality and attendance;
Read and adhere to the various policies of the school as expressed in the Aiglon Guide and other agreed documentation, and support the ethos of the school by upholding the behaviour code, uniform and kit regulations and other expectations;
Be available to work on campus in good time to complete all necessary preparations and meetings before the start of term;
Take personal responsibility for professional development and participate in staff training in line with the continued professional development programme of Aiglon;
Encourage members of their faculty to take responsibility for their own professional development and ensure all in the faculty participate in staff training in line with the CPD programme of Aiglon;
Reflect on personal and school practices in pursuit of continuous improvement.
Participate in appraisal and self-evaluation activities and ensure the appraisal system is adhered to and completed within the faculty;
Chair a weekly faculty meeting;
Ensure all faculty members are aware of and adhere to departmental deadlines, policies and procedures;
Undertake pastoral and other duties, including weekend and evening duties, as prescribed within school policies;
Ensure that all deadlines are met as published in the school calendar and as directed by the Head of Faculty/Deputy School Directors;
Undertake professional duties that may be reasonably assigned, including cover and exam invigilation and ensure members of their faculty also undertake these duties;
Attend Assembly/Meditation on at least two mornings a week when averaged over any term and be prepared to give a Meditation once each year;
Be proactive and take responsibility for matters relating to health and safety;
Support the school through regular attendance at various events in the School Calendar (these may be religious, spiritual, sporting or cultural).
Departmental Management
Implement a clear vision for curriculum Physical Education and all aspects of Sport at Aiglon, making sure that there is continuity and progression between Junior School and Senior School;
Develop and manage the strategic development plan for the faculty in line with the School’s strategic development plan thus fostering a love of Physical Education and inspiring a lifelong commitment to Sport;
Line management of Head of Junior Physical Education and Sport, Head of Senior Physical Education and Sport, Head of Snowsports and Performance Athletes, MCFC football coach and the Sports Facilities Manager and support  them in the management of all other members of the Physical Education and Sport faculty;
Ensure that the faculty embraces the opportunities available through strategic partnerships including MCFC;
Ensure the faculty handbook is updated annually and includes reference to objectives for the year ahead which tie into the school’s overall objectives;
Provide a strategic link between the Academic Leadership Group and the Physical Education and Sport faculty, attending meetings and reporting on School-wide initiatives;
Ensure that the Department meets the curriculum requirements for the School;
Monitor and develop the quality of teaching, coaching and learning, through regular visits to lessons and otherwise, with a clear focus on excellence;
Implement a clear vision and structure for competitive inter-school sport across the School at Aiglon;
Implement a clear programme for inter-house sport at Aiglon. Liaise with the Director of Boarding and attend House Parent meetings where necessary to publicise and promote sporting initiatives, with clear communication to all stakeholders (students, staff and parents);
Promote and communicate to the Aiglon community initiatives and success stories from the Physical Education and Sport faculty, through weekly assemblies and the calendar alongside regular liaison with stakeholders in Admissions, Communications and Alumni teams;

jobs.title: Postdoc in intestinal regeneration and mucosal immunology
jobs.description:
A full-time (100%) postdoctoral position is available in the lab of Dr. Srustidhar Das, at the Department of Clinical Research and at the Research Unit of Inflammation Research, Department of Molecular Medicine, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. The position is limited to two years, with the possibility of extension subject to funding.

Research tasks

The position comprises research, teaching, professional development and supervision within intestinal tissue regeneration, epithelial biology, mucosal immunology and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). The postdoc will join a translational research programme that investigates how inflammation reshapes the intestinal epithelium and its surrounding tissue niche, and how these changes can be targeted to promote safe and durable mucosal healing.

The successful candidate will combine patient-derived organoid and co-culture models with molecular biology, functional assays, and computational analysis of single-cell and spatial datasets. The position is particularly suited to a researcher who can connect experimental biology with bioinformatics and clinically relevant questions.

Research environment

The postdoc will be embedded in a dynamic and highly collaborative research environment spanning the Department of Clinical Research and the Department of Molecular Medicine at SDU. The project benefits from close interaction among basic scientists, clinicians, bioinformaticians and translational researchers, with strong links to Odense University Hospital and access to patient-derived material, advanced disease models and state-of-the-art molecular technologies.

The environment provides excellent opportunities to develop an independent research profile, contribute to clinically relevant discoveries in IBD and tissue regeneration, and build collaborations across experimental, computational and clinical disciplines.

Research project

The project investigates how inflammatory history establishes persistent epithelial and niche memory, shapes epithelial plasticity and influences intestinal regeneration in IBD. Using patient-derived biopsies, intestinal organoids, fibroblasts and immune-cell co-cultures, we will determine how epithelial memory and injury-induced cell-state transitions influence regenerative capacity and distinguish effective from impaired mucosal healing.

Functional experiments will be integrated with single-cell RNA sequencing, chromatin-accessibility analysis, spatial transcriptomics and spatial epigenomics. CRISPR-engineered patient-derived organoids, including lineage reporters and targeted genetic perturbations, will be used to trace epithelial cell states and validate candidate mechanisms. Selected organoids will also be tested in engraftment models to determine whether regenerative phenotypes translate into improved tissue integration and repair in vivo.

Key responsibilities

  • Establish and manipulate patient-derived intestinal organoids and fibroblast–immune-cell co-cultures to investigate epithelial plasticity, cell-state transitions, regeneration, inflammatory responses and barrier function.

  • Generate and validate CRISPR-engineered organoids, including reporter lines and targeted genetic perturbations, and perform engraftment studies to assess regenerative potential in vivo.

  • Analyse and integrate scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, spatial transcriptomic and spatial epigenomic datasets using reproducible workflows for quality control, differential analysis, cell-state annotation, trajectory analysis and multimodal integration.

  • Apply molecular and cellular methods, including qPCR, immunostaining, advanced microscopy, flow cytometry and ELISA-based assays, and validate candidate pathways using pharmacological and CRISPR-based perturbations where appropriate.

  • Collaborate with clinicians, experimental scientists and bioinformaticians to analyse and interpret patient-derived samples and data.

  • Maintain accurate and reproducible records, present findings, prepare manuscripts and conference contributions, and contribute to grant applications, teaching and supervision where relevant.

Expectations of qualifications

The successful applicant must hold a PhD in molecular biology, cell biology, immunology, bioinformatics, computational biology, regenerative medicine, biomedicine or a closely related discipline, with documented research experience relevant to the project.

Essential qualifications

  • Documented experience in organoid biology, preferably involving intestinal or other tissue-derived epithelial organoids, and in designing mechanistic studies of epithelial plasticity and regeneration.

  • A strong background in tissue regeneration, epithelial biology, mucosal immunology, inflammatory disease or a closely related field.

  • Demonstrated expertise in analysing single-cell or spatial-omics data, with proficiency in R and/or Python and experience developing reproducible computational workflows.

  • Hands-on experience in molecular and cell biology, with the ability to design, perform, troubleshoot and interpret experiments using a structured and careful approach to data analysis, documentation and responsible research practice.

  • A strong publication record appropriate to career stage; excellent written and spoken English; and the ability to drive projects independently while collaborating effectively in a multidisciplinary and international environment.

Desirable qualifications

  • Experience with intestinal organoids, patient-derived material, fibroblast or immune-cell culture, or epithelial–stromal–immune co-culture models.

  • Experience integrating scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, spatial transcriptomic, spatial epigenomic or other multimodal datasets.

  • Familiarity with advanced imaging, quantitative image analysis, flow cytometry, organoid phenotyping or high-content screening.

  • Demonstrated experience generating and validating CRISPR-engineered organoids, including knock-in reporters or targeted gene perturbations, and with intestinal organoid engraftment or transplantation and in vivo assessment of epithelial regeneration is highly preferred.

  • An interest in supervising junior researchers and contributing to collaborative teaching and research activities.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision –We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information, please contact Dr. Srustidhar Das, Department of Clinical Research and Department of Molecular Medicine, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), tel.: +45 71504339, e-mail: srudas@health.sdu.dk

Application deadline

November 1, 2026 at 23.59 hrs. (CET).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M, Denmark.

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a detailed description of research experience

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Bli med meg på markeder – BPA-assistent søkes hver tredje helg
jobs.description:
Jeg er en livsglad kvinne i 40-årene som bor i Holum sammen med mine to katter. Nå ser jeg etter en BPA-assistent som vil jobbe fast hver tredje helg og være med meg på markeder.

Jeg syr klær som jeg selger på markeder, og dette er noe jeg ønsker å bruke mer tid på. Markedshelgene innebærer gjerne reise, pakking, bæring, rigging av stand og praktisk hjelp underveis. Du må derfor like å være på farten og trives med at helgene kan se litt forskjellige ut. Jeg har en tilpasset kassebil som vi begge kan kjøre.

Etter en operasjon bruker jeg rullestol og trenger assistanse for å kunne leve det aktive og selvstendige livet jeg ønsker. Jeg har nylig flyttet inn i eget hus med stor hage, hvor jeg blant annet dyrker grønnsaker. Jeg liker å lage mat fra bunnen av, sy, dra på tur og være ute i naturen. Hos meg kan en arbeidsdag derfor også handle om matlaging, hagearbeid, husarbeid eller andre praktiske oppgaver hjemme.

Om stillingen

Jeg søker først og fremst en assistent til fast arbeid hver tredje helg ( 11,27% stilling ). Det kan også være mulighet for å jobbe mer innimellom, blant annet ved fravær, i ferier og i forbindelse med reiser. Skriv gjerne i søknaden hvor fleksibel du har anledning til å være.

Arbeidet vil blant annet innebære:

  • Assistanse på markeder og under reiser
  • Pakking, bæring og andre praktiske oppgaver knyttet til markedsvirksomheten
  • Praktisk hjelp hjemme, som matlaging og husarbeid
  • Personlig assistanse
  • Bilkjøring ved behov

Jeg håper du er pålitelig, praktisk anlagt og glad i å finne løsninger. Du må trives med både rolige oppgaver hjemme og aktive dager på farten. Siden kattene mine er en del av hverdagen, er det også fint om du er glad i dyr.

Krav til deg:

  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Gode norskkunnskaper
  • Gyldig politiattest før oppstart

Personlig egnethet og god kjemi betyr mye for meg. Du får opplæringen du trenger. På grunn av arbeidets art oppfordres kvinner til å søke.

Høres dette ut som en jobb du kunne trivdes i? Da håper jeg å høre fra deg!


Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: Personlig assistent till en flicka i 4-årsåldern
jobs.description:
Stolthet, trivsel, lojalitet, bra chefer och kollegor och en känsla av att bidra till ett bättre samhälle. Så känner medarbetarna för Sölvesborgs kommun som arbetsgivare. Vi erbjuder våra medarbetare meningsfulla arbetsuppgifter som gör skillnad för andra människor. Vill du bli en av oss?

Arbete- och välfärdsförvaltningen består av Individ- och familjeomsorg, Stöd, service och boende samt Utbildning, försörjning och förebyggande. Totalt är vi cirka 300 medarbetare som arbetar salutogent och lösningsinriktat med en kunskapsbas i metoder med vetenskaplig grund.

Vårt uppdrag är att hjälpa och stödja individer med sociala problem och/eller funktionsnedsättning, att arbeta förebyggande och främjande för att motverka utanförskap och sociala problem och genom studier eller sysselsättning hitta vidare ut i arbetslivet mot självförsörjning. Utifrån ett barnrättsperspektiv hjälper, stödjer och skyddar vi barn och ungdomar för att de ska kunna leva och utvecklas under goda och trygga förhållanden.

1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Brukaren är en flicka i 4-årsåldern bosatt i Sölvesborg. Brukaren har ett medicinskt omvårdnadsbehov. Hon sitter i rullstol och behöver omfattande hjälp med det mesta i vardagen så som hygien, mat, påklädning och aktiviteter.

Som personlig assistent är din uppgift att stärka brukarens möjligheter till att leva ett självständigt och tryggt liv. Att stödja, hjälpa och handleda personen i det dagliga livet med hjälp av rutiner, stöd med vardagssituationerna, planering av olika aktiviteter och bidra till en stimulerande fritid.

    • Du ska kunna ge individuellt stöd och medicinsk omvårdnad i hemmet.
    • Du ska utveckla och upprätthålla förmågor och kommunikation med hänsyn till funktionsnedsättningen.
    • Du ska stödja brukarens delaktighet på olika nivåer, individ, grupp och samhällsnivå.
    • Du ska stödja brukarens självbestämmande och personliga integritet.
    • Du ska svara för social dokumentation enligt gällande riktlinjer.
    • Du ska utföra samt medicinska uppgifter på delegation av sjuksköterska.
    • Vi arbetar utifrån ett tydliggörande, där metoden alternativ kommunikation AKK är central.

Tjänsten innebär dag-, kväll- och helgtjänstgöring.

Du kommer att få en längre introduktionför att lära känna och bygga upp en relation tillsammans med brukaren innan du börjar arbeta själv.

Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Heltid med möjlighet till lägre sysselsättningsgrad.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som har godkänt vård- och omsorgsprogram eller är utbildad undersköterska. Det är meriterande om du läst inriktning funktionshinder.

Du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med människor med funktionsnedsättningar, goda kunskaper i omvårdnadsarbete och inom tydliggörande pedagogik. Det är meriterande om du tidigare arbetat med alternativ kommunikation AKK, kan tolka kroppsspråk, mimik och ljud samt förmedla bilder, symboler och objekt. Du behöver kunna hantera brukare med problemskapande beteende och arbeta med ett lågaffektivt bemötande.

Det krävs att du är ansvarstagande, och trygg i dig själv samt kan arbeta i samverkan med andra. Du har lätt att anpassa dig till ändrade omständigheter och kan snabbt ändra ditt synssätt och förhållningssätt. Du ser möjligheter i förändringar.

Du är en person med god samarbetsförmåga, är flexibel, har stort tålamod samt kan fatta egna beslut eftersom arbetet innebär ensamarbete.

Dokumentation och kommunikation är en viktig del av det dagliga arbetet och du behöver därför ha goda kunskaper i svenska språket i tal och skrift. Saknas godkänt betyg i svenska på gymnasienivå används språktest för att säkerställa kompetensen. Rekryterande chef kan göra en bedömning att språktest ska användas även om det finns godkänt betyg.

Du som söker till oss har B-körkort för att smidigt kunna ta dig runt inom Sölvesborgs kommun vid behov.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet: Tillsvidare, tillträde: Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Heltid med möjlighet till lägre sysselsättningsgrad.

Enligt Lagen (2010:479) om registerkontroll av personal som utför vissa insatser åt barn med funktionshinder ska du vid erbjuden anställning kunna visa ett utdrag ur belastningsregistret.

Provanställning kan komma att tillämpas ifall det föreligger ett prövobehov.

I denna rekrytering arbetar vi med löpande urval. Det innebär att vi kan komma att kalla till intervju innan ansökningstiden gått ut.

I Sölvesborgs kommun arbetar våra 1 500 medarbetare efter ledorden värme, närhet och engagemang. Vår värdegrund genomsyrar all verksamhet och vi arbetar tillsammans för att Sölvesborg ska vara en plats där det skapas möjligheter för den som bor, verkar eller vistas här.

Vi erbjuder dig en dynamisk och lyhörd arbetsplats där vi är positiva till nya idéer och god stämning och trivsel har hög prioritet. Som arbetsgivare värnar vi om alla våra medarbetare och erbjuder därför många förmåner. Läs mer på www.solvesborg.se/jobb

Sölvesborg ligger vid Blekinges kust med goda pendlingsmöjligheter från både Karlskrona och Malmö.

Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.

jobs.title: FPGA Engineer - Electronic Warfare
jobs.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

  • Own the development of FPGA functions for our electronic warfare and signals intelligence capabilities, from initial architecture to validation on operational hardware.

  • Work with systems and algorithm engineers to define processing requirements and assess implementation feasibility.

  • Build RTL modules in VHDL or SystemVerilog to process digitized RF signals, extract relevant information, and generate waveforms.

  • Adapt and validate DSP algorithms for FPGA implementation, balancing numerical accuracy, processing speed, and hardware resources.

  • Integrate acquisition and processing chains, including digital down-conversion, filtering, channelization, FFT, detection, direction-finding, and classification.

  • Establish verification methods and testbenches to check functional behavior and performance throughout development.

  • Connect programmable logic to RF converters and embedded processors, defining data transfers, control interfaces, clocking, and synchronization.

  • Resolve implementation constraints, achieve timing closure, and optimize resource utilization and power consumption.

  • Bring up FPGA designs on target boards, investigate integration issues, and correlate measured behavior with simulation results.

  • Contribute to laboratory and field testing alongside RF, software, and systems engineers.

  • Maintain clear design records, interface specifications, and validation evidence.

  • Improve reusable FPGA components and development practices as the product portfolio grows.

Candidate Profile

  • MSc in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Signal Processing, or a related field.

  • Strong experience developing and verifying RTL in VHDL or SystemVerilog, with a focus on digital signal processing.

  • Practical experience implementing designs on SoC FPGAs, including synthesis, implementation, timing analysis, and hardware debugging.

  • Strong understanding of sampled signals, frequency conversion, digital filtering, spectral analysis, and fixed-point numerical behavior.

  • Ability to reason across FPGA, processor, and RF hardware boundaries when making design decisions.

  • Experience modelling algorithms and comparing reference models with hardware results; familiarity with MATLAB, Simulink, Python, or HLS is a plus.

  • Familiarity with RF measurements and laboratory equipment, including spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and oscilloscopes, is a plus.

  • Prior experience in electronic warfare is welcome but not required.


Skills & Qualities

  • Hands-on engineer who enjoys taking designs from simulation to working hardware.

  • Methodical approach to debugging, with the ability to isolate problems across complex signal chains.

  • Able to own a technical scope independently and communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly.

  • Rigorous approach to verification, documentation, and design traceability.

  • Comfortable collaborating across disciplines and adapting to evolving product requirements.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-growing company.

  • High integrity and professionalism in handling sensitive defense technologies.

jobs.title: FPGA Engineer - Radar
jobs.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

  • Turn radar sensing requirements into FPGA designs that support reliable drone detection in operational conditions.

  • Define how radar data is acquired, processed, and delivered to the rest of the system, working across RF, electronics, and software teams.

  • Establish processing budgets and select implementation approaches based on detection performance, latency, numerical accuracy, and available FPGA resources.

  • Develop reference models to study radar behavior in noise and clutter and guide hardware design decisions.

  • Build reusable RTL functions for waveform generation and receive processing in FMCW and pulsed radar systems.

  • Implement the processing stages needed to extract targets from radar returns, including matched filtering, pulse compression, range-Doppler processing, clutter rejection, and CFAR detection.

  • Integrate ADC/DAC interfaces, coordinate transmit and receive timing, and ensure synchronization with the radar front end.

  • Specify how detections and associated measurements are passed to tracking functions and embedded software.

  • Verify designs against reference models through automated testbenches and hardware-in-the-loop testing.

  • Investigate performance gaps on target hardware and use laboratory measurements and field results to improve the processing chain.

  • Document design decisions, interfaces, and validation results to support integration and future product development.


Candidate Profile

  • At least three years of FPGA development experience, with practical exposure to radar or sonar processing.

  • Ability to take a signal-processing function from an algorithmic description to verified RTL in VHDL or Verilog/SystemVerilog.

  • Strong DSP foundations, including FFT, digital filtering, windowing, and the effects of quantization and fixed-point precision.

  • Understanding of how radar systems estimate target range and velocity, distinguish returns from clutter, and set detection thresholds.

  • Working knowledge of matched filtering, pulse compression, range-Doppler maps, and CFAR techniques.

  • Familiarity with FMCW and pulsed radar, including the relationship between waveform choices, acquisition timing, and digital processing.

  • Experience assessing radar performance through simulation, including signal-to-noise ratio and clutter effects.

  • Experience developing testbenches, debugging FPGA hardware, and validating processing chains with hardware-in-the-loop methods.

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, Applied Physics, or a related field.

Skills & Qualities

  • Hands-on engineer motivated by making radar processing work reliably on physical hardware.

  • Able to connect system-level performance issues with their causes in algorithms, RTL, interfaces, or timing.

  • Methodical approach to debugging, verification, and documenting technical decisions.

  • Comfortable owning development tasks and coordinating integration work across disciplines.

  • Clear communicator who makes trade-offs explicit and flags risks early.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-growing company.

  • High integrity and professionalism in handling sensitive defense technologies.

jobs.title: Software engineer with AI experience
jobs.description:
PinMeTo helps large multi-location companies manage their business information across hundreds of online services, through a SaaS platform that puts businesses in control of their location data and lets them manage online interactions with customers. Our offering is a set of web applications developed internally by our Product department, headquartered in Malmö, Sweden.

As a Software Engineer with AI experience you would join one of our product teams focused on building our agentic AI capabilities. The team consists of a product manager, product designer, and 3 software engineers, all located together and working with a shared goal and focus. The team collaborates to first discover the most valuable opportunities to address, then define, validate, and deliver solutions to them.

We're looking to strengthen the team with a software engineer with AI experience who can work across a wide range of problems: software design and planning, system architecture, full stack web application development, agentic AI capabilities, etc.

What makes this position interesting?

🏡 Join a great work environment built on people and collaboration - we work together from the office in small teams, with a strong work/life balance and lots of opportunity to learn from a diverse group of colleagues and a culture where helping each other succeed is highly valued.

🌟 You will be part of a team of highly skilled engineers who prioritize working together over someone handing out tasks. This collaborative approach gives everyone on the team the chance to both learn from each other and influence the team. You will have ample opportunity to shape both the team and the work you do, letting you maximize your impact and personal long term growth.

💡 The team is fully responsible for our agentic AI capabilities, from learning about the needs from customers and the market, driving experiments to test different solutions, to building and maintaining highly automated solutions that save our users from manual work. Being part of that whole journey is also where the learning happens.

What to expect when joining PinMeTo?

    

7 days: Your first week will be focused on getting to know your team and our system, setting up your development environment, and pushing your first (small) change to production. Your onboarding buddy and your team will be supporting you from day 1, making sure that you get started as smoothly as possible.

    

30 days: Continuing in your first month you will focus on learning about our codebase, products, and infrastructure while participating in whatever initiative the team is working on, pair working as much as possible with your teammates to contribute to what is being delivered. During this time we also encourage you to spend time learning the parts of our tech stack that you might not have previous experience with.

    

90 days: A quarter in you should be able to apply your previous experience to the specific context of your team and what you are working on together, thereby increasing your impact by contributing to everything from technical decisions to how the team works. You will also be able to take ownership of driving larger tasks to completion.

    

365 days: By this time your contribution to the team is indistinguishable from that of the other software engineers that you work together with. You will have been able to leverage your strengths and experience to become proficient with work that you are used to, and together with the team you will have learned the things that were new to you at the beginning.

We have an office first working environment, so we assume you live in or around Malmö or are willing to commute.

    

To promote a healthy work/life balance and professional development, we have:

    

Flexible working hours.

    

One paid hour per week to use for exercise and workout, perfectly paired with your wellness allowance.

    

A learning environment where we have regular hackdays, knowledge sharing forums, workshops, retrospectives, and other opportunities to grow and develop your skills.

Interested? Next steps

We look forward to welcoming you to PinMeTo!

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

jobs.title: Compliance Officer till internationellt bolag i City
jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta i en roll där du får kombinera administration, regelverk och verksamhetsstöd? Nu söker vi en strukturerad och noggrann Compliance Officer för ett konsultuppdrag hos en väletablerad aktör inom finanssektorn.
Detta är ett konsultuppdrag med start så snart som möjligt och förväntas pågå till årsskiftet.


Om tjänsten


I rollen kommer du att vara en viktig del av arbetet med regelefterlevnad och kundkännedom. Du arbetar nära verksamheten och bidrar till att säkerställa effektiva processer inom KYC och AML


Ansvarsområden


•    Följa upp och koordinera pågående KYC-ärenden
•    Säkerställa att nödvändig kunddokumentation samlas in och följs upp
•    Ge stöd till verksamheten i frågor kopplade till KYC och AML
•    Administrera och uppdatera register, rapporter och uppföljningslistor
•    Dokumentera rutiner och processer
•    Medverka vid implementering av nya systemstöd och säkerställa att nya arbetssätt etableras
•    Följa upp att interna compliance-relaterade aktiviteter genomförs enligt plan


Lämplig bakgrund


Vi söker dig som har:
•    Erfarenhet av KYC, AML, Compliance eller liknande administrativa kontrollfunktioner
•    Vana av att arbeta strukturerat med processer och dokumentation
•    God administrativ förmåga och hög noggrannhet
•    Förmåga att arbeta självständigt och driva uppföljningsarbete mot olika delar av verksamheten
•    Erfarenhet av implementering eller användning av systemstöd, vilket ses som meriterande
•    Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift


Personliga egenskaper


För att lyckas i rollen är du strukturerad, ansvarstagande och noggrann. Du trivs med att arbeta i en administrativ miljö med flera parallella processer och har förmågan att skapa ordning och driva arbetet framåt. Du är kommunikativ och känner dig bekväm med att samarbeta med olika delar av verksamheten.


Ansökan


Vi intervjuar löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!


Konsult hos SJR


Att arbeta som konsult hos SJR innebär att du blir en del av en dedikerad organisation med kompetens att ge dig perfekta förutsättningar att utvecklas både inom din yrkesroll och på ett personligt plan. Du får tillgång till vårt stora nätverk av intressanta företag och uppdragsgivare och därmed en unik möjlighet att ta din karriär till nästa steg.

Vi på SJR bryr oss om vår personal och tillsammans med oss får du en långsiktig partner som ger dig trygghet och stöd. Vi är lyhörda för dina behov och du kommer att ha en nära relation med din konsultchef som stöttar dig i din utveckling.

\* preparing cold dishes and hot dishes

\* independently preparing food for larger groups of customers

\* good practical skills in handling ingredients, preparation and cooking

\* interest in designing and developing new Chinese dishes

\* careful, responsible and motivated approach to work

jobs.description:
**Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Tampereen alueelle.**

Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A

- Joustavan työajan

- Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan

- Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

- Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen

- Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin


**Toivomme sinulta**

- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan

- Positiivista ja iloista asennetta

- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi

- Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi


Edellytämme sinulta Tartuntatautilain **48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa** sekä **55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä**. Lisäksi tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteensosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti.

Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! Lisätietoja tehtävästä kaivatessasi voit olla yhteydessä meihin sähköpostitse hkapuhr@validia.fi

**Rekrytoinnin eteneminen**

Panostamme siihen, että rekrytointi on reilua ja että juuri sinun osaamisesi pääsee esiin. Tässä rekrytoinnissa hyödynnämme **Hubert.ai -tekoälyhaastattelua.**

Hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen sinut kutsutaan chat-pohjaiseen haastatteluun virtuaalisen rekrytointiassistenttimme Hubertin kanssa. Haastattelu kestää noin 15-20 minuuttia, ja voit tehdä sen sinulle sopivana aikana. Suosittelemme kuitenkin aloittamaan sen pian, jotta rekrytointi etenee sujuvasti. Tekoälypohjainen haastattelu toimii vain tukityökaluna, kaikki lopulliset arviot ja päätökset tekee ihminen.

jobs.title: Logistikassistent elev søges hos Molly&My
jobs.description:
Vil du være en del af holdet på lageret hos Molly&My?

Vi søger en logistikassistent-elev til vores webshop i Fredericia.

Er du færdig med skolen – eller snart færdig – og har du mere lyst til en hverdag med fart på end at sidde stille foran en computer hele dagen?

Så kunne du måske være vores nye elev

Molly&My er en dansk fashion-webshop, og fra vores lager i Fredericia sender vi hver dag pakker afsted til kunder i Danmark og resten af Europa.

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor vi arbejder hurtigt, hjælper hinanden og samtidig har det sjovt sammen. Vi tror på, at man både kan tage sit arbejde seriøst og have en arbejdsplads, man faktisk glæder sig til at møde ind på.

Og vi laver også andet end at pakke pakker Det unge team skal bl.a. ud at bowle og til Horror Walk sammen – og der kommer løbende sociale arrangementer.

Hvad kommer du til at lære?

I løbet af din elevperiode kommer du hele vejen rundt om logistikken bag en stor webshop:

  • Pluk og pak af webshopordrer

  • Varemodtagelse og håndtering af returvarer

  • Lagerstyring, lagerstatus og optællinger

  • Fragt-, forsendelses- og emballagesystemer

  • Opgaver på tværs af lageret og vores øvrige afdelinger

Du kommer altså ikke til at lave det samme i tre år. Målet er, at du lærer, hvordan hele logistikken bag en moderne e-commerce-virksomhed fungerer.

Hvem er du?

Det vigtigste for os er ikke, at du allerede kan det hele.

Vi leder efter dig, der:

  • møder stabilt og tager ansvar

  • kan lide en aktiv arbejdsdag med tempo på

  • har styr på dine ting og kan holde overblik

  • er klar på at lære nyt og tage fat

  • har lyst til at blive en del af holdet – både fagligt og socialt

Det får du hos os

Du får en arbejdsplads med højt tempo, masser af humor og korte veje fra idé til handling.

Vi tilbyder selvfølgelig grundig oplæring og de rammer, der hører til din elevuddannelse – men du bliver også en rigtig del af teamet fra starten.

Du får bl.a.:

  • Et ungt team og sociale arrangementer

  • En uformel arbejdsplads med plads til humor

  • Grundig oplæring og ansvar i takt med, at du lærer

  • Indblik i logistikken bag en webshop i vækst

  • Gode personalerabatter på Molly&My

Det praktiske

Stillingen er en 2-årig elevstilling som logistikassistent.

EUX- og HHX-elever har direkte adgang til elevpladsen. STX-, HF- og HTX-elever skal have et supplerende 5 ugers EUD-S-forløb med fagretning handel. EUD- og HG-elever med adgang til handelsspecialet kan også søge.

Stillingen er omfattet af HK-overenskomst for handel, viden og service.

Arbejdsplads: Fredericia/Taulov

Kunne du se dig selv på holdet?

Send din ansøgning og CV til mail@mollyogmy.dk og skriv “Logistik elev” i emnefeltet.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

jobs.description:
Are you an experienced and proactive Relocation Project Manager with a knack for leading complex business moves? Do you thrive in dynamic roles where your communication skills and structured approach keep operations running smoothly? Then this might be the project for you!

About the position

Perido is currently looking for a Relocation Project Manager to our large client in the automotive industry. In this role, you will take full responsibility for leading and coordinating a major operational relocation project from planning through to final handover, ensuring a smooth transition with minimal disruption to ongoing business activities and daily operations. The position is placed in Gothenburg.

Your daily tasks

As the Relocation Project Manager, you will take full ownership of planning, organizing, and executing the operational transfer between facilities.

Your main responsibilities will include:

    Creating a comprehensive inventory of assets, equipment, furniture, technical installations, and operational requirements
    Assessing dependencies, prerequisites, and site adaptations required for the relocation
    Developing a detailed relocation plan, including milestones, sequencing, resource allocation, and budget follow-up
    Establishing a realistic timeline covering preparation, move execution, commissioning, and validation at the new location
    Identifying critical activities that can be completed in advance versus those requiring coordinated downtime
    Managing risk assessments, identifying constraints, and implementing mitigation actions to minimize business interruption
    Coordinating stakeholders across facilities, operations, IT, external suppliers, and business representatives to ensure alignment throughout the project

Your characteristics

We are looking for a hands-on, solution-oriented professional with strong project management instincts who takes clear accountability for their work. You work independently, act proactively, and have excellent stakeholder management capabilities. You possess a structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to keep all moving parts aligned during complex operational transformations.

Does this sound like an exciting challenge for you? We look forward to receiving your application—apply today!

Qualifications:

    Proven track record in managing relocation, facility, infrastructure, or operational transformation n projects
    Demonstrated experience with asset inventory, resource planning, budget management, and timeline execution
    Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills with both internal teams and external suppliers
    Fluent communication skills in English, both written and verbal

Meritorious:

    Previous experience successfully leading a similar end-to-end business or facility relocation project

Contract type and hours

Full-time, consulting assignment until 2027-07-09. Start 2026-10-08.

Let us help you take the next step in your career

Our vision is to ensure that everyone thrives and feels engaged at work. With us, you will find a wide variety of assignments, where you can either be employed directly by a company or work as a consultant through Perido. We are one of Sweden’s largest consulting firms for professionals, which gives you many opportunities. As a consultant, you become an important part of our organization and contribute your expertise within our clients’ organizations. Read more about us at Perido: https://perido.se/om-oss/

Responsible recruiter is: charlotte.crowley@perido.se

You can find answers to most questions or concerns at perido.se/vanliga-fragor/. If you still cannot find what you are looking for, you are welcome to contact us at fraga@perido.se. Please always include the position reference number 36022 in the subject line. Please note that we only accept applications through our website and that we are unable to provide updates on your application status or disclose the client company if it is not stated in the job advertisement.
