jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to: Division General Counsel, Marine & Ports.

Your role and responsibilities

As Senior Legal Counsel for Marine & Ports in Sweden, you will serve as the lead legal advisor in Sweden and a key member of the Marine & Ports Legal & Integrity team. In this role, you will provide strategic, solution‑oriented legal guidance on a wide range of domestic and international matters, ensuring that business objectives are achieved responsibly, ethically, and in full compliance with relevant laws and ABB policies.

The work model for the role is: onsite

Location: Västerås, Sweden

Reporting to Division General Counsel for Marine & Ports, you will be a member of the global Marine & Ports Legal & Integrity team.

You will be mainly accountable for:

Strategic Legal & Business Partnership

    Serve as the primary legal advisor for ABB’s Marine & Ports business in Sweden, covering all aspects of commercial, corporate, and regulatory law.
    Provide clear, pragmatic legal advice that support strategic decision‑making and risk‑balanced business growth.

Commercial & Contractual Support

    Lead the drafting, review, negotiation, and interpretation of a broad range of commercial agreements, including EPC contracts, procurement agreements, consortium agreements, and framework agreements in various countries globally.
    Conduct risk assessments and recommend mitigation strategies that align with ABB policies, commercial practices, and local/ international regulations.

Integrity, Compliance & Ethical Leadership

    Serve as Integrity Officer for the Marine & Ports Sweden team, partnering closely with Business Area Integrity team and Integrity Investigations & Monitoring team.
    Identify and assess integrity risks related to business opportunities and transactions, implementing appropriate mitigation measures.
    Deliver legal and integrity training programs, conduct investigations, and support ongoing compliance initiatives.

Dispute Management

    Manage complex disputes, engaging and managing external counsel and ABB Centers of Expertise to achieve optimal outcomes in a cost‑effective manner.

Risk Management

    Manage and participate in ABB’s risk review process according to Company, Business Area and Division policies with the business team for legal and contractual issues and provide guidance as to risk management.

Qualifications for the role

    At least 7 years of qualified legal practice with work experience in a multi-national company, preferably in EPC, construction, energy or power industries
    Experience working under both common law and civil law jurisdictions is a plus
    Degree in Law from a reputable university in Sweden and a member of Swedish Bar Association
    Multiple jurisdiction experience in Europe or other regions is a plus
    Proactive & positive attitude with collaborative team spirit, team player with strong communication skills, good interpersonal skills and able to work effectively with business stakeholders
    Excellent communication skills in spoken and written English

More about us

At ABB Marine & Ports, we are committed to transforming our customers' vessels and terminal operations with innovative electric, automated, and digital technologies. As part of enabling a low-carbon society, we strive to preserve resources and promote social progress. Our sustainable solutions have a far-reaching impact, and by joining us you will actively play a part in contributing to a more sustainable future.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Ordinarie servitör/barservitör med intresse för öl och bryggeri
jobs.description:
Park Alandia Hotell är ett hotell med 90 rum. I hotellet finns Park Restaurang & Bar med 70 sittplatser i restaurangen och 60 platser i baren. Här finns även en konferens- och festvåning och snyggaste poolen i stan! Skön live musik spelas fredag-lördag året om och vår uteservering med ca 90 sittplatser har många soltimmar. Hotellet kan från sensommaren 2026 även stoltsera med sitt egna bryggeri.

Park Alandia Hotell är ett familjeägt bolag där laganda, att ha kul på jobbet och att brinna för det man gör står i fokus. Hos oss jobbar 25 personer året runt och nu behöver vi förstärkning av en pigg och glad kollega till vår restaurang och bar.

Vi söker dig som brinner för öl och utöver servering i bar, restaurang och konferens även kan bistå vår bryggtekniker vid ölprovningar. Tids nog ser vi gärna att du även kan hålla egna provningar. Hos oss arbetar vi alla tillsammans som ett team mot gemensamma mål och vår ambition är att varje gäst ska trivas och få en härlig upplevelse hos oss. Det är med stolthet vi serverar god mat, drinkar och inom kort även öl från vårt egna bryggeri.

**Dina arbetsuppgifter**

Vi söker dig som är noggrann och tycker om att ge gästen det lilla extra. Arbetsuppgifterna består av följande:

- Servera

- Duka av och på

- Kassahantering

- Blanda drinkar

- Bistå vid och även hålla ölprovningar

- Övrigt förekommande serveringsuppgifter


**Personliga egenskaper**

Som medarbetare hos oss behöver du vara serviceinriktad och alltid sträva efter att ge våra gäster den bästa helhetsupplevelsen. jobs.title: Workshop Assistant, Bluefors Oy
jobs.description:
Bluefors Oy is a Finnish technology company and a global leader in cryogenic measurement systems used in quantum computing research. Their Helsinki workshop is where precision materials meet cutting-edge science - and they need someone like you to keep it running.

As a Workshop Assistant, you'll handle real materials - copper, aluminium, brass, stainless steel - and cut them to exact measurements using modern ERP systems. Full training is provided, so you don't need prior experience to get started.

This is a full-time, fixed-term position (4 months) with day shifts and a 40-hour work week. It's a great entry point into industrial work at a company that genuinely stands out.

YOUR TASKS

You'll be working as a Workshop Assistant at Bluefors Oy's Helsinki facility, employed through Barona Teollisuus Oy. Your day-to-day work keeps the workshop stocked, organised, and running smoothly.

- Receiving, inspecting, and storing incoming raw materials
- Cutting materials - copper, stainless steel (AISI 316), brass, aluminium, and POM plastic - to specified dimensions using workshop tools
- Reading and following cutting instructions from the ERP system
- Maintaining accurate inventory records and stock levels
- Keeping the workshop tidy and organised
- Handling parts ranging from 12 mm to 360 mm in diameter

REQUIREMENTS

- Ability to follow precise technical instructions carefully and accurately
- Comfortable working independently and taking responsibility for your tasks
- Good practical hands-on skills
- Willingness to learn - full training is provided

NICE TO HAVE

- Previous experience in a warehouse or industrial environment
- Forklift licence (trukkikortti)
- Familiarity with ERP systems or similar tools

You will be employed with Barona Teollisuus Oy for 4 month fixed-term employment contract. An employee with good performance in the role may also have the opportunity for a longer-term employment relationship. The work starts as agreed, no later than in the beginning of November. This is full-time position from Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week in a day shift.

Apply via application form. We are handling the applications already before the application deadline closes and the role will be fulfilled as soon as the right candidate is found. Please note, that applications sent via email are not taken into account.

jobs.title: Join Us as Our Next Tool Engineer – MOCVD
jobs.description:
Company

SweGaN is a European semiconductor manufacturer that develops and produces customer-made materials and high-performance epitaxial wafers of gallium nitride for manufacturers of conductive components and devices. We develop and deliver unique material solutions based on the company's groundbreaking GaN epitaxial technology.

SweGaN's products are used for a wide range of applications, including 5G telecommunications infrastructure, defence radar, satellite communications, electric vehicles, high-voltage switches, and more. SweGaN's benchmark QuanFINE® epitaxial growth technology increases the performance of RF and power devices and reduces energy consumption.

What you will be a part of

At SweGaN, we work together to develop and produce advanced semiconductor materials for our customers. Our production equipment plays an important role in ensuring stable and reliable manufacturing, and close collaboration between our technical teams is essential to our continued development.

As our Tool Engineer – MOCVD, you will work closely with Production, Process Engineering, and Maintenance to ensure reliable and safe operation of our production equipment. The role combines hands-on technical work with troubleshooting, analysis, and continuous improvement.

You will work with advanced MOCVD equipment and supporting systems, investigate technical issues, and contribute to improving equipment reliability and performance.

You will be part of a growing semiconductor company where collaboration between different technical functions is important for developing and strengthening our production capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

    Take technical ownership of assigned MOCVD reactors and supporting equipment.
    Monitor and improve equipment performance, availability, reliability, capability, and maintainability.
    Troubleshoot complex equipment issues and identify recurring or systematic failures.
    Lead technical root-cause investigations and implement corrective technical actions.
    Support Maintenance Technicians in troubleshooting and complex maintenance activities.
    Develop and improve preventive maintenance procedures, technical instructions, and troubleshooting guides.
    Identify and implement equipment modifications, upgrades, and technical improvements.
    Support equipment installation, commissioning, qualification, and acceptance activities.
    Work closely with Process Engineering to ensure that equipment meets defined process requirements.
    Support equipment-related deviations, change control, FMEA, and technical risk assessments.
    Maintain relevant equipment documentation and ensure traceability of equipment changes and maintenance activities.
    Provide technical guidance and training to Maintenance Technicians and Operators.
    Contribute to safe equipment operation and participate in equipment-related safety and risk assessments.



Qualifications

    B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Chemical Engineering, Semiconductor Engineering, or equivalent.
    Experience working with complex industrial or semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
    Strong analytical, technical, and systematic troubleshooting skills.
    Good understanding of mechanical, electrical, vacuum, gas, control, and safety systems.
    Ability to work both analytically and hands-on in a production environment.
    Good technical documentation and communication skills.
    Experience with MOCVD/MOVPE equipment, semiconductor manufacturing, vacuum systems, specialty gas systems, PLC/SCADA, equipment qualification, or structured problem-solving methods such as FMEA, 8D and RCA is considered an advantage.
    Experience with or knowledge of Monitor ERP is also considered an advantage.



If you are a technically driven problem solver who enjoys understanding complex equipment, solving challenging problems, and turning technical insights into long-term improvements, we encourage you to apply.

    The employment is full-time and indefinite. Starting date by agreement.
    A security clearance will be carried out before a decision on employment is made.



Are you ready to make a difference? Apply now and be a part of something extraordinary.

Please submit your application with CV and cover letter no later than 20261016



We will have interviews on an ongoing basis, the position needs to be filled immediately

The application is sent to career@swegan.se

Contact person: Sarah Wallberg, HRBP

jobs.title: Head of Quality & Sustainability Management
jobs.description:
At Icomera, we build technology that keeps people connected while they’re on the move. Every day, our solutions deliver fast, reliable internet and digital services on trains, trams, buses, and coaches - supporting millions of passengers across the world. Quality is how Icomera earns customer trust, and this role helps make it consistent across our products, services and ways of working. As rail helps make transport more sustainable, this role ensures Icomera advances that ambition while reducing the environmental impact of its own products and operations.

Are you an experienced quality and sustainability leader who wants to shape how a global technology company works? As our Head of Quality & Sustainability Management, you will have the opportunity to modernize our management systems, develop a capable international team and amplify digital tools, automation and responsible AI to make quality and process management more effective and valuable across the organization

About the Role

As Head of Quality & Sustainability Management, you will lead and develop Icomera’s Process, Quality & Environmental function. You will be responsible for ensuring that our business processes, products, services and management systems support customer satisfaction, compliance, operational efficiency, environmental performance and continuous improvement.

You will own and develop Icomera’s Quality and Environmental management systems, including our work relating to ISO 9001 and ISO 14001. You will also coordinate our broader sustainability agenda, bringing together environmental activities, data, KPIs and reporting with sustainability work led by relevant specialists across the organization.

This is both a strategic and hands-on leadership role. You will lead an international team of three direct reports and collaborate closely with senior leadership and colleagues in Sustainability, Finance, HR and IT, as well as stakeholders across Equans. You will influence without relying solely on formal authority, turn complex requirements into practical ways of working and help colleagues understand the business value of structured quality and process management.

A key part of your mission will be to support Icomera’s ongoing transformation from predominantly manual process management towards modern, data-driven and AI-enabled ways of working. You will explore and implement effective tools for document, deviation and process management while ensuring that automation and AI are used responsibly, transparently and in line with relevant quality, risk, information security and compliance requirements.

Key responsibilities

    Lead, support and develop the Quality & Environment team, setting clear objectives and creating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration, learning and ownership.
    Own and continuously improve Icomera’s Quality and Environmental management systems, including ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 compliance, audits, management reviews, corrective actions and risk management.
    Define and implement quality, environmental and process-management strategies that support customer satisfaction, operational performance, compliance and sustainable business development.
    Establish clear KPIs, targets and action plans for quality, environmental and process performance, assign ownership, monitor progress and provide regular, data-driven reporting to senior management.
    Drive the digitalization of processes and management systems by identifying and introducing suitable IT solutions, automation and responsible AI-enabled ways of working.
    Coordinate environmental and sustainability data, objectives, improvement activities and reporting, while partnering across Icomera and Equans to align expectations and translate requirements into effective local practices.

Requirements

    Proven experience leading quality, process or environmental management in a complex organisation, preferably within technology, software, product development or a related industry.
    Strong practical knowledge of ISO 9001 and ISO 14001, including management systems, management reviews, internal or external audits, findings and corrective actions.
    Previous people-management experience, with the ability to provide direction, develop team capability and create a collaborative and supportive working environment.
    Experience influencing senior stakeholders, leading cross-functional change and turning governance or compliance requirements into practical, value-adding ways of working.
    A relevant university degree, or equivalent education and professional experience within quality, environmental management, sustainability, engineering, technology or business processes.
    Fluency in spoken and written English, as the role operates in an international environment

Meritorious:

    Knowledge of ISO 27001, information security or governance relating to responsible AI.
    Auditor training or certification, with experience planning or conducting management-system audits.
    Experience using Lean, Six Sigma, ITIL or similar continuous-improvement frameworks.
    Experience coordinating sustainability reporting, environmental data, KPIs or management reporting.
    Experience introducing digital process-management tools, automation or AI-enabled solutions.
    Swedish language skills.

Who You Are

You are a structured and forward-looking leader who combines strategic thinking with a willingness to engage in practical implementation. You understand that effective quality and environmental management depends on people, collaboration and clear communication as much as it depends on frameworks and standards.

You communicate complex topics in an accessible way, build credibility with stakeholders at different levels and can create momentum even when priorities or responsibilities are not immediately clear. You are comfortable working across organisational boundaries, balancing different perspectives and making well-reasoned decisions in a changing environment.

You create clarity without adding unnecessary bureaucracy. With curiosity about technology and modern ways of working, you can identify where data, digital tools, automation and responsible AI can simplify processes and generate measurable value. You also recognise the importance of governance, transparency and sound risk management when introducing new technology.

As a people leader, you listen, coach and empower. You provide direction while giving team members the space and support they need to grow, collaborate and take ownership of their work.

jobs.title: Serviceinriktad Biluthyrare till Hertz Arlanda

Att det är människorna som skapar Hertz framgång är ingen hemlighet. Bilarna är grunden i vår verksamhet, men det är medarbetarnas engagemang, kunskap och omtanke som gör oss till det marknadsledande hyrbilsföretaget vi är. Om du vill vara en del av ett familjärt bolag där mobilitetslösningar, socialt ansvarstagande, engagemang för människor och omvärld ligger högt på agendan – så kanske detta är nästa steg för dig!

Vi söker både dig som vill arbeta heltid och dig som vill arbeta extra vid behov, där du i din ansökan gärna får specificera vad som passar dig bäst. För oss är flexibilitet gentemot våra kunder mycket viktig, varav arbetstiderna kommer att variera veckans alla dagar mellan 06:00-23:00.

Om rollen

Som Biluthyrare hos oss har du en central roll i kundens helhetsupplevelse – från första kontakt och utlämning av bilen till återlämning. Ditt uppdrag är att skapa en smidig, trygg och positiv hyrprocess där både kunden och bilen står i fokus.

Dina arbetsuppgifter inkluderar bland annat:

    Hantera bokningar och kundförfrågningar via telefon, mejl och över disk
    Uthyrning av bilar och upprättande av hyresavtal
    Ta emot och leverera bilar samt planera stationens tillgängliga vagnpark
    Rengöring, färdigställande och enklare skadehantering av fordon
    Löpande administration kopplad till verksamheten

Vem är du?

Vi tror att du trivs i en serviceinriktad roll och får energi av att möta människor. Du är ansvarstagande och drivs av att lösa problem i en fartfylld vardag. Kanske har du tidigare arbetat inom service, försäljning, hotell, restaurang, butik eller transport. Du delar våra värdeord – trygghet, service, glädje och respekt – och uppskattar lagarbete där vi tillsammans skapar bästa möjliga kundupplevelse i alla lägen.

Ett krav för tjänsten är B-körkort samt att du behärskar svenska och engelska väl, såväl i tal som skrift. Vidare tror vi att du är en administrativ stjärna som har en fallenhet för att lära dig nya system.

Det här är Hertz 💛

Hertz möter människors behov av rörelse med smarta mobilitetslösningar. Vi drivs av omtanke för våra kunder, människor och omvärlden. Vi är ett familjärt företag med det gula hjärtat i allt vi gör och med ett stort samhällsengagemang som bland annat stöttar Maskrosbarn, Childhood och Barncancerfonden. Vi tror på mångfald och vill att vår organisation ska spegla både samhället och våra kunder, där alla medarbetare kallas för Medansvariga.

Vi erbjuder

    En arbetsplats präglad av servicekultur
    Stora möjligheter att påverka och utveckla vår kundupplevelse
    Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter inom en snabbrörlig organisation
    Fantastiska kollegor och mycket mer

Urval sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, så välkommen in med din ansökan redan idag!

Bakgrundskontroll kan komma att genomföras på slutkandidater.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Platform & Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
Company description:

"Founded in 1927, the Volvo Group is committed to driving prosperity and shaping the future landscape through sustainable transport, mobility, and infrastructure solutions. By offering trucks, buses, construction equipment, power solutions for marine and industrial applications, financing and services that increase our customers’ uptime and productivity. Our headquarters are in Gothenburg, Sweden. Volvo Group shares are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm."

Job description:

Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.



Join us as an Senior Embedded Software Platform & Integration Engineer, where your expertise and skills will be the driving force behind securing our vehicle systems and protecting connected vehicles from evolving cyber threats.







Are you ready to be part of a groundbreaking transformation?



At Function & Software Defined Vehicles (FSDV), we shape tomorrow’s technology by delivering sustainable, innovative, and data-driven solutions that improve safety, efficiency, and performance throughout the vehicle life cycle. We support the Volvo Group engineering community with advanced platforms, tools, methods, and architectures that enable continuous innovation and deliver customer value throughout a vehicle's lifetime.







This is us, your new colleagues



We are responsible for our embedded software platform which includes Volvo Autosar Platform (VAP) based on Classic Autosar, Linux, and Volvo Dynamic Software Platform (VDSP) based on Adaptative Autosar and Hypervisor technologies. It is on this platform that all in-house developed applications run on and make our commercial vehicles come to life that bring joy to our end-customer and their day-to-day work. Our organization consists of warm, supporting and beyond everything, highly skilled people that seek a new colleague that has worked with embedded software on platform level in an automotive context.







What you will do




    Configure and integrate the AUTOSAR stack, including various Basic Software (BSW) modules and Microcontroller Abstraction Layers (MCALs), to ensure seamless operation within our systems.
    Manage the configuration of software components and watchdogs to align with project specifications and requirements.
    Oversee memory allocation, memory partitioning, and multi-core processing to optimize system performance and efficiency.
    Contribute to software design, collaborating with team members to develop innovative and effective solutions.
    Integrate application and signal databases (CAN/CAN-FD) to enhance data management and communication across systems.
    Perform technical reviews on software component design, code, and testing strategies, including integration test planning.
    Perform fault tracing and troubleshoot errors within the technical area to maintain system integrity and reliability.







Who are you?



You are a collaborative and dependable colleague who enjoys working in cross-functional settings and building strong relationships with stakeholders. You take full ownership of your work, manage your time effectively, and stay focused when complex problems need to be investigated and driven to resolution. You communicate clearly and constructively, and you are comfortable standing by your technical recommendations while staying open to feedback and different perspectives. You bring a structured, quality-minded way of working and a calm approach when priorities shift. You enjoy sharing knowledge, and you are willing to mentor others to help the team grow and deliver a stable embedded software platform over time.







Requirements:




    A bachelor's degree or master's degree in computer science, Electronics or Mechatronics Engineering
    10+ years of experience working with Embedded Software
    Proficient in programming languages such as Python and C, with solid experience in software development.
    At least 6 years of experience working with AUTOSAR on platform level, demonstrating a strong understanding of its architecture and components.
    Familiarity with software testing methodologies and tools, including CANoe, to ensure high-quality software delivery.
    Self-driven, with a strong eagerness to learn and adapt to new technologies and methodologies.
    Familiarity with automotive communication protocols, network management concepts, bootloaders and functional safety development with ISO 26262 automotive standards.
    Security design using Hardware Security Modules (HSM) for bootloader implementation, to ensure secure booting and secure flashing processes are in place.







Ready for the next move?



We value the uniqueness of every individual and the diverse backgrounds and experiences they bring and ignite curiosity.







If you’re looking to increase your expertise and broaden your responsibility, this is a fantastic opportunity within Volvo Group.







Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait to apply.







Location: Gothenburg, Sweden.







Last application date: October 18th, 2026.







We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.







Who we are and what we believe in



We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.



Trucks Technology & Industrial Division hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need.

Company description:

Part of Volvo Group, Volvo Autonomous Solutions accelerates the development, commercialization and sales of autonomous transport solutions, focusing on defined segments for the on- and off-road space. The combination of strong tech expertise and skilled customer solutions creates innovative transport offers never seen before. We are constantly pushing our own skills and ability to drive change in a traditional industry to meet a growing customer demand. We are now looking for innovative, committed individuals to join us in our endeavor to create customer solutions that enhance safety, flexibility and productivity.

Job description:

What you will do

  

At Volvo Autonomous Solutions, we are at the forefront of innovation, designing the autonomous transport solutions of tomorrow. As part of our global and diverse team, you will have the opportunity to work on an industrial research challenge that contributes to the future of safe, efficient and sustainable transport.







We are looking for a master’s thesis student to investigate how shared information from multiple vehicles can be used to detect changing site conditions and support operational decision-making across a fleet.







The thesis project



Conditions observed by one vehicle may affect vehicles that subsequently approach the same area. For example, changes in road conditions, traffic situations or operational environments may have an impact on vehicle safety, routing and mission execution.







The goal of this thesis is to investigate whether a shared spatiotemporal representation of sensor observations, vehicle signals, maps and operational events can be used to maintain a dynamic model of site conditions. The representation should also be reusable for applications such as ODD monitoring, road-condition assessment, mission assistance, traffic coordination, incident investigation and maintenance analysis.







The project will include developing and comparing timestamp-based, single-modality and multimodal methods for maintaining a dynamic site-condition model. You will also investigate how the model can provide evidence-grounded recommendations, such as warning another vehicle, identifying an affected route or proposing a review of speed, routing or traffic-control settings.







The work will include:




    Developing and comparing different approaches for modelling changing site conditions over time.
    Combining information from vehicle sensors, CAN signals, maps and operational events.
    Demonstrating evidence-grounded recommendations for fleet-level decision support.
    Measuring detection quality, warning lead time, false alarms and robustness to missing sensors.
    Evaluating how well the approach generalises across vehicles and operating conditions.
    Analysing the results and documenting your findings in a scientific report.











Resources and research environment



You will have access to multi-vehicle camera, CAN and operational data, as well as position data, site maps and reviewed events or condition changes. GPU compute resources and multimodal models will be available for developing and evaluating your approach.







Additional sensor data from LiDAR and RADAR may also be available, depending on the selected scope of the project. You will work closely with experienced engineers and researchers in a collaborative AI and autonomy team, gaining insight into fleet-level intelligence, autonomous systems and the development of operational decision-support solutions.

     Who are you?  

You are enrolled in a master’s programme in computer science, data science, machine learning, electrical engineering, robotics or a related field. You have solid Python programming skills and hands-on experience with a deep-learning framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.







We are looking for someone who is interested in autonomous systems, machine perception, spatiotemporal modelling and working with real-world sensor and vehicle data.







You should also be:




    Independent, structured and curious.
    Analytical and motivated to solve challenging technical problems.
    Comfortable working with multimodal data, machine-learning experiments and evaluation metrics.
    Interested in fleet-level intelligence and operational decision support.
    Proficient in written and spoken English.





     What’s in it for you?  

This thesis gives you the opportunity to work on a real industrial research problem with access to unique multimodal vehicle data and the tools needed to conduct advanced experiments. You will receive close technical supervision from experts in AI and autonomous systems, as well as access to GPU resources and multimodal models. You will also become part of a dynamic and inclusive work environment where new ideas are encouraged and celebrated.







How to apply



To apply, send your CV, grade transcript and a short motivation explaining your interest in the project and relevant experience. Start and scope can be adjusted together with the supervisor.

  

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.



Who we are and what we believe in We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.

jobs.title: Join Us as Our Next Process Engineer – MOCVD
jobs.description:
Company

SweGaN is a European semiconductor manufacturer that develops and produces customer-made materials and high-performance epitaxial wafers of gallium nitride for manufacturers of conductive components and devices. We develop and deliver unique material solutions based on the company's groundbreaking GaN epitaxial technology.

SweGaN's products are used for a wide range of applications, including 5G telecommunications infrastructure, defence radar, satellite communications, electric vehicles, high-voltage switches, and more. SweGaN's benchmark QuanFINE® epitaxial growth technology increases the performance of RF and power devices and reduces energy consumption.

What you will be a part of

At SweGaN, we work together to develop and produce advanced semiconductor materials for our customers. Stable and well-controlled production processes are important for ensuring consistent product performance, and close collaboration between our technical teams is an important part of our work.

As our Process Engineer – MOCVD, you will work closely with Production, R&D, Tool Engineering, Maintenance, and Quality. The role combines process engineering, data analysis, problem solving, hands-on technical work, and continuous improvement.

You will work with advanced MOCVD production processes, investigate process-related issues, support the transfer of new processes into production, and contribute to improving process stability, capability, yield, and performance.

You will be part of a growing semiconductor company where collaboration between different technical functions is important for developing and strengthening our production capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

    Take technical ownership of assigned MOCVD production processes and approved production recipes.
    Monitor and improve process performance, stability, capability, yield, and repeatability.
    Define and maintain critical process parameters, operating windows, limits, and acceptance criteria.
    Analyse process and measurement data to identify trends, deviations, and improvement opportunities.
    Investigate abnormal runs, process excursions, and deteriorating process performance.
    Develop, implement and maintain SPC and other statistical process-control methods.
    Perform structured experiments and DOE to understand process sensitivities and optimize process windows.
    Support the transfer and industrialization of new processes and products from R&D into production.
    Define process qualification and requalification requirements for new or modified processes and following significant equipment interventions.
    Work closely with Tool Engineering and Maintenance to distinguish process-related from equipment-related issues.
    Support root-cause investigations of process-related deviations, non-conforming products, and customer issues.
    Participate in PFMEA, CAPA, change control, and other process-related quality activities.
    Develop and maintain process specifications, production recipes, control plans, qualification documentation, and technical reports.
    Contribute to continuous improvement of yield, throughput, process stability, cycle time, and manufacturing cost.
    Provide technical process support to Operators and Production personnel.

Qualifications

    B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Semiconductor Engineering, Nanotechnology, or equivalent.
    Understanding of semiconductor, thin-film, epitaxy, vacuum, or comparable advanced manufacturing processes.
    Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills.
    Experience in analyzing process and measurement data.
    Ability to work both analytically and hands-on in a production environment.
    Good technical documentation and communication skills.
    Fluency in spoken and written Swedish.
    Experience with MOCVD/MOVPE processes or equipment, III-V semiconductor materials such as GaN, AlGaN, InGaN or GaAs, epitaxial growth, SPC, DOE, Cpk/Ppk, PFMEA, 8D, RCA, semiconductor gas and utility systems, or ISO 9001/IATF 16949 is considered an advantage.

jobs.title: AI Scientist - Domain Expert Crashworthiness
jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the job

Mistral AI is looking for a Domain Expert in crashworthiness simulations to help build AI-accelerated simulation capabilities for industrial engineering.

You will work at the intersection of industrial simulation, physics modeling, machine learning, and engineering workflows. Your role is to bring deep solid-mechanics expertise into the design, training, evaluation, and deployment of AI Physics Models for real engineering use cases.

This is a hands-on technical role. We are looking for someone who understands industrial structural simulation not only conceptually, but through direct experience with simulation models, solver workflows, data generation, validation, and engineering decision-making.

You will work with research, product, and customer-facing teams to ensure that our models are useful against real engineering standards — not only benchmark metrics.

Relevant application areas may include automotive crashworthiness, aerospace structures, consumer-electronics drop/reliability, manufacturing, durability/fatigue, and other nonlinear structural mechanics problems.

What you will do

  • Work with our research team to define, generate, and iteratively improve simulation datasets for training and evaluating crashworthiness foundation models, balancing coverage of relevant physical scenarios, simulation fidelity, and computational cost.

  • Design and run high-fidelity simulation campaigns using structural mechanics solvers such as Abaqus, LS-DYNA, Ansys Mechanical, Radioss or equivalent tools.

  • Define the relevant variation space for training data: geometry, mesh resolution, material behavior, boundary conditions, loading, contact, joints, failure modes, and engineering KPIs.

  • Build or guide automated pipelines for simulation setup, execution, post-processing, dataset creation, and model evaluation.

  • Work with research teams to train and evaluate AI models on simulation data, and diagnose failure modes caused by data gaps, poor coverage, numerical artifacts, or model limitations.

  • Evaluate model outputs against industrial engineering needs, including field-level accuracy, scalar KPIs, deformation modes, load paths, energy absorption, stress/strain fields, failure indicators, uncertainty, and out-of-domain behavior.

  • Work with industrial customers to understand their simulation workflows and engineering priorities, define use cases and success criteria, and incorporate their feedback into model development and validation.

About you

  • You have deep expertise in crashworthiness, solid mechanics, and structural mechanics, with substantial experience in industrial simulation workflows.

  • You have a Master’s degree or equivalent technical depth in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, civil/structural engineering, computational mechanics, applied physics, or a related field.

  • You have 4+ years of relevant industrial experience (or PhD +1 years) in domains such as automotive, aerospace, and consumer electronics.

  • You have hands-on experience with explicit dynamics for crash or impact simulation and understand nonlinear FEM and related topics such as contact, plasticity, structural dynamics, buckling, material modeling, fracture/damage, fatigue, crashworthiness, or durability.

  • You have direct experience with simulation validation, correlation, model quality, numerical sensitivity, and engineering KPI definition.

  • You are a strong Python developer who can build and maintain reliable tools for simulation automation, data processing, and model evaluation. You apply sound software engineering practices, including version control with Git, automated testing, code review, and clear documentation.

  • You have hands-on experience working in Linux and HPC environments, including submitting and monitoring batch jobs, selecting appropriate compute resources, and troubleshooting simulation workflows. You can run simulation campaigns efficiently across a compute cluster.

  • You are comfortable operating in ambiguous technical environments and turning poorly defined industrial problems into scoped datasets, experiments, metrics, and execution plans.

  • You communicate clearly with both deep technical experts and non-specialist stakeholders.

It would be great if you

  • Have experience applying machine learning, surrogate modeling, reduced-order modeling, optimization, or data-driven methods to simulation problems.

  • Have contributed to reusable internal tools, open-source code, simulation automation frameworks, or production-quality engineering workflows.

  • Have experience working directly with industrial customers, product teams, or engineering decision-makers.

  • Have publications, patents, internal technical leadership, or recognized contributions in engineering, simulation, computational mechanics, or ML-for-physics communities.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

This role exists because a design org at our scale needs someone whose full-time job is the operating system itself: defining it, holding it, and continuously tuning it so the team runs with a heartbeat rather than on ad-hoc heroics.

You will own the team's weekly and quarterly cadences — from leadership syncs to planning, retros, and share-outs — and establish how we track work, surface it outward, and make decisions. You'll design the forums where decisions get made and recorded, keep the rituals that create alignment, and aggressively cut the ones that are just overhead.

Equally, you are the bridge across the org. You will coordinate the interlocks between Brand and Marketing for upcoming launches, and between Product and Product Design for the build pipeline — so interdependencies are understood and planned for, not discovered at the last minute. You will partner closely with marketing, PMs, engineering, GTM to align design work with go-to-market timing and surface what's shipping before it ships.

This is a team-of-one role with a founding design-ops mentality. You will build the discipline from scratch, automate repetitive coordination with AI where it helps, and coordinate people where it matters. You report to the Head of Product Operations, working day-to-day with the Head of Design and the design team.

What You Will Do

  • Define the operating system of the design team — the cadences, forums, rituals, and source-of-truth that keep the team aligned and moving forward.

  • Own the weekly and quarterly cadences, from leadership syncs and critiques to planning, retros, and headcount-cycle inputs.

  • Coordinate the Brand × Marketing and Product × Product Design interlocks so design work is surfaced with enough lead time and dependencies are planned, not discovered late.

  • Establish how the team tracks and shares out work — a single source of truth for status, and the forums where design is made legible to the rest of the org.

  • Design and hold decision-making forums so decisions get made, recorded, and not relitigated.

  • Separate ritual from overhead — keep the cadences that create alignment and cut the ones that are just tax.

  • Automate repetitive coordination, reporting, and tracking with AI so the team spends time on design, not admin.

  • Bring the wider Product Operations toolkit to the design team — data and analytics for transparent reporting, structured feedback loops and early-access programmes, and launch coordination that aligns design work with product release cycles and go-to-market timing.

  • Partner with marketing, PMs, engineering and GTM to align design work with go-to-market timing and surface what's shipping.

What We're Looking For

  • 6–10 years of experience in design operations, product operations, program management, or a chief-of-staff role within a creative or product organization.

  • A founding design-ops mindset — you've built operational disciplines from scratch, not just maintained inherited ones.

  • Comfortable automating with AI tools to remove repetitive overhead, while equally skilled at coordinating people and building coalitions without authority.

  • Strong systems thinking — you design repeatable rhythms and processes, not just run meetings.

  • Design literacy — enough background to have felt the pain designers feel and to be credible with the team.

  • A make-it-happen attitude: positive, bias to action, unblocks rather than escalates.

  • Excellent communication and synthesis skills — you turn scattered signals into a shared source of truth.

  • Ability to thrive in ambiguity and define your own scope in a role with no playbook and no team to delegate to.

jobs.title: Applied AI Software Engineer - Defense
jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the role

Join Mistral AI’s Defense team to build software for defense institutions and industry.

We are looking for an experienced software engineer with strong engineering fundamentals and a background in data engineering or transactional, analytical or distributed systems. You will help shape the architecture, write production code and own substantial software components, from design through deployment and operation.

This role offers the scope and autonomy of a senior technical individual contributor in a small team. It is particularly suited to engineers operating at Senior or Staff level in demanding product engineering environments who want broad ownership and to stay deeply involved in implementation.

What you will do

  • Design and build services for data ingestion, transformation, storage, querying and operational workflows.

  • Develop shared data models, APIs and SDKs that help engineers build applications on a consistent foundation.

  • Make authorization a core part of the architecture: define and enforce which users, applications and agents can access data or perform actions, with clear audit trails.

  • Solve problems involving data consistency, schema evolution, concurrency, performance and failure recovery across services and data systems.

  • Turn needs from our applied engineers and defense users into reusable software capabilities, making pragmatic choices about what to build and how to evolve them.

  • Own delivery end to end, including implementation, testing, observability, debugging and maintainability in demanding deployment environments.

  • Use AI coding tools and coding agents extensively to accelerate implementation, testing, refactoring and debugging. Help the team improve these workflows while maintaining a high engineering standard.

What we are looking for

  • Strong practical familiarity with AI coding tools and agentic engineering workflows. You use coding agents regularly, can break complex work into well-scoped tasks, provide effective context, review generated code and validate the result through tests and debugging. You remain accountable for the architecture, correctness, security and maintainability of what you ship.

  • A strong track record of building and operating production software, with substantial ownership of complex systems.

  • Experience in data engineering or in building transactional, analytical or distributed systems. You understand the trade-offs behind data models, storage, query execution and service boundaries.

  • Experience building products where access control, permissions and data governance are central to how the system works. Work on platforms such as Foundry, or systems with comparable requirements, is particularly relevant.

  • Broad software engineering skills and the ability to move between architecture, implementation and production debugging. You are comfortable working across unfamiliar parts of a codebase.

  • Strong proficiency in Python or another programming language, solid SQL skills and the ability to become productive quickly in a Python and TypeScript environment.

  • High autonomy and sound judgment: you can turn an ambiguous problem into a concrete plan, make technical decisions and deliver useful increments with limited supervision.

  • A collaborative approach to technical leadership through code, design discussions, reviews and mentoring, and a clear motivation to build software for defense institutions and industry.

  • Experience building a data platform or developer product used by other engineering teams.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Real-Time Systems (Early Career)
jobs.description:
Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

Legion's Command & Control platform lets a single operator plan, direct, and execute missions across a networked swarm of heterogeneous aircraft, in real time, over intermittent comms, at a scale nobody else in the industry is attempting. That means distributed state under unreliable networks, dense telemetry moving fast enough to strain anything you've built before, and interfaces for a problem space that barely has prior art. You'll work across the stack, wherever the hard problem is that week.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build and ship features in the C2 system that directs swarms of heterogeneous aircraft

  • Work on systems that hold state and stay responsive when comms degrade or drop entirely

  • Move between the interface layer and the services behind it, following the problem rather than a job description

  • Prototype new ways to represent and control vehicle telemetry, sensor data, and scheduling

  • Take features end to end, from a rough problem statement through design, implementation, and deployment

  • Ship early and often, backed by strong CI/CD, QA, and DevSecOps

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent self-taught depth

  • Real strength in fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, concurrency, networking, systems

  • Evidence you've built something hard because you wanted to. A renderer, an emulator, a game, a compiler, a multiplayer server, a robotics project, a serious open source contribution. We care more about what you've built than where you worked

  • Comfort writing code at more than one layer of the stack, and no strong attachment to staying at one

  • Willingness to work on problems where the right answer isn't known yet, and to be wrong in public on the way to finding it

WHAT SETS YOU APART

  • Competitive programming background (ICPC, IOI, Codeforces, USACO, Putnam)

  • Game development, game jams, engine work, or simulation

  • Performance-sensitive work: profiling, frame budgets, memory pressure, running on constrained hardware

  • Real-time or distributed systems experience: multiplayer netcode, streaming, pub/sub, robotics middleware

  • Graphics: WebGL, OpenGL, Vulkan, shaders

  • Working fluency in Go, C++, or Rust

  • Familiarity with video streaming protocols or geospatial applications

WHY THIS ROLE

You'll be one of the earliest engineers shaping how humans command autonomous systems at scale, work that's currently being defined in real time, by a small team, with your fingerprints on the architecture. If you want to build the future of human-swarm interaction rather than maintain someone else's, this is that seat.

Swarm Aero is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences and make employment decisions without regard to race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, or disability.

What We Offer

  • Meaningful equity in a high-growth defense technology company

  • Competitive base salary commensurate with experience

  • Medical, dental, vision, and 401k

  • PTO and paid sick leave

  • Monthly wellness stipend

  • Daily catered lunch (office)

  • Paid parental leave

  • Direct impact on a critical national security mission

  • A world-class team of engineers and operators solving genuinely hard problems

Compensation: $170K – $220K

jobs.description:
We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

The team:

You'll join the Data Team, responsible for turning data into actionable insights and recommendations for our consumer sales and marketing operations across all channels.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Own analytics across the full consumer sales scope: Ledger.com e-commerce, Amazon marketplaces, wholesale and resellers/distributors - covering both sell-in and sell-out- with one consistent view of revenue, units and margin reconciled in Snowflake, our source of truth

  • Develop and improve data models (dbt/Snowflake) across varied data sources (sales, sell-out, marketing, web analytics) with the support of the data engineering team; co-own data quality alerting (SKU, refunds, sales anomalies)

  • Build and maintain Tableau dashboards for business stakeholders: e-commerce performance, wholesale, resellers sell-out, affiliation, editorial content, shipping costs

  • Own the measurement of performance marketing channels - SEM / Google Ads, affiliation & retargeting, Amazon Ads: spend, revenue attribution, ROAS/CAC across GA4, ad platforms and internal sales data, reconciling discrepancies between sources

  • Measure the true impact of pricing, promotional and marketing campaigns using causal inference methods (CausalImpact, pre-post, control/synthetic groups) and recommend budget arbitrations to the Growth team

  • Model customer value (LTV, repurchase behavior, services attach) and feed it back into marketing ROI decisions

  • Contribute to cross-functional data projects (Salesforce data model, new data source integrations) and leverage AI tooling (Claude, LLM-based workflows) to scale analytics delivery

  • Create and deliver presentations that turn complex analyses into clear recommendations for stakeholders up to ExCom level

What we’re looking for:

  • Strong SQL and dbt skills (Snowflake)

  • Python for analysis and statistics; experience with causal inference methods is a strong plus

  • Strong Tableau skills

  • Familiarity with marketing/web analytics data: GA4, ad platforms (Google Ads, Amazon Ads), affiliation networks

  • 3-4 years of experience in data analytics/analytics engineering

  • Data driven and business oriented; able to challenge stakeholders' methodology

  • Excellent organizational skills, fluent in English

At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to:

  • Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week

  • Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance.

  • Financial growth opportunities - Employees can become shareholders in Ledger as well as other financial benefits depending on your country of work.

  • Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation.

  • Learning & Development - A comprehensive suite of training solutions providing a personalised learning experience for every employee.

For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information.

 

We’re committed to building an inclusive hiring process. If you need any adjustments or accommodations, just let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.

jobs.description:
Etsimme asiakaspalveluhenkistä ja motivoitunutta Kotipalveluyrittäjää liittymään osaavien Kotirinki-yrittäjien joukkoon. Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden rakentaa omaa menestystäsi joustavasti.

Työ sisältää: Siivouspalvelut arkipäivisin asiakkaiden kodeissa esimerkiksi säännöllisesti tehtävät ylläpitosiivoukset tai kertaluoteisia palveluita kuten teho- ja muuttosiivouksia tai ikkunoidenpesua. Mahdollisuus laajentaa tehtäviä myös ikäihmisten Kotiapupalveluihin, kuten asiointiapuun, seuranpitoon ja arjen tukitehtäviin jos sinulla on siihen soveltuvuutta ja kiinnostusta

Edellytämme: Vähintään B-ajokorttia (Suomalainen ajo-oikeus) ja auton käyttömahdollisuus Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa, minimi taso B2 (asiakasviestintä tapahtuu suomeksi suullisesti ja kirjallisesti) Nuhteeton tausta ja luottotiedot kunnossa Hyvä fyysinen ja henkinen kunto

Arvostamme: Asiakaspalveluasennetta ja aitoa halua auttaa Kiinnostusta markkinointiin ja oman toiminnan kehittämiseen Valmiin toimintamallin arvostamista Tahtoa menestyä yrittäjänä ja tehdä töitä yhdessä

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden kasvaa ja kehittyä osana lämminhenkistä ja tyytyväistä Kotirinkiläisten joukkoa. Jos tunnet kutsumusta auttaa ihmisiä arjessa ja haluat rakentaa omaa yrittäjyyttäsi tuetusti ja kannustavasti tämä voi olla juuri sinulle!

Joustavat aikataulut ja itsenäisyys: Päätä itse, milloin ja kuinka paljon haluat työskennellä. Tämä työ joustaa elämäntilanteesi mukaan mahdollisuus rauhallisiin aamuihin, aikaisiin iltapäiviin tai vapaiden viikonloppujen suunnitteluun on omissa käsissäsi.

Vahva tuki markkinointiin ja asiakashankintaan: Saat käyttöösi valmiin verkkokaupan ja nautit Kotiringin tekemästä markkinointi- ja myyntityöstä, joka tukee yrityksesi kasvua. Vaikutat omaan menestykseesi omilla paikallisilla markkinointitoimilla ja aktiivisella asiakastyöllä.

Valmis konsepti ja helppokäyttöiset työvälineet: Kotiringin kehittämät järjestelmät tekevät yrittäjyydestä yksinkertaista. Hallinnolliset työt, kuten laskutus ja työvuorosuunnittelu, hoituvat muutamalla klikkauksella, joten aikaa jää itse työlle, asiakkaille ja omasta vapaasta ajasta nauttimiseen.

Koulutus ja jatkuva tuki: Oli sinulla aiempaa kokemusta alalta tai ei, Kotirinki kouluttaa sinut tuottamaan kotipalveluitamme konseptimme mukaisesti. Tukemme ja kattavat ohjeemme varmistavat, että onnistut laadukkaan palvelun tuottamisessa yrittäjänä.

Kenelle Kotirinki-yrittäjyys sopii? Tämä mahdollisuus on sinulle, joka: Haluat itsenäisyyttä ja vapautta päättää omasta ajankäytöstäsi. Nautit asiakkaiden auttamisesta ja heidän arkeensa vaikuttamisesta. Olet oma-aloitteinen ja haluat kehittää itseäsi yrittäjänä. Etsit tasapainoa työn ja muun elämän välille.

Kotirinki on kotimainen ketju, joka on tarjonnut palveluita asiakkaiden kotiin jo vuodesta 2002. Ketjussa toimii jo yli 80 tyytyväistä yrittäjää. Toimimme mikrofranchising-toimintamallilla, eli jokainen palveluntuottajamme on itsenäinen paikallinen pienyrittäjä. Kotirinki-ketjuun liittymisessä et joudu maksamaan kallista liittymismaksua, vaan aloituskustannukset koostuvat työvälineistä ja -vaatteista sekä muista yrityksen perustamiseen liittyvistä kustannuksista.

Testaa vastaammeko me sinun haaveisiisi paremmasta työstä ja sujuvammasta arjesta: Hyppää uudenaikaiseen kotipalvelutyöhön! Käy tekemässä onnellisuustestimme

Nyt on täydellinen hetki hypätä mukaan kasvavaan kotipalvelualaan tukea, asiakkaita ja etuja heti alusta alkaen. Mahdollisuus aloituskoulutukseen jo toukokuussa 2026.

Hae mukaan jo tänään ja kerro, miksi juuri sinä olisit sopiva Kotipalveluyrittäjäksi. Haastattelut käynnistetään jo hakuaikana ja paikat täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Hakemuksen ja infopaketin löydät sivuiltamme,

Tervetuloa nauttimaan siistimmästä arjesta kanssamme!

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden kasvaa ja kehittyä osana lämminhenkistä ja tyytyväistä Kotirinkiläisten joukkoa. Jos tunnet kutsumusta auttaa ihmisiä arjessa ja haluat rakentaa omaa yrittäjyyttäsi tuetusti ja kannustavasti tämä voi olla juuri sinulle!

Joustavat aikataulut ja itsenäisyys: Päätä itse, milloin ja kuinka paljon haluat työskennellä. Tämä työ joustaa elämäntilanteesi mukaan mahdollisuus rauhallisiin aamuihin, aikaisiin iltapäiviin tai vapaiden viikonloppujen suunnitteluun on omissa käsissäsi.

Vahva tuki markkinointiin ja asiakashankintaan: Saat käyttöösi valmiin verkkokaupan ja nautit Kotiringin tekemästä markkinointi- ja myyntityöstä, joka tukee yrityksesi kasvua. Vaikutat omaan menestykseesi omilla paikallisilla markkinointitoimilla ja aktiivisella asiakastyöllä.

Valmis konsepti ja helppokäyttöiset työvälineet: Kotiringin kehittämät järjestelmät tekevät yrittäjyydestä yksinkertaista. Hallinnolliset työt, kuten laskutus ja työvuorosuunnittelu, hoituvat muutamalla klikkauksella, joten aikaa jää itse työlle, asiakkaille ja omasta vapaasta ajasta nauttimiseen.

Koulutus ja jatkuva tuki: Oli sinulla aiempaa kokemusta alalta tai ei, Kotirinki kouluttaa sinut tuottamaan kotipalveluitamme konseptimme mukaisesti. Tukemme ja kattavat ohjeemme varmistavat, että onnistut laadukkaan palvelun tuottamisessa yrittäjänä.

Kenelle Kotirinki-yrittäjyys sopii? Tämä mahdollisuus on sinulle, joka: Haluat itsenäisyyttä ja vapautta päättää omasta ajankäytöstäsi. Nautit asiakkaiden auttamisesta ja heidän arkeensa vaikuttamisesta. Olet oma-aloitteinen ja haluat kehittää itseäsi yrittäjänä. Etsit tasapainoa työn ja muun elämän välille.

Kotirinki on kotimainen ketju, joka on tarjonnut palveluita asiakkaiden kotiin jo vuodesta 2002. Ketjussa toimii jo lähes 80 tyytyväistä yrittäjää. Toimimme mikrofranchising-toimintamallilla, eli jokainen palveluntuottajamme on itsenäinen paikallinen pienyrittäjä. Kotirinki-ketjuun liittymisessä et joudu maksamaan kallista liittymismaksua, vaan aloituskustannukset koostuvat työvälineistä ja -vaatteista sekä muista yrityksen perustamiseen liittyvistä kustannuksista.

Testaa vastaammeko me sinun haaveisiisi paremmasta työstä ja sujuvammasta arjesta: Hyppää uudenaikaiseen kotipalvelutyöhön! Käy tekemässä onnellisuustestimme

Nyt on täydellinen hetki hypätä mukaan kasvavaan kotipalvelualaan tukea, asiakkaita ja etuja heti alusta alkaen. Mahdollisuus aloituskoulutukseen loka- tai marraskuussa.

Hae mukaan jo tänään ja kerro, miksi juuri sinä olisit sopiva Kotipalveluyrittäjäksi. Haastattelut käynnistetään jo hakuaikana ja paikat täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Hakemuksen ja infopaketin löydät sivuiltamme,

Tervetuloa nauttimaan siistimmästä arjesta kanssamme!

Avainsanoja: siivous, kotiapu, kotipalvelu, kotisiivous, lisätyö, osa-aikatyö, lisäansio, lisätulo, kotipalvelu, asiakaspalvelu, asiakaspalvelutyö, yrittäjä, yrittäjyys, siivousala, puhtausala, siivooja, lähihoitaja, sairaanhoitaja, kotihoiva, siistijä, kokoaikatyö, hoiva-avustaja, kodinhuoltaja, päivätyö, laitoshuoltaja, puhtausala, hoitoala, kotipalveluala, siivoustyö, avointyöpaikka, palvelutyö, yrittäjyys, kotipalvelutyö,

jobs.title: Fulfillment Operator
jobs.employer: ODA NORWAY AS AVD LIER DISTRIBUSJON
jobs.description:
Join our team of Fulfillment Operators at Lier!

At Oda, we develop affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy. First, we built Norway’s leading online grocery store, and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective retail system, delivering to thousands of Scandinavian doorsteps every week.

At Oda, you’ll work in a fast-paced, inclusive environment with passionate colleagues who value collaboration and learning. As a Fulfillment Operator, you’ll play a key role in picking and delivering high-quality groceries to the right customer. Together, we tackle operational challenges, support each other, and help shape Oda as a great place to work💪🏼


What you’ll be doing

  • Pick and pack goods for customers

  • Be the first point of contact for the handover of goods from suppliers

  • Ensure that products are on the shelves and that the workplace is kept tidy

  • Work closely with your team to achieve our operational goals and measure against company KPI´s

  • Contribute to a culture that works with continuous improvement of processes and working methods


What you’ll need to succeed🌟

  • Like working as part of a team towards a common goal and are keen to help others

  • See solutions rather than problems and offer suggestions for improvement where necessary

  • Are comfortable with and like routine-based tasks

  • Are motivated by working in a fast-paced, physically active environment

  • Are self-driven and enjoy taking ownership of tasks

  • Have a genuine desire to work and grow in Oda

  • Speak and understand English. Norwegian is a plus

  • The minimum age requirement for this position is 18 years


What would be nice to have💡

  • Previous experience in warehouse work, in a value chain, trade, or production

  • It's a plus if you have a forklift certificate

  • Being service-minded and customer-focused

  • Having your own car or being able to drive is great, as our working hours don't align well with public transportation


What we offer🚀

This is your chance to make a real impact at a fast-moving company with a product people love—while shaking up the grocery industry. You’ll experience:

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, which means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere.

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop—less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.

  • Discounted lunch and a free gym to keep you fuelled and energised 🏋

  • Free parking

  • Oda Shuttle Bus: We offer a shuttle bus service for all employees between Lørenskog (Solheimveien) ➔ Helsfyr ➔ Sjølyst/Skøyen ➔ Lier 🚌


Practical informationℹ️

  • We are currently hiring for both day and night shifts.

    • Working hours:

      • Day shift: 06:30:-14:30

      • Night shift: 22:00-06:00

      • You are going to follow a fixed schedule with a shift rotation, working every fourth weekend

  • We're hiring for our Dry and Cold departments. You’ll primarily work in one department, but assist in the others when needed. Please specify in your application which department you're applying for

  • Application deadline: 6 November. We're actively looking for the right person to join our team, so we’ll be interviewing candidates on a rolling basis. Because we might close the ad early if we find the perfect fit, make sure to get your application in as soon as possible

  • Location: Drammensveien 189, 3420 Lierskogen


A few final words

At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job🧡


Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium. As part of our work to ensure a fair and open-minded recruitment process, we have chosen to collaborate with Hubert.ai, a virtual recruitment assistant that helps with the selection process. As soon as you submit an application for this position, you will be invited via email to a chat-based interview. Therefore, be careful to enter your correct email address so the invitation reaches the right place🤖


We look forward to hearing from you🧡

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

jobs.title: Department Manager Interior
jobs.description:
At VARD, we create innovative and sustainable solutions for the global maritime industry. Combining future-oriented engineering excellence, cutting-edge technology, and strong teamwork, we design and build some of the world’s most advanced vessels for a wide range of market segments, including offshore energy, naval, fisheries, icebreaking and research. 

At the same time, we believe our people are our greatest strength.  We need people with a wide range of skills, professional backgrounds, and experience. Engineers, designers, skilled workers, project managers, finance professionals, procurement specialists and many others all work together towards a common goal. Different perspectives and areas of expertise are essential to delivering high-quality vessels. 

To be able to build the ships of tomorrow today, we foster an inclusive and supportive environment where talents can grow, ideas are valued, and individuals are empowered to make an impact. 

 

Vard Interiors is a leading supplier of turnkey interior, insulation, piping, and HVAC-R solutions for the maritime industry. As part of the VARD value chain, we work closely with shipowners, designers, and shipyards to create functional, sustainable, and high-quality onboard environments. With a strong focus on innovation, craftsmanship, and customer value, we help bring some of the industry’s most advanced vessels to life.

We are currently looking for a Department Manager Interior to join our team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to apply your expertise, collaborate with skilled colleagues, and contribute to exciting projects across the VARD value chain.

Ready to make an impact at VARD?


Duties and responsibilities

In this role, you will:

  • Lead and support Production Coordinators and Supervisors across projects.
  • Drive operational performance, productivity, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
  • Monitor project progress, resource utilization, quality, and efficiency. 
  • Ensure compliance with HSE requirements and promote a strong safety culture.
  • Collaborate with Project Management, Engineering, Procurement, and installation teams to secure successful project execution. 
  • Resolve operational challenges and support the delivery of projects according to quality, schedule, and budget objectives. 
  • Contribute to planning, performance reporting, and development of the Interior department
Qualifications
  • Relevant technical education or equivalent industry experience.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience within interior shipbuilding.
  • Leadership experience and strong people management skills.
  • Strong operational, planning, and resource management capabilities.
  • Good understanding of HSE, quality, and project execution.
  • Technical understanding of interior installation and production processes.
  • Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

 

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above. 

This employment may require a background check, or security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority.

Personal qualities
  • Strong leadership and communication skills.
  • Team-oriented and collaborative approach.
  • Proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Results-oriented with a focus on quality, safety, and efficiency.
  • Ability to motivate, coach, and develop employees.
  • Identify yourself with the VARD values Craftmanship, Salesmanship and Fellowship.
Why you'll enjoy working at VARD

 At VARD, you'll join an international company where innovation, collaboration, and continuous development are part of everyday work. We are committed to creating an environment where people thrive, grow, and succeed together. 

As part of our team, you'll benefit from: 

  • Exciting and meaningful work in a global maritime environment 
  • Opportunities for continuous learning, professional development, and career growth 
  • A competitive pension scheme and comprehensive insurance coverage 
  • Flexible working arrangements, including the possibility to work from home 
  • Subsidized lunch in our office canteen 
  • Subsidized gym membership to support your health and wellbeing 
  • Occupational health services 
  • Free mobile phone usage 
  • Modern office facilities with free parking 

At VARD, we also know that a great workplace is about more than just work. Through Social by VARD, you'll have the opportunity to connect with colleagues across teams and locations through a wide range of social activities and events. From fjord cruises, hiking, and cooking classes to football practice, go-karting, and wine tasting, there are plenty of opportunities to build relationships, share experiences, and create lasting memories.

6018 Ålesund

Vard Interiors AS is a specialized company for interior, insulation, piping, and HVAC-R installation in Vard Group AS. Our company is present in VARD shipyards in Norway, Romania, and Vietnam. We have also established a subsidiary in Romania.
