Finance - Payroll - Benefits and Compensation - Associate

Location:  Luxembourg
Other locations:  Primary Location Only
Salary: Competitive

Job description

Requisition ID:  1728733

Junior Payroll - Benefits and Compensation

September 2026

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.
We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Are you ready to shape the future with confidence?

Here at EY, you'll have the chance to build a truly exceptional experience. We'll empower you with the latest technology, surround you with high-performing teams, and provide the global scale and diverse and inclusive culture you need to discover your full potential. Through our coaching and training programs, you'll develop the skills you need to stay relevant today and, in the future, – all while building a network of colleagues, mentors, and leaders who will be on the journey with you at EY and beyond.

The opportunity: your next adventure awaits

• Be responsible and accountable for the timelines, accuracy and operational delivery of the end to end payroll processes in close collaboration with our payroll provider.
• Contribute to the regular review and implementation of the benefits program (car leasing, insurance, pension plans, health insurance etc..)
• Prepare monthly and yearly reports related to compensation and benefits matters
• Be responsible for ensuring compliance with social security and local law and regulations.
• Be responsible for internal policies and processes
• Ensure compliance with local labor, social security, and regulatory requirements while maintaining and continuously improving internal policies and processes.
• Manage the relevant systems and tools (i.e.: participating in set up of new systems & processes, testing and implementation phases…)
• Act as an escalation point for payroll and benefits related questions and provide internal trainings on the topics to employee
• Liaising, interacting and maintaining relationships with external providers
• Close collaboration with other teams to ensure timely and accurate service delivery
• Be part of the onboarding program: Train new joiners about administrative, compensation and benefits matters
• Participate in various projects and initiatives
• Perform administrative tasks, process employee information accurately and efficiently, and ensure the highest level of confidentiality when handling sensitive data.

What we look for:

• You have an agile, growth-oriented mindset. What you know matters. But the right mindset is just as important in determining success. We're looking for people who are innovative, can work in an agile way and keep pace with a rapidly changing world.
• You are curious and purpose driven. We're looking for people who see opportunities instead of challenges, who ask better questions to seek better answers.
• You are inclusive. We're looking for people who seek out and embrace diverse perspectives, who value differences, and team inclusively to build safety and trust.

• Qualifications:

o You hold a Bachelor Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or similar.
o You have a first experience in a similar position
o Ability to develop strong partnerships with colleagues across the firm
o Good management of Microsoft Office package (Word, Excel, Power Point)
o In terms of languages, you must be fluent in English and French. An additional language will be an asset.
o Knowledge of payroll digitalization and process improvement practices will be an asset
o High attention to detail and ability to work under pressure within tight details

What's in it for you:

• Accelerate your technical capabilities and transformative leadership skills with future-focused courses and development programs.
• Broaden your horizons by working on highly integrated teams across the globe and collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds — both professionally and culturally.
• Bring out the best in yourself with continuous investment in your personal well-being and career development.
• Develop your own personal purpose and help us create a positive ripple effect on our teams, our business, clients and society.

What you can expect:

• A first conversation with one of our recruiters
• A technical interview with the manager of the team
• A final interview with the director of the Finance department
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create the best experience during the recruitment process, please describe any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

EY  |  Building a better working world
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

jobs.title: Kinésithérapeute (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Le Rehazenter recrute Kinésithérapeute (m/f/x)

CDD de 12 mois à 100%

Localité: Neudorf-Weimershof

Missions:

Dans le cadre du renforcement de ses équipes, le Centre de Rééducation Fonctionnelle et de Réhabilitation recherche un kinésithérapeute diplômé pour intégrer son environnement pluridisciplinaire au service de la rééducation spécialisée.
Vous aurez l'opportunité de travailler au sein d'un établissement de référence au Luxembourg, doté d'infrastructures modernes et dédié à la prise en charge globale des patients en rééducation fonctionnelle.

• Effectuer des évaluations complètes de l'état physique et fonctionnel des patients.
• Elaborer des plans de traitement personnalisés, en fonction des objectifs de rééducation établis avec le patient
• Mettre en œuvre une large palette de techniques de kinésithérapie pour améliorer la mobilité, la force et la fonctionnalité.
• Assurer une communication claire avec les patients afin d'atteindre les objectifs de traitements.
• Suivre l'évolution des patients et ajuster les traitements en fonction des progrès observés.
• Accompagner le patient dans une démarche d'éducation thérapeutique, en lui transmettant de manière claire les objectifs de traitement et en lui donnant les moyens de comprendre, réaliser et intégrer les exercices dans une logique d'autonomie et d'autogestion de sa santé.
• Fournir des conseils aux patients sur les exercices à domicile, sur la gestion de la douleur, les stratégies de prévention des blessures et la promotion du bien-être général.

Profil requis et compétences techniques:

• Vous disposez du diplôme de masseur-kinésithérapeute reconnu par le Ministère de l'Education Nationale du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg et vous êtes détenteur de l'autorisation d'exercer délivrée par le Ministère de la Santé
• Vous faites preuve d'un sens relationnel développé et êtes à l'écoute du patient
• Vous êtes capable de travailler en équipe pluridisciplinaire
• Maîtrise de l'une des trois langues administratives du Grand-Duché (luxembourgeois, français, allemand), la connaissance de l'anglais ou toute autre langue sont un atout.
• Vous utilisez les outils informatiques courantes (MS Office)
• Horaires de travail : 8h00 – 12h00 et 13h00 – 17h00
• Permanence kiné : +/-2 weekends par an

Compétences sociales et savoir-être:

• Sens de l'écoute, de la communication et accompagnement bienveillant des patients et de leurs proches.
• Rigueur, autonomie et sens des responsabilités dans la prise en charge thérapeutique.
• Aptitude à travailler en équipe pluridisciplinaire (médecins, ergothérapeutes, orthophonistes, infirmiers).

jobs.title: Ergothérapeute (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Le Rehazenter recrute Ergothérapeute (m/f/x)

Un CDI à 100%, expérience pédiatrique requise

Localité: Neudorf-Weimershof

Missions:

Dans le cadre du renforcement de ses équipes, le Centre de Rééducation Fonctionnelle et de Réhabilitation recherche un ergothérapeute diplômé pour intégrer son équipe pluridisciplinaire au service de la rééducation spécialisée.

Vous aurez l'opportunité de travailler au sein d'un établissement de référence au Luxembourg, doté d'infrastructures modernes et dédié à la prise en charge globale des patients en rééducation fonctionnelle.

• Assurer la prise en charge des patients, enfants et adulte, en rééducation fonctionnelle et réadaptation, dans le cadre d'un suivi pluridisciplinaire.
• Évaluer les besoins des patients pédiatriques et adultes, élaborer des projets de soins personnalisés en lien avec leur environnement, leur projet de vie et leur environnement familial.
• Réaliser des séances de rééducation en lien avec la prescription médicale et le projet de vie du patient
• Actualiser les bilans et réévaluer régulièrement les objectifs de soins en fonction de l'évolution du patient.
• Mettre en place des mises en situation de vie, incluant des activités adaptées à l'enfant (jeux, scolarité, autonomie), et effectuer des visites à domicile ou en milieu scolaire selon les besoins.
• Identifier les besoins en aides techniques, à la mobilité et au positionnement, y compris spécifiques à la pédiatrie.
• Collaborer avec les partenaires externes, notamment les structures scolaires et médico-sociales, pour assurer la continuité de la prise en charge.
• Travailler en interdisciplinarité autour de la prise en charge globale des patients.
• Actualiser ses compétences afin de s'adapter aux évolutions des pratiques et des technologies, notamment en pédiatrie.
• Participer aux projets de développement du service et de l'établissement.

Profil requis et compétences techniques:

• Vous disposez du diplôme d'ergothérapeute reconnu par le Ministère de l'Education Nationale du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg et vous êtes détenteur de l'autorisation d'exercer délivrée par le Ministère de la Santé.
• Vous disposez de connaissances solides en rééducation fonctionnelle et réadaptation.
• Vous êtes en capacité d'analyser et d'élaborer des bilans et des plans thérapeutiques individualisés.
• Vous vous inscrivez dans une organisation institutionnelle en tenant compte des cadres normatifs et de la structure hiérarchique.
• Vous faites preuve d'un sens relationnel développé et vous êtes à l'écoute du patient.
• Maîtrise de l'une des trois langues administratives du Grand-Duché (luxembourgeois, français, allemand), la connaissance de l'anglais ou toute autre langue sont un atout.
• Vous utilisez les outils informatiques courantes. (MS Office)

Compétences sociales et savoir-être:

• Excellentes capacités d'écoute et de communication, avec un accompagnement bienveillant des patients et de leur entourage..
• Rigueur, autonomie et sens des responsabilités dans la prise en charge thérapeutique.
• Capacité à collaborer efficacement au sein d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire (médecins, ergothérapeutes, orthophonistes, infirmiers).

jobs.title: Fund Finance - Associate or VP (m/f)
jobs.description:
Fund Finance - Associate or VP

locations Luxembourg (Siège Lux House)
time type Full time
job requisition id REQ-10121861

Fund Finance - Associate or VP

Sitting within the Financial Institutions (‘FI') Sector, the EMEA Fund Finance (‘FF') team is part of a global business responsible for the origination and structuring of primarily lending transactions to funds managed by European financial sponsors and asset managers. Our clients are predominantly made up of unlisted funds investing in private equity, secondaries, private credit, real estate, and infrastructure, and are managed by leading financial sponsors across the globe. The product offering includes investor-backed capital call facilities for commingled funds, SMA and continuation vehicles, asset-backed NAV financing (across direct buyout, secondaries and private credit) and hybrid solutions combining the two approaches.

The FF EMEA team is now looking to hire an Associate/VP into the team to support continued growth of the business as it looks to deliver on growth targets, drive product expansion into NAV financing and support wider ING sponsor relationships. The role will sit within the EMEA Sectors team, which is made up of experienced fund finance professionals focused on relationship management, origination and structuring of transactions.

Main Duties and Responsibilities of Role:

• Contributing to the origination and execution of fund finance transactions alongside the Deal Principal within the Fund Finance team based in Luxembourg.
• Structuring and pricing of fund finance transactions working with the Transaction Management team on execution and documentation negotiation.
• Assess credit risk across fund structures, investor bases and underlying portfolios, contributing to transaction structuring and risk mitigation discussions.
• Analyze fund structures, investor ecosystems and underlying portfolio assets to identify financing opportunities and deliver tailored solutions across the private markets value chain.

Desirable:

Personal Competencies

• Client relationship management and origination focused with a drive to deliver on ambitious targets.
• Strategic mindset with a view of the big picture considerations
• Technical understanding of complex structures and issues impacting Fund Finance
• Team player.

jobs.description:
Gestionnaire Assurances Vie Entreprises

Location Leudelange
Experience Level Professionnels

Votre job en bref

En tant que Gestionnaire Vie Entreprises, vous assurez la gestion et le suivi des contrats d'assurance groupe destinés aux entreprises au Luxembourg. Vous accompagnez les clients, partenaires et affiliés tout au long du cycle de vie des contrats, tout en garantissant leur conformité aux exigences légales et réglementaires. Grâce à votre expertise en assurance Vie Groupe (Employee Benefits), vous contribuez à la qualité du service, à la satisfaction des clients et au développement durable des relations commerciales.

Ce qui vous attend

Vos principales missions seront les suivantes :

• Gérer l'ensemble du cycle de vie des contrats d'assurance groupe et des régimes complémentaires de pension : mise en place, renouvellements, décomptes, paiements, investissements, affiliations, sorties et prestations.
• Accompagner les entreprises, les services RH, les affiliés et les courtiers dans le traitement de leurs demandes et le suivi de leurs contrats.
• Contrôler la conformité des dossiers et veiller au respect des exigences légales et réglementaires applicables, notamment en matière d'AML/KYC et d'IGSS.
• Analyser les besoins des entreprises et contribuer à la mise en œuvre de solutions adaptées ainsi qu'à la mise en place de nouveaux contrats.
• Développer et renforcer les relations avec les clients et partenaires, participer aux présentations auprès des employés et assurer le suivi des commissions des agents et courtiers.
• Collaborer avec les équipes Finance, Actuariat, Ventes, Juridique et Compliance afin de garantir une gestion fluide et efficace des contrats.
• Participer au partage des connaissances, aux projets de l'équipe et aux initiatives contribuant à l'amélioration continue de l'activité Vie Entreprises.
• Assurer une veille sur les évolutions du marché et du cadre réglementaire afin de contribuer au maintien de la qualité et de la pertinence des solutions proposées.

Ce que nous attendons

• Formation de niveau BAC+3 à BAC+5 en assurances, gestion, finance ou domaine équivalent.
• Expérience de 3 à 5 ans dans une fonction opérationnelle du secteur des assurances, idéalement dans l'environnement Vie Groupe ou Employee Benefits.
• Bonne connaissance des produits Vie Groupe, des régimes complémentaires de pension et du fonctionnement des contrats collectifs.
• Compréhension des enjeux fiscaux, financiers et réglementaires liés au marché luxembourgeois de l'assurance et capacité à évoluer dans un environnement fortement réglementé.
• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques, bonnes capacités rédactionnelles et aisance dans l'utilisation des outils de gestion propres au secteur de l'assurance.
• Esprit d'analyse, aisance avec les chiffres, sens de l'organisation et capacité à gérer plusieurs dossiers avec rigueur.
• Excellentes aptitudes relationnelles, orientation client, sens du service et capacité à collaborer efficacement avec des interlocuteurs internes et externes.
• Maîtrise courante du français et de l'anglais. L'allemand et/ou le luxembourgeois constituent un atout.

Nous sommes plus qu'une compagnie d'assurance traditionnelle : nous sommes le partenaire personnel de quiconque veut se sentir tout simplement en sécurité. Outre nos activités financières classiques, nous cherchons à innover et à créer des liens générateurs de valeur avec des partenariats et des start-ups. Nous considérons l'ère numérique comme une opportunité et aspirons à ce que notre offre de demain soit encore plus durable, plus innovante et plus orientée client. Vous voulez y participer ?

Nous vous donnons la liberté de poursuivre vos idées... Investissez-vous ! Remettez-nous en question ! Continuez à évoluer et à nous faire évoluer !  Tout ceci est possible grâce à notre culture de l'apprentissage et de l'erreur ainsi qu'à une communication d'égal à égal. Parce que ce n'est qu'ensemble que nous pourrons aller de l'avant.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Corporate Governance Officer

Location: Luxembourg

1. Overview

1.1 ONE corporate (“ONE”) is a dynamic and young business focused on delivering quality, value-add, next-gen company secretarial and corporate governance support to a wide variety of clients. We are looking for a governance specialist to manage a portfolio of clients and lead a team responsible for delivering ONE's core services. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced, passionate and career driven governance specialist to work in a flexible and energetic culture focused on delivering premium company secretarial support services.

2. Your Role

2.1 Title: Senior Corporate Governance Officer
2.2 Reports To: Manager, Corporate Governance
2.3 Function: The Senior Corporate Governance Officer supports the Manager, Corporate Governance in the delivery of Company Secretarial and Domiciliation Support Services to clients of ONE.
2.4 Location: Luxembourg

3. Your Attitude and Skills

3.1 You are passionate about your field, understand the importance of corporate governance and are excited about delivering a great product. Entrepreneurial in mind-set, you take ownership, strive to grow relationships, develop the people around you and seek out new opportunities for growth & improvement. You take pride in your work and you view the successes of your colleagues and of ONE as your own.
3.2 You are keen to work in a dynamic, flexible culture that is focused on the job, not the hours; providing you a high degree of autonomy and flexibility as to where and when you work.
3.3 You enjoy a challenge, don't shy away from taking on responsibilities outside of your core role and are at ease talking with, supporting and challenging senior management / board members.
3.4 You hold a Bachelor's degree (or higher/equivalent), have experience relevant to this role (minimum 3 years) and in supporting a variety of alternative and/or UCITS fund structures and like to keep up-to-date with the latest trends in governance practice. You either hold a related Company Secretarial / Corporate Governance qualification or would be keen to study one with our financial support. You have a great command of English and knowledge of other languages would be a plus.

4. What we offer

4.1 A chance to be a driving force behind a growing success story at a young and exciting firm with a culture focused on the successes of its staff and clients. An environment with driven people, who have an entrepreneurial mindset, to help support your development ambitions.

5. Your Responsibilities and Duties

5.1 Leadership Responsibilities:
5.1.1 Support the mentoring of junior members of the team of corporate secretaries and dedicated minute takers to deliver top-tier, responsive and quality focused company secretarial services commensurate with ONE's corporate culture and product offering.
5.1.2 Assist the Manager, Corporate Governance, to manage a portfolio of boards and clients as the lead relationship manager, responsible for overseeing the delivery of services.
5.1.3 Assist with tracking events for invoicing purposes and assist with the invoicing process through to collection of fees.
5.1.4 Assist with the client on-boarding and review process.
5.2 Operational Responsibilities:
5.2.1 Support and deliver Company Secretarial and Registered Office / Domiciliation Support Services in a team environment on a timely basis consistent with client commitments/SLAs.
5.3 Core responsibilities include:

• Acting as a key point of contact with clients, boards, administrators, regulators, counsel and other third parties.
• Support clients and boards with best corporate governance practice.
• Organise and attend Board, Shareholder and Committee meetings for a varied portfolio of clients.
• Take and/or review meeting minutes and resolutions.
• Facilitate and project manage transactions.
• Travel to board meetings (within Luxembourg).
• Support company incorporations.
• Prepare and submit filings with the regulator and Luxembourg Business Registers.
• Maintain corporate records and statutory registers.
• Presenting a professional image in line with our company culture: enthusiastic, upbeat and engaging.

jobs.title: Business Analyst, Banking Operate Services (m/f)
jobs.description:
Job Title:  Business Analyst, Banking Operate Services

Company:  Deloitte Tax & Consulting
Job Function:  Consulting Services
Level of Experience:  Experienced
Contract Type:  Open-term
Req ID:  14080

Job Description:  

Your future team

As a global leader in providing managed services to the financial industry, Deloitte is deeply committed to expanding its Operate offering in the banking space, a model where Deloitte takes ownership of running critical middle- and back-office processes on behalf of banking clients, combining operational excellence with innovative technology.

Our Banking Operate practice has already identified and validated a comprehensive portfolio of services to be launched, covering multiple banking value chains. We are now entering a decisive phase: translating this strategic vision into detailed, actionable specifications that will serve as the foundation for service delivery, technology enablement, and client onboarding.

We are seeking a Business Analyst to join our Banking Operate development team. In this role, you will be responsible for authoring Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Service Functional Descriptions (SFDs) across our target service catalogue. You will work hand-in-hand with subject matter experts, partners, and technology teams to transform high-level service concepts into structured, implementable specifications, at pace.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of our banking managed services from the ground up, with a clear evolution path toward a Project Manager role to oversee the implementation and go-live of the services you will have helped design.

The advantages of joining us

• Career growth, your way Access top-notch training and career development. Start as the architect of our service specifications, then evolve into a project leadership role to drive implementation, with a clear progression path tailored to your ambitions.
• Global impact, local connections Work on strategic banking initiatives with international reach, collaborate with diverse teams of experts, and contribute to building a market-leading Operate offering from Luxembourg.
• Innovative work that matters Leverage the latest AI and LLM technologies to accelerate your work, tackle greenfield service design challenges, and directly contribute to a high-visibility growth initiative backed by firm leadership.
How you'll contribute to our success
• Author high-quality BRDs and SFDs for a portfolio of banking Operate services spanning multiple value chains (payments, securities, lending, investment management, cash management, trade finance, and more).
• Translate strategic service concepts into structured specifications, detailing functional scope, process flows, roles and responsibilities, SLAs, controls, data requirements, and technology dependencies.
• Engage with senior stakeholders and subject matter experts (partners, banking operations specialists, technology leads) to capture requirements, challenge assumptions, and ensure completeness and feasibility of specifications.
• Map end-to-end banking processes across middle and back office, identifying operational touchpoints, regulatory constraints, and integration requirements for each target service.
• Leverage AI tools and Large Language Models (LLMs) to accelerate research, drafting, benchmarking, and structuring of documentation, enabling rapid turnaround without compromising quality.
• Ensure consistency and standardisation across the full service catalogue, establishing reusable templates, taxonomies, and documentation standards.
• Identify dependencies, risks, and gaps early in the specification phase, proactively escalating and proposing solutions to keep the programme on track.
• Contribute to the definition of target operating models for each service, including process design, governance frameworks, technology requirements, and staffing considerations.
• Support the transition from design to delivery by preparing the ground for implementation, you will be positioned to take on project management responsibilities as services move into build and launch phases.
• Act as a central knowledge hub for banking Operate service design, maintaining a clear and organised repository of all specifications and supporting documentation.

Why this role is different

You'll be joining at the inception of a strategic growth programme, in a role that goes beyond traditional maintenance or support, where the services you design today will become the backbone of Deloitte's Banking Operate offering tomorrow. jobs.title: Lower School Learner Support Teacher - 1 year contract (m/f)
jobs.description:
Want to help every learner access, participate and thrive?

At the International School of Luxembourg (ISL), we believe that learner diversity enriches our community. We are looking for a Lower School Learner Support Services (LSS) Teacher who is passionate about creating inclusive learning environments where children feel known, valued and empowered to grow.
Working within our learning community, you will support students with language acquisition and/or diverse learning needs, partnering closely with classroom teachers, families and colleagues across Learner Support Services. Through responsive teaching, targeted intervention and inclusive practice, you will help remove barriers to learning and enable students to develop confidence, agency and independence.
Why does this Role matter?
You will be an important advocate for learners and a resource for our whole learning community. Your expertise will help teachers respond to learner variability, help families understand and support their child's development, and—most importantly—help students recognise themselves as capable, active and successful learners. At ISL, learner support is not simply about helping students overcome challenges. It is about creating the conditions in which every child can participate, develop agency, experience success and reach their potential.

Why ISL?
At ISL, you will join a diverse, caring, and forward-thinking community where:
● Learning is driven by curiosity, compassion, and connection
● Educators are supported to grow, reflect, and innovate
● Students are empowered to find their voice and shape their future
At ISL, learning is deeply human. We believe in creating spaces where students feel seen, heard, and inspired to take ownership of their learning. At our school, learning is driven by curiosity, inquiry, and hands-on experimentation. We are looking for teachers who see teaching as relational, creative and purposeful.

What will You do?
● Support learners individually, in small groups and within the classroom through inclusive, evidence-informed language and learning interventions.
● Co-teach and collaborate with classroom teachers to differentiate learning experiences and ensure meaningful access to the IB Primary Years Programme curriculum.
● Build learner agency by involving students in understanding their strengths, setting learning goals and reflecting on their progress.
● Use assessment purposefully to identify learning needs, monitor growth and adapt interventions and support.
● Develop and monitor Individual Learning Plans, accommodations and targeted learning goals for students requiring additional support.
● Case-manage students receiving language or learning support, maintaining clear records and coordinating communication between students, families, teachers and relevant specialists.
● Partner with families, building trusting and respectful relationships around each child's learning, development and wellbeing.
● Collaborate across multidisciplinary teams, including classroom teachers, counsellors, school leaders and external specialists.
● Strengthen inclusive practice by sharing expertise, resources and strategies with teachers and teaching assistants.
● Contribute actively to the wider Learner Support Services Team and our collaborative professional learning culture.
● Taking active part in the vibrant life of the school — from parent evenings to community events to leading beyond-the-classroom activities.
● Engaging in personal professional growth and bring fresh ideas into the classroom.
● Engage with AI effectively in guiding learners by having a human-centered mindset, promoting ethical principles and responsible use, and providing the knowledge, understanding and skills needed to create and use AI to complement their education.
You will thrive here if you …
● Build positive, trusting relationships with children and creates a strong sense of belonging and psychological safety.
● See learner variability through a strengths-based and inclusive lens.
● Differentiate learning thoughtfully and creatively to reduce barriers and increase participation.
● Collaborate effectively and sees co-teaching as a shared professional practice.
● Communicate sensitively and clearly with students, families, colleagues and external specialists.
● Use evidence, observation and assessment to make informed decisions about learning.
● Are organised and dependable when managing individual learning plans, referrals, documentation and confidential information.
● Reflect on your practice, seeks feedback and remains curious about developments in language acquisition and inclusive education.
● Demonstrate cultural responsiveness, empathy and respect within a diverse international community.

Who are You?
● Strong knowledge of inclusive education, learning differences and/or English language acquisition.
● An understanding of multi-tiered systems of support (“MTSS”) and the use of targeted, evidence-informed interventions.
● Experience with co-teaching, differentiation and inclusive classroom practice.
● Able to use assessment information to identify needs, establish goals and monitor student progress.
● Hold a current teaching qualification/certification and a Bachelor's degree or equivalent; a Master's degree in Special/Inclusive Education, Learning Support, Learning Differences or Language Acquisition is highly valued.
● Preferably two years of recent successful experience working with preschool or primary-aged learners with language and/or learning support needs.
● Experience supporting multilingual learners and recognising multilingualism as an asset.
● Experience interpreting psychoeducational assessments and translating recommendations into classroom practice would be an advantage.
● Experience in an international school and/or IB PYP environment is highly valued.
● Near-native fluency in English and confidence using digital tools to support learning, collaboration and documentation.

We are keen to attract applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly those whose nationality, identity, gender or race is currently under-represented in international education.
We are committed to safeguarding and prioritising the wellbeing of children and young people and expect all staff to share this commitment.
Recruitment timeline:
• If you are shortlisted, you will receive a notification email to book your interview.
• If you have not been contacted after the deadline, your application is potentially unsuccessful but, in any case, you will receive an official answer.

jobs.title: MYP -DP Spanish Language B Teacher (m/f)
jobs.description:
Interested in Joining Our Learning Community at ISL?

Do you believe every learner has unique potential and that education should nurture curiosity, critical thinking and global awareness? Are you passionate about creating meaningful learning experiences that help students make sense of the world and their place within it? If so, we'd love to hear from you.
At ISL, teaching is relational, creative and purposeful. Our teachers design engaging learning experiences that encourage inquiry, reflection and connections between learning and students' lives — locally and globally.

Why ISL?
You will join a diverse, caring and forward-thinking international community where:
● Learning is driven by curiosity, compassion and connection;
● Students are encouraged to find their voice, take ownership of their learning and shape their future;
● Educators collaborate, reflect, innovate and grow professionally;
● Every learner is supported to feel known, valued and challenged.
For our language teachers, language learning is about more than vocabulary and grammar. It opens doors to communication, culture and different perspectives, helping learners become confident, open-minded and internationally minded.
What's the Role?
We are seeking two passionate and reflective Spanish Language B Teachers to join our Upper School learning community in Luxembourg.
Working within the IB Middle Years Programme (MYP) and Diploma Programme (DP), you will help learners develop confidence and proficiency in Spanish through authentic, inquiry- and concept-based learning. You will encourage students to communicate across cultures, explore different perspectives and use language meaningfully.

What will you do?
● Design and facilitate engaging, inquiry- and concept-based Spanish language learning;
● Develop learners' proficiency and confidence in listening, speaking, reading and writing through authentic texts, contexts and experiences;
● Collaborate with colleagues to develop interdisciplinary and innovative learning experiences;
● Prepare learners for MYP and DP assessments, including oral and written components;
● Differentiate learning to respond to varied levels of language proficiency, strengths and learning needs;
● Foster learner agency, voice and ownership, using assessment and feedback to guide progress;
● Build positive relationships and create an inclusive classroom culture that promotes wellbeing and belonging;
● Use digital tools and a Learning Management System effectively to support learning, organisation and collaboration;
● Guide learners to engage with AI critically, ethically and responsibly, using it purposefully to complement their learning;
● Contribute to the pastoral and wider life of the Upper School, including serving as a student advisor and participating in beyond-the-classroom and community activities;
● Collaborate, reflect and contribute actively to your own and the team's professional growth.

We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from people whose identities and experiences are under-represented in international education.
ISL is committed to safeguarding and prioritising the wellbeing of children and young people and expects all staff to share this commitment.
What will you bring?

Essential:
● A recognised teaching qualification and relevant university degree (MA preferred);
● High-level proficiency in Spanish appropriate for teaching Language B;
● Experience teaching Spanish as an additional/acquired language at secondary level;
● Strong skills in inquiry-based, student-centred and differentiated teaching;
● The ability to create inclusive learning experiences for multilingual learners with diverse strengths and needs;
● Strong communication, collaboration and relationship-building skills;
● A reflective, culturally responsive and internationally minded approach to teaching and learning;
● A commitment to safeguarding, student wellbeing and belonging.

Valued Experience:
● Experience teaching IB MYP Language Acquisition and/or DP Spanish Language B;
● Experience preparing students for IB assessments;
● Experience teaching within an international and multilingual school community;
● Experience integrating educational technology and AI thoughtfully into language learning;
● Contributions to advisory, pastoral, co-curricular or beyond-the-classroom programmes.

    Fähig eine ruhige und vertrauenswürdige Ausdrucksweise am Telefon zu haben

In der Taxizentrale kann es zu Zeiten mit hohem Arbeitsaufkommen kommen, in denen mehrere Ereignisse gleichzeitig eintreten – beispielsweise mehrere Anrufe in der Warteschleife, ein verspäteter Fahrer, eine dringende Buchung, ein unzufriedener Kunde und eine Fahrt, für die umgehend eine Lösung gefunden werden muss.

jobs.title: Regulatory Transaction Reporting Officer (m/f)
jobs.description:
Regulatory Transaction Reporting Officer

Description du poste

Intitulé du poste  Regulatory Transaction Reporting Officer
Type de contrat  CDI
Temps de travail  Temps plein
Référence 2026-1257  

Activités / Missions

A la Banque de Luxembourg, nous servons trois types de clients : les clients privés, les clients entreprises de type familial et les clients professionnels issus des métiers de la gestion d'actifs. Certifiée B Corp depuis 2023, notre Banque s'engage à renforcer l'impact social, sociétal et environnemental de ses activités.

Le service « Regulatory Transaction Reporting » offre une vue globale et transverse sur l'ensemble des flux transactionnels de la banque. Son rôle est d'assurer la bonne réalisation des reportings règlementaires, notamment EMIR, MIFIR, CDDP, PST, relatifs aux transactions titres et cash réalisés pour nos clients.

Vos missions

Au sein de cette équipe, vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :

• Production et conformité : Contribuer à la transmission dans les délais des rapports réglementaires aux différentes autorités luxembourgeoises et étrangères (CSSF, BCL, CFTC, ICE, etc.), avec l'objectif de prendre l'entière autonomie sur ces transmissions à moyen terme.
• Gestion des anomalies/incidents : Analyser et corriger les erreurs, rejets, ou retours de manière proactive et dans les délais légaux.
• Data Management : Assurer la collecte, le formatage et le rapprochement de volumes importants de données financières complexes, avec une forte capacité à faire interagir des fichiers aux formats hétérogènes.
• Interface Régulateurs : En lien avec l'équipe, agir en tant que point de contact face aux autorités de contrôle des marchés financiers (BCL, CSSF, etc.) et gérer ces interactions institutionnelles avec professionnalisme.
• Projets & Évolutions : Participer activement à l'adaptation des flux ''reporting'' en collaboration avec l'équipe Projet et les différents services du département afin d'être en phase avec les diverses évolutions aussi bien réglementaires, internes que de la part des différents services providers

Profil

Ce poste est idéal pour un.e titulaire d'un Master en Finance, doté.e d'une excellente connaissance des instruments financiers, fort.e d'une première expérience d'1 à 3 ans en reportings réglementaires transactionnels, et désireux.se d'acquérir une vision transversale unique des activités d'une salle de marchés ainsi que des flux financiers.

Vos atouts pour réussir :

• Excellente compréhension des instruments financiers
• Bonne compréhension de la chaine de valeur transactionnelle au sein d'une banque.
• Connaissance des reportings règlementaires transactionnels, notamment EMIR et/ou MIFIR et/ou PST et/ou CDDP, …
• A l'aise avec les données, vous êtes capable d'en gérer massivement avec desoutils comme Excel et via l'usage de format tel que le XML, CSV, et autre.
• Vous avez un appétit pour participer à des projets, l'optimisation des processus et l'intégration de nouvelles solutions technologiques.
• Vous êtes rigoureux.se et organisé.e.
• Vous savez gérer la pression engendrée par la gestion des deadlines.
• Curieux.se et ouvert.e d'esprit vous êtes volontaire et prêt à monter en compétences sur des nouvelles missions en fonction des actualités de l'équipe.
• Enfin, vous pratiquez couramment le français et l'anglais.

Convaincu·es que notre diversité fait notre force, nous sommes signataires de la Charte de la Diversité, Lëtzebuerg. Attentifs à l'égalité des chances, nous nous engageons à travers des actions concrètes, notamment en faveur des jeunes talents, des femmes, des collaborateurs seniors…

Vous souhaitez …

• rejoindre des équipes composées de femmes et d'hommes d'horizons multiples, aux parcours et compétences complémentaires ;
• vous développer dans un cadre de travail respectant l'équilibre vie privée-vie professionnelle ;
• évoluer dans un environnement propice à l'épanouissement de tous les talents…

jobs.description:
Supply Chain Analyst, Supply Chain Operations
Job ID: 10553338 | Amazon EU Sarl - A84

Description

Amazon Supply Chain forms the backbone of the fastest growing ecommerce business in the world. The sheer growth of the business and the company's mission "to be Earth's most customer-centric company” makes the customer fulfilment business bigger and more complex with each passing year.

Our Supply Chain team is responsible for planning and executing the network for our UK fulfilment business. We work closely with Amazon's Fulfillment Centers (FCs), Transportation, Retail and Finance teams, orchestrating the upstream and downstream partners to exceed customer expectations while optimizing end-to-end supply chain speed and cost.

We are looking for an analytical and driven Supply Chain Analyst to join our team. In this role, a S&OP Supply Chain Analyst will seek out problems, dive deep into data, earn trust of partner teams, and deliver results that can have a large scale influence. This role is a blend of short term execution and long term strategic planning, that requires quick decision-making, with incomplete data, while also thinking big and influencing the long term direction of the network.
You will be responsible for driving EU level strategic projects and change initiatives in collaboration with multiple stakeholders and in alignment with senior management. You will also work on key analytical projects to drive smarter and optimal decisions within the team.
The end goal of this role is to answer the question of how we can fulfill more products to our customers in a safer, faster, more efficient, and more cost-effective manner.

Key job responsibilities

- Make sound business judgments to drive both tactical as well as strategic improvements
- Own programmatic execution and the detailed and strategic levels
- Identify, prioritize, and implement processes to eliminate defects in the supply chain
- Create, develop, and drive solutions that lead to a richer end to end customer experience
- Successfully operate and influence in a cross-functional capacity

About the team

Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team which handles more than 1.5 million orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we're always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range – delivered quickly and affordably.

Our centres are sometimes referred to as the ‘First Mile' because it's where most Amazon packages start their journey. We help to manage dynamic inventory and facilitate speedy deliveries round the clock.

Lots of different people work in our Fulfilment Centres, so there are plenty of opportunities for every skillset. Some of us work with physical products, while others analyse data to help everyone across the business make smart decisions.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in business or a related field
- Experience working in supply chain, transportation, project management or management consulting
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Knowledge of SQL

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in engineering, management, or technology, or Master's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
- Experience with planning, performance metrics, and process improvement
- Experience using data analysis to drive business decisions
- Experience building and growing relationships with internal and external partners
- Experience communicating complex concepts clearly and persuasively to different audiences

Job ID: 10553049 | Amazon Europe Core Sarl

Description

Amazon's Employee Experience & Outcomes (EXO) organization exists to earn, drive, deliver and protect the trust between Amazon and its 1.5M+ workforce. Within EXO, the Research, Strategy & Solutions Team is EXO's center of excellence for employee relations research, intelligence, proactive strategies/consulting and solutions. We are seeking a HR Specialist to join our team as an individual contributor reporting to the Research, Strategy and Solutions Leader.

In this role, you will assess data, workplace dynamics, behaviors, external trends, and relationships to identify risks and gaps in the work environment, and translate those insights into sustainable, scalable initiatives, mechanisms, and programs that drive long-lasting change at all levels. You will influence leaders to gain alignment and support, and work cross-functionally and globally to design and execute large-scale proactive strategies.

This is a research-forward role: the emphasis is on data-driven analysis, strategic foresight, and forward-looking trend intelligence rather than reactive ER issues management or investigations. Success requires deep employee and labor relations expertise, strong analytical and research skills, sound judgment, and the ability to communicate complex findings clearly and persuasively.

Key job responsibilities

Research & Trend Intelligence

• Design and maintain ongoing workforce research and trend-monitoring frameworks that detect emerging labor market shifts, geopolitical signals, and employee sentiment patterns
• Conduct competitive benchmarking to identify best practices and emerging risks
• Develop predictive risk models to anticipate ER challenges before they escalate
• Produce research outputs that inform strategic decision-making

Risk Detection and Mitigation

• Apply employee and labor relations expertise to successfully identify trends and challenges, predict and mitigate risk, and develop and execute solution-focused strategies and programs
• Synthesize workforce data, labor-market intelligence, and employee sentiment to surface emerging risks and opportunities

Data Analysis & Strategic Insights

• Exercise strong analytical skills using data and anecdotes to develop persuasive narratives and recommendations
• Define and measure success of programs through clear KPIs and research-backed evaluation frameworks

Cross-Functional Leadership & Partnership

• Partner with cross-functional teams including Internal Communications, Public Policy, Public Relations, Legal, Human Resources, and Operations to develop and implement comprehensive strategies that align with organizational priorities
• Lead research initiatives that inform policy decisions and public-facing communications

Program & Project Delivery at Scale

• Independently design, own, and lead successfully large-scale, network-wide projects that improve frontline employee experience
• Translate research findings into scalable mechanisms and programs for entire networks
• Lead the design and implementation with cross functional partners (e.g., Ops Tech) of tech solutions aiming at managing employee relations

Communication & Executive Influence

• Present research findings and strategic recommendations to senior leadership with clarity and impact
• Build constructive relationships with critical stakeholders and peers to share information, influence change, and leverage resources to deliver results

Problem-Solving & Ambiguity Management

We are open to hiring this role out of a corporate location from the following countries: Luxembourg, UK/IE, France, Germany, Italy, Spain.

About the team

Our team is committed to building an inclusive workplace where every employee can do their best work. We partner closely with business leaders to deliver people programs that support Amazon's long-term goals, and we pride ourselves on tackling tough problems with creativity and rigor. As we continue to grow, we are focused on scaling our processes and raising the bar on the employee experience. If you want to be part of a collaborative group that values trust, candid feedback, and continuous improvement, we would love to hear from you.

- Experience in employee relations, labor relations, human relations or labor/employment law
- Experience as an HR specialist, HR generalist (e.g., HR Business Partner or HR Partner), HR manager, or in HR program roles

jobs.description:
EU Third Party Logistics Procurement Specialist, External Fulfilment, EU
Job ID: 10551585 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Are you ready to shape how Amazon partners with third-party logistics (3PL) providers across Europe? As a Procurement Specialist on the 3PL Category Procurement team, you will play a key role in sourcing the services and equipment that keep our fulfillment network running. You will drive sourcing initiatives from initial request through contract negotiation, build commercial relationships with suppliers, and use business intelligence and data analytics to turn operational data into actionable insights.

In this role, you will support Senior Category Managers while managing your own sourcing projects across cross-functional teams. You will negotiate contracts, track supplier performance, and identify cost-saving opportunities, all while collaborating with Operations, Finance, Data Engineering, and other partner teams to execute category strategies that deliver real results for the business.

Key job responsibilities
Strategic Sourcing & Commercial Management

- Lead end-to-end sourcing initiatives (from RFI to contract award), partnering with cross-functional teams and driving category roadmap decisions with senior leadership
- Manage commercial relationships with suppliers, with a focus on achieving optimal cost and performance
- Negotiate costs, contracts, and key commercial terms, ensuring compliance with Amazon standards, policies, and regulations
- Support supplier performance management

Strategy Deployment & Process Improvement

- Coordinate with operational teams to deploy and manage the implementation of sourcing strategies
- Drive innovation in tools and processes to streamline execution and improve sourcing efficiency

Data Analytics & Reporting

- Design, maintain, and improve dashboards and reporting tools (e.g. QuickSight, Excel models) to track procurement KPIs, supplier performance, and cost evolution
- Translate operational and commercial data into actionable insights for tender evaluations, contract renewals, and strategic sourcing decisions
- Partner with Data Engineering and Finance teams to ensure data integrity, automate recurring reports, and reduce manual data handling
- Support the development of self-service analytics capabilities to enable the broader EF Procurement team to make data-driven decisions independently

A day in the life

You will split your time between collaborative work and focused analysis. On a given day, you might join a sourcing review with Operations stakeholders in the morning, then spend the afternoon building a cost comparison model or preparing a supplier negotiation brief. You will regularly connect with Senior Category Managers for guidance on strategy, while independently managing your own sourcing projects and supplier relationships. Expect a proactive, roadmap-driven rhythm where you gather business needs, shape sourcing strategies, and coordinate with 3PL providers to deliver on time.

About the team

Our team serves as a single point of contact for procurement support across Amazon's Customer Fulfillment network. We are part of the Global Procurement Organization and work closely with Network Planning, Supply Chain, Operations, Finance, Legal, and other partner teams to source the services and capacity our business needs.

We are focused on finding ways to move faster and more efficiently, and we value collaboration, curiosity, and a willingness to improve how we work. jobs.title: Head of After-Market Services Returns & Remedies, EU FBA (m/f)
jobs.description:
Head of After-Market Services Returns & Remedies, EU FBA
Job ID: 10544483 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Over the past 20 years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of consumers and become one of the world's largest internet retailers, with more than 152 million active customer accounts, over 2 million active seller accounts, and $500 billion in global revenue. Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) delivered more than seven billion units on behalf of sellers in 2024, with sellers from over 130 countries fulfilling orders to customers in 185 countries.

The Opportunity:

Customer Returns sit at the intersection of customer satisfaction, seller profitability, and FBA growth. In 2025, 581 million FBA units were returned worldwide, incurring significant cost to Amazon and sellers. Beyond the financial impact, unnecessary returns generate significant waste; preventing them is one of the most tangible ways to improve sustainability outcomes while strengthening seller economics.

The Role:

As Head of After-Market Services Returns & Remedies, EU FBA, you will lead a team of Product Management managers to build and execute the strategic EU FBA After-Market-Service Customer Returns that prevent returns that do not need to happen, enhancing the customer experience in any purchase at Amazon and the seller experience in any sales at Amazon — at EU and worldwide scale.

Location: Flexible within EU FBA footprint. Preferably Luxembourg, Paris.

Key job responsibilities

- Own the product strategy and roadmap for one or more Return Prevention products, from BRD (Business Requirements Document) through spec through launch, working hand-in-hand with engineering and worldwide product and tech teams to build scalable solutions
- Envision, Influence and Drive the future of Customer Experience and Seller Experience on Returns & Remedies with AI-native solutions across EU marketplaces
- Drive adoption at scale by partnering across Go-to-Market, Account Management, and Seller Experience to convert proven products into default seller behaviors
- Operate across VP-level organizations - including WW Returns & Recommerce, WW FBA, Operations & Reverse Logistics, Finance, and Customer Experience - gaining broad exposure to Amazon's post-purchase ecosystem
- Influence globally - several products carry worldwide scope, giving you direct impact beyond EU.

As the portfolio matures, this role offers a natural path toward expanded product, technical, and geographical scope.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in product marketing, program management, or business development
- Experience hiring and leading a high-performance team

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree or above in business, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics or related field

Description

Amazon builds fast-and behind every new Fulfillment Center, Sortation Center, Delivery Station, and capital investment is a critical question: **Are we buying the right solution at the right price?** We're looking for a **Cost & Value Engineering Manager** to partner with Amazon's North America Design & Construction stakeholders, delivering construction cost engineering and value engineering services that optimize design, validate costs, and inform capital investment decisions across Amazon's infrastructure network.

This role is high-impact, high-variety, and technically demanding. You'll develop bottom-up cost estimates, should-cost models, and Value Engineering analyses across a diverse portfolio of building types, material handling equipment (MHE), automation, and capital projects. From multi-site retrofit programs to complex, one-off initiatives, you'll evaluate design alternatives, optimize specifications, identify cost drivers, and produce defensible cost models that shape sourcing, design, and investment decisions. Working from early concepts through bid-ready construction documents, you'll apply technical expertise to balance cost, quality, performance, and operational requirements.

As part of Amazon's Global Procurement Organization within the Sourcing Excellence pillar, you'll partner closely with Engineering, Design, Construction, Procurement, and Category teams to ensure Amazon is buying the right solution at the right price. You'll also collaborate with AI and Market Intelligence Solutions, leveraging AI-powered tools to accelerate analysis, develop scalable cost intelligence, and advance next-generation automation that expands the reach and impact of Cost & Value Engineering across Amazon.

Key job responsibilities

Deliver independent, bottom-up cost estimates for construction, equipment, and capital investment projects across Amazon's global portfolio, spanning retrofit, expansion, new-build, automation, and equipment deployment initiatives.
Develop cost estimates from early-stage concepts through supplier selection and implementation, adapting methodologies and analytical depth to available project information and design maturity.
Build and maintain scalable estimating models and templates while developing detailed bottom-up cost models for complex, site-specific initiatives requiring advanced analytical judgment.
Perform should-cost modeling, benchmarking, and Value Engineering analyses to evaluate design alternatives, optimize specifications, identify cost drivers, and ensure Amazon is buying the right solution at the right price.
Leverage AI-powered tools to automate data gathering, cost modeling, benchmarking, and pattern recognition while applying engineering judgment to validate outputs and resolve complex or ambiguous scopes.
Drive the development of scalable AI-enabled cost intelligence solutions by curating project and market data, validating model performance, and identifying opportunities to automate routine analytical activities.
Partner with Engineering, Design, Construction, Procurement, Category Management, and business stakeholders to validate assumptions, communicate cost risks, evaluate alternatives, and influence sourcing and investment decisions.
Peer review cost models, estimates, and Value Engineering recommendations to ensure technical rigor, consistency, and alignment with current market conditions and best practices.

About the team

The Sourcing Excellence team helps Amazon answer two fundamental questions: **Are we buying the right product?** (Value Engineering) and **Are we paying the right price?** (Cost Engineering). **Value Engineering** ensures Amazon is investing in the right construction solutions, equipment, and technologies by optimizing specifications, design, materials, and performance to maximize business value while meeting operational requirements. **Cost Engineering** establishes cost transparency and price confidence through bottom-up cost estimation, should-cost modeling, benchmarking, market intelligence, and cost driver analysis to determine what construction projects, equipment, and services should cost.

Together, these disciplines provide transparent, fact-based insights that enable informed sourcing, design, and investment decisions throughout the project lifecycle. Our vision is to make cost and value transparency a strategic capability across the organization, ensuring every investment delivers the optimal balance of cost, quality, performance, and operational requirements. Today, the team supports billions of dollars in managed spend across construction, material handling equipment, automation, and other strategic sourcing categories, and continues to scale its impact through AI-enabled solutions, standardized mechanisms, and cross-functional partnerships.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Instore Experience (ISX), Reverse Logistic Services (RLS) (m/f)
jobs.description:
Program Manager, Instore Experience (ISX), Reverse Logistic Services (RLS)
Job ID: 10541583 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Reverse Logistics Services (RLS) exists to make returns effortless and reliable for every Amazon customer — no matter which store or partner they walk into. In France, we deliver that experience across more than 15,000 partner and carrier locations, through convenience-led options such as Label-Free, Box-Free (LFBF) drop-off and every other way a customer can return an item in-store.

The ISX Regional Program Manager, France owns the quality and consistency of that experience across the whole French network. Because returns run through thousands of independent partner sites, the experience can vary widely from one location to the next and the core of this role is closing that gap. You will get into the field, see how returns actually happen at partner locations, coach partners and their teams to the standard customers expect, and use data to focus your time on the sites that need help most. Your mission is holistic: improving in-store returns execution across all return types, so a customer's experience is just as good at the busiest location as it is at the smallest.

This is not only a field-execution role. It carries a strategic remit that reflects its level. Beyond coaching individual sites, you will help design and deploy the network-wide improvements that lift the entire France network at once: in-store signage and wayfinding, store supplies and replenishment mechanisms, associate support and training, and the tools partners rely on to process returns. You will translate what you learn in the field into scalable programs, work across internal teams to launch them in France, and help shape how the broader EU standards themselves are built, turning local, on-the-ground insight into lasting structural improvement.

This is also a founding, build-from-scratch role. You'll be the first ISX Program Manager for France and one of the earliest members of the EU field team, reporting directly to the EU ISX Senior Manager. There's no established playbook yet, you'll help create it. We're looking for someone with real ambition, comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to focus relentlessly on the initiatives that matter most while the team, tools, and standards are still taking shape.

Key job responsibilities

• Own the in-store returns experience in France across ~17,000 partner and carrier locations, ensuring returns are fast, easy, and reliable for customers across all return types.
• Get into the field and coach. Visit partner locations, observe how returns are handled, and coach partner teams to Amazon's standards for speed, accuracy, and customer experience.
• Use data to prioritize. You can't be everywhere. Use performance data to identify the locations and partners falling furthest behind and concentrate your effort where it improves the customer experience most.
• Drive measurable improvement on the metrics that define a great returns experience: how fast customers are served, how reliably returns are processed, customer satisfaction, and site readiness.
• Deploy network-wide improvements. Lead the rollout of scalable programs that raise the standard across the entire Italian network, including in-store signage and wayfinding, store supplies and replenishment, associate support and training, and returns-processing tools , using your field insight to prioritize and adapt them for the market.
• Shape strategy from the field. Turn on-the-ground observations into recommendations that influence how EU-wide returns standards, mechanisms, and programs are designed, ensuring the field perspective is built in from the start.
• Manage performance to resolution. Follow a structured coaching and follow-up cycle for underperforming sites, and partner with the right internal teams (Business Partnerships for retail partners, the Transportation team for carriers) when issues need to be escalated to a partner's leadership.
• Build the foundation. As a founding team member, help shape how the EU field team audits, coaches, and reports, adapting proven practices from the North America team to the French market and feed your field insights into the monthly ISX reporting that informs strategy.

A day in the life

You start the week by reviewing performance data for France and identifying the partner locations and carriers falling furthest behind on the customer experience. You spend time in the field visiting a risk-weighted set of those sites, watching real customers complete returns, checking that the process is running smoothly, and coaching partner teams on the spot. Back at your desk, you're also driving the French rollout of a new signage standard and a store-supplies replenishment mechanism, using what you saw in the field to shape how they're deployed. You log your findings, build improvement plans for the sites that need them, escalate the bigger systemic issues to the right internal team, and close the week by capturing insights for the monthly ISX report and re-planning around wherever the customer experience needs you most.

About the team

Reverse Logistics Services (RLS) owns the returns journey end-to-end for Amazon, everything that happens after a customer decides to send something back until delivery at our FC. Our purpose is simple but hard: make returns effortless and reliable for every customer, while running one of the largest, most complex reverse-logistics networks in retail.

Within RLS, the In-Store Experience (ISX) team focuses on where returns meet the real world, the thousands of partner and carrier locations customers walk into to drop off an item. We turn a single promise into a consistent reality across every one of them: fast, easy, dependable returns, no matter which door a customer chooses. Working from the field, we close the gap between the best and worst locations, coach partners to a standard customers can count on, and build the mechanisms that lift the whole network at once.

Our culture is hands-on, data-driven, and high-ownership. We obsess over the customer, thrive in ambiguity, dive deep into the details on the ground, and think big about how to scale what works - because the best decisions about in-store returns are made by people who've seen them happen firsthand.

The Sr. Program manager role will challenge you to push boundaries and lead transformative innovation while having the autonomy to make rapid data-driven decisions and invent on behalf of Operators (leaders) and Associates. In this role, you will work cross-functionally with members from various teams, including Operations; Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT); Amazon Robotics (AR); Inbound Supply Chain; Launch; Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP); Capacity Planning; Finance and others to deploy solutions at scale.

Job ID: 10538609 | Amazon External Fulfillment Services Europe SARL

Description

Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you'll fit right in here at Amazon Robotics. We are a smart team of doers that work passionately to apply the latest advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers' experiences in ways we can't even imagine yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are Amazon Robotics and we will give you the tools and guidance you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun.

Our diverse teams come from all over the world to design, test and build our dynamic fleet of robots, mechatronic systems and pack automation solutions. Having our offices, labs, test floors and factories all co-located means that we can design the hardware, write the code, test, build and watch it all come to life. This allows us to innovate quickly and on limitless ideas. Current advancements are underway in autonomous movement and mobility, artificial intelligence and machine learning, manipulation, simulation, robotic management software, predictive analytics, and much more.

We are seeking Robotics Supply Chain New Product Lead - Tech tackle to most critical, technologically advanced products at Amazon. The Lead will be responsible for a small portfolio of robotic products and accountable for supplier and supply chain strategies, product cost roadmaps, enabling rapid NPI builds, and ensuring a successful ramp to mass production. They manage their products from concept, through development, to scaled deployment. They work with senior product and engineering leaders to drive appropriate trade-offs between commercial vs. technical constraints, risks and goals. Within the robotic product they lead, they must be able to drive the multiple advanced technologies and commodities, driving a clear path to production.

Essential to the role is a level of technical subject matter expertise to work effectively with the technical teams developing these robotic products. While it varies by group, this expertise includes an understanding of the technologies and architectures of the robotic products and key commodities that make up the robotic products, including the technology's development and integration strategy and trajectory, both within Amazon and its wider position in the business and industry. This role will contribute to technical strategies and decisions, with contributions that balance technical and business requirements, to help drive engineering teams toward scalable products that achieve Amazon's cost targets.

Alternate Job location - ANR10 (Hamme) can be considered for this role

Key job responsibilities

The RSC New Product Lead - Tech is a trusted subject matter expert, consulted by teams above and below. They clearly communicate with direct and indirect stakeholders, advocating for commercial opportunities at the Director level and above. They contribute to strategic documents for aligning goals with cross-functional teams, own reporting on forecasting and planning the business impact of each opportunity, and regularly report on the status and impact of their contributions. Their impact is measurable via quantifiable metrics, and they have the ability to deeply influence measurable business outcomes.

- Lead Product Development Process working cross-functional supply chain team dedicated to the supplier, supply chain design, sourcing, logistics decisions, and supply chain execution for robotics products from concept, through development, to scaled deployment.
- Act as single point of contact for program resources (leadership and working teams) to communicate Supply Chain decisions and progress, provide feedback on supply chain implications of program decisions and changes, and support financial planning and capital approvals for the program.
- Work with Robotics leadership to ensure partnership between Robotics Supply Chain, hardware engineering, operations and program teams on commodity and supplier selection, cost performance tradeoff analysis, cost road map development and execution, and enabling rapid product development stages, and delivering an effective path to scaled deployment.
- Responsible for definition and approval of the Product level Supply Chain Strategy documents, including identification of critical components and suppliers, product cost roadmap to meet payback targets, definition of capacity plan and associated sourcing and tooling requirements, supply chain risk assessment & mitigation plans.
- Work with sourcing in developing negotiation strategies for categories which impacts the product to deliver against business objectives and achieve sustainable relationships with strategic suppliers pertaining to Amazon Robotics products supporting the priority programs as driven by the Operating Plan (OP)
- Work with GCMs on managing overall supplier relationships including supplier performance, capability development, capacity planning, contracting, risk mitigation, and cost and quality improvements.
- Develop roadmap to achieving total cost targets (TCO), including make vs. buy analysis and value engineering opportunities
- Ensure non-cost goals (Sustainability, Supplier Development, Cost Savings) are met and supported by the product specific supply chain strategy.
- Travel internationally across Europe for around 20-25% of the time.

A day in the life

The NPI STL orchestrates new product introduction across Amazon Robotics' supply chain.
A typical day involves leading PDP gate reviews, aligning DfX requirements with engineering teams, and driving supply chain readiness for hardware programs. Internal stakeholders include mechanical/electrical engineers, sourcing managers, manufacturing partners, and program managers. Customers are the robotics product lines launching new systems. The role solves problems at the intersection of design and supply — ensuring parts are sourceable, manufacturable, and available on time. Expect cross-functional stand-ups, supplier escalations, regionalization strategy sessions, and risk reviews tracking critical path components to production milestones.

About the team

The Amazon Robotics Supply Chain team provides strategic sourcing for a portfolio of robotic technologies and is responsible for delivering new products by enabling the right suppliers and technologies, and getting the right materials at the right cost to the right place at the right time to support our network of global fulfillment and transportation solutions. It is a fast-paced operation that works cross-functionally with teams across Amazon and is driven by data and metrics.

The NPI Supply Chain Product Management team develops supply chain strategies for new Fulfillment Tech and Robotics products from concept to general availability. As the central integration point between technical, commercial, and operational teams, we drive PDP adherence and comprehensive supplier readiness oversight. Our vision establishes scalable, cost-effective solutions leveraging AI-driven insights to exceed performance targets. Our mission encompasses end-to-end strategy development through data-driven decisions, comprehensive make-vs-buy frameworks, regional manufacturing strategies, and cross-functional integration with partner ops teams. We maintain accountability for product cost targets, supplier readiness metrics, and program milestones while optimizing total landed cost and operational efficiency across FTR's portfolio.

jobs.title: Regulatory reporting product manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Regulatory reporting product manager (f/m/d)
Location: Luxembourg, LU
Company: Deutsche Börse Group

Your area of work:

Clearstream Fund Services is seeking an experienced Product Manager to lead the development and delivery of regulatory reporting solutions within the fund industry. The role focuses on key regulations such as PRIIPs, MiFID, SFDR, and the production of factsheets. The ideal candidate will act as the bridge between business and technology, ensuring compliance, accuracy, and timely delivery of data products that meet regulatory requirements.
This position requires detailed domain knowledge of the funds industry and the associated regulatory regimes, strong ability to work autonomously, a good understanding of how managed services operate, fast-decision-making skills, a thinking-outside-the-box approach and strong stakeholder management skills.

Your responsibilities:

• Own the product lifecycle for chosen regulatory reporting solutions: from identifying opportunities, gathering requirements, and writing specifications for IT development, to deployment and operational readiness as a managed service.
• Ensure compliance and accuracy: translate regulatory obligations placed on our clients (e.g. PRIIPs, MiFID, SFDR, AIFMD) into clear product requirements and maintain alignment with evolving rules.
• Bridge between business and IT: facilitate communication between clients, sales, operations, and technical teams to ensure shared understanding of goals and value to be created by our services.
• Enable technical delivery: collaborate with analysts, architects, and developers to design and implement robust data models and reporting solutions.
• Deliver full-stack reporting products: oversee both back-end processes (data ingestion, modeling) and front-end outputs (factsheets, disclosures, dashboards).
• Drive Agile practices: manage backlog, prioritize tasks based on regulatory deadlines and business needs, and contribute to sprint planning and iterative delivery.
• Document and communicate: produce clear requirements, user stories, and presentations of released solutions, and manage proactive communication with management.
• Act autonomously: make informed decisions, manage priorities, and ensure timely delivery without constant supervision.

Your profile:

• Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Business, or a related field.
• 3-6 years of experience in the funds industry, with strong exposure to regulatory reporting regimes (e,g, PRIIPs, MiFID, SFDR, AIFMD).
• Solid understanding of regulatory frameworks and their practical implications for data and reporting.
• Strong grasp of data ecosystems, software building skills and Agile methodologies.
• Knowledge of data quality, lineage, and governance practices.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to work independently and take ownership of decisions.
• Fluent in English; French is a plus.

In case you are selected for an interview, you will be asked to present a case study that will be communicated to you in advance.

Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji.

Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48.
