Wenn Sie einmal nicht mehr weiterwissen, können Sie sich immer auf Ihre Gebietsleitung verlassen, die sie in schwierigen Situationen unterstützt. Sie nehmen sich auch die Zeit den Menschen zuzuhören, sind empathisch und bringen sie vielleicht zum Lachen.

Tunnid toimuvad vaid nädala sees ning algavad enamasti alates kella kolmest pärastlõunal. Töö paindlik graafik ning väike koormus (1-10 tundi nädalas) sobivad väga hästi kooli või teise töö kõrvalt töötamiseks. Omalt poolt pakume: Meie õpetajad töötavad toetavas ja teineteist hoidvas kollektiivis, kus ükski mure ei jää lahendamata. Korraldame õppeaasta jooksul mitmeid koolitusi esile kerkivatel teemadel ning veedame niisama mõnusalt koos aega.
Õpetajal on vabadus kujundada omanäoline tund! Selleks pakume omalt poolt mahukat õppematerjalide ning -laulude kogumikku, kuid lõpuks kujundab iga õpetaja oma tunnid ise. Samuti hüvitame transpordikulud nii isikliku auto kui ühistranspordiga sõites.

Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

We’re looking for a Tech Talent Acquisition to join our People team at Pigment! You’ll be part of a close-knit team of 3 dedicated to Talent Acquisition and a manager, focusing on our R&D department (Engineering, Product) and IT & Security. Together, we aim to build an outstanding candidate journey and attract the brightest talents to help Pigment thrive.

What you'll do
  • Headhunt top talent for our Engineering, Product, IT, and Security teams by understanding needs, sourcing proactively, and reaching out to great profiles.
  • Assess candidates through screening applications and the all hiring process until the onboarding for the roles you own.
  • Deliver an excellent candidate experience, making every interaction meaningful and aligned with our values.
  • Partner with hiring managers / Interviewers, coaching them on best practices and sharing feedback to make hiring smoother and sharper.
  • Own projects that shape our TA strategy: Candidate experience improvements (communication flows, feedback loops, transparency), Interview calibration and training with hiring managers, Employer branding initiatives to strengthen our visibility in the tech ecosystem, etc.
  • Track and share insights by monitoring talent acquisition metrics to celebrate successes and spot areas for improvement.

    • Who you are
  • You already have solid experience in Talent Acquisition within a fast-growing environment, with exposure to Engineering hiring (from Junior to Staff engineer).
  • You bring an entrepreneurial mindset: you enjoy challenges, move fast, and aren’t afraid to get hands-on.
  • You have great communication skills: you connect easily with people, build trust with candidates and colleagues, and know how to pitch with impact.
  • You’re organized and structured, able to lead projects and make the most of productivity tools to juggle priorities.
  • You’re curious and eager to learn, thriving when given autonomy.
  • You’re pragmatic and problem-solving oriented, with an analytical eye to back decisions.
  • You’re fluent in French & English, both spoken and written, as you’ll be working with international candidates daily.

Perhehoidon vastaava sosiaalityöntekijä - sosionomi
jobs.description:
Haemme nuoreen ja virkeään yritykseemme perhehoidosta vastaavaa sosiaalityöntekijä- sosionomia. Kyseessä on kapulanvaihto nykyisen vastuuhenkilömme siirtyessä eläkkeelle. Tiimissä on työkaverina kokenut, perheitä tukeva ja valmentava työntekijä ja pestimme on ainakin aluksi osa-aikainen. Tässä työssä on mahdollista sopia työajoista joustavasti.

Mitkä ovat tärkeimmät työtehtävät?

Yrityksemme rekrytoi, valmentaa ja tukee sijaisperheitä heidän arjessaan. Lisäksi meillä on myös tukiperhetoimintaa. Tehtävässäsi pääset osallistumaan kaikkiin osa-alueisiin. Tämän lisäksi sinulla on vastaavana sosiaalityöntekijänä keskeinen rooli toimintamme kehittämisessä sekä vastaat myös suhteista viranomaisiin ja muihin sidosryhmiin. Meillä pääset siis jättämään oman kädenjälkesi kaikkeen toimintaamme ja kasvamaan kanssamme.

Millainen työpaikka Suomen Perhekodit on?

Yrityksemme missio on auttaa apua tarvitsevia lapsia, yksi lapsi kerrallaan. Tämä tarkoittaa maltillista kasvua ja panostusta laatuun. Olemme täysin suomalaisessa omistuksessa oleva perheyritys ja investoimme henkilökuntaamme etukenossa. Sinua ei odota hallitsematon määrä perheitä ja lapsia, vaan työmäärä pysyy meillä aisoissa. Panostamme perhehoitajiimme ja tarjoamme heille tilanteen vaatiman tarvittavan tuen, eikä aina vain puitesopimuksen määrittämää pienintä mahdollista palvelua. Uskomme, että riittävä tuki auttaa perheitämme jaksamaan ja silloin heille sijoitetut lapsetkin voivat paremmin. Pidämme myös tärkeänä hyvää ja luontevaa yhteistyötä hyvinvointialueiden kanssa. Teemme työtämme lasten etu edellä. Yrityksemme on vielä pieni, mutta meillä on vakaa talous ja hyvät tulevaisuudennäkymät.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Sinulla on sekä sosiaalityöntekijän että sosionomin koulutus ja laillistettu pätevyys. Aikaisempaa kokemusta lastensuojelusta tarvitaan vähintään kahden vuoden ajalta. Arvostamme myös kokemusta perhehoidosta sekä erilaisia lisäkoulutuksia, jotka tukevat tehtävää (esim. työnohjaaja, perheterapeutti, neuropsykiatrinen valmentaja, traumaosaaminen). Tärkeintä on kuitenkin into ja halu jatkuvaan itsensä kehittämiseen ja uuden oppimiseen. Voit olla nuori ja nälkäinen tai pitkän linjan ammattilainen. Inhimillinen, myönteinen ja toisia kunnioittava asenne on vahva toivomus, kuten myös kyky itsenäiseen työskentelyyn. Olet valmis työskentelemään perheiden ja erilaisten verkostojen kanssa. Toivottavasti olet tämän lisäksi myös joustava tiimipeluri ja innostunut yhteisestä kehittämisestä. Puhut ja kirjoitat sujuvaa suomea. Muu kielitaito on plussaa.

Tässä työssä pärjää parhaiten, jos on hyvä mahdollisuus etätyöhön, oma auto käytössä ja ajoittaista joustavuutta työaikojen suhteen. Esim. valmennuksemme on perhekohtainen ja perheiden omat aikataulut vaikuttavat valmennusaikoihin. Myös kotikäynnit perheisiin saattavat joskus ajoittua myöhäiseen iltapäivään/alkuiltaan.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Tarjoamme mielenkiintoisen, monipuolisen ja vastuullisen pestin hyvässä jengissä. Työ on pääosin etätyötä, sisältäen myös live-tapaamisia Etelä-Suomen alueella. Palkkahaarukkamme on 4100-4600 euroa kuukaudessa kokoaikatyöstä, riippuen kokemuksestasi, henkilökohtaisista ominaisuuksistasi ja osaamisestasi. Jatkossa palkkatasoon on mahdollista vaikuttaa myös omilla ja yhteisillä onnistumisilla. Tehtävä on nyt aluksi osa-aikainen, mutta toiminnan kasvaessa on mahdollista siirtyä kokoaikaiseen työhön. Pesti voi halutessasi jatkua osa-aikaisena myös tulevaisuudessa. Meille sopivin työaikaprosentti työsuhteen alussa asettuu 40-60 % väliin. Toimimme tällä hetkellä Uudenmaan ja Päijät-Hämeen alueilla, mutta tulevaisuudessa alueenamme on laajemmin koko Etelä-Suomi.

Miten haen?

Meille saa soittaa tai laittaa viestiä. Voit lähettää vapaamuotoisen hakemuksen ja/tai CV:n. Parhaiten tutustumme tapaamalla.

Soita Kenneth Blomsterille numeroon 050-564 1828 tai laita sähköpostia osoitteeseen kenneth@suomenperhekodit.fi. Paikka voidaan täyttää jo hakuaikana, heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Työn aloitus on viimeistään tammikuussa 2027. Työhön valittavan rikostausta tarkistetaan lain vaatimalla tavalla.

jobs.title: HR Business Partner, EMEA
jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s People team aims to hire, engage, and retain world-class talent to safely build and deploy universally beneficial Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). The HR team, a vital subset of the People team, supports a diverse group of scientists, engineers, and business professionals, with expertise spanning employee relations, immigration, compensation and benefits, learning and development, project management, and more.

About the Role

We’re seeking an HR Business Partner to support our growing teams across EMEA, with a particular focus on France. This role will help build scalable, locally compliant people practices and support strong employee relations as we grow.

You will partner closely with regional People leadership, Legal, Employee Relations, and other People COEs to strengthen our approach to employee relations and employee representation in France. This will include building practical governance, manager practices, and operating processes that are compliant and sustainable as we scale.

Beyond France, this role will serve as a trusted HR partner to managers and teams across EMEA. You will combine strong operational execution with thoughtful business judgment to support performance, organizational health, employee relations, and disciplined people practices at scale.

This role reports into the International HRBP Lead, who owns regional organizational design and workforce planning. You will operate as a key regional execution partner to them, translating strategic direction into consistent delivery, elevating manager capability, and proactively surfacing people risks and themes.

If you're joining us in person, we offer relocation support and follow a hybrid schedule: three days a week in the office, with the option to work from home on Thursdays and Fridays. Our offices are designed for focus and connection, with spaces for both individual work and collaboration.

Your Responsibilities

  • Lead employee-representative work in France: Partner with Legal, Employee Relations, People Operations, and local stakeholders to own and deliver CSE-related processes, including elections, consultations, employee communications, documentation, governance, and effective ongoing operating rhythms.

  • Build sustainable employee relations processes: Help establish clear processes for engaging with employee representatives, preparing for required information and consultation processes, maintaining appropriate documentation, and coordinating inputs from relevant business and People stakeholders.

  • Support managers operating in the French employee relations environment: Equip managers and leaders with practical guidance on working effectively within French employment and employee-representation frameworks, escalating complex matters to Legal or specialist teams as appropriate.

  • Drive strong day-to-day HR execution: Partner with managers across EMEA to support performance management cycles, feedback conversations, organizational changes, and employee relations matters with consistency and care.

  • Be the go-to partner for frontline managers: Provide practical, timely guidance on team health, coaching conversations, policy interpretation, performance management, and manager enablement.

  • Support and operationalize People programs: Help implement and maintain performance, engagement, retention, and employee experience initiatives, ensuring processes are clear, scalable, and well executed across different EMEA jurisdictions.

  • Triage and resolve employee relations issues: Identify issues early, assess risk, recommend appropriate actions, and partner with Employee Relations, Legal, and other COEs on complex or sensitive matters.

  • Maintain operational rigor: Track employee relations themes, maintain complete and accurate documentation, coordinate recurring processes, and ensure actions and commitments are followed through.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with HRBPs, Legal, Employee Relations, People Operations, Total Rewards, and other COEs to provide a consistent and high-quality employee experience across EMEA.

We’re Seeking

  • Strong HR foundation: Approximately 8+ years of HR experience, including meaningful experience partnering directly with managers in fast-paced, high-growth, or complex international environments as a Senior HR Generalist or HR Business Partner.

  • French employee relations experience: Practical experience working with French employment practices and employee representative bodies. Direct experience establishing, supporting, or working closely with a CSE, works council, or comparable employee representative structure is highly valued.

  • Experience with employee representative processes: Familiarity with employee elections, consultation processes, employee representative communications, and the governance and documentation associated with formal employee representation.

  • Execution-oriented partnership: Comfortable owning detailed, time-sensitive workstreams and coordinating across multiple stakeholders while maintaining sound judgment and strong follow-through.

  • Strong project management: Able to take complex, multi-stage employee-representative processes and translate them into clear milestones, owners, dependencies, communications, and operating processes.

  • Manager coaching capability: Able to guide managers through performance conversations, organizational changes, and employee relations issues with clarity and confidence.

  • Operational strength: Brings structure, organization, and discipline to people processes and can build repeatable practices as the organization scales.

  • Good judgment under pressure: Balances empathy, employee experience, business needs, and appropriate risk management while handling sensitive matters with discretion.

  • High integrity: Trusted, fair, principled, and comfortable operating in an environment where confidentiality and sound judgment are essential.

  • Language capability: Professional fluency in French and English is strongly preferred given the role’s responsibility for supporting employee relations and representative processes in France.


About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.title: Head of Financial Controller
jobs.description:
🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

🎯 The Role

As Head of Financial Controller, you will own the full accounting function across Filigran's entities, including revenue recognition, consolidation, monthly and year-end close, and internal controls. You will act as the finance function's technical backbone building the infrastructure, controls, and processes needed to support a fast-scaling, multi-entity, international organization.

You will report directly to the VP of Finance. The team is small so this role demands both strategic ownership and significant hands-on execution.

💼 Your Responsibilities

General Accounting Operations

  • Own the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all financial transactions across Filigran entities

  • Continuously improve a scalable monthly/quarterly close process

  • Ensure revenue recognition is correctly applied and documented

Multi-Entity Oversight

  • Lead consolidation across Filigran's growing international entity structure (including new entity set-ups as the company expands)

  • Partner with the VP of Finance on transfer pricing, inter company transactions, and cross-border compliance matters

Controls, Risk & Governance

  • Perform ongoing gap analyses of accounting processes and proactively design and implement internal controls and policies

  • Manage the yearly financial audit end-to-end, acting as the primary point of contact for auditors

  • Own the relationship with the external accounting firm, holding them to a high standard of accuracy and responsiveness

Systems & Scalability

  • Identify opportunities to automate and streamline accounting workflows

  • Build documentation that make the accounting function auditable and transferable

Leadership & Cross-Functional Support

  • Act as a thought partner to the VP of Finance on technical accounting matters and process design

  • Manage a current team of 3 general accountants.

  • Grow the team to help support scalability and growth.

  • Support ad hoc business requests, including finance topics adjacent to accounting (e.g., payroll coordination)

🔎 Preferred Experience

  • 10+ years in accounting roles, including senior/lead or controller-level experience

  • Strong knowledge of French accounting standards; exposure to multi-GAAP/consolidation environments is a strong plus

  • Proven ability to build processes and internal controls from scratch in a fast-growing or scaling environment

  • Comfortable operating with high autonomy and ambiguity; adapts quickly to change

  • Prior people management experience

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

⭐ Be part of something bigger

We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative.

💻 Work at the edge of what’s next

We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice.

🌍 Global opportunity without borders

Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us.

🧭 A culture grounded in CORE

Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 What you can expect

  • Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success

  • Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate

  • 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work

  • Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you

  • Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve

  • Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture.

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify.

🚀 Ready to Join Us?

Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering at Cebon Industrial
jobs.description:
Would you like to combine strategic leadership with in-depth technical expertise in batteries and energy solutions? Cebon Industrial is now looking for a Head of Engineering to lead and further develop the company’s Engineering function while remaining hands-on in technically complex customer projects.

ABOUT CEBON INDUSTRIAL:

Cebon Industrial is one of four business units within Cebon Group, offering integrated battery cells and customised battery packs for industrial OEM applications across the European market.

The business is undergoing a strategic transformation, with the ambition of evolving from a distributor of customised battery cells into a full-service provider of industrial battery and energy solutions. With local Engineering and assembly expertise in Europe, Cebon Industrial can provide customers with broad, integrated support – from technical advice and development to complete solutions.

The business unit consists of more than 20 specialists and is supported by Cebon Group’s central functions within areas such as regulatory compliance, logistics and quality management.

Cebon Group was founded in Gothenburg in 1986 by three high school entrepreneurs who remain active in the company today. The Group develops and provides safety and energy solutions for both consumer and industrial markets. Its portfolio includes well-known brands such as GP Batteries, Housegard, CGS, Aqiila, Brentz and Sparq.

The Group has approximately 160 employees, annual revenue of around SEK 1 billion and operations across the Nordics, Italy, France, the Benelux region and the DACH region. Its headquarters and largest warehouse are located in Gothenburg, with an additional warehouse in the Netherlands. Cebon combines a strong commercial focus with a family-oriented and entrepreneurial culture.

Learn more at www.cebon.com.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As Head of Engineering – Battery & Energy Solutions, you will be responsible for leading and developing Cebon Industrial’s Engineering function. While the team currently consists of one engineer, you will play a key role in building and expanding the function as the business continues to grow. As the company’s technical expert within battery and energy solutions, you will help shape its technical direction and support its continued growth. The role combines strategic responsibility with hands-on, operational leadership. You will work closely with Sales, Product Management, suppliers and customers across the European Group. As Head of Engineering, you will set the technical direction, develop the team’s ways of working and ensure that customer needs are translated into sustainable, scalable and commercially viable solutions. Monthly travel within Europe is part of the role.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

    Leading and developing the Engineering team, including its priorities and ways of working.
    Defining the technical roadmap and monitoring developments within batteries, BMS, chargers, power electronics and energy storage.
    Leading technical activities in OEM projects, from requirements definition through to implementation.
    Translating customer requirements into system architectures, technical specifications and feasible solutions.
    Supporting the Sales and Product organisations in customer discussions, tenders, product development and supplier selection.
    Driving technical evaluations and make-or-buy decisions.
    Ensuring quality, regulatory compliance and risk management while developing the Engineering function’s processes and tools.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO:

    Has a strong technical background within batteries, battery technologies, power electronics or related industrial energy applications.
    Has experience leading other engineers, either formally or informally, and driving technical projects. You may already have some leadership experience and are eager to grow into a broader leadership role.
    Has worked in a customer-driven organisation or on projects involving OEM customers.
    Has experience translating complex technical requirements into structured and scalable solutions.
    Is confident making decisions in complex environments and comfortable challenging both suppliers and internal stakeholders.
    Communicates fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.

We believe that you combine strong technical expertise with sound commercial understanding and enjoy working closely with customers, Sales and Product Management. You are structured, proactive and accountable, with a natural ability to lead and bring others forward. You are motivated to continue developing your leadership skills and take on broader responsibility over time.

ABOUT THE EMPLOYMENT:

This is a direct recruitment, meaning that you will be employed directly by Cebon Industrial. Cebon is collaborating with Friday on this recruitment process.

OTHER INFORMATION:

    Scope: Full-time.
    Location: Gothenburg.
    Start date: As agreed.
    Recruitment process: An initial interview with Friday, followed by interviews with Cebon.

Apply by clicking the link below. We encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible, as applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. The position may be removed before it has been filled if the process has progressed to the selection and interview stage.

ABOUT FRIDAY:

At Friday, we are passionate about giving you as a tech professional the best possible opportunities in your career. By listening to your ambitions and what motivates you, we match you with companies and opportunities that make you look forward to going to work.

We place great value on ambition and potential and actively promote an inclusive, unbiased recruitment process in which everyone is given the same opportunity to succeed. We have offices in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Malmö, Linköping and Örebro. Every year, we conduct more than 5,000 career meetings and match candidates with organisations ranging from global companies to innovative start-ups.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Millions of people rely on Notion to do their most important work, and protecting that trust is foundational to everything we build.




We’re looking for a hands-on Detection Engineer to build and operate the systems and workflows we use to detect and respond to attacks across Notion’s cloud-native environment. You’ll ship high-signal detections, improve the platform that powers them, participate in incident response, and help shape how detection and response engineering scales at Notion.




You’ll work closely with Engineering, Corporate Security, and Infrastructure, with broad latitude to identify gaps, prioritize investments, and build what’s needed next.




We view detection and response as a software engineering discipline: detections are code, platforms are products, and measurement matters




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Build and tune high-signal detections across cloud, identity, endpoint, and SaaS environments, with review and mentorship from senior teammates as you ramp up.

 - Contribute to the detection platform, including rule lifecycle management, tuning, measurement, and rollout safety.

 - Build tooling and automation that speed up triage, enrichment, investigation, and detection authoring, including LLM-based workflows where useful.

 - Turn threat intelligence and adversary TTPs into detections, telemetry requirements, and response improvements.

 - Take part in investigations, incident response, and postmortems, and help turn what we learn into lasting fixes.

 - Help define and track metrics such as coverage, MTTD, and alert quality.

 - Join a shared on-call rotation for incident response.
   




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - We're hiring across a range of experience levels. If you have some of these skills but not all, we'd still like to hear from you.
   
   - 3+ years of experience in detection engineering, security operations, incident response, threat hunting, or a closely related security or software engineering role.
   
   - Have written or tuned detections that run in production, and care about signal quality and cutting noise.
   
   - Working knowledge of at least one detection or query language (Sigma, KQL, SPL, YARA-L, EQL, or Panther), or strong SQL or Python skills and the drive to learn one quickly.
   
   - An understanding of how attackers operate (for example, MITRE ATT&CK), and the ability to use it to decide what to detect.
   
   - Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure, ideally including identity and access logs.
   
   - Have used SIEM, EDR, or SOAR tools in any size of environment.
   
   - Write clearly in runbooks, design docs, and incident notes, and can own well-scoped projects end to end.
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Have led purple team, blue team, or adversary emulation exercises that improved detections or telemetry.

 - Experience running SIEM, EDR, or SOAR platforms at large scale.

 - Experience building or maintaining detection-as-code workflows (version control, CI, and tests for detections).

 - Experience applying LLMs or agent-style tooling to security workflows.

 - Experience securing AI-enabled systems or endpoint tooling.

 - Kubernetes or container detection experience.

 - Background in threat intelligence, malware analysis, or digital forensics.

 - Contributions to the security community through research, tooling, CTFs, or talks.

 - Experience at a high-growth startup or AI company.

jobs.title: Security Engineer, Detection and Response
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Millions of people rely on Notion to do their most important work, and protecting that trust is foundational to everything we build.


We’re looking for a hands-on Detection Engineer to build and operate the systems and workflows we use to detect and respond to attacks across Notion’s cloud-native environment. You’ll ship high-signal detections, improve the platform that powers them, participate in incident response, and help shape how detection and response engineering scales at Notion.


You’ll work closely with Engineering, Corporate Security, and Infrastructure, with broad latitude to identify gaps, prioritize investments, and build what’s needed next.


We view detection and response as a software engineering discipline: detections are code, platforms are products, and measurement matters




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Build and tune high-signal detections across cloud, identity, endpoint, and SaaS environments, with review and mentorship from senior teammates as you ramp up.

 - Contribute to the detection platform, including rule lifecycle management, tuning, measurement, and rollout safety.

 - Build tooling and automation that speed up triage, enrichment, investigation, and detection authoring, including LLM-based workflows where useful.

 - Turn threat intelligence and adversary TTPs into detections, telemetry requirements, and response improvements.

 - Take part in investigations, incident response, and postmortems, and help turn what we learn into lasting fixes.

 - Help define and track metrics such as coverage, MTTD, and alert quality.

 - Join a shared on-call rotation for incident response.
   


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - We're hiring across a range of experience levels. If you have some of these skills but not all, we'd still like to hear from you.
   
   - 3+ years of experience in detection engineering, security operations, incident response, threat hunting, or a closely related security or software engineering role.
   
   - Have written or tuned detections that run in production, and care about signal quality and cutting noise.
   
   - Working knowledge of at least one detection or query language (Sigma, KQL, SPL, YARA-L, EQL, or Panther), or strong SQL or Python skills and the drive to learn one quickly.
   
   - An understanding of how attackers operate (for example, MITRE ATT&CK), and the ability to use it to decide what to detect.
   
   - Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure, ideally including identity and access logs.
   
   - Have used SIEM, EDR, or SOAR tools in any size of environment.
   
   - Write clearly in runbooks, design docs, and incident notes, and can own well-scoped projects end to end.
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Have led purple team, blue team, or adversary emulation exercises that improved detections or telemetry.

 - Experience running SIEM, EDR, or SOAR platforms at large scale.

 - Experience building or maintaining detection-as-code workflows (version control, CI, and tests for detections).

 - Experience applying LLMs or agent-style tooling to security workflows.

 - Experience securing AI-enabled systems or endpoint tooling.

 - Kubernetes or container detection experience.

 - Background in threat intelligence, malware analysis, or digital forensics.

 - Contributions to the security community through research, tooling, CTFs, or talks.

 - Experience at a high-growth startup or AI company.

jobs.title: Senior Social Legal Counsel - CDD (H/F)
jobs.description:
Pourquoi rejoindre l'aventure Swile ?
 
Depuis son lancement en 2018, Swile a révolutionné le marché des avantages salariés.
En digitalisant la gestion et l’utilisation des avantages, grâce à notre super app, nous avons amélioré l’expérience, afin de la rendre plus simple, plus moderne et plus intuitive.
Swile, c’est aussi une ambition forte : devenir le leader de la worktech, en cherchant à adresser, à termes, via nos produits, toute la sphère de la gestion de la vie au travail.
Nous misons sur l’innovation technologique, un design soigné et une approche RSE rigoureuse, pour contribuer à améliorer le quotidien des travailleurs et des décideurs, tout en dynamisant l'engagement.
Avec plus de 1000 collaborateurs et une présence internationale, notamment au Brésil, Swile a déjà convaincu des millions d’utilisateurs et des milliers d’entreprises.
 
Rejoignez-nous pour bâtir ensemble un monde du travail plus épanouissant.
 
Au cœur de la croissance de Swile, l’équipe Legal intervient de manière transverse sur l’ensemble des sujets clés de l’entreprise. Elle soutient les équipes au quotidien avec une approche à la fois stratégique, pragmatique et business-oriented, afin de sécuriser le développement de l’activité tout en permettant d’aller vite.

💫 Tes futures missions

En tant que Juriste Droit Social, tu joueras un rôle central dans la sécurisation et la fluidité de la gestion RH au quotidien.

Ton rôle consistera à faire du droit social un levier de sécurité, de pragmatisme et d’efficacité opérationnelle pour l’ensemble de nos équipes.
Rattaché.e à la Directrice des Relations Sociales, et en lien avec les équipes opérationnelles, tu seras le garde-fou juridique capable de passer à l'action très rapidement dès que le feu vert est donné.

À ce titre, tu seras notamment en charge de :

  • Gérer et sécuriser les dossiers individuels (contentieux et pré-contentieux) : Piloter de A à Z les procédures disciplinaires, licenciements (pour motif personnel, faute ou insuffisance professionnelle) ainsi que les négociations de sorties (procédures de rupture conventionnelle, protocoles transactionnels) ;

  • Être le partenaire juridique clé des HRBP : Conseiller et accompagner quotidiennement l'équipe RH sur l'ensemble des questions liées à la vie du contrat de travail (embauches, fins de périodes d'essai, congés payés/maternité/paternité, arrêts maladie, etc.) ;

  • Assurer le suivi contractuel : Sécuriser et faire évoluer la documentation contractuelle (promesses d'embauche, contrats de travail, avenants, lettres d'information, mesures disciplinaires) ;

  • Piloter l’activité avec réactivité et proactivité : coordonner un portefeuille varié de demandes et de dossiers, en apportant une réponse adaptée aux sollicitations du quotidien et en conduisant en parallèle une dizaine de dossiers individuels et contentieux complexes à forts enjeux.

  • Appliquer et faire respecter le cadre conventionnel : Assurer la bonne application de la Convention Collective (SYNTEC) et de la réglementation en vigueur sur l'ensemble du périmètre individuel.

    •  

    ✨ Tu te reconnais sur le poste si tu as …

  • Expérience : 5 à 7 ans d'expérience minimum en tant que Juriste en Droit Social, impérativement en entreprise (expérience In-house) ;

  • Expertise technique : Maîtrise solide du droit du travail individuel (contentieux, pré-contentieux, licenciements, transactions) et idéalement une très bonne connaissance de la Convention Collective SYNTEC ;

  • Orienté.e Business & Pragmatique : Capacité à délivrer des conseils sûrs mais réalistes, adaptés aux enjeux du terrain et de la direction RH ;

  • Qualités rédactionnelles : Une excellente plume juridique pour la rédaction rapide et irréprochable des actes, contrats, avenants et courriers disciplinaires ;

  • Organisation & Gestion de volume : Capacité à prioriser, anticiper et traiter un flux important de questions du quotidien tout en faisant avancer des dossiers lourds ;

  • Poste à pourvoir : CDD – Disponibilité immédiate / ASAP.


    • 🔥 Ton futur process de recrutement
    Nous avons un processus de recrutement en 3 étapes : 3 étapes pour te convaincre que Swile est le bon choix pour ta future carrière.
     
    Durant ces étapes, tu seras amené à rencontrer :
  • Charlotte, recruteuse (45min - Visio)
  • Un échange avec ta futur manager : Rachel (1h)
  • Un échange avec deux membres de l'équipe pour évaluer le fit : Véro & Leslie (1h)

Kundens maskinpark omfatter alt fra gamle maskiner med relæstyring til nye produktionsanlæg med PLC, HMI og robotter. jobs.title: Critical Environment CMMS Technician
jobs.description:
Overview

As a Critical Environment CMMS Technician, you will support the operational integrity of Microsoft’s datacenters by managing maintenance systems, coordinating vendors, supporting procurement activities, and ensuring compliance with maintenance and operational standards.

You will serve as the primary owner of the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS), ensuring preventive and corrective maintenance activities are accurately scheduled, tracked, documented, and completed. Working closely with technicians, operations teams, and external vendors, you will help maintain accurate asset data, work orders, purchase orders, maintenance plans, and compliance records.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) team powers the infrastructure behind services such as Azure, Microsoft 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and Bing. Our global portfolio spans more than 400 datacenters across 32 countries, supporting billions of customers and millions of businesses worldwide.

At Microsoft, we embrace a growth mindset, value collaboration, and are committed to empowering every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more.

Responsibilities

    Build, manage, and maintain Planned Preventive Maintenance (PPM) schedules within the CMMS, ensuring alignment with Critical Environment standards.
    Serve as the primary point of contact for CMMS-related support, guidance, and issue resolution.
    Provide training and support to operational teams on CMMS processes, standards, and best practices.
    Ensure consistent CMMS utilization and data management practices across the campus.
    Monitor system performance, data quality, compliance, and maintenance record accuracy.
    Generate and communicate CMMS performance metrics and KPIs to Datacenter management.
    Identify compliance risks, process gaps, and opportunities for operational improvement.
    Analyse maintenance and asset data to identify trends, risks, and optimisation opportunities.
    Develop and maintain maintenance plans and task schedules within the CMMS.
    Manage asset, equipment, location, and inventory records to ensure system accuracy.
    Coordinate procurement activities, including reviewing quotations, creating purchase orders, tracking deliveries, recording receipts, and processing invoices.
    Monitor compliance and operational performance through Power BI dashboards and reporting tools.
    Ensure processes, documentation, and systems remain aligned with current operational standards and requirements.
    Provide administrative support to technicians, including ticket creation, tracking, and system updates.
    Support vendor onboarding activities, ensuring all required documentation and registrations are completed.
    Coordinate and schedule third-party preventive maintenance activities and vendor service visits.
    Maintain a strong focus on safety, security, compliance, and quality while carrying out all responsibilities.
    Embody Microsoft’s culture and values in all aspects of work.

Required Qualifications

    Experience using a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) or similar work order management platform.
    Understanding of maintenance workflows and work order lifecycle management.
    Strong organisational, coordination, and communication skills with high attention to detail.
    Demonstrated commitment to safety, compliance, quality, and accountability.
    Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, mission-critical environment.
    Proactive and collaborative approach with strong stakeholder management skills.
    Experience working with operational processes, documentation, data management, and Microsoft 365 tools.
    Continuous improvement mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

    Experience working in Datacenter Operations, Critical Environments, or other mission-critical facilities.
    Experience coordinating vendors, contractors, and maintenance service providers.
    Experience supporting asset management, inventory management, procurement, or facilities operations.
    High School Diploma, Technical Trade Certification (Electrical, HVAC, Mechanical, Marine Engineering, or similar), or equivalent practical experience.
    Experience in high-availability or critical infrastructure environments such as datacenters, hospitals, manufacturing, pharmaceutical facilities, utilities, oil and gas, or related industries.

Background Check Requirements

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements is required for this role.

This position requires successful completion of the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter.

jobs.title: Selskabskoordinator hos Smag & Slægt
jobs.description:
Selskabskoordinator hos Smag & Slægt

Er du detaljeorienteret, serviceminded og god til at holde mange bolde i luften?

Hos Smag & Slægt søger vi en engageret Selskabskoordinator på fuld tid, som brænder for at skabe den bedste oplevelse for vores gæster – længe før de træder ind ad døren.

Du bliver den gennemgående kontaktperson for vores selskaber og arrangementer. Fra første tilbud til den endelige bekræftelse og opfølgning sikrer du, at alle detaljer er på plads, og at både gæster og kollegaer føler sig i trygge hænder.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Udarbejdelse af tilbud og bekræftelser på selskaber og arrangementer.

  • Opfølgning på eksisterende og kommende selskaber.

  • Håndtering af gæstehenvendelser via mail og kontortelefon.

  • Oversættelse og korrekturlæsning af materiale på engelsk.

  • Daglig administration af vores bookingsystemer

  • Betjening af vagttelefonen

  • Tæt samarbejde med køkken, Front of House og salgsafdelingen for at sikre en gnidningsfri afvikling.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Er struktureret og har sans for detaljen.

  • Har erfaring med administration, booking eller koordinering – gerne fra restaurations-, hotel- eller eventbranchen.

  • Trives med kundekontakt og sætter en ære i at yde en professionel service.

  • Kommunikerer på dansk og har gode engelskkundskaber – både skriftligt og mundtligt.

  • Er fortrolig med IT-systemer og lærer hurtigt nye programmer.

  • Bevarer overblikket, også når tempoet er højt.

Din arbejdsdag

Du får en fast kontorplads, men ikke fast arbejdstid hos Smag & Slægt. Du bliver omdrejningspunktet for koordineringen af vores selskaber og arrangementer. Her håndterer du bookingforespørgsler, udarbejder tilbud, følger op på gæster og sikrer, at alle detaljer er på plads inden afviklingen.

Selvom din primære arbejdsplads er kontoret, skal du forvente at være en synlig del af huset ved større arrangementer. Her hjælper du med koordinering og fungerer som bindeled mellem gæsterne og vores drift, så arrangementerne forløber professionelt og gnidningsfrit.

Det er en stilling for dig, der motiveres af at skabe struktur, tage ansvar og være med til at levere oplevelser, hvor intet er overladt til tilfældighederne.

Arbejdstid og ansættelse

  • Fuldtidsstilling

  • Primær arbejdstid er kl. 12.00–20.00.

  • Fri hver anden weekend.

  • Der må forventes fleksibilitet i forbindelse med større arrangementer, samt deltagelse i vagttelefonordningen efter nærmere aftale.

  • Fast arbejdsplads hos Smag & Slægt.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og alsidig stilling med stor kontaktflade.

  • Et passioneret team med fokus på kvalitet, samarbejde og gæsteoplevelser.

  • En arbejdsplads, hvor ordentlighed, værtskab og gastronomi går hånd i hånd.

  • Mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send din ansøgning og CV til os. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Want to build automotive software where correctness, timing, and safety matter? Join technically demanding projects in ADAS, electrification, and connected vehicles.

You will develop embedded software for systems with complex interactions and strict requirements for performance, reliability, and functional safety. The work is hands-on, with opportunities to influence architecture, design decisions, and technical direction.

Depending on the assignment, you may:

    

develop safety-critical embedded software in C and C++

    

work close to the operating system using RTOS, Linux, or QNX

    

debug and optimize systems with critical timing and resource constraints

    

collaborate with systems engineers, testers, and hardware teams to ensure end-to-end functionality

    

contribute to software architecture, technical decisions, testing, and quality assurance

Many assignments involve AUTOSAR and ASPICE, where traceability, testing, and structured quality processes are integral to development.

To succeed in this role, we expect you to have:

    

several years of experience in embedded software development or automotive software

    

solid knowledge of C and C++

    

a strong understanding of embedded systems and low-level behavior

    

experience working with RTOS, Linux, QNX, or a similar environment

    

the ability to communicate technical tradeoffs and collaborate across software, systems, testing, and hardware disciplines

Preferred qualifications

Experience with AUTOSAR, ASPICE, automotive communication protocols, or tools from Vector is valuable. Knowledge of Rust is also a plus.

Fluency in Swedish is beneficial for some assignments.

You will work on technically challenging assignments that allow you to deepen your expertise, influence technical direction, and continue growing as an engineer. Application

Work with us at Knowit Connectivity, where we develop technically advanced systems within embedded and connected solutions. With us, you will work on complex products alongside experienced engineers on assignments at the forefront of technology.

Knowit is a Nordic consultancy that helps companies, public sector organizations, and businesses succeed in digital transformation. With expertise in software development, AI, cybersecurity, cloud services, digital customer experiences, and management consulting, we create solutions that contribute to a more sustainable and human-centered society.

We are approximately 3,700 employees working across our business areas – Solutions, Experience, Connectivity, Insight, and Products – primarily in the Nordics, as well as in Poland, Serbia, and Germany.

jobs.title: Raw Materials Specialist
jobs.description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

The future is here. At Volvo Group, we are taking the knowledge from building vehicles, automotive systems and creating new technology that will not only make our cities less noisy and polluted, but also change the world of construction forever. If you would like to be part of this change journey, we would like you to join us. Read on…

This is us, your new colleagues

We are part of business controlling at Volvo Trucks Technology and Industrial. We develop and deploy raw material market expertise, tools, methods, and governance. These enable the Volvo Group to secure and enhance its raw material-related performance and thus provide a competitive advantage to its brands.

Our team is globally spread across Asia, Europe and the Americas and is considered a center of excellence on raw material (commodity) markets. As part of our scope today, we cover various materials like flat steel, ferrous castings, forging steel, base metals, precious metals, plastics, rubber, battery materials, energy etc. Our expertise is used to support and ensure Volvo Group’s competitiveness and eventually our customers’ success. Working together in a global team is a great opportunity for some interesting cross-cultural experiences.

What you will do ?

Now, we have an opening and are looking for a person to join our team of commodity market analysts for battery materials & base metals. This position is to be the knowledge center on the raw material market for battery materials and base metals across our major geographies i.e., Europe & Americas primarily but also Asia.  

As part of the job, you will consolidate and use all internal and external business intelligence available to understand the position/influence of different related factors in the commodity market. Based on identified, reliable business intelligence you will provide periodic market forecasts. You will on a regular basis support buyers in negotiation, participate in cost workshops, supply chain activities, and provide contractual guidance to the Volvo Group Purchasing organization. Keeping sustainability in perspective on these commodities, is key. You will contribute as needed to the segment strategies within Trucks Technology and Industrial and you will work closely with the Purchasing team.

In this position you will be part of the raw material business controlling team and report to the head of raw material.  

Who are you ?

We believe it is the right mindset that will make a difference within our organization. We are looking for a person who understands that the key to success is curiosity. A person who is able to look at the bigger picture, as well as go down in details when needed. To be successful in this position you need to have/build solid business acumen together with cross-functional networking agility. Teamwork, collaboration & cross-cultural sensitivity are key to succeed in this position. As we are a global and diverse team, all our meetings and e-mails will be in English, hence you need to be fluent in both speaking and writing in English.  

To be successful in your new role it’d be helpful if you had the following knowledge/experience:

    University/Master’s degree in science, engineering, economics or finance
    Analytical & critical thinking
    Ability to work efficiently independently as well as in a team
    Commodity market knowledge/experience in battery materials/base metals



Are we a perfect match?

We can’t promise you an effortless job, but what we can promise you are some skilled colleagues and truly exciting challenges to work with. You will work in a global environment that provides you with developmental opportunities both professionally and personally. We at Volvo Group want you to prosper and be happy, because when you succeed, we succeed. Together we drive prosperity. We are eager to learn from you and you will get fantastic opportunities to learn and develop with us.

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

jobs.title: Sairaanhoitaja uuteen Keisarinnaan!
jobs.description:
**Sairaanhoitaja, haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa jotain uutta?**

**Nyt on mahdollisuus päästä mukaan heti alusta asti.**

Keisarinnan uusi palvelukoti avaa ovensa, ja etsimme joukkoomme **sairaanhoitajaa**, joka haluaa tehdä merkityksellistä työtä, mutta myös vaikuttaa siihen, millainen työpaikka ja arki meillä rakentuu.

Keisarinnassa tuotetaan **yhteisöllistä asumispalvelua ja ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista ikäihmisille**. Me emme halua vain avata uutta yksikköä – haluamme rakentaa paikan, jossa on hyvä asua, hyvä tehdä töitä ja hyvä tulla kohdatuksi.

**Miksi juuri Keisarinna?**

Koska tässä työssä et astu valmiiseen muottiin.

Uuden yksikön käynnistyessä pääset oikeasti vaikuttamaan siihen, **miten meillä tehdään asioita**. Saat tuoda pöytään omat ideasi, osaamisesi ja persoonasi.

Me haluamme rakentaa työyhteisön, jossa ei tarvitse miettiä:

_"Näin tämä on aina tehty."_

Vaan kysytään:

**"Voisiko tämän tehdä vielä paremmin?"**

Sairaanhoitajana olet tärkeässä roolissa sekä asukkaiden kokonaisvaltaisen hoidon että turvallisen arjen rakentamisessa. Päivissä on vaihtelua, vastuuta, kohtaamisia ja ennen kaikkea mahdollisuuksia tehdä työ omalla ammattitaidollasi näkyväksi.

**Tässä työssä pääset**

- olemaan mukana käynnistämässä täysin uutta palvelukotia

- rakentamaan kanssamme hyvää työyhteisöä alusta asti

- hyödyntämään ja kehittämään omaa sairaanhoitajan osaamistasi

- kohtaamaan ikäihmiset yksilöinä – ei vain asiakkaina

- vaikuttamaan arjen toimintatapoihin ja niiden kehittämiseen

- tekemään työtä, jolla on oikeasti merkitystä.


**Meille hyvä hoitotyö on muutakin kuin suorittamista**

Keisarinnassa asukkaiden elämä ei pysähdy siihen, että he muuttavat palvelukotiin.

Haluamme mahdollistaa **oman näköistä elämää, turvallisuutta, yhteisöllisyyttä ja hyviä hetkiä**. Siksi tarvitsemme hoitajia, joille ihminen tulee ennen rutiinia.

Sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis paketti.

**Riittää, että olet ammattitaitoinen, utelias, vastuullinen ja valmis tekemään yhdessä.**

Arvostamme myös huumoria, hyvää energiaa ja sitä, että uskallat sanoa ääneen omat ajatuksesi.

**Tule tekemään tästä meidän näköisemme Keisarinna.**

Jos kaipaat työltäsi enemmän kuin valmista työvuorolistaa ja tuttua kaavaa, **Keisarinna saattaa olla juuri sinua varten.**

Täällä pääset näkemään oman kädenjälkesi.

**Uusi paikka. Uusi tiimi. Uudet mahdollisuudet.**

Ja ehkä juuri sinä olet yksi niistä ihmisistä, joiden ansiosta Keisarinnasta tulee paikka, jonne on maanantainakin kiva tulla töihin.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Jos olet **sairaanhoitaja** ja haluat olla mukana rakentamassa uutta palvelukotia alusta asti, **lähetä meille hakemuksesi!**

Kerro meille lyhyesti, kuka olet, mitä osaat ja ennen kaikkea:

**Mitä sinä haluaisit tuoda Keisarinnaan?**

**Tule mukaan rakentamaan Keisarinnaa. Meillä on paikka sinulle.**

jobs.title: Aluevastaava
jobs.description:
Aluevastaava Rovaniemelle

Hoivaaco etsii aluevastaavaa Rovaniemelle.

Meille henkilökohtainen apu tarkoittaa sitä, että apu on oikeasti henkilökohtaista. Avustettava tulee kuulluksi, avustaja kohdataan ihmisenä ja kohtaamiselle on aikaa.

Aluevastaavana olet rakentamassa Rovaniemen Hoivaacoa. Aloitamme Rovaniemeltä, mutta myöhemmin toimintaa on mahdollista kasvattaa koko Lapin alueelle.

Mitä työ on?

Tärkein tehtäväsi on kohdata avustettavat ja avustajat henkilökohtaisesti ja kiireettömästi.

Tapaat uusia asiakkaita, tutustut heidän tarpeisiinsa ja kohtaat Hoivaacon keskitetyn rekrytoinnin löytämät avustajaehdokkaat. Olet tuttu paikallinen ihminen, jonka puoleen asiakkaat ja avustajat voivat kääntyä.

Lisäksi rakennat paikallisia verkostoja, teet Hoivaacoa tunnetuksi Rovaniemellä ja kuvaat noin 1–2 lyhyttä videota viikossa. Hoivaaco hoitaa niiden editoinnin ja julkaisemisen.

Me hoidamme taustan, jotta sinulla on aikaa ihmiselle.

Hoivaaco vastaa keskitetysti rekrytoinnista, henkilöstö- ja sopimusasioista, palkanlaskennasta, laskutuksesta, järjestelmistä, hallinnosta ja markkinoinnista.

Joustava työ

Työ alkaa noin 5 tunnista viikossa, ja sitä voi tehdä muun työn ohessa.

Työskentelet pääosin omasta kodistasi käsin ja tapaat avustettavia sekä avustajaehdokkaita tarpeen mukaan. Avustajat työskentelevät avustettavien luona.

Reilu palkkaus

Palkka muodostuu vähintään 300 €/kk takuupalkasta ja alueen toteutuneisiin palvelutunteihin perustuvasta palkkiosta.

Lapissa palkkio on tällä hetkellä noin 1,90 € / toteutunut palvelutunti.

Suuntaa-antavasti:

10 asiakasta noin 830 €/kk, 25 asiakasta noin 2 080 €/kk, 40 asiakasta noin 3 325 €/kk,

50 asiakasta noin 4 160 €/kk

Palkkaus on tarkoituksella rakennettu reiluksi ja kannustavaksi. Haluamme, että aluevastaava hyötyy alueen kasvusta ja että hyvästä työstä maksetaan hyvin.

Miksi Hoivaaco?

Hoivaaco on suomalainen perheyritys. Haluamme tehdä henkilökohtaista apua tavalla, jossa kiireetön kohtaaminen, tuttuus, luottamus ja jatkuvuus ovat osa hyvän palvelun peruslaatua.

Rakennamme uusia laadullisia vaatimuksia henkilökohtaiselle avulle emmekä halua olla kasvoton toimija.

Etsimme ihmistä, joka osaa kuunnella, kohdata ja olla läsnä.

Jos tämä kuulostaa sinulta, kerro meille lyhyesti kuka olet ja miksi tehtävä kiinnostaa.

Hoivaaco – sydämen asialla.

jobs.title: Digitalization Project Manager for Manufacturing

You will work closely with production teams, AM engineers, site management, and global digitalization stakeholders to drive digital transformation initiatives that support production ramp-up and cost optimization. A key part of your role will be developing and executing a local digitalization roadmap while leading the implementation of critical shopfloor systems such as MES and SCADA. Your expertise will help bridge local operational needs with global strategies while building long-term digital capabilities within the manufacturing organization.

How You’ll Make an Impact

    Lead end-to-end digitalization projects, ensuring delivery against budget, schedule, and quality objectives
    Develop and execute a site-specific digitalization roadmap aligned with business priorities and global strategies
    Define project scopes, deliverables, and success metrics in collaboration with engineering teams and key stakeholders
    Monitor project progress, manage risks, and provide clear status reporting to leadership and stakeholders
    Drive the implementation of Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) and SCADA capabilities within the Additive Manufacturing environment
    Analyze manufacturing workflows and implement digitalization, automation, and process improvement opportunities

What You Bring

    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, Manufacturing Technology, or a related technical field
    Significant experience in project management within manufacturing, production, industrial engineering, or industrial digitalization environments
    Proven success in leading digital transformation, process improvement, automation, MES, SCADA, or other shopfloor IT system implementation projects
    Strong technical knowledge of manufacturing processes, smart factory technologies, workflow management, process development, and Lean Manufacturing principles
    Experience in Additive Manufacturing, advanced production technologies, or Industry 4.0 environments considered a strong advantage
    Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, analytical, troubleshooting, and change management skills with the ability to build organizational capabilities and drive business impact

About the Team
Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

Who is Siemens Energy?

The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Data Foundations team ⭐

At Alan, every decision we make about our members' care, contracts and claims is a data decision. The Data Foundations team builds the platform that makes those decisions possible in a safe way.

  • Being part of the Data Foundations team means you’ll build, maintain, and improve the Data Platform used by everyone at Alan.

  • We enable Alan’s data-driven nature and help our colleagues make the most of their data.

  • Partner closely with people across Alan (technical and non-technical) to understand their needs and build data solutions they can trust and use effectively.

  • We own and manage all data-related tools that power Alan.

  • AI is changing the way companies work with data: agents are becoming first-class users of our data warehouse. It opens a world of new usage and exciting features, as well as concerns around security, data quality and governance. We are building the foundations that allow Alan to make the most of this exciting new paradigm.

  • Alan is expanding quickly: we went from 4 to 6 countries this year and we won’t stop there. Our objective is to onboard new countries in weeks, not months. Having strong data foundations is a cornerstone of that expansion, allowing our teams to make sense of a patchwork of insurance systems, regulations and reporting rules.

  • Examples of our missions:

    • improve the developer experience when building and maintaining data pipelines,

    • enable reliable and secure access to our data warehouse for Alaners and AI agents,

    • strengthen security and governance around our data assets,

    • define and implement standard data practices across Alan,

    • maintain and evolve our core data infrastructure to accommodate Alan's international expansion and growing product breadth…

  • Our core tools include Python, Airflow, Snowflake, AWS/GCP, Metabase, Terraform, dbt, and others.

  • Who you'll work with: Data Foundations is a small, high-leverage team inside the Tech Foundations area, whose mission is to enable product crews through world-class infrastructure, developer experience, operational excellence, and built-in security. You'd be joining as one of its core engineers, working daily with the whole Data community at Alan.

🎯 Expected skills and abilities

You would thrive at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

  • Passionate about owning ambitious problems and developing simple solutions for them.

  • 3+ years of experience demonstrating impact in Data positions. We welcome candidates from early-career to highly experienced profiles. You may already have strong expertise in Data Engineering, or be an experienced data or software engineer looking to deepen your specialization in this area.

  • Experience building and operating production data infrastructure: orchestration (Airflow or similar), a cloud data warehouse, infrastructure as code.

  • Experience designing systems, tools or libraries used by other engineers, scientists or analysts.

  • Proficient in Python and SQL. Setting a high standard of rigor and precision for yourself, interested in your craft.

  • Curious about AI and eager to use it thoughtfully to increase your impact.

  • Great listening and communication skills.

  • Humble, kind, collaborative, and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!).

  • Fluent and clear in English, both oral and written (no need to speak French!).

For this role, we are looking to hire within the C0-E level range.

⚙️ Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learning or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

jobs.title: Software Tester & Quality Specialist – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition
jobs.description:
Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. 

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet. 

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.  

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system. 

Right now, we are looking for a Software Tester & Quality Specialist who likes to make a difference! 

Job description: 

As a Software Tester & Quality Specialist in the Quality Management team, you will work closely with developers, business experts, product owners, project managers, test managers, and fellow testers to help ensure the quality of Nordic RCC's systems and services.

We believe quality starts long before testing begins. Therefore, you will be involved early in the development process, helping teams identify risks, clarify requirements, and prepare testing activities before solutions are implemented. We are in the progress of strengthening our processes and “shifting-left” to achieve this target state.

You will contribute throughout the development lifecycle by reviewing acceptance criteria, creating test data, designing and executing tests, supporting business and operators is test decision and execution, and communicating test results and quality concerns. By working closely with both business and development teams, you will help ensure that quality is built into our solutions from the start.

Your key responsibilities are:

  • Work closely with developers, business experts, product owners, project managers, test managers, and fellow testers throughout the development lifecycle.

  • Participate in requirement reviews, refinement sessions, and solution discussions to identify risks, gaps, and testing needs as early as possible.

  • Help ensure that testing considerations are included early in development activities and that quality is addressed before implementation is completed.

  • Review requirements, user stories, and solution designs to identify potential risks, gaps, and ambiguities.

  • Identify dependencies, prerequisites, and test data requirements for testing activities.

  • Create, maintain, and analyse test data to support testing across different systems and environments.

  • Design, maintain, and execute test cases and test scenarios based on business and technical requirements.

  • Perform manual and exploratory testing to verify functionality, usability, integrations, and business processes.

  • Identify, document, and follow up on defects and quality issues in collaboration with development teams and business stakeholders.

  • Support investigation and root cause analysis of defects and recurring quality issues.

  • Contribute test cases, effort estimates, dependencies, and risks as input to test planning activities.

  • Document and communicate test results, findings, and quality concerns to support project and test management reporting.

  • Collaborate with developers and test automation specialists to improve testing practices and automated quality controls.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing methods, test data practices, and quality assurance processes across Nordic RCC.

Proactive position with outstanding attention to detail and excellent communication skills 

On the personal level you have attention to details, good communication and collaboration skills, analytical thinking and problem solving. You are a self-driven and proactive person, responsible, structured and have a strong focus on finding a solution to the problems at hand.

The ideal candidate is expected to have a minimum of 5 years in manual test experience, an education at BA or MA level in computer science or engineering, but experience from a similar role is more important.

Technical skills: 

  • Collaborate with internal and external development teams in the CI/CD process. 

  • Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, etc), tools, processes, and development cycles (SDLC). 

  • Experience with test data creation

  • Good understanding of test automation

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • ISTQB certification or equivalent 

  • Experience with test management tools - Azure DevOps, Jira, etc. 

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements.

Employment conditions 

You will join a team of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently 22 nationalities with more than 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

Your daily workplace will be in our office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We are offering workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance including the possibility for working from home some of your worktime. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

Note: The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note, that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than 1st November 2026. We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system. 

If you have any questions, please contact Håkon Rosenaa Nystad, Manager, Quality Management, hny@nordic-rcc.net.

Der er tale om et forretningsområde i vækst, og du får en central rolle i både den strategiske og kommercielle udvikling af området.

Stillingen er placeret i Kolding, og du refererer direkte til direktøren for området. For den rette kandidat vil stillingen på sigt kunne medføre deltagelse i chefgruppen i Meldgaard-koncernen. 

Om dig
Vi søger en leder, der kan være det stabile omdrejningspunkt i en travl hverdag. Du bevarer overblikket, skaber struktur og sætter en tydelig retning, samtidig med at du bidrager med positiv energi og skaber et arbejdsmiljø, hvor medarbejderne trives og udvikler sig.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra en lignende lederstilling - dog betyder det rigtige mindset mere end tidligere titel 
  • Har stærke kommercielle kompetencer og en veludviklet købmandsmæssig forståelse 
  • Er en dygtig leder, der kan skabe engagement og følgeskab 
  • Trives med ansvar og evner at skabe struktur i komplekse processer 
  • Er resultatorienteret og motiveres af at udvikle forretning

Det er samtidig vigtigt at du:

  • Kan sætte en tydelig retning og sikre opfølgning på mål og aktiviteter 
  • Er stærk i relationer og samarbejde med både kunder, leverandører og kolleger 
  • Har gennemslagskraft og naturlig autoritet 
  • Kan bevare roen og overblikket, også når tempoet er højt 
  • Bidrager aktivt til en positiv kultur og et godt arbejdsmiljø

Hos Meldgaard kan vi tilbyde en spændende og udfordrende stilling med gode løn- og ansættelsesforhold i en velkonsolideret familievirksomhed med over 55 års erfaring. Vores omgangstone er åben og uformel, og der er frihed under ansvar med korte kommandoveje.
