• Proven experience working with regulators and supervisory authorities.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, organisational and reporting skills.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with a collaborative and adaptable mindset.
• Very good command of English and French, both written and spoken. Any additional language is an asset.

About Baloise

We are more than a traditional insurance company: we are the personal partner for everyone who wants to feel simply safe. In addition to our traditional financial business, we are also broadening our range with ecosystems in the areas of mobility and home. We see the digital age as an opportunity to make our offering even more sustainable, innovative and customer-oriented in the future. Are you shaping it with us?

We give you the freedom to pursue your ideas. Get involved! Question us! Develop yourself and us even further! Our culture of learning and making mistakes as well as communication at eye level all make this possible. Because only together can we move forward.

Infirmier diplômé (m/f/d)


Chez quelqu'un à domicile, vous n'êtes pas simplement là pour réaliser un soin. Vous êtes souvent la présence soignante la plus régulière dans leur vie. Un patient qui vous ouvre sa porte vous fait confiance avant même de vous connaître — et chez Verbandskëscht, nous cherchons des infirmier(ère)s qui prennent cette responsabilité au sérieux, et qui y trouvent du sens.

Sur le terrain :

• Prendre en charge une tournée de patients à domicile au sein d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire, en lien étroit avec votre cadre de soins.
• Réaliser l'ensemble des soins infirmiers prescrits, avec une expertise particulière en soins de plaies.
• Observer, analyser et adapter votre approche : chaque patient est différent, chaque situation évolue.
• Assurer la continuité du lien entre le patient, sa famille et le reste de l'équipe.

Au sein de l'équipe :

• Participer activement aux transmissions et aux réunions pluridisciplinaires.
• Contribuer à la qualité globale des soins en partageant vos observations et votre expertise.
• Évoluer dans une organisation certifiée Great Place to Work, où la qualité des soins est une conviction partagée — pas un argument de communication.

CE QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS

Prérequis :

• Autorisation d'exercer la profession d'infirmier(ère) au Luxembourg.
• Maîtrise du luxembourgeois et du français, indispensable pour créer un lien de confiance avec vos patients.
• Permis B valide.

Qualités recherchées :

• Sens clinique aiguisé — vous repérez ce qui change, ce qui inquiète, ce qui n'est pas dit.
• Rigueur et autonomie dans l'organisation de votre tournée, sans perdre le sens du collectif.
• Capacité à établir une relation de confiance, même lors de visites courtes.
• Une expérience en milieu hospitalier ou extrahospitalier est appréciée.

CE QUE VOUS TROUVEREZ CHEZ NOUS

• Une organisation certifiée Great Place to Work — parce qu'un collaborateur bien entouré prend de meilleurs soins.
• Des formations continues pour rester à la pointe, accessibles à tous les collaborateurs.
• Une culture où l'exigence professionnelle et la bienveillance ne s'opposent pas — elles se renforcent.
• Des conditions de travail à la hauteur de votre engagement, selon le Contrat collectif SAS en vigueur.
• Une équipe pluridisciplinaire qui travaille vraiment ensemble — coordinateurs, infirmiers, aides-soignants, thérapeutes.

Les candidatures sont traitées en toute confidentialité.

En cas d'embauche un extrait de casier judiciaire (bulletin n°3, n°4 et n°5) vous sera demandé aux fins de l'appréciation de votre honorabilité.

About the FSTM
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.
Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and the environment we live in.
The Department of Engineering (DoE) is a dynamic, interdisciplinary group engaged in civil, electrical, mechanical engineering and operations research/management, driving forward innovative research and solutions. It also has an internationally leading profile in computational science and engineering. We develop cutting-edge technologies, promoting the sustainable and economical use of resources, and meeting the technological demands of Luxembourg, the Greater Region, and beyond. Nearly all research projects are supported by a network of national and international partnerships, several with public or industrial stakeholders. At the University, the Department cooperates across faculties and with the interdisciplinary centres. In particular, the new interdisciplinary centre focused on complex environmental systems opens up significant opportunities for future collaborations.
The Department of Engineering seeks to hire a Research Support Engineer to integrate the Technical Support Unit (TSU). The candidate will work closely with the TSU Team Leader and technicians to support the DoE members (PhD students, Post-doctoral researchers, professors), in their research activities, specially in the fields of Concrete, Steel, Composite and Geotechnical structures. The candidate will work both in Kirchberg and Belval Campus.

• Assist the research support engineers in scientific test preparation and execution, analysis and preparation of experimental data, setup of new equipment and test procedures
• Planification and execution of testing cf. to relevant standards
• Definition and installation of measurement instrumentation
• Production of samples: un molding, preparing, placing reinforcement, concrete mixing and casting
• Handling of samples: measure, weigh, process, store
• Housekeeping of the laboratories:
o Updating the inventories: spare parts, sensors, scientific equipment
o Cleaning and maintaining the laboratory equipment
o Archiving, storing of documentation, samples
o Waste management: recycling, disposing off



Your profile
• Junior engineer with a master degree, preferably in civil engineering
• Experience in lab support in industry and/or academia
• Ability in executing standard workshop jobs. e.g., concrete casting
• Adaptability and willingness to learn new skills
• Ability to work proactively, independently
• Team spirit, dynamism and sense of initiative
• Flexibility
• Good command of MS Office tools: Outlook, Word, Excel
• Excellent command (C1) of English is required. Good working knowledge (B1) of French, German and Luxembourgish would be an advantage

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

Job Description & Summary

Pwc Luxembourg is hiring a Manager Customs & Trade Facilitation, Government and Public Sector Advisory (m/f/d). What if it was you?  
Your mission: As a Manager in our Government and Public Sector Advisory team, you will lead strategy and transformation engagements at the intersection of international trade, customs governance, and digital modernisation. Our clients are customs administrations, customs unions, ministries, and international institutions (EU, GCC, WBG, UN and beyond) seeking to transform, modernise, and align with international trade facilitation standards. This is a full-time, on-site position based in Luxembourg, with frequent international travel.

Be a part of our team where you will:  

• Lead and deliver consulting engagements for customs and tax administrations, customs unions, and international institutions, covering transformation, modernisation, and trade facilitation reform agendas;
• Take ownership of projects in the domain of Single Window, interoperability, and data exchange workstreams, advising clients on architecture, governance, applicable international standards (e.g. WCO Data Model, UN/CEFACT), and implementation roadmaps;
• Design and deliver training, capacity-building, and knowledge-transfer programmes for public-sector counterparts in EU and donor-funded projects;
• Manage client relationships, contribute to proposal writing and business development, and represent the team in client workshops, international conferences, and working groups;
• Coach junior consultants and trainees, structure complex multi-workstream engagements, and ensure the quality and consistency of deliverables (reports, frameworks, presentations).

Let's talk about you. If you …
  
• Have at least 10 years of relevant experience in trade facilitation, customs modernisation, or Single Window implementation, including assignments delivered for or with public administrations and international organisations (e.g. UN, WCO, WTO, EU, WBG, regional development banks);
• Bring hands-on expertise in areas such as Single Window design and implementation, customs IT systems architecture, customs-to-customs data exchange, or cross-border digital trade, with a solid understanding of international standards (WCO, UN/CEFACT, WTO TFA);
• Have a strong track record in stakeholder engagement, including delivering trainings, speaking at international conferences or technical working groups, and contributing to thought leadership (articles, studies, working papers) in trade facilitation;
• Demonstrate an entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to structure engagements from scratch, develop new client opportunities, and operate with a high level of autonomy, while being open to frequent international travel;
• Communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken (additional languages such as French, Modern Standard Arabic, or Luxembourgish are considered an asset);

…You are the candidate we are looking for!

PwC Luxembourg (www.pwc.lu) is the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg with over 3,600 people employed from 90 different countries. PwC Luxembourg provides audit, tax and advisory services including management consulting, transaction, financing and regulatory advice. The firm provides advice to a wide variety of clients from local and middle market entrepreneurs to large multinational companies operating from Luxembourg and the Greater Region. The firm supports its clients in creating the value they are looking for by contributing to the smooth operation of the capital markets and providing advice through an industry-focused approach.

At PwC, we help clients build trust and reinvent so they can turn complexity into competitive advantage. We're a tech-forward, people-empowered network with more than 364,000 people in 136 countries and 137 territories. Across audit and assurance, tax and legal, deals and consulting, we help clients build, accelerate, and sustain momentum. Find out more at www.pwc.com and www.pwc.lu.

jobs.title: 6. NADZORNIK/CA
jobs.description: Na temelju članka 30. Statuta, ravnatelj ustanove Upravljanje sportskim objektima, Trg Krešimira Ćosića 11, Zagreb, raspisuje J AV N I N A T J E Č A J za prijam radnika u radni odnos na neodređeno vrijeme 6. Naziv radnog mjesta: NADZORNIK (m/ž) – 1 izvršitelj/izvršiteljica Rad s punim radnim vremenom, neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rad u trajanju od 6 mjeseci Mjesto rada: Zagreb Sprema: VKV/SSS, edukacija kroz seminar Slučajni spasilac (edukacija se može provesti u roku od 2 mjeseca od zaposlenja) Koeficijent složenosti poslova: 1,44 Radno iskustvo: 1 godina Posebna znanja i vještine: nisu potrebna Opis poslova: provodi preventivne aktivnosti vezane uz sigurnost korisnika te brine za sigurnost korisnika u smislu životne ugroze i spašavanja iz vode, pruža neodgodivu prvu pomoć, vrši nadzor na svom području djelovanja za koje je zadužen i odgovoran tijekom u vremenu utvrđenom rasporedom, brine za čistoću bazena, raspored pruga, rekvizita i opreme na bazenu, jezeru ili plaži, dnevno obavlja čišćenje bazenskog oplošja i/ili plaže, sudjeluje u pripremi i realizaciji sportskih natjecanja ili drugih događanja na bazenu, jezeru ili plaži, daje informacije korisnicima u smislu uputa i pravila za korištenje bazena, jezera ili plaže prema potrebi, obavlja redarske poslove na prostoru cijelog objekta, vodi pisanu evidenciju o dnevnom čišćenju bazena, intervencijama te oštećenjima na bazenu, jezeru ili plaži, sudjeluje u remontu bazena, prvenstveno u čišćenju školjke i oplošja bazena, obavlja i druge poslove po nalogu nadređenog u okviru stručne spreme i djelokruga rada i sl. Plaću radnika čine osnovna odnosno ugovorena plaća i dodaci na osnovnu plaću. Osnovna plaća je umnožak koeficijenta složenosti poslova radnog mjesta na kojemu radnik radi i osnovice za izračun plaće, uvećan za 0,5% za svaku navršenu godinu radnog staža. Osnovica za obračun plaće iznosi 1.075,94 eura bruto. Na javni natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Radni odnos se zasniva na neodređeno vrijeme, uz obavezni probni rad u trajanju od 6 mjeseci. Kandidati su u prijavi dužni navesti osobne podatke (ime i prezime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona odnosno mobitela, po mogućnosti e-mail adresa), naziv i redni broj radnog mjesta za koje se podnosi prijava. Kandidati koji se natječu za više radnih mjesta dužni su za svako radno mjesto podnijeti posebnu prijavu. Uz svaku prijavu dužni su priložiti traženu dokumentaciju. Kandidati su prilikom prijave dužni priložiti sljedeću dokumentaciju: • prijavu za javni natječaj (obrazac prijave može se preuzeti na web stranici Ustanove: https://www.sportskiobjekti.hr/pravilnici-i-natjecaji/1164), • životopis, • dokaz o državljanstvu (osobna iskaznica, putovnica, vojna iskaznica ili domovnica), • dokaz o stručnoj spremi: presliku diplome ili svjedodžbe (ukoliko kandidat uz prijavu priloži inozemnu kvalifikaciju, dužan je uz istu dostaviti i dokaz o priznavanju inozemne obrazovne kvalifikacije), • uvjerenje o nevođenju kaznenog postupka (ne starije od 3 mjeseca od dana objave javnog natječaja), • dokaz o ukupnom radnom iskustvu, ne stariji od 1 mjeseca od dana objave javnog natječaja: Elektronički zapis (e–radna knjižica) ili Potvrda o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje, a koji Zapis/Potvrda, između ostalih podataka, mora sadržavati i podatke o poslodavcu, početku i prestanku osiguranja, stvarnoj i potrebnoj stručnoj spremi, radnom vremenu, općini rada – prebivališta i trajanju staža osiguranja. Kandidati koji dostavljaju dokumentaciju na stranom jeziku dužni su uz istu dostaviti ovjereni prijevod na hrvatski jezik. Ukoliko kandidat uz prijavu priloži dokumente u kojima osobni podaci nisu istovjetni, dužan je dostaviti i dokaz o njihovoj promjeni (presliku vjenčanog ili rodnog lista). Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužan je u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Da bi ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, kandidat koji ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava, dužan je uz prijavu na javni natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja, kao i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu o priznatom statusu, te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (ugovor, rješenje, odluka i sl.) Temeljem članka 103. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihove obitelji (Narodne novine, 121/17, 98/19, 84/21 i 156/23) i članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, 84/21), kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti dužni su dostaviti sve dokaze iz citiranih odredbi Zakona. Dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju objavljeni su na Internet stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja Republike Hrvatske https://branitelji.gov.hr/pristup-informacijama/835 . Kandidat koji se, sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20), poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja, dužan je uz prijavu na natječaj, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i dokumentaciju navedenu u javnom natječaju. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz javnog natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na javni natječaj. Kandidati prijavljeni na javni natječaj biti će pozvani pisanim putem na prethodnu provjeru znanja i sposobnosti bitnih za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta na koje se primaju. Prethodnoj provjeri znanja i sposobnosti mogu pristupiti samo kandidati koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete iz natječaja. Ako kandidat ne pristupi prethodnoj provjeri znanja, smatra se da je povukao prijavu na javni natječaj i više se ne smatra kandidatom. Rok za podnošenje prijava je 8 (osam) dana od dana objave javnog natječaja u novinama, na web stranici i oglasnoj ploči HZZ-a te na web stranici i oglasnoj ploči ustanove Upravljanje sportskim objektima. Prijave s naznakom „ZA NATJEČAJ – PRIJAM U RADNI ODNOS – NAZIV I REDNI BROJ RADNOG MJESTA ZA KOJE SE PODNOSI PRIJAVA“ dostavljaju se na adresu: Upravljanje sportskim objektima, Baštijanova 52a, 10 000 Zagreb. Ustanova Upravljanje sportskim objektima zadržava pravo poništenja natječaja, u cijelosti i/ili u dijelu, odnosno pravo ne odabrati niti jednog kandidata, bez obveze obrazlaganja svoje odluke i bez ikakve odgovornosti prema kandidatima. jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern, Mobile (Winter 2027)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.



Notion is an in person company, and currently requires its employees to come to the office for three Anchor Days (Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays). This internship will take place from Jan 25 - Apr 16 and you will need to be able to work out of our NY or SF office during this time.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Mobile devices have reshaped personal computing—the power of a desktop now fits in our pockets. By giving everyone the building blocks to create their own tools, we'll solve more problems wherever we go. A delightful, intuitive mobile experience: that's our guiding light, and we need Android and iOS engineers to make it a reality.

During your 12-week internship, you will be paired with a mentor that will help guide you as you work closely with our team to build and ship impactful projects. These projects will drive valuable impact to our customers and engineers. Take a look at what our past intern cohort worked on with our Blog post here https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Intern-Spotlight-d0260c4e2317490db89f367d95cb4e68 and here https://www.notion.so/blog/saluting-notions-winter-interns and TikTok https://www.tiktok.com/@notionhq/video/7216440106356395306?lang=en post.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Write clean, secure, tested, and documented code.

 - You'll collaborate with the team to strategize, mold, and develop innovative features for our Android and iOS application.

 - At our core, we prioritize crafting top-tier applications. Your role could involve enhancing the Android or iOS app's performance, reliability, and overall refinement. Additionally, you'll have the opportunity to optimize aspects of the app within the web stack.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or another related field. Must graduate before December 2027.

 - Previous mobile internship experience.

 - Working towards a proficiency of one or more programming languages such as Kotlin, Java, Typescript, Node.js, Swift, Go, Python, or Rust.

 - You find large challenges exciting and enjoy discovering problems as much as solving them.

 - You are able to problem-solve and adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

 - This internship will take place from Jan - Apr and you will need to be able to work out of our SF or NY office during this time.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Thoughtful problem-solving: For you, problem-solving starts with a clear and accurate understanding of the context. You can decompose tricky problems and work towards a clean solution, by yourself or with teammates. You're comfortable asking for help when you get stuck.

 - Put users first: You think critically about the implications of what you're building, and how it shapes real people's lives. You understand that reach comes with responsibility for our impact—good and bad.

 - Not ideological about technology: To you, technologies and programming languages are about tradeoffs. You may be opinionated, but you're not ideological and can learn new technologies as you go.

 - Empathetic communication: You communicate nuanced ideas clearly, whether you're explaining technical decisions in writing or brainstorming in real time. In disagreements, you engage thoughtfully with other perspectives and compromise when needed.

 - Team player: For you, work isn't a solo endeavor. You enjoy collaborating cross-functionally to accomplish shared goals, and you care about learning, growing, and helping others to do the same.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You're proficient with any part of our technology stack: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android SDK, Dagger, Swift, React, TypeScript, Postgres.

 - You've heard of computing pioneers like Ada Lovelace, Douglas Engelbart, Alan Kay, and others—and understand why we're big fans of their work.

 - You have interests outside of technology, such as in art, history, or social sciences.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated hourly range for this role is $57/hr for Bachelors or $61/hr for Master’s.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Cloud Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Replit enables people to build software with AI. The infrastructure underneath that experience must make it straightforward to launch services, isolate workloads, and run reliable systems at scale.

We're hiring a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead Cloud Infrastructure: the shared infrastructure as code (IaC), networking, storage, compute, and service mesh platforms that Replit's product and platform teams depend on. You'll lead and grow an existing engineering team building and operating these foundations, including Kubernetes, shared edge networking, service mesh and workload identity.

This is a platform-building role with production accountability. You should be comfortable going deep on a design or incident while developing a team that does not depend on you for every decision.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the cloud-platform roadmap. Lead the team's IaC, networking, storage, compute, and service mesh platforms. Translate product, platform, reliability, and security needs into sequenced outcomes, balancing foundational investment, lifecycle work, and delivery commitments against the team's capacity.

 - Make infrastructure repeatable and self-service. Build maintained IaC interfaces for services, cells, connectivity, identities, and shared resources. Enable internal customer teams to provision infrastructure without bespoke coordination or dependence on individual experts.

 - Operate what the team builds. Own platform availability, upgrades, isolation, recovery, and incident remediation. Maintain clear SLOs, sustainable on-call coverage, and primary and backup owners for critical systems.

 - Stay technically engaged. Review designs and production changes, debug difficult failure modes, and use AI coding tools—including Replit—to prototype and automate. Apply rigorous review and verification to AI-generated infrastructure changes.

 - Build and grow a high-ownership engineering team. Coach engineers, develop technical leaders, set clear expectations, manage performance, and hire against agreed needs. Delegate meaningful ownership as the team grows.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

jobs.title: QA/RA Engineer – Medical Devices (MDR)
jobs.description:
Copenhagen area, Denmark (Industrivej 12, 3540 Lynge). Hybrid: remote work with on-site visits to Valcon typically once or twice a month. Candidates based elsewhere in the EU are welcome to apply. Application deadline: 30 October 2026. We are hiring as soon as possible, so applications are reviewed as received and the posting may close earlier once the position is filled.

Do you have solid experience with quality assurance and regulatory affairs for medical devices under EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016, and are you motivated by the opportunity to build a QA/RA function from the ground up?

Would you like to take ownership of technical documentation, risk management, and Notified Body compliance for a growing medical device portfolio?

Then you might be our new QA/RA Engineer.

About Valcon Medical

Valcon Medical A/S manufactures medical cannabis extracts and cannabis oils for the Danish market and a number of export markets. We are approved by the Danish Medicines Agency to manufacture medical cannabis in accordance with EU-GMP and applicable Danish legislation on medical cannabis.

We are a company in development, with new products, processes, and technologies entering the organization, including an expanding medical device portfolio. This role is being established to build our QA/RA function for compliance with EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016, and to ensure our device documentation and processes meet Notified Body and Competent Authority expectations.

You will work closely with colleagues across Quality, R&D, Manufacturing, and Clinical Affairs. As a smaller company, we have short decision-making paths, and the QA/RA function works closely with the rest of the organization. You will therefore have the opportunity to work with both classic QA/RA tasks and take responsibility for new issues, where you will independently investigate, assess, and help find the right solution, including shaping how our MDR compliance function is built from an early stage.

Areas of responsibility for the QA/RA function

  • Implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System in compliance with ISO 13485:2016 and EU MDR 2017/745

  • Maintain current knowledge of EU MDR 2017/745, ISO 13485:2016, and relevant harmonised standards, and advise the organization on compliance matters

  • Preparation and maintenance of Technical Documentation (MDR Annex II/III), including GSPR checklist (Annex I) traceability to design and verification/validation evidence

  • Document Control as a core, ongoing function: creation, revision, review/approval routing, distribution, and archival of controlled documents and records (ISO 13485:2016 Clauses 4.2.4/4.2.5)

  • Change Control: assessment and impact evaluation across design, risk, and regulatory documentation, and approval routing for design, process, and document changes

  • Risk management (ISO 14971) throughout the product lifecycle, including FMEA documentation and risk control/mitigation measures

  • Review and approval of verification and validation protocols and reports, and support for validation of processes, software, and equipment (e.g. IEC 62304, as applicable to the product)

  • Preparation and review of CAPAs and nonconformance reports

  • Supplier qualification and ongoing oversight of critical suppliers, including Quality Assurance Agreements (ISO 13485:2016 Clauses 4.1.5 and 7.4)

  • Conduct supplier audits and support Notified Body audits under the MDR Annex IX conformity assessment procedure

  • Post-Market Surveillance per MDR Articles 83–86, including complaint handling, PMS reporting, and PMCF as applicable

  • Vigilance reporting to Competent Authorities per MDR Articles 87–92, including serious incident reporting and Field Safety Corrective Actions

  • UDI assignment and EUDAMED registration activities (Basic UDI-DI, UDI-DI, device and certificate registration)

  • Clinical Evaluation Report maintenance per MDR Article 61 / Annex XIV, in coordination with Clinical Affairs, where applicable

  • Collaborate with R&D, Manufacturing, and Clinical Affairs to embed GSPR (Annex I) and Design Control (ISO 13485:2016 Clause 7.3) requirements into product development and production

  • Provide training to employees on QMS requirements, EU MDR obligations, and risk-management practices

  • Provide input on EU regulatory submissions and CE-marking compliance strategy, including engagement with Notified Bodies

Your qualifications and experience

We envision that you have:

  • A bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field

  • A minimum of 2–5 years of experience in QA/RA roles within the medical device industry, working under EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016

  • Hands-on working experience inside a live, certified ISO 13485:2016 Quality Management System, not solely academic or classroom knowledge of the standard

  • Direct, hands-on experience operating within core QMS processes: Supplier Control, Document Control, Change Control, Complaint Handling, and CAPA

  • Working knowledge of ISO 13485:2016 and EU MDR 2017/745, and of relevant harmonised standards (e.g. ISO 14971, IEC 62366-1, IEC 60601 series, IEC 62304 as applicable to the product)

  • Demonstrated, hands-on authorship or maintenance experience with EU MDR Technical Documentation (Annex II/III), including GSPR checklist mapping and design/verification/validation evidence linkage. General familiarity with the standard is not sufficient

  • Ability to interpret and apply EU regulatory requirements effectively, including direct engagement with Notified Bodies

  • Fluent English, written and spoken, for Notified Body and international supplier communication

It is an advantage, but not a requirement, to have experience with one or more of the following areas:

  • EUDAMED, the UDI system, and Basic UDI-DI concepts

  • EU GMP requirements, given Valcon's GMP-regulated production environment

  • Danish language skills

Your competencies

  • Works in a structured and systematic manner, with a focus on completing tasks

  • Able to work independently, take responsibility for own tasks, and drive projects forward

  • Strong grasp of risk management (ISO 14971) and verification/validation principles

  • Enjoys a mix of technical assessment, practical problem-solving, and documentation work

  • Is proactive, solution-oriented, and contributes positively to collaboration with colleagues

  • Competencies in data processing and report writing

What we offer

You will have a broad and independent role in a company in development, where you will help build our medical device QA/RA function from an early stage and work closely with production, product development, and the company's other activities.

As part of a smaller organization, you will have short decision-making paths, extensive insight across the company, and the opportunity to have real influence on both your own areas of responsibility and the development of our QA/RA function.

For the right person, there are good opportunities to develop the role as the company grows and to take responsibility for new subject areas and projects.

This is a hybrid role. Most of the work can be done remotely, and we expect you on site at our facility in Lynge, north of Copenhagen, typically once or twice a month. Expect more frequent presence during onboarding and around Notified Body and supplier audits. [Travel costs to Valcon are covered by the company.]

How to apply

The position is based in our QA/RA function. If you would like to hear more about the job, please contact Chanel La (cl@valcon-medical.com)

Please send your CV to job@valcon-medical.com. In your application, please include 3–4 sentences on a Technical Documentation or CAPA process you personally owned under a certified ISO 13485 QMS: what you did and what the outcome was.

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: Flytta till Barcelona i vinter!
jobs.description:
Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare av mobila bredbandsabonnemang till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 300 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Vi hjälper många av Sveriges vassaste varumärken i deras försäljning. Under tio års tid har vi byggt upp vår verksamhet och breddat vårt tjänsteutbud för att alltid ligga i framkant. Vårt team består idag av över trehundra drivna och talangfulla medarbetare på våra kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona.

jobs.title: Senior Automation Engineer, DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop advanced automation solutions for critical energy and marine infrastructure?

As a Senior Automation Engineer at Semco Maritime, you will join our Automation & Electrical team, working with complex control systems for energy facilities, marine installations and offshore platforms.

You will take technical ownership of automation solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from functional design and software development to commissioning, troubleshooting and lifecycle support. You will also contribute to the continued development of our technical standards and provide professional guidance to colleagues and project teams.

The role includes opportunities to work with advanced drive and motor-control solutions, including commissioning, troubleshooting and retrofit activities involving Danfoss VLT and VACON products.

At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value. In this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering reliable and pragmatic solutions for critical installations.

Your place of work will be our Global Headquarters in Esbjerg, located at the heart of the Danish energy industry and directly on the waterfront. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 10–30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

You will work across the full project lifecycle in close collaboration with project managers, electrical designers, customers and other technical specialists.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Taking technical ownership of automation solutions and defining system architecture, interfaces and software structures.
  • Designing and developing PLC software, functional descriptions and structured code for complex marine, offshore and energy systems.
  • Developing automation solutions for BMS, PMS and hybrid energy systems, including ESS, shore power and generator control.
  • Integrating, configuring and commissioning variable-frequency drives and motor and pump-control systems, including various solutions.
  • Performing network and system integration across automation, electrical and third-party systems.
  • Conducting FAT, SAT and commissioning activities both onshore and offshore.
  • Troubleshooting live systems and resolving complex technical issues on critical installations.
  • Reviewing and quality-assuring automation designs, software and technical documentation.
  • Supporting and mentoring less experienced engineers and contributing to the development of internal standards and best practices.
  • Maintaining close technical dialogue with project management, customers, suppliers and other engineering disciplines.


Your profile & qualifications

You have a technical background in automation, electrical engineering or mechatronics and solid experience from the energy, power generation, oil and gas, offshore wind or maritime industries.

You are comfortable working with complex systems where safety, reliability and uptime are essential. You approach your responsibilities proactively, communicate clearly and are capable of taking technical ownership while remaining a strong team player.

We expect that you:

  • Have at least five years of experience with PLC programming in Siemens TIA Portal, preferably using SCL.
  • Have experience developing automation solutions for energy, marine or offshore applications.
  • Have a strong understanding of automation architecture, industrial networks and protocols such as Profinet, Modbus TCP and CAN/J1939.
  • Have knowledge of energy systems, power management or hybrid solutions such as ESS and shore power.
  • Have experience with variable-frequency drives, motor control and commissioning. Experience with Danfoss VLT or VACON products will be considered an advantage.
  • Can translate functional and operational requirements into scalable, structured and well-documented software.
  • Are capable of reviewing technical solutions and guiding colleagues on complex automation-related matters.
  • Thrive in a project-driven environment with close interdisciplinary collaboration and customer interaction.
  • Are willing to participate in commissioning and service assignments both onshore and offshore.
  • Are professionally fluent in English. Danish language skills will be considered an advantage.


Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Lønbogholder til barselsvikariat – deltid
jobs.description:
Har du erfaring med lønadministration, sans for detaljer og trives du med at være den, kollegaerne går til, når de har spørgsmål til løn og overenskomster?

Så kan det være dig, vi søger til et barselsvikariat i en veletableret produktionsvirksomhed i Langeskov.

 

Vi søger en lønbogholder på deltid, som kan blive en del af økonomifunktionen og være med til at sikre en korrekt og effektiv lønadministration for virksomhedens medarbejdere.

 

Om jobbet

Som lønbogholder får du en central rolle i virksomhedens lønteam, hvor du sammen med en lønbogholderkollega får ansvaret for den daglige lønadministration.

Du bliver en del af økonomiafdelingen, som består af ca. 8 medarbejdere inden for bogholderi og controlling, og du vil referere til Finance Manager.

Stillingen har en bred kontaktflade, og du kommer til at samarbejde med forskellige afdelinger i organisationen. Du bliver samtidig en del af en supportfunktion, hvor du bidrager med specialistviden inden for løn og hjælper kollegaer med at finde løsninger på løn- og overenskomstrelaterede spørgsmål.

 

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Lønkørsel for timelønnede og funktionærer i lønsystemet Lessor

  • Registrering og bogføring af timer i ERP-system

  • Lønafregning og lønafstemning

  • Vedligeholdelse af stamdata

  • Sikre korrekt håndtering af overenskomster samt vejlede organisationen om løn- og overenskomstspørgsmål

  • Håndtering af refusionsansøgninger

  • Diverse indberetninger til Danmarks Statistik, pensionsselskaber og myndigheder

  • Ajourføring af lønrelaterede statistikker

  • Ad hoc-opgaver samt mulighed for at bidrage til øvrige opgaver inden for økonomi, HR og reception

 

Din profil

Vi søger dig, som har erfaring med lønadministration og gerne har arbejdet med ERP- og lønsystemer.

Du arbejder struktureret og grundigt og har en naturlig sans for detaljer. Du forstår vigtigheden af, at løndata er korrekte hele vejen gennem processen, og du tager ansvar for, at opgaverne bliver fulgt til dørs.

Da lønfunktionen har en bred kontaktflade i organisationen, er det samtidig vigtigt, at du har gode kommunikative evner. Du trives med at hjælpe og vejlede dine kollegaer og kan formidle regler og komplekse problemstillinger på en letforståelig måde.

Det er en fordel, hvis du:

  • Har erfaring med lønadministration

  • Har kendskab til Lessor eller et tilsvarende lønsystem

  • Har erfaring med ERP-systemer

  • Har arbejdet med overenskomster

  • Er struktureret og detaljeorienteret

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og ansvarsbevidst

  • Trives med en bred kontaktflade og med at yde intern support

 

Virksomheden tilbyder

Du bliver en del af en solid og veletableret produktionsvirksomhed med base i

Langeskov, tæt på motorvejen.

 

Virksomheden tilbyder blandt andet:

  • Et spændende og alsidigt barselsvikariat

  • Deltidsansættelse

  • Fleksible arbejdstider

  • Mulighed for delvist hjemmearbejde efter endt oplæring

  • Sundhedssikring

  • Kantineordning

  • Aktiv personale- og idrætsforening

  • Fritvalgskonto

  • Feriefridage

  • Bonusordning baseret på virksomhedens samlede omsætningsmål

 

Om virksomheden

Virksomheden er en veletableret aktør i den nordeuropæiske stålbranche og har mere end 400 medarbejdere samt omfattende produktionsfaciliteter.

Virksomheden arbejder med kundetilpassede løsninger og har et stærkt fokus på medarbejdernes engagement og trivsel. Samtidig er bæredygtighed og den grønne omstilling centrale fokusområder, hvor stålets muligheder for genanvendelse spiller en væsentlig rolle.

Du bliver en del af en organisation, hvor samarbejde, faglighed og ansvarlighed er en naturlig del af hverdagen, og hvor økonomifunktionen spiller en vigtig rolle i at understøtte resten af organisationen.

 

Ansøgning:

Matcher ovenstående dine kvalifikationer, hører vi meget gerne fra dig. Send en ansøgning og CV på mail@vkconsulting.dk. Vi holder løbende samtaler og ansætter, når rette match er fundet. Ved evt. spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at henvende dig til VKCONSULTING på tlf. 70201512 alle hverdage. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

 

Bemærk, alle ansøgninger behandles fortroligt og med stor diskretion. Med henvisning til reglerne omkring GDPR modtages ansøgninger kun via linket i stillingsannoncen. Kan du ikke uploade din ansøgning via ansøgningsknappen, bedes du kontakte os. Vores annonce bliver automatisk og løbende fornyet på jobportalerne, indtil stillingen er besat. En fornyelse af et stillingsopslag er dermed ikke et udtryk for genopslag, men blot en automatisk fornyelse af annoncen.

Our restaurant in Kalundborg is a well-run, busy operation with a proven concept, experienced ownership and a clear direction. Located right in the middle of Kalundborg's main pedestrian street, we are a lively, pulsing part of the town and a gathering place for its residents. Our purpose is to create a vibrant place for the people of Kalundborg, built on quality ingredients and good food. We are now strengthening our kitchen team and are looking for chefs who want to become part of a structured, professional kitchen and contribute to consistent, high-quality service every day.

Our concept is based on modern Danish cuisine with a Nordic twist, combined with well executed brasserie classics and a varied à la carte menu. We focus on quality ingredients, solid craftsmanship and seasonal cooking, with dishes that combine flavour, comfort and consistency. Our menu includes both classic meat dishes, such as pepper steak, pasta dishes and other popular brasserie favourites.

Alongside our à la carte service, we have a private dining and events room, which you will also be part of. It brings welcome variety to the daily kitchen work, with menus that differ from the standard à la carte and the chance to cook for parties, celebrations and special occasions.

You will be joining a business with an already proven concept, an organised kitchen and a strong operational foundation. The setup is stable and well prepared, giving you a secure framework in which to do great work and develop your craft. Here you also get the freedom to bring your own ideas to life. We are not a place where everything is dictated from above — our chefs and kitchen staff are given the room to develop dishes, contribute to the menu and put their own mark on the food.

We are a serious but friendly workplace with respectful leadership, an organised kitchen environment and a no-drama culture. We believe strong kitchens are built on structure, teamwork and professionalism.

We are looking for chefs / cooks who:
• Have experience working in a professional kitchen

jobs.title: Country Manager (Nordics)
jobs.description:
David Kennedy Recruitment is working with a leading B2B solution provider who are looking to recruit a Country Manager for the Nordic region for their offices in Malta.

Position: Country Manager

Location: Sliema, Malta

Employment type: Full-time

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are seeking a dynamic Country Manager to drive market expansion, build strategic client relationships, and accelerate revenue growth. You will play a key role in identifying new business opportunities, managing the full sales cycle, and positioning our solutions effectively in the market. This is an exciting opportunity to make a direct impact in a fast-paced, international environment.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Identify and develop new business opportunities through research, networking, and strategic outreach, managing prospects through the full sales cycle

Build and maintain a strong, active sales pipeline through consistent and targeted activity

Understand customer needs and deliver consultative, solution-driven sales approaches

Develop deep relationships with clients to ensure long-term partnerships and tailored solutions

Act as a product expert, confidently presenting current and upcoming offerings

Collaborate with internal teams to convert leads into successful client engagements

Create and maintain high-quality sales materials, including presentations and supporting resources

Develop commercially viable proposals aligned with both business and client objectives

Track and report on sales pipeline progress and customer journey stages

Represent the company at trade shows, industry events, and conferences

Deliver product demonstrations both remotely and in person

Partner with Product and Marketing teams to drive initiatives that support new business acquisition.

REQUIREMENTS:

Fluent in Swedish or Danish, along with strong English communication skills, in both written and spoken communication

Strong network of C-level contacts within the gaming or gambling sector

Proven experience within Nordic iGaming markets, either in B2B sales/account management or a commercial B2C role

In-depth knowledge of casino, slots, and live casino products

Demonstrated experience in developing and executing regional or global sales strategies

Solid understanding of marketing principles

Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, complex, and evolving environment

Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines

Self-driven with the ability to work independently and collaboratively

Highly motivated with the ability to influence and inspire others

Hands-on, proactive approach with a strong sense of ownership

Commercially focused with a data-driven mindset

Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills with the ability to build lasting relationships.

BENEFITS:

Comprehensive onboarding and training aligned with high industry standards

Supportive, collaborative, and inclusive company culture

Excellent career progression opportunities within a fast-growing international organisation

Access to continuous learning and development through a dedicated learning platform.

Du bliver en del af klinikkens daglige drift og skal kunne indgå naturligt i teamet samt hurtigt sætte dig ind i klinikkens arbejdsgange.

  • Har erfaring som tandklinikassistent

  • Taler og forstår dansk på et godt niveau

  • Er stabil og møder til tiden

  • Er ansvarsbevidst og fleksibel

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og som en del af et team

  • Hurtigt kan sætte dig ind i nye rutiner og arbejdsgange

Arbejdssted: 8643 Ans

Omfang: Ca. 30–35 timer om ugen
Varighed: Ca. 1–2 måneder

The Technical Standards Engineer is responsible for developing, maintaining, and controlling maintenance standards, procedures, and technical documentation that support safe, compliant, and efficient aircraft maintenance operations. Acting as a key link between operational teams, Safety, and Compliance functions, the role ensures that technical requirements are clearly communicated, consistently applied, and effectively managed across the organisation. The position also supports continuous improvement and key organisational change. Maintenance Organisation Exposition (MOE) - Technical Standards Manual (TSM) - Safety Management Manual (SMM) • Navigate and utilize engineering systems including: - Boeing fleet technical documentation systems - Digital technical document libraries - Technical Services Query dashboards • Promote and apply human factors principles throughout all duties Key Skills & Competencies • Strong knowledge of aviation regulatory requirements (EASA/UK CAA Part 145 & Part CAMO) would be a distinct advantage • Attention to detail and high standards of documentation accuracy • Effective communication and problem-solving skills • Ability to work independently and as part of a team • Strong safety mindset and awareness of human factors Experience & Qualifications • Experience in aircraft maintenance or technical support environment • Knowledge of document control/revision in a technical/regulated environment • Familiarity with MyBoeingFleet, Microsoft Office • Knowledge and experience of using AMOS

Dag Log – Brøndby (Storkøbenhavn)

Er du en stabil, ansvarsbevidst og erfaren lastbilchauffør, som trives med varierende opgaver? Så er det måske dig, vi søger til vores team hos Dag Log.

Vi søger en lastbilchauffør til blandet kørsel, hvor opgaverne kan variere mellem distributionskørsel, afhentning og levering samt eventuelt længere ture – afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og ønsker.

Vi tilbyder

  • Fuldtidsstilling med ordnede forhold

  • Varieret kørsel – både lokal og regional (evt. længere ture)

  • Gode kollegaer og uformel, professionel omgangstone

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer og gældende overenskomst

  • Fast bil og moderne materiel

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har gyldigt kørekort kategori CE

  • Har gyldigt EU-chaufførbevis og førerkort (tachografkort)

  • Er mødestabil, ansvarlig og serviceminded

  • Taler og forstår dansk (eller engelsk på rimeligt niveau)

  • Har erfaring med lastbilkørsel
    (gerne både distributions- og landevejskørsel)

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og har styr på dokumentation og kørselsregistrering

Arbejdssted

Vores base ligger i Brøndby (Storkøbenhavn).

Ansøgning

Lyder det som noget for dig?
Så send din ansøgning og evt. CV til:

Dag-group@outlook.dk

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende.

Truck Driver – Mixed Transport

Dag Log – Brøndby (Greater Copenhagen)

Dag Log is seeking 5 new reliable and professional truck driver for mixed transport operations. The position is a key part of our daily logistics operations, where punctuality, quality, and professional customer interaction are essential.

As a driver at Dag Log, you will handle a variety of transport tasks, including distribution, pickup and delivery, and potentially longer-distance routes, depending on your qualifications and operational needs.

Key responsibilities

  • Execution of planned transport assignments with a strong focus on on-time delivery and high service quality

  • Distribution, pickup, and delivery of goods

  • Ensuring correct documentation and transport records

  • Professional interaction with customers and business partners

  • Compliance with all applicable transport legislation and driving/rest regulations

We offer

  • A full-time position with stable and well-organized employment conditions

  • Varied and independent driving assignments

  • Modern vehicles and equipment, including a dedicated truck

  • A professional working environment with skilled and supportive colleagues

  • Competitive salary based on qualifications and applicable collective agreements

We expect that you

  • Hold a valid CE driving license

  • Possess a valid EU Driver Qualification Card and digital tachograph card

  • Are reliable, responsible, and well-structured

  • Have experience with truck driving, preferably both distribution and long-distance transport

  • Can work independently and maintain a high level of professionalism

  • Communicate effectively in English (Danish is an advantage)

  • Have a strong focus on safety, quality, and accurate documentation

Work location

The position is based in Brøndby, Greater Copenhagen.

Application

If you are interested in joining a professional and well-established logistics company, please submit your application and CV to:

Dag-group@outlook.dk

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Construction - Civil Project Manager Kildare
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
The main duties and responsibilities of the Civil Project Manager are outlined as follows: Work as part of a team in the delivery of one or more projects at any one time, embracing the ethos of a “one team” culture. Ensure Health, Safety, Environmental & Sustainability standards, policies and procedures are always adhered to on-site. Instil a positive Health and Safety culture within the team in their thinking and actions. Work closely and collaborate with all key stakeholders including clients, client representatives and third-party agencies. Ensure a positive experience for the client and their representatives instilling an ethos of collaboration and cooperation. Lead the construction team in all aspects of the Civil Engineering and Building scope of works. Liaise closely and support other engineering disciplines including mechanical, electrical and process engineering. Facilitate the co-ordination role of the PSDP for live projects with internal and external designers. Represent the company as PSCS on live sites within your remit and co-ordinate all required documentation to be present on-site and up to date. Conduct regular Health and Safety inspections on live sites as well as conducting and leading toolbox talks and white-board meetings. Ensure best practice project management techniques are used such as Lean Construction and Last Planner. Monitor project performance including risk and opportunities. Mitigate/reduce risk where possible and manage opportunities. Report on the monthly performance of your project to the framework manager including performance against programme, budget and HSQE. Lead the team in the procurement of supplies and sub-contracts on time and within budget. Manage cashflow on projects and work with the Contracts Manager/ Commercial Manager to ensure interim payment applications are submitted on-time to the client. Build and promote industry-leading teams by providing training and mentoring of staff including setting out development plans for your team. Provide an active involvement in resource management and recruitment within your team as a hiring manager. Provide assistance, oversight and guidance from time to time on tendering opportunities for new upcoming projects. Respond to and address any client and stakeholder complaints in a timely manner. Obtain client satisfaction surveys and provide any feedback on how to improve our client satisfaction. Seek to improve the project delivery process by providing lessons learned feedback and innovative solutions for adoption on future projects. Keep appraised of the latest standards and technology through continuous professional development (CPD). Other duties as required from time to time. Knowledge, Skills and Experience: The main knowledge, skills and experience required of the Civil Project Manager are outlined as follows: Minimum of 5 years’ experience working in a similar role, preferably in the water and wastewater industry.

jobs.title: Tilkaldevikar søges til Opholdsstedet SAFE
jobs.description:
Opholdsstedet SAFE søger engagerede og fagligt kompetente tilkaldevikarer til arbejdet med børn og unge i alderen 9–17 år.

SAFE er et privat børn- og ungehjem, hvor vi tilbyder en tryg, struktureret og udviklingsstøttende hverdag for børn og unge, som blandt andet kan have erfaringer med omsorgssvigt, traumer, skolevægring, social kontrol, relationsvanskeligheder eller andre belastende livsomstændigheder.

Vores mål er at skabe stabile og forudsigelige rammer, hvor børnene og de unge mødes med respekt, nærvær og tydelighed, og hvor deres ressourcer, udviklingsmuligheder og individuelle behov er i centrum.

Vi arbejder ud fra et fælles fagligt fundament med blandt andet mentalisering, anerkendende relationsarbejde, LØFT og ADL. I hverdagen arbejder vi målrettet med relationer, struktur, skolegang, fritid, selvstændighed, følelsesmæssig udvikling og sociale kompetencer.

Vores børn og unge er som udgangspunkt ikke kendetegnet ved udadreagerende adfærd, men flere har behov for voksne, som kan være rolige, stabile og vedholdende i relationen. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du kan være en tydelig og omsorgsfuld voksen, som kan skabe tryghed uden at presse, og som kan bevare overblik i forskellige situationer.

Om arbejdet

Som tilkaldevikar bliver du en del af den daglige pædagogiske indsats og vil blandt andet skulle:

  • skabe trygge og stabile relationer til børnene og de unge

  • støtte den enkelte i hverdagsstruktur, skole, fritid og sociale relationer

  • arbejde målrettet med individuelle mål og delmål

  • deltage i aktiviteter, måltider og praktiske opgaver i huset

  • støtte børnene og de unge i ADL og udvikling af selvstændighed

  • arbejde mentaliserende og anerkendende i kontakten

  • dokumentere fagligt og præcist i vores journalsystem

  • samarbejde tæt med kolleger og ledelse

  • følge husets faglige procedurer og pædagogiske retningslinjer.

Arbejdstiden kan ligge på både hverdage, aftener, nætter, weekender og helligdage. Der kan forekomme længere vagter afhængigt af husets behov.

Hvem søger vi?

Det er vigtigt for os, at du har en relevant faglig baggrund. Vi søger derfor primært dig, som er uddannet eller under uddannelse inden for det pædagogiske eller socialfaglige område, eksempelvis som:

  • pædagog

  • pædagogisk assistent

  • socialrådgiver

  • anden relevant socialfaglig uddannelse.

Vi lægger desuden vægt på, at du har erfaring med eller kendskab til børn og unge, som har været udsat for omsorgssvigt, traumer eller andre sociale belastninger.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • kan arbejde relationsorienteret og professionelt

  • har ro, tålmodighed og tydelighed

  • kan arbejde struktureret og ansvarligt

  • kan følge aftaler, handleplaner og procedurer

  • kan indgå i et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde

  • kan dokumentere fagligt og reflekteret

  • er fleksibel i forhold til vagter.

Introduktion og SAFE Akademiet

Som ny medarbejder eller vikar bliver du tilbudt et struktureret introduktions- og kompetenceforløb gennem vores eget SAFE Akademi.

SAFE Akademiet består af 8 faglige moduler, som skal sikre, at alle medarbejdere arbejder ud fra et fælles fagligt grundlag og har kendskab til vores målgruppe, metoder, dokumentationskrav og arbejdsgange.

Inden din første introduktionsvagt skal du have gennemført og bestået de første to moduler. Herefter starter du med introduktions- og følgevagter, hvor du bliver introduceret til huset, børnene og de unge samt vores daglige pædagogiske praksis.

De resterende moduler skal gennemføres inden for en fastsat tidsfrist efter ansættelsen.

Den tid, du bruger på at gennemføre SAFE Akademiet, er betalt arbejdstid.

Vi tilbyder

Hos SAFE får du:

  • et meningsfuldt arbejde med børn og unge

  • en grundig introduktion til målgruppen og huset

  • kompetenceudvikling gennem SAFE Akademiet

  • betalt tid til gennemførelse af de faglige moduler

  • mulighed for løbende vagter

  • et fagligt miljø med fokus på udvikling, refleksion og samarbejde

  • mulighed for at gøre en konkret forskel i børn og unges hverdag.

Ansættelsesproces

Vi indkalder løbende relevante kandidater til samtale, og stillingerne besættes, når vi har fundet de rette profiler.

Som led i ansættelsesprocessen indhenter Opholdsstedet SAFE straffeattest og børneattest for alle medarbejdere, inden ansættelsen kan gennemføres.

Send gerne dit CV og en kort motiveret ansøgning, hvor du beskriver din uddannelsesbaggrund, relevante erfaring og motivation for at arbejde med vores målgruppe.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: GTM Recruiter, Tokyo
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for an experienced Go-To-Market (GTM) Recruiter in Tokyo to partner closely with our Japan leadership team to attract, engage, and close top talent from an array of backgrounds. In this role, you’ll help build our Japan organization in a high-ownership, high-growth environment. We will look to you to advise and consult with hiring managers and interviewers, proactively source and engage future Notinos, and design a rigorous hiring processes while ensuring a delightful candidate experience.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the Japan recruiting process for GTM roles, primarily for Solutions Consultants (direct sales) and other GTM roles.

 - Operate autonomously across the end-to-end cycle, from direct sourcing and screening through close, while ensuring a thoughtful candidate experience at every step.

 - Run role kick-off meetings, define profiles, and align interview plans and scorecards to drive consistent, high-quality decisions.

 - Utilize internal hiring metrics and external market data to proactively propose recommendations and solutions to leaders.

 - Drive our diversity and inclusion strategy forward, with a heavy emphasis on sourcing and maintaining a well-balanced and diverse top-of-funnel candidate slate.

 - Build and nurture future talent pipelines for priority Japan GTM roles.

 - Establish trusted partnerships with the Japan leadership team to ensure Notion hires the right talent at the right time to achieve the company’s ambitious goals.

 - Ensure scalable, structured hiring plans for all roles with a strong sense of urgency and agency, while building repeatable processes and creative solutions that help the recruiting team scale for years to come.

 - Inspire candidates throughout all stages of the interview process, and build a customized close for each candidate.

 - Collaborate closely with peers and cross-functional partners, including Recruiting Coordinators, HRBPs/People Partners, Compensation Partners, Recruiting Operations, Executive Operations Partners, and Revenue Operations.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - You have at least 5 years of recruiting experience, preferably in a high-growth, in-house environment. Agency background is also welcome if you have full-cycle IT/SaaS sales hiring experience.

 - You have a track record of directly sourcing, qualifying, and closing exceptional GTM talent (e.g. Sales, Customer Success, Pre-Sales, Professional Services) based in Tokyo.

 - You can partner with, manage, and influence leadership stakeholders effectively. You have coached and guided hiring managers and interviewers through the full recruiting process.

 - You have built diverse candidate pipelines and helped hiring managers build inclusive teams.

 - You have outstanding communication and interpersonal skills in both English and Japanese (written and spoken fluency in both are required.)

 - You have a relentless focus on delivering a high-touch, high-quality recruiting experience, while respecting candidates’ and hiring managers’ time.

 - You can multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment.

 - You’re a team player with an optimistic attitude, and you’re comfortable wearing many hats in a smaller organization.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You have owned the end-to-end hiring process at global SaaS companies.

 - You have managed roles and candidates across regions outside of Japan.

 - You’re a Notion power user!




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Arbejdet ligger mandag til fredag, primært i dagtimerne og med enkelte vagter frem til kl. 20.00.

Hos os arbejder læger, sygeplejersker og øvrige faggrupper tæt sammen om sikre, effektive og trygge patientforløb. Vi er et mindre hospital med korte beslutningsveje, hvor der er mulighed for at få indflydelse på både hverdagen og den fortsatte udvikling af området.

Vi tilbyder

  • En fast stilling på 28–32 timer om ugen

  • Primært arbejde i dagtimerne på hverdage

  • Cirka 75 % anæstesi og 25 % opvågning

  • Elektive og veltilrettelagte patientforløb

  • Et fagligt stærkt og tværfagligt miljø

  • Grundig introduktion til hospitalet og vores arbejdsgange

  • Synlig ledelse og korte beslutningsveje

  • Løn efter DSR-overenskomst samt sundhedsforsikring

jobs.title: Vi søger Servicemedarbejder til rengøring i Helsingør
jobs.description:
Ansøgningsfrist: 23. oktober 2026

 

Er du serviceminded, ansvarsbevidst og kan du lide at arbejde selvstændigt? Vi søger lige nu servicemedarbejder til rengøring hos to af vores kunder i Helsingør.

 

Som vores nye kollega vil dine primære arbejdsopgaver være kontorrengøring og øvrige faciliteter. Erfaring med rengøring er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har en positiv indstilling, er omhyggelig og ønsker at levere en god service.

Din oplæring vil bestå af sidemandsoplæring, hvor du grundigt bliver introduceret til arbejdsopgaverne og de enkelte lokationer. Efter oplæringsperioden vil du arbejde selvstændigt med ansvar for dine daglige opgaver.

 

Arbejdstider

På den ene lokation udføres rengøringen uden for kundens normale arbejdstid. Arbejdet skal derfor enten være afsluttet inden kl. 08.00 eller påbegyndes efter kl. 16.00.

  • 4,75 timer ugentligt

  • Fleksibel arbejdstid inden for de angivne rammer

Den anden lokation er døgnåben, og rengøringen kan udføres på det tidspunkt, der passer bedst. Der er afsat 30 minutter dagligt, svarende til 2,5 timer ugentligt.

For at kunne arbejde på lokationen er det et krav, at du gennemfører kurset "Pas på banen". Kurset kan gennemføres på én dag og kræver, at du kan forstå dansk eller engelsk.

Kurset består af:

  • En online del på cirka 1 time

  • En fysisk undervisningsdag hos Banedanmark i Ringsted

 

Skab værdi med din service

Vi ønsker at levere den bedste service til vores kunder. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du er imødekommende, ansvarsfuld og fokuseret på kvalitet i dit arbejde.

Derudover ser vi gerne, at du:

  • Har erfaring med rengøring, gerne kontorrengøring, men det er ikke et krav

  • Er serviceminded, hjælpsom og positiv

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for egne opgaver

  • Er fleksibel og løsningsorienteret

  • Har sans for detaljen og leverer et højt kvalitetsniveau

  • Kan kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk

  • Er villig til at gennemføre "Pas på banen"-kurset

 

Vi tilbyder

  • Grundig oplæring og introduktion til opgaverne

  • Selvstændigt arbejde med fleksible arbejdstider

  • Arbejdstøj og nødvendige arbejdsredskaber

  • Mulighed for relevante kurser og kompetenceudvikling

  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på kvalitet, samarbejde og god service

 

Ansøgning

Send dit CV og eventuelt en kort ansøgning hurtigst muligt via linket "Ansøg nu" senest d. 23. oktober 2026. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Service Manager Nedzhati Nizamiev Hasanov på mail: nedzhati.hasanov@dk.issworld.com 

 

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.description:
Faglært/ufaglært smed/maskinoperatør søges til opstilling og kørsel med transportsneglemaskine.
Der findes kun én maskine til dette formål i Nordeuropa og du skal lære at betjene, opstille og fremstille sneglespiraler til vores egen produktion og salg.

Du vil blive oplært af folk med flere års erfaring og undervejs lære at svejse, bruge skærebrænder, vinkelsliber og flere andre smedemæssige opgaver. Det tager ca. 1-2 år at bliver rigtig dygtigt til at betjene maskinen og der vil være meget manuelt smede- og opstilling og vedligeholdelses arbejde, hvor du bliver sort på hænderne.

Hvem er du?

  • Du har tålmodighed og gåpåmod også selvom arbejdet driller og ikke lykkedes første gang. (Vigtigt!)

  • Du er ansvarsbevidst, struktureret og har en positiv indstilling til teamwork.

  • Du er klar på at arbejde i et lille sammensluttet team med erfarne og gode kollegaer, hvor der er mulighed for at få råd, hjælp og vejledning i forhold til dine opgaver og udarbejdelse af transportsnegle.

  • Arbejdet kan til tider kræve god fysik.

  • Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • Mulighed for at lære en helt speciel niché inden for smedefaget som kun få i verden er gode til.

  • Mulighed for gode lønvilkår som ufaglært.

  • En fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen med fast arbejdstid.

  • Løn der matcher dine kvalifikationer og erfaring.

  • En arbejdsplads, der vægter samarbejde og godt kollegaskab højt.

  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling og specialisering inden for transportsnegle.

  • Mulighed for at deltage i spændende fremtidige projekter og udvikling af maskiner inden for udarbejdelse af snegle.

Arbejdstider:
Mandag til onsdag kl. 7.00-15.30, torsdag 7.00-14.45, fredag 07.00-14.30

Om Arni Maskinfabrik.

Lille familievirksomhed med 8 ansatte placeret ved Eskilstrup på Falster. 
Vores speciale er Transportsnegle, udarbejdelse af sneglevindinger og profilvalsning.
Besøg gerne vores hjemmeside eller Facebook for at se eksempler på vores projekter.
https://arni.dk/
https://www.facebook.com/ArniMaskinfabrik

Virksomheden fyldte 90 år i 2025 og gennemgår i disse år en opdatering hvad angår lokaler og maskiner.

Send ansøgning og CV til Søren Lund på e-mail: sl@arni.dk
Vi holder løbende samtaler og ansætter når den vi finder den rette.
